content: Fact Check: Smriti Irani Did NOT Make Any Objectionable Comment on... A video has been doing the rounds on social media, claiming that Union Minister Smriti Irani called goddess Durga a ‘sex worker’.The video is being shared with a caption: “#মা_দূর্গা প্রসংগে সেদিনের #স্মৃতি_ইরানির কুৎশিত মন্তব্য ভুলে গেলে চলবে না বন্ধুগণ‼ স্মৃতি ইরানিকে #কে #কখন #কোন_অবস্থায় মা দূর্গা প্রসংগে কুৎসিত মন্তব্য করেছে যা স্মৃতি ইরানি ছাড়া আর কেউ জানে না‼” (English translation: Friends, don’t forget the ugly comment of #Smriti_Irani in the context of #Ma_Durga!! Smriti Irani #when #in #what_situation made ugly comments about Maa Durga, which no one else knows except Smriti Irani!!)In the viral video, she can be heard saying: “Durga Puja is the most controversial racial festival, where a fair-skinned beautiful goddess Durga is depicted brutally killing a dark-skinned native called Mahishasur. Mahishasur, a brave self-respecting leader, was tricked into marriage by Aryans. They hired a sex worker called Durga, who enticed Mahishasur into marriage and killed him after nine nights of honeymooning during sleep.”Here’s the link to the above video.FACT CHECKNewsMobile fact-checked the video, and found it to be deceptive.We ran a keyword search and found that the video is from 2016 when Smriti Irani was addressing the Lok Sabha. We found the original video uploaded by Bharatiya Janata Party on their official YouTube channel titled: “Smt. Smriti Irani’s speech in reply to debate on JNU and Rohith Vemula issues – 24.02.2016.”After listening to the entire video, it became evident that the viral clip is misleading.The viral clip has been taken from 31:50 minutes of the original video. In the video, then HRD Minister Smriti Irani is referring to a pamphlet posted in JNU commemorating “Mahishasura Martyrdom Day.”Here’s the transcript of the relevant clip (from 30:50 – 32:25): “What is Mahishasur Martyrdom Day, madam speaker? Our government has been accused. I miss today Sugata Bose and Saugata Roy in the House – champions of free speech because I want to know if they will discuss this particular topic which I am about to enunciate in the House, on the streets of Kolkata. I dare them this. Posted on October 4, 2014. A statement by the SC, ST and minority students of JNU. And what do they condemn? May my God forgive me for reading this.Durga puja is the most controversial racial festival, where a fair-skinned beautiful goddess Durga is depicted brutally killing a dark-skinned native called Mahishasur. Mahishasur, a brave self-respecting leader, was tricked into marriage by Aryans. They hired a sex worker called Durga, who enticed Mahishasur into marriage and killed him after nine nights of honeymooning during sleep.”The above information proves that Irani was actually reading out a pamphlet, and those were not her own words. Hence the viral clip is highly misleading.If you want to fact-check any story, WhatsApp it now on +91 11 7127 9799Your nameYour emailSubjectYour message (optional)ΔClick here for Latest News updates and viral videos on our AI-powered smart news

content: Fact Check: Did An Earthquake Destroy Georgia Guidestones In US? Here’s... Sharing videos and images of broken Georgia Guidestones in Elbert County of Georgia, US, people claim that an earthquake destroyed the granite monument.The Georgia Guidestones, which were carved with inscriptions in Spanish, Hebrew, Hindi, English, Swahili, Arabic, traditional Chinese, and Russian, were solid granite pillars that were constructed in 1980. After a nuclear war, the writing on the stones was intended to serve as “guides” for humans on how to save mankind.The video is shared on Facebook with a caption: “BREAKING: At 4 am this morning, one of the Georgia Guidestones collapsed and crumbled. Reports say it was an earthquake, but be not deceived — this is a sign from God intervening on our behalf. Down with the Globalists and the New World Order. CHRIST IS KING!”Here’s the link to the above post.People are also sharing images, claiming the same.FACT CHECKNewsMobile fact-checked the above claim, and found it to be MISLEADING.Doing a simple keyword search directed to several credible media news outlets that carried similar visuals stating, “A rural Georgia monument has been bombed, damaging one of four granite panels that some people dubbed ‘America’s Stonehenge'”. The Georgia Guidestones monument near Elberton was damaged by an explosive device, the Georgia Bureau of Investigation said. The bombing comes weeks after a Republican candidate for governor claimed that the Georgia Guidestones are satanic and called for their demolition.” This clearly means that an earthquake had no role to play in its destruction.The Wall Street Journal claimed that the monument was blasted on June 7, 2022. According to the report, which cited GBI, the remainder of the building was taken from the site and destroyed for safety concerns.We found two surveillance footage of the explosion uploaded by the GBI’s verified Twitter account. According to the footage that is now available, a vehicle was spotted departing the scene immediately after the explosion.(2/3) The videos show the explosion and a car leaving the scene shortly after the explosion. No one was injured. pic.twitter.com/8YNmEML9fW — GA Bureau of Investigation (@GBI_GA) July 6, 2022The agency also released a video showing an unknown individual setting off explosives at the location. They went on saying that the explosion had damaged the building and made it “unsafe for investigators to explore,” so they decided to completely destroy the monument.Additionally, we looked at the United States Geological Survey’s (USGS) website to see whether there had ever been any seismic activity in Georgia, and it turned out that there hadn’t been any quake recently.Thus, it is now clear that an explosion had destroyed Georgia Guidestones, and not an earthquake. So, the viral claim is misleading.If you want to fact-check any story, WhatsApp it now on +91 11 7127 979l9Your nameYour emailSubjectYour message (optional)ΔClick here for Latest News updates and viral videos n our AI-powered smart news

content: Fact Check: Altered Image Shared As Portrait of Ambedkar With Wife... An image is widely shared on social media, showing the portrait of Dr BR Ambedkar and his wife Savita Ambedkar on a bus. Sharing this image, social media users claim that Dr Ambedkar was honoured by putting a picture on the city bus in Columbia, US.The text embedded on the image reads: “कोलंबिया (अमेरिका) की सड़कों पर दौड़ती सिटी बस पर बाबा साहब का चित्र यह असली सम्मान है, अमेरिका आज भी बाबा साहब को अपना आदर्श मानता है। किंतु अपने यहाँ अधिकांश बहुजन भी बाबा साहब के मिशन से भटके हुये है। जागरुक हो। जय भीम।” (English translation: The picture of Baba Saheb on the city bus running on the streets of Columbia (US) is a real honour. America still considers Baba Saheb as its ideal. But most of the Bahujans here are deviated from the mission of Baba Saheb. Be aware, Jai Bheem)Here’s the link to the above post.FACT CHECKNewsMobile fact-checked the above claim, and found it to be MISLEADING.We did a keyword search, but could not find any recent credible media report that corroborated the viral claim.Doing a simple Reverse Image Search directed us to Wikimedia Commons website that carried the original image. The details suggest that this picture is of a tourist bus in Bath, Somerset, England. The image found on Wikimedia does not contain the poster of Dr Ambedkar. More such images of the bus can be seen here and here.Below is the comparison between the viral image and the original image.Searching further, we found the image of Dr Ambedkar and his wife published in a blog post in 2017.Thus, it is evident from the above information that an altered image is being shared as the image of Dr Ambedkar and his wife Savita Ambedkar put up on the US city bus.If you want to fact-check any story, WhatsApp it now on +91 11 7127 979l9Your nameYour emailSubjectYour message (optional)ΔClick here for Latest News updates and viral videos n our AI-powered smart news

content: Fact Check: The Viral Post Does NOT Show SC Judges Surya... A picture is being shared on social media with a claim that Supreme Court Judges Surya Kant and J.B. Pardiwala are having lunch with NDTV Founders Prannoy Roy, Radhika Roy and Communist Party of India leader Brinda Karat.A bench of Justices Surya Kant and J.B. Pardiwala on July 1, 2022, refused to entertain former Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) spokesperson Nupur Sharma’s petition to club the multiple FIRs against her for the controversial remarks against Prophet Mohammad. They said that Nupur Sharma’s statements were ‘single-handedly’ responsible for igniting ’emotions in the country’.The picture is being shared with the caption: “Rinita Mazumdar The 2 SC judges,#SuryaKant and #Pardiwala with the Naxal gang. U can see…. Pranab Roy is there.Then there is Radhika Roy. See with whom the Supreme court judges who passed verdict are having lunch with.”Here’s the link to the above post.FACT CHECKNewsMobile fact-checked the post, and found it to be false.We ran a keyword search and found that the same image was tweeted by N. Ram, Director of The Hindu Publishing Group, calling it a fake post. “How idiotic! The calibre of your disinformation is pathetic, beneath contempt,” he tweeted.Sharing the false post, he wrote: “How idiotic! Fact: The two persons you identify as Justices Surya Kant and JB Pardiwala of the Supreme Court of India are Tamil Nadu Finance Minister. Dr P Thiaga Rajan (PTR), and me, N Ram. And our lunch was at a restaurant in Ketti near Ooty. The calibre of your disinformation is pathetic, beneath contempt.“We also found the same image, shared by a social media handle of a community club in Tamil Nadu — MindEscapes, on July 3, 2022. “A Chef’s Table session with Finance Minister – Tamil Nadu, Mr. P. Thiagarajan, Dr. Prannoy Roy and Mrs. Radhika Roy, Mrs. Brinda Karat and Mr. Prakash Karat, Mrs. and Mr. N. Ram and Dipali Sikand. #ExperienceMindEscapes #ChefsTable #Nilgiris #GreatMindsMeet” the tweet reads.We also checked photos of Justice J.B. Pardiwala and Justice Surya Kant on the Supreme Court website where they look visibly different from the people in the picture.Hence, it is clear that the post in circulation is false.If you want to fact-check any story, WhatsApp it now on +91 11 7127 9799Your nameYour emailSubjectYour message (optional)ΔClick here for Latest News updates and viral videos on our AI-powered smart news

content: Fact Check: Staged Video Of Child Abduction Is From Egypt, NOT... A video is widely shared on social media, showing the person in burqa abducting a child in broad daylight from a busy street.A facebook user shared the video with the Hindi text: “हिन्दू सावधान और सचेत रहे क्या पता अगला शिकार आप या हम ही हो.. ये आप या आपके परिवार के साथ भी हो सकता है..अपने आसपास भी नजरें दौड़ाते रहिये कोई अनहोनी तो नहीं हो रही यदि ऐसा कुछ जो आपको आशंकित कर रहा है तो अनदेखा ना करिये मददगार बनिये..” (English translation: Hindus should be careful and alert, the next victim could be you or us… It can happen to you or your family also… Keep looking around you to see if something like this is happening, don’t ignore be helpful)Here’s the link to the above post.FACT CHECKWhen NewsMobile fact-checked the post, it was found to be scripted, and NOT from India.We extracted the keyframes of the video and put them through a Reverse Image Search. The search led us to Al Hadath, an Arabic news website, which had published a screenshot of the same video.The article, dated June 29, 2022, stated that it was a staged video, created by four teenagers in Egypt to gain views on social media. However, the video went viral creating panic in the community.We also found more articles related to the same incident. The articles can be read here and here.The reports also mentioned that after the video went viral in Egypt, the Ministry of Interior published a video on Facebook and Instagram on June 29, 2022, clarifying that the video was staged and NOT real.The post mentioned that the four people are residents of Sohag Governorate in Egypt, and the fabricated video was created with the motive of achieving a high financial return by increasing the viewership.Thus, it is clear that the viral video is staged, and NOT from India.If you want to fact-check any story, WhatsApp it now at +91 11 7127 9799Your nameYour emailSubjectYour message (optional)ΔClick here for the Latest News updates and viral videos on our AI-powered smart news

content: Fact Check: Teesta Setalvad Did Not Spit on Cops; Here’s the... A video is swiftly shared on social media, showing a woman spitting at police while taken into custody. And the video claims that the woman is Teesta Setalvad — a civil rights activist and journalist.The video is shared with a caption: “यह हैं देश की महान स्वयं सेविका श्रीमती तीस्ता सीतलवाड़। कितनी शालीन कितनी सौम्या! दूसरी तरफ हमारे पुलिस महिला की सहनशक्ति का बेजोड़ दृश्य भारतीय पुलिस गर्व के योग्य हैं।” (English translation: “This is the great social activist of the country, Mrs Teesta Setalvad. Indian police are worthy of pride.”)The link to the post can be seen here.FACT CHECKNewsMobile did the fact-check, and found it to be fake.On doing a Google Reverse Image Search with one of the keyframes of the viral video, we found the same video was uploaded by India Today on June 21, 2022. It was shared with a description: “Mahila Congress acting president Netta D’Souza on Tuesday caught on camera, spitting at security personnel while protesting against the Enforcement Directorate (ED) for questioning former Congress president Rahul Gandhi in the National Herald case”Newswire ANI had also tweeted the same video on June 21, 2022, with a caption: “Mahila Congress President Netta D’Souza spits at police personnel during a protest with party workers in Delhi against ED for questioning Congress leader Rahul Gandhi in the National Herald case.”Hence, we can ascertain that the woman in the viral video is not Teesta Setalavd but Mahila Congress president Netta D’Souza. content: Fact Check: Video of Karnataka Dam Overflowing Falsely Linked To Bangladesh... A video is being widely shared on social media, showing the Farakka dam in West Bengal is overflowing, and resulting in extensive flooding in neighbouring Bangladesh.About 18 km from Bangladesh’s northwest border, Farakka dam was constructed over the Ganges river in West Bengal. In June 2022, Bangladesh’s Sylhet area saw significant flooding due to unrelenting downpours, leaving more than four million people trapped.The video is shared on Facebook with a caption in Bengali language: “ভারতের ফারাক্কা বাধ এর 109 টি গেট দিয়ে পানি প্রবেশ করছে বাংলাদেশে। তিস্তা টিপাইমুখী সহ মোট ১১ টি পানির গেইট খুলে দিয়েছে ভারত সরকার। ডুবে যাওয়ার আশঙ্কা বেশ কয়েকটি জেলা। মহান আল্লাহ তায়ালা আমাদের এই বাংলাদেশকে ও দেশের সকলকে বন্যা কবল থেকে হেফাজত করুন। আমিন” (English translation: Water is entering Bangladesh through 109 gates of Farakka dam in India. The government of India has opened a total of 11 water gates, including Tista Tipaimukhi. Fear of drowning in several districts. The great Allah Ta’ala to this Bangladesh of ours, too. Protect everyone in the country from floods.)Here’s the link to the above post.FACT CHECKNewsMobile fact-checked the above claim, and found it to be MISLEADING.We extracted keyframes from the viral video using InVid Tool and performed a Reverse Image Search. We found a YouTube channel that carried the same viral video on August 11, 2019, with a caption: “Hemavthi Dam Gorur”.Taking a cue from this, we found that the Gorur Dam is located in the Hassan district of Karnataka, on Hemavathi river. The distance from the Farakka Barrage is over 2,300 km.Below is the comparison between the viral video and YouTube video.We also searched for the Gorur dam on Google Maps and the images correspond to the YouTube video. This clearly means the dam seen in the viral video is Gorur dam in Karnataka.Thus, it is evident from the above information that the viral claim is misleading.If you want to fact-check any story, WhatsApp it now on +91 11 7127 979l9Your nameYour emailSubjectYour message (optional)ΔClick here for Latest News updates and viral videos n our AI-powered smart news

content: Fact Check: Video of Cops Drinking Muddy Water Shared with Misleading... BJP’s national executive meet was held in Telangana’s capital Hyderabad on July 2-3, 2022. Against this backdrop, a video of police personnel drinking water from mud is being widely shared on social media, claiming that fresh water could not be provided to the staff who arrived at the national executive meet.The video is shared on Facebook with a caption in the Telugu language: “ఎమిరా మీవల్ల దేశానికి ఉపయోగం..!! బీజేపీ సభలో బందోబస్తుకు వచ్ఛిన సిబ్బందికి మంచినీళ్ళు ఇవ్వలేని పరిస్తితి, తు..మి.. బతుకు చెడ”(English translation: Emir, the country is useful because of you..!! The situation where drinking water was not given to the staff who came for the bond in BJP meeting. Life is a mess)Here’s the link to the above post.FACT CHECKNewsMobile fact-checked the above claim and found it to be MISLEADING.We did a keyword search, but could not find any credible media report that corroborated the viral claim. Had such an incident happened at BJP’s national executive meet, it would have been covered by the mainstream media.Using the InVid Tool, we extracted keyframes from the viral video and performed a Reverse Image Search. This directed us to the verified YouTube channel of 10TV News Telugu, which carried the longer version of the same viral video on July 4, 2022, with a caption: “Bhimavaram Police facing problems by water shortage”. Bhimavaram is a city in Andhra Pradesh.We also did a comparison between the police uniform seen in the viral video and the uniform of both Andhra Pradesh police and Telangana police. It is evident from the comparison (below) that the insignia seen in the viral video matches Andhra Pradesh police uniform.Searching further, we found that a 30-foot bronze monument of Alluri Sitaramaraj was unveiled by Prime Minister Narendra Modi in Andhra Pradesh as part of the 125th birth anniversary festivities on July 3, 2022. We also found a Telugu news article that reported the same event, stating that basic facilities were not provided to the police personnel who participated in this meeting. The article also reported that police even washed their hands in rainwater due to water scarcity.Thus, the video showing police personnel drinking water from mud is from Andhra Pradesh, and is not related to BJP’s recent national executive meet in Telangana. Therefore, the viral claim misleading.If you want to fact-check any story, WhatsApp it now on +91 11 7127 979l9Your nameYour emailSubjectYour message (optional)ΔClick here for Latest News updates and viral videos n our AI-powered smart news

content: Fact Check: Old Image From Pakistan Viral As Despicable State Of... An image showing some school students sitting in the mud is being widely shared on social media, claiming that this is the situation of government schools in India.The post is shared on Facebook with a caption in Hindi language: “अब #बताओ अपने #दिल में #इंसानियत रखने वालों..!! देश में 3,200 करोड़ की #मूर्ति, सेंट्रल विस्टा या मन्दिरों में अथाह #दान, प्रचारों के #पोस्टर जरुरी है/था…. या शिक्षा के लिए #विद्यालय.. जर्जर विद्यालय ढह नहीं जाए, इसलिये बच्चे भवन के बाहर कीचड़ जैसी मिट्टी में बैठे है। शर्मनाक है ये, सरकारी स्कूलों का ये हाल।” (English translation: Now #tell me those who have #humanity in your #heart..!! 3,200 crore #statue, Central Vista or temples in the country, unlimited #donation, publicity #posters are necessary…. Or #school for education. The shabby school will not collapse, so the children are sitting in the mud. This is shameful… this is the condition of government schools.)Here’s the link to the above post.FACT CHECKNewsMobile fact-checked the claim, and found it to be FALSE.Doing a simple Reverse Image Search directed us to a June 10, 2015 tweet that carried the same viral image. The text in Urdu can be translated into English as: “Mian Sahib has been ruling Punjab for thirty years, and the girls are getting an education on the metro bus”Searching further, we found the same image uploaded on a Pakistan-based website with the description that it is from a primary school for girls in Punjab, Pakistan.In 2016, media activist and president of the Pakistan Supreme Court Press Association, Abdul Khiayum Siddiqui, had also tweeted the same image stating that it was from a school in Pakistan.A school in Shujaabad District Multan pic.twitter.com/1QtW2VVXqh — Abdul Qayyum Siddiqui (@QayyumReports) March 23, 2016The same image was also tweeted in 2017 by a user stating that it was from Pakistan.Thus, it is clear that the viral image has been on the internet since 2015, that too, it is from Pakistan, NOT India.If you want to fact-check any story, WhatsApp it now on +91 11 7127 979l9Your nameYour emailSubjectYour message (optional)ΔClick here for Latest News updates and viral videos n our AI-powered smart news

content: Fact Check: Morphed Picture of Draupadi Murmu with RSS Chief Bhagwat... An image has gone viral on social media, in which the National Democratic Alliance’s (NDA) presidential candidate, Draupadi Murmu, is seen along with the Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) chief, Mohan Bhagwat. The image is shared with a caption suggesting that Murmu went to meet Bhagwat.The image is shared with a caption that reads: “ബിജെപിയുടെ രാഷ്ട്രപതി സ്ഥാനാർത്ഥി ദ്രൗപതി മുർമു നാഗ്പൂരിലെ ആർഎസ്എസ് ആസ്ഥാനത്ത് മോഹൻ ഭഗവതിനെ സന്ദർശിച്ചു! അവർ ഒരു റബ്ബർ സ്റ്റാമ്പ് മാത്രമായിരിക്കുമെന്നും സ്വതന്ത്രമായി പ്രവർത്തിക്കാൻ കഴിയില്ലെന്നും എന്ന കാര്യത്തിൽ സംശയമുണ്ടോ?” (English translation: “BJP’s presidential candidate Draupadi Murmuvisits Mohan Bhagwat at RSS headquarters in Nagpur! Any doubt that they will just bea rubber stamp and cannot function independently?”)The link to the post can be seen here.FACT CHECKNewsMobile did the fact-check, and found it to be fake.On doing a Google Reverse Image Search, we found the original image uploaded by Newsroom Post on March 11, 2022.The post reads: “Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh’s (RSS) annual three-day Akhil Bharatiya Pratinidhi Sabha, which will deliberate on various issues, including expansion of the organisation, began in Ahmedabad on March 11, 2022”In this image, Mohan Bhagwat appears on the right side of the frame. We cannot see Murmu in this image.Also, we found a BBC report published on June 23, 2022, featuring Murmu wearing the same sky blue saree with a mask and white band on her hand. However, in this image, Murmu is welcoming Jharkhand’s Chief Minister Hemant Soren.Hence, we can ascertain that the viral image is made by merging two images and the viral image is morphed.If you want to fact-check any story, WhatsApp it now on +91 11 7127 9799Your nameYour emailSubjectYour message (optional)ΔClick here for Latest News updates and viral videos on our AI-powered smart news

content: Fact Check: ‘Pak Zindabad’ Slogans Were Not Raised In MP’s Katni;... A video has surfaced on the internet showing a crowd raising slogans. It has been claimed that the people in the video were raising slogans ‘Pakistan Zindabad’ (long live Pakistan) in Katni district of Madhya Pradesh, in support of the winning sarpanch candidate.The above post can be seen here.Several mainstream media outlets carried the video with the same claim.FACT CHECKNewsMobile fact-checked the above video, and found that the claim is false.On carefully listening to the slogans, we noted that people were actually saying ‘Jeet Gaya Bhai Jeet Gaya… Wajid Bhai Jeet Gaya’ and ‘Wajid Bhai Zindabad’.In the above slow-motion version of the video, it is clear that there was no mention of Pakistan.Shaikh Shahid Wajid (Wajid Bhai) is the husband of winning panchayat poll candidate Rahisha Bagam, and the slogans were being raised in support of her husband.Meanwhile, we came across a video byte on Twitter, dated July 3, 2022, by @KashifKakvi, in which Shaikh Shahid Wajid refuted the claims of ‘Pakistan Zindabad’ slogans being raised outside his residence.Local police have also launched an investigation into the matter.In conclusion, the above findings establish that the video in question is being circulated with a false claim and no ‘Pakistan Zindabad’ slogans were raised.If you want to fact-check any story, WhatsApp it now on +91 11 7127 9799Your nameYour emailSubjectYour message (optional)ΔClick here for Latest News updates and viral videos on our AI-powered smart news

content: Fact Check: This Viral Video Doesn’t Have Any Link with PM... Prime Minister Narendra Modi addressed a massive gathering in Hyderabad after a two-day National Executive Meeting of the Bharatiya Janata Party concluded on July 3, 2022.In the above context, a video is circulating on social media, where BJP workers are seen distributing alcohol. The video is shared with a caption hinting that it is from the same event.The video is shared with a caption that reads: “वाह मोदी जी, आपकी पार्टी ने तो तेलंगाना को भी गोवा बना दिया! क्या ऐश है! तेलंगाना मे भाजपा की दारू पार्टी” (English translation: Waah Modi Ji Waah! Your party has turned Telangana into Goa. What enjoyment! BJP’s alcohol party in Telangana.”)The link to the post can be seen here.FACT CHECKNewsMobile did the fact-check, and found it to be misleading.On doing a Google Reverse Image Search, we found the same video uploaded by Congress on December 20, 2021, with a caption: alcohol was distributed at a BJP rally in Uttar Pradesh.We also found that the viral video was published by Dainik Jagran in December with a caption, claiming that Congress tweeted a video alleging BJP’s liquor distribution at a rally. However, the report warns that the website cannot verify the source of the video.UP Tak also shared the video on December 21, 2021, and credited UP Congress’s Twitter handle. They, too, warned against the authenticity of the video.Hence, we can ascertain that the viral video is old and has no relation to BJP’s recent rally in Hyderabad.If you want to fact-check any story, WhatsApp it now on +91 11 7127 9799Your nameYour emailSubjectYour message (optional)ΔClick here for Latest News updates and viral videos on our AI-powered smart news

content: Fact Check: Old Video of Journalist Questioning Amit Shah Resurfaces As... A video of a journalist has surfaced on social media, in which he can be seen questioning Union Home Minister Amit Shah: why the Centre did not help financially when there were floods in Telangana.The video is being shared in the backdrop of Amit Shah’s recent Hyderabad visit for the BJP’s National Executive Meeting.Facebook users are sharing the video with a caption: “उत्तर भारत के किसी भी पत्रकार के गांव में इतना दम नहीं है कि वो अमित शाह से इस तरह का कड़क सवाल कर दे !…..👇 सीधी बात , नो बकवास #तेलंगाना” (English translation: No journalist of north India has enough courage to ask such a tough question to Amit Shah!…👇 Straight talk, no nonsense #Telangana)The above post can be seen here.FACT CHECKNewsMobile fact-checked the post, and found that the video is old.In the above video, we could see the logo of V6. Based on this, we ran a keyword search and scanned through their YouTube channel. We traced a longer version of the video — shared on V6 News Telugu YouTube Channel on November 29, 2020 — with a title: “Amit Shah face-to-face over Hyderabad floods, GHMC Elections 2020 | Exclusive | V6 News.”The viral clip can be seen at 0:41 seconds. In the video, replying to journalists, Amit Shah said: “We have given maximum amount of money to Hyderabad. But I want to say that houses of seven lakh people were flooded, but where were Owaisi and KCR? Our party workers, ministers and MPs were amongst the people.”We also found another video with live streaming of Amit Shah’s Road Show. This video clip can be heard at time code 4 hours 15 minutes and 36 seconds.Thus, it is now clear that the video is quite old and resurfaced recently.If you want to fact-check any story, WhatsApp it now on +91 11 7127 9799Your nameYour emailSubjectYour message (optional)ΔClick here for Latest News updates and viral videos on our AI-powered smart news

content: Fact Check: Did PM Modi Refer Himself As ‘Child of a... A video of Prime Minister Narendra Modi is circulating on social media, where he can be heard saying that ‘he is the child of a Pathan’.“I am the son of a Pathan. I speak truth, and my actions are true,” he can be heard saying in Hindi.Here’s the link to the above post.FACT CHECKNewsMobile fact-checked the post, and found it to be misleading.Running a keyword search, we found a report by NDTV, dated February 23, 2019. The title of the video reads: On Pulwama, PM Modi’s Dare for Imran Khan, “Son of a Pathan”.In the viral video, he is referring to former Pakistan Prime Minister Imran Khan. It can be seen at 1:26 minutes of the report.We also found the original video on YouTube channel of the Bharatiya Janata Party. It was streamed live on February 23, 2019, when he was addressing a public meeting in Tonk, Rajasthan.In the original video, it can be heard at 59:45 minutes. PM Modi can be heard saying that when Imran Khan came to power in Pakistan, as per protocol he called and congratulated him. During the conversation, Imran khan said that he is the son of a Pathan.Referring to Imran Khan, Modi had said: “And he [Imran Khan] told me one more thing, that, ‘Modi Ji, I am the child of a Pathan. I speak truth, and work with honesty’.”Thus, it is clear that a viral clip has been taken out of context and is being shared with misleading claims.If you want to fact-check any story, WhatsApp it now on +91 11 7127 9799Your nameYour emailSubjectYour message (optional)ΔClick here for Latest News updates and viral videos on our AI-powered smart news

content: Fact Check: Staged ‘Awareness’ Video On Child Kidnapping Viral As Real... A video showing abduction of kids is being circulated on social media, claiming that a gang is involved in kidnapping children and selling their organs.The video was shared with a caption: “School കുട്ടികളെ തട്ടി കൊണ്ട് പോയി അവയങ്ങൾ എടുത്ത് വിലപ്പന നടത്തുന്ന സംഘം” (English translation: A gangkidnaps schoolchildren and sells their organs)Here’s the link to the above post.FACT CHECKWhen NewsMobile fact-checked the post, it was found to be scripted.On watching the video carefully, we found a disclaimer at 00:30 seconds, stating that the video is NOT real. The text reads: “Please read the video disclaimer carefully. This is not a real incident.”At 1:28 minutes of the video, we found the full disclaimer which stated, “Disclaimer This video is a complete fiction, all the events in the video are scripted and made for awareness purpose, it does not promote any kind of activity or defame any kind of ritual. This video has nothing to do with any real incident. Note – This is not a true incident, all the characters/persons shown in the video are playing their roles.”Earlier also, NewsMobile had fact-checked similar scripted videos that were being shared as real incidents. Check here, here and here.https://newsmobile.in/articles/2021/12/30/fact-check-educational-video-showing-man-attempting-to-kidnap-a-school-girl-shared-as-real-incident/Thus, it is evident from the above information that the viral claim is false.If you want to fact-check any story, WhatsApp it now on +91 11 7127 9799Your nameYour emailSubjectYour message (optional)ΔClick here for Latest News updates and viral videos on our AI-powered smart news

content: Fact Check: Picture of Spilled Cash on Chinese Hospital Floor Resurfaces... A picture is widely being shared on social media, showing huge cash on the floor with an empty bag and people around it.The picture claims that it is from China’s Henan Hospital, where a cancer patient came to the doctor with a bag full of notes, and asked him to save her life. After the doctor informed her that nothing can be done, she threw the cash all over the hospital.The caption in Hindi reads: “ये तस्वीर चायनीज़ हेनन हॉस्पिटल में ली गई है जिसमें एक कैंसर की मरीज नोटों से भरा बैग लेकर डॉक्टर के पास आई और उसने डॉक्टर से कहा- मेरी जिंदगी बचाएँ। मेरे पास और भी बहुत दौलत है तुम्हें देने के लिए लेकिन जब डॉक्टर ने बताया- अब उसका इलाज मुमकिन नहीं है क्योंकि उसका कैंसर लास्ट स्टेज पर है और अब डाक्टर्स उसकी जिंदगी नहीं बचा सकते। तो वह बहुत गुस्सा हुई और पागलों की तरह चीखते हुए पूरे हॉस्पिटल के बरामदे में नोटों को फेंकती गई और बोलती रही- “क्या फ़ायदा इस दौलत का जो मेरी जान नहीं बचा सकती।” क्या फ़ायदा इतना अमीर होने का, ये दौलत मुझे सेहत नहीं दे सकती। ये दौलत जिंदगी नहीं दे सकती। इसलिए दोस्तों भाग-दौड़ वाली इस ज़िन्दगी में सिर्फ पैसे कमाने में व्यस्त ना रहे,अपने स्वास्थ्य,अपने परिवार और मित्रो के साथ देश धर्म के लिये समय निकाल लिया करो,ये जीवन दोबारा नही मिलेगा रुपयों का ढेर कुछ काम नही आएगा,,इस लिए आज से ही अपने स्वास्थ और अपनो का ध्यान रखो”(English translation: This picture was taken in the Chinese Henan Hospital, where a cancer patient came to the doctor with a bag full of notes, and asked to save her life. I have more money to give you, she said. But when the doctor said the treatment was not possible, because the cancer was in the last stage, she got very angry and screamed like crazy. Then she threw notes on the whole hospital verandah, saying: “What is the use of this wealth, which cannot save my life? What is the use of being so rich when this wealth cannot give me health? This wealth cannot give life. So, friends, in this run-of-the-mill life, don’t be busy just earning money, take out time for your health, country, religion, time for your family and friends. This life will not be available again, and money will not be of any use. So, take care of your health and your loved ones from today itself)The above post can be seen here.FACT CHECKNewsMobile fact-checked the above claim attached with the picture, and found it to be false.On putting the picture through Reverse Image Search, we came across several articles from 2016, describing the same story. However, we did not find any authentic source to corroborate the viral claim.We also came across a news article in ETtoday, dated July 5, 2014 — a Chinese media outlet — which carried the same picture. According to the report, the picture in question was originally shared by Doctor Niu on the Chinese social media website Weibo.The report suggested that a man came to see his girlfriend, who is a nurse, at the Harbin hospital, and an argument took place between the two. Finally, the young man opened the bag and threw away all the money. The security personnel arrived to calm down the scene, but this video went viral on social media.Since Weibo is banned in India 2020 onwards, NewsMobile cannot independently access and verify the original post.Hence, it is certain that the picture in question is quite old, and has resurfaced with misleading claims.If you want to fact-check any story, WhatsApp it now on +91 11 7127 9799Your nameYour emailSubjectYour message (optional)ΔClick here for Latest News updates and viral videos on our AI-powered smart news

content: Fact Check: Zee News Editor-in-Chief & CEO Sudhir Chaudhary Has Resigned,... A post has surfaced on the internet linking Indian journalist and anchor Sudhir Chaudhary, who was recently fired from Zee News channel.The post with with a caption in Hindi reads: “यही एक बंदा था जो गरीबी से लेकर बेरोजगारी तक के फायदे बताता था अब पता नहीं कौन बताएगा…??? सुधीर चौधरी को ZEE NEWS ने निकाला” (English translation: This was the person who used to tell the benefits of poverty to unemployment, now I don’t know who will tell…??? Sudhir Chaudhary was removed by ZEE NEWS)The above post can be seen here.FACT CHECKNewsMobile fact-checked the above claim, and found it to be false.Going through Google search with relevant keywords, we came across several news reports suggesting that Chaudhary had resigned from his position to start his new media venture. Such reports can be seen here, here and here.In an e-mail, dated June 28, 2022, to Zee Media Corporation Chairman Subhash Chandra, Chaudhary has resigned from the position of CEO of ZMCL. “With a heavy heart, I am submitting my resignation with a request to relieve me as early as possible,” Chaudhary wrote in the e-mail.Chaudhary was serving as Editor-in-Chief and CEO of Zee News, WION, Zee Business, and Zee 24 Taas.Hence, it is clear that Sudhir Chaudhary resigned from Zee News and the claim of him being sacked is false.If you want to fact-check any story, WhatsApp it now on +91 11 7127 9799Your nameYour emailSubjectYour message (optional)ΔClick here for Latest News updates and viral videos on our AI-powered smart news

content: Fact Check: Image of Hanuman Jayanti Celebrations Falsely Linked to Udaipur... An image of a crowded street is being circulated online with a claim that it shows people in Rajasthan protesting against the murder of a tailor in Udaipur.Kanhaiya Lal, a tailor in Udaipur, was hacked to death at his shop by two people — Riaz Akhtari and Gos Mohammad — for allegedly supporting Nupur Sharma’s comments on the Prophet.Facebook users are sharing the image with the Bangla caption: “লক্ষ লক্ষ রাজস্থানী রাজপুত ভাইয়েরা পথে নেমেছে, পুরো রাজস্থান জুড়ে রেড এলার্ট জাড়ি।🔥 দাংগা পরিস্থিতি সৃষ্টি হয় সমগ্র রাজ্যে- ইন্টারনেট বন্ধ বলে কোন খবর আসছে না! উত্তর প্রদেশ,বিহারে ও হিন্দু সংগঠন পথে নামছে, সারা ভারতের হিন্দু ভাইরা পথে নামুক🔥কানাই লালের মৃত্যুকে বৃথা হতে দেওয়া যাবে না! 🔥 #Justice_for_kanhaiya_lal.” (English translation: Millions of Rajasthani Rajput brothers have taken to streets, with red alerts all over Rajasthan. Riots erupted in the entire state… there is no news since the internet is off! In Uttar Pradesh and Bihar, Hindu organisations are on the way, and the death of Kanhaiya Lal cannot be allowed to go in vain… Hindu brothers all over India are on the way! #Justice_for_kanhaiya_lal)Here’s the link to the above post.FACT CHECKWhen NewsMobile fact-checked the post, it was found to be false.We put the image through a Reverse Image Search and found the same picture in an article from 2015. The headline reads: “Telangana — Details about Hanuman Jayanti Shobha Yatra 2015.”In April 2013, a blog post had also carried the same image, claiming that it was of the Hanuman Jayanti celebration.In the picture, we could also see the board of ‘Jagdamba Boutique Ladies Hosiery’, located in Begum Bazar, Hyderabad.Thus, we can ascertain that the viral image is quite old and from Hyderabad, NOT Rajasthan.If you want to fact-check any story, WhatsApp it now on +91 11 7127 9799Your nameYour emailSubjectYour message (optional)ΔClick here for Latest News updates and viral videos on our AI-powered smart news

content: Fact Check: Old Video Of Madurai’s Chithirai Festival Viral As 2022... A video of a huge crowd is being shared on social media with a claim that it was shot during the recent Jagannath Rath Yatra in Puri.It is being shared with the caption: “सनातन क्या है जानने के लिए एक उदहारण के तौर पर इस वीडियो क्लिप को देखे श्रद्धा क्या होती है? अनुशासन क्या होता है? देखना चाहेंगे? तो देखिए जगन्नाथ जी की रथ यात्रा का यह वीडियो क्लिप। करोड़ों लोग एक साथ, एक लय में चलते हुए! कोई कुछ भी कहे, लेकिन अगर सत्य कहीं है, सहनशीलता कहीं है, अनुशासन कहीं है, दृढ़ता कहीं है, भक्ति कहीं है, शक्ति कहीं है तो वह सनातनियों में ही है… अहा! मंत्रों की यह पवित्र ध्वनि, यह दुर्लभ दृश्य। कोई मंत्रमुग्ध हुए बिना रहे भी तो कैसे रहे जयतु सत्य सनातन संस्कृति”(English translation: To know what is Sanatan, watch this video clip as an example. What is faith? What is discipline? Would like to see it? So watch this video clip of Jagannath ji‘s Rath Yatra. Millions of people moving in unison, together! Whatever one may say, if there is truth, tolerance and discipline somewhere, if there is perseverance, devotion and strength somewhere, then it is only in the Sanatanis… Aha! This sacred sound of mantras, this rare sight.. Jayatu Satya Sanatan Sanskruti)Here’s the link to the above post.FACT CHECKNewsMobile fact-checked the video, and found it to be misleading.We extracted keyframes of the video and put them through a Reverse Image Search. The search led us to the same video uploaded on YouTube on October 11, 2018. The title of the video in English translation was: “Where is this sea of people..! This is your Madhura Meenakshi Ammavari Rath Yatra in our Madurai.”The same video also had been shared on YouTube on May 8, 2017, with a caption: “Chithirai Festiv — Car No 2, 2017.”Based on this, we found that Chithirai Festival — known as Chithirai Thiruvizha, Meenakshi Kalyanam or Meenakshi Thirukalyanam — is celebrated for 15 days, during the month of April, in Madurai in a grand manner.According to the Tamil calendar, Chithirai is the first month of the year and on the full moon day of this month, Madurai celebrates Chithirai festival.We found pictures of celebrations from different years, where the same rath can be seen. Read the articles here, here and here.Thus, we can ascertain that the video is of the Chithirai Festival in Madurai, and has been on the internet since long time.However, the video of the 2022 Rath Yatra of Lord Jagannath can be seen here, where the Rath is evidently different.Hence, based on the above facts, it can be concluded that the video is being shared with a misleading claim.If you want to fact-check any story, WhatsApp it now on +91 11 7127 9799Your nameYour emailSubjectYour message (optional)ΔClick here for Latest News updates and viral videos on our AI-powered smart news

content: Fact Check: Old Video Of A Councillor Taken Hostage Shared With... A video — showing a man tied to a chair on a flooded street — is being circulated online, with a claim that this is how people treated a Municipal Councillor who never visited the locality after being elected.The video is shared with a caption: “पार्षद बनने के बाद जो पार्षद वार्ड देखने नहीं आए उसके साथ आप ऐसा कर सकते हैं महाराणा प्रताप चौक” (English translation: After becoming a councillor, if a person does not come to see the ward, then you can also do this to him)Here’s the link to the above post.FACT CHECKNewsMobile fact-checked the post, and found it to be misleading.Running a search, we found multiple media reports from November 2020. According to a report by NDTV, people in Varanasi took their own Councillor hostage after getting fed up with the administrative system due to sewer waterlogging.The report mentioned that the Councillor was tied to a chair for several hours, and kept sitting in the middle of the same sewer water.Navbharat Time had also reported that the sewer water was flowing in the streets for four months. When the local people got tired of complaining, they took the Councillor — who was roaming on the streets — hostage and made him sit in the middle of the flooded street. The report identified the man as Tufail Ansari.News 18 had also covered the same incident in November 2020. However, none of the reports mentioned that the Councillor had not visited the locality after being elected.Thus, based on the above information, it is clear that a video of an old incident is being shared with a misleading claim.If you want to fact-check any story, WhatsApp it now on +91 11 7127 9799Your nameYour emailSubjectYour message (optional)ΔClick here for Latest News updates and viral videos on our AI-powered smart news

content: Fact Check: Viral Landslide Video Is NOT From Maharashtra’s Rajapur FACT CHECKNewsMobile did the fact-check, and found it to be false.On doing a Google Reverse Image Search with one of the screenshots, we found that the same video was uploaded by a YouTube channel on June 23, 2022, with a caption: “Footage of a landslide at Silchar — Mizoram Highway (NH 306).”Another YouTube channel, Current Affairs, also uploaded the video, claiming that it is a landslide at Silchar — Mizoram Highway (NH-306)Tak News also claims that the video is of Assam landslide. But we did not find any media reports of a landslide in Assam. A local reporter from Maharashtra also confirmed that no landslide took place at Rajapur.Though NewsMobile independently cannot confirm the origin of the video, it is certain that the video is not from Maharashtra’s Rajapur.

content: Fact Check: PM Modi Presented With Gold Necklace In UAE Recently?... Following Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s brief stopover at Abu Dhabi on his return from Munich on June 28, 2022, a video has started making the rounds on social media with a claim that the Sultan of Arab gifted PM Modi a gold necklace of 170 tolas (1.98kgs).The video is being shared with the caption: “अरब के सुल्तान ने मा. प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी जी को 170 तोले सोने का हार भेंट किया यह है आज के भारत का सम्मान और आज के भारत की शक्ति..” (English translation: The Sultan of Arabia presented a gold necklace of 170 tolas to Prime Minister Narendra Modi… this is the honour of today’s India and the power of today’s India)Here’s the link to the above post.FACT CHECKNewsMobile fact-checked the post, and found the claim to be misleading.We ran a keyword search on YouTube and found a similar video uploaded by Hindustan Times, on August 24, 2019. The title of the video reads: “PM Modi conferred with UAE’s highest civilian award by Crown Prince”The description of the video reads: “Prime Minister Narendra Modi was conferred the Order of Zayed — UAE’s highest civilian award — by Crown Prince Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan, on Saturday [August 24, 2019]. PM Modi reached Abu Dhabi from Paris on Friday [August 23, 2019], on the second leg of his three-nation tour to France, UAE and Bahrain. In Abu Dhabi, the two leaders discussed measures to improve trade and cultural ties between India and the UAE. PM Modi and Crown Prince Al Nahyan also discussed the “full spectrum of the strong India-UAE partnership”.The same video was also uploaded by NDTV and The Economic Times in August 2019.According to a report by The Hindu Business Line, “Prime Minister Modi was honoured with the ‘Order of Zayed’ as a mark of appreciation for his efforts to boost bilateral ties between the two nations.”The same was also tweeted by the official Twitter handle of PM Modi on August 24, 2019. The pictures were shared with the caption: “Humbled to be conferred the ‘Order of Zayed’ a short while ago. More than an individual, this award is for India’s cultural ethos and is dedicated to 130-crore Indians. I thank the UAE government for this honour.”Thus, it can be concluded that an old video is being shared with a misleading claim.If you want to fact-check any story, WhatsApp it now on +91 11 7127 9799Your nameYour emailSubjectYour message (optional)ΔClick here for Latest News updates and viral videos on our AI-powered smart news

content: Fact Check: Video of Flooded Roads In Haryana’s Rohtak Falsely Shared... On the first day of the monsoon this year — June 30 — Delhi got more than half the amount of rain that it typically gets during the whole month of July. The IMD predicts that Delhi will get moderate rain throughout next week.Against this backdrop, a video is widely shared on social media in which people can be seen pushing a car on a flooded road. It is claimed that this is the aftermath of a day’s incessant rain in Delhi.The video is shared on Facebook with a Hindi caption: “कितनी खूबसूरत है ये दिल्ली, कितनी खूबसूरत है यहाँ की सड़के धन्यवाद अरविंद केजरीवाल” (English translation: How beautiful is Delhi, how beautiful are the roads here…. Thank you Arvind Kejriwal)Here’s the link to the above post.FACT CHECKNewsMobile fact-checked the above claim, and found it to be MISLEADING.We did a keyword search, but could not find any credible media article that reported flooding of this intensity in Delhi during the recent rain.We then carefully checked the video and saw that the initial letter of the car’s number plate reads ‘H’ not ‘DL’.Also, towards the end of the video, we saw ‘Chopra Electricals’ written on one of the shut shops. Taking this cue, we ran a Google search with ‘Chopra Electricals’ shops in either Haryana or Himachal. The top result showed a shop in Haryana’s Rohtak.We searched further and found images in Google Maps that matched the viral video. Thus, it can be concluded that the video is from the Rohtak area of Haryana.We also found that the AAP Haryana had tweeted a similar video from the same neighbourhood on July 1, 2022, with the caption: “In Rohtak, Haryana, the whole city was submerged in a boat-like situation. Government’s inaction came out openly in the first rain of the season in whole of Haryana. The work of development gets lost due to corruption.”Thus, it is evident from the above information that the viral claim is misleading.If you want to fact-check any story, WhatsApp it now on +91 11 7127 979l9Your nameYour emailSubjectYour message (optional)ΔClick here for Latest News updates and viral videos n our AI-powered smart news

content: Fact Check: Goldy Brar Was Not Thrashed In Canada; Here’s The... Punjabi singer Sidhu Moose Wala was assassinated on May 29, 2022. After his death, Goldy Brar, a Canada-based gangster, took responsibility for killing Moose Wala. In the above context, a video has gone viral on social media, showing some people beating a man. content: Fact Check: This ‘Sinkhole-in-a-Pond’ Video Is from Brazil, NOT Assam A video of a sinkhole in the middle of a huge pond is being circulated online with a claim that it is from Assam.Facebook users are sharing the video with a caption: “নগাঁৱৰ সুতিৰপাৰ কাটাখাল ৰৌমাৰী বিলৰ আজৱ দৃশ্য।” (English translation: Scene from ROUMARI lake in Sutishal of Katakhal in Nagaon)Here’s the link to the above post.FACT CHECKWhen NewsMobile fact-checked the post, it was found to be false.On putting the keyframes from the video through Reverse Image Search, we found the same video uploaded on YouTube in July 2018. The translated title of the video reads: “Bolonha lake overflowing.”We also found similar videos of Bolonha lake taken from different angles. The video was geotagged to the Utinga State Park in Pará, Brazil.A few blog posts and articles also confirmed that the video was, indeed, from Utinga State Park in Brazil. They can be read here and here.Hence, it is clear that the video is not from Assam but Brazil.If you want to fact-check any story, WhatsApp it now on +91 11 7127 9799Your nameYour emailSubjectYour message (optional)ΔClick here for Latest News updates and viral videos on our AI-powered smart news

content: Fact Check: Rahul Gandhi’s Comment In Wayanad Falsely Linked To Udaipur... A report by Indian news channel Zee News is being shared on social media with a claim that Congress leader Rahul Gandhi said that the accused in the Udaipur murder case were ‘kids’.The video is being shared with the caption: “कन्हैया लाल के हत्यारे मासूम बच्चे हैं मैं उनपर बिल्कुल गुस्सा नहीं हूँ , उन्हें माफ कर दो, – राहुल गांधी” (English translation: Kanhaiya Lal’s killers are innocent children, I am not angry at them at all, forgive them — Rahul Gandhi)Here’s the link to the above post.FACT CHECKNewsMObile fact-checked the post, and found it to be false.We ran a keyword search and found a report — by The Indian Express — that Rahul Gandhi’s office in Wayanad, Kerala, was vandalised by CPI(M)’s student wing SFI. The report also mentioned that the Congress leader visited his vandalised office on July 1, 2022, and said the incident was unfortunate but he did not have any hostility or anger over it.“This is my office. But before being my office, this is the office of Wayanad people. It is quite unfortunate that the office has been attacked. Violence will never resolve problems. It is not good that they have acted in an irresponsible manner. I don’t have any anger or hostility towards them. They are kids and they don’t understand the consequences of their act,” Indian Express quoted Rahul Gandhi as saying.We also found the similar video on YouTube channel of ANI. The video was uploaded on July 1, 2022, with the title: “Rahul Gandhi terms violence in office ‘unfortunate’, says don’t have hostility towards perpetrators.”On searching further, we found that Zee News had issued an apology after the news channel misleadingly aired unrelated remarks by Rahul Gandhi as his statement on the Udaipur killing.Shocking that a leading TV channel, made a gaffe that spread across India like a wildfire on a sensitive burning #Udaipur row. The channel has apologised now. But original clip has already misled lakhs including some of us. Clip carried @RahulGandhi’s remarks on different issue pic.twitter.com/kkXhwGm1YT — Rohan Dua (@rohanduaT02) July 2, 2022Hence, it is clear that the video is being shared with a false claim.If you want to fact-check any story, WhatsApp it now on +91 11 7127 9799Your nameYour emailSubjectYour message (optional)ΔClick here for Latest News updates and viral videos on our AI-powered smart news

content: Fact Check: Viral Post On SC Justice Pardiwala Is Misleading The Supreme Court on July 1, 2022, refused to entertain former Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) spokesperson Nupur Sharma’s petition to club multiple FIRs against her for controversial remarks against Prophet Mohammad. A bench of justices Surya Kant and JB Pardiwala said that Sharma’s statements were ‘single-handedly’ responsible for igniting ’emotions in the country’.Following this, a picture of a judge with Congress leader Sonia Gandhi started making the rounds on social media with a claim that Judge Pardiwala was an MLA from the Congress party in 1989-90.The picture is being shred with the caption: “कन्हैयालाल की हत्याके लिए नुपुर शर्मा जिम्मेदार – सुप्रीम कोर्ट जज जे.बी पारदीवाला (कांग्रेस MLA 1989-90) कुछ समझें ?” (English Translation: Nupur Sharma responsible for Kanhaiyalal’s murder — Supreme Court Judge J.B Pardiwala (Congress MLA 1989-90) understand something?)Here’s the link to the above post.FACT CHECKWhen NewsMobile fact-checked the post, it was found to be false.We fact-checked the posts in two parts:1. Who is the man in the picture?Firstly, we put the image through a Reverse Image Search and found a blog post from 2007 featuring the same image. According to the post, the image is of former CJI KG Balakrishnan with Sonia Gandhi.On searching further, we found another picture of Sonia Gandhi at the swearing-in ceremony of KG Balakrishnan (January 2007), where she can be seen in the same attire.There was one more picture of KG Balakrishnan with former President of India APJ Abdul Kalam, which was also taken at the same ceremony. In the background, Sonia Gandhi was visible.So, it can be concluded here that the man in the picture is KG Balakrishnan and not Justice Pardiwala;2. Was Justice Pardiwala a Congress MLA?We then ran a keyword search and found the profile of Justice JB Pardiwala, available on the website of the Supreme Court.As per the profile, he was born on August 12, 1965, in Mumbai. After completing his law degree from KM Mulji Law College, Valsad, in 1988, Pardiwala started practice at Valsad in January 1989, and then shifted to Gujarat High Court, Ahmedabad, in September 1990.It was also mentioned that his father, Burjor Cawasji Pardiwala, was the Speaker of the 7th Gujarat Legislative Assembly — from December 1989 to March 1990. The same information was available on the Gujarat Assembly website.Moreover, we found that Burjor Cawasji Pardiwala had won the 1985 Gujarat Assembly elections as a candidate of the Congress Party from Bulsar.Hence, it is clear that the claim in the viral post is false.If you want to fact-check any story, WhatsApp it now on +91 11 7127 9799Your nameYour emailSubjectYour message (optional)ΔClick here for Latest News updates and viral videos on our AI-powered smart news

content: Fact Check: Quote About Reservation Erroneously Attributed to BR Ambedkar As BJP-led NDA announced Draupadi Murmu its candidate for the upcoming presidential elections, a quote attributed to Dr BR Ambedkar has started making the rounds on social media. The quote suggests that whenever a tribal woman will become the President of India, the reservation should be abolished from the nation.The quote in Hindi reads: “जिस दिन कोई आदिवासी महिला भारत के सर्वोच्च पद ‘राष्ट्रपति’ तक पहुंच जाएगी। देश में आरक्षण खत्म कर दिया जाना चाहिए। डॉ. भीमराव रामजी अंबेडकर” (English translation: The day a tribal woman reaches the highest post of ‘President’ of India, reservation should be abolished in the country. Dr Bhimrao Ramji Ambedkar)The above post can be seen here.FACT CHECKNewsMobile fact-checked the above claim, and found it to be false.We ran a keyword search, but could not find any reliable report/transcript supporting the above claim. We also checked the official website of Lok Sabha, but failed to find any statement by BR Ambedkar along the lines of the quote in question. These transcripts can be seen here, here, here and here.Hence, we can conclude that the quote in question has been falsely attributed to Dr BR Ambedkar.If you want to fact-check any story, WhatsApp it now on +91 11 7127 9799Your nameYour emailSubjectYour message (optional)ΔClick here for Latest News updates and viral videos on our AI-powered smart news

content: Fact Check: Are Kashmiris Enjoying Free Electricity Since Independence? Here’s The... In Jammu and Kashmir, there were protests against the installation of smart meters. In that context, many social media users are sharing a post, claiming that Kashmiris have been using free-of-cost electricity since India’s Independence. The caption hints that they are protesting against the installation of metres as they will have to pay the electricity bill.The post reads: “कश्मीर में लोगों को बिजली का बिल भरना पड़ेगा! जी हाँ, आजादी के बाद से अबतक कश्मीरियों को मुफ़्त बिजली मिलती थी” (English translation: People in Kashmir will have to pay electricity bills! Yes, since Independence Kashmiris have been getting free electricity.)The link to the post can be seen here.FACT CHECKNewsMobile did the fact-check, and found it to be fake.On searching with appropriate keywords, we found an article published by the website Daily Excelsior. The article says that people, especially women, are protesting in Jammu and Kashmir against the installation of smart metres. The article also quoted a protestor, saying: “We already have meters installed in our homes and we are paying regular bills. What is the fun of installing new meters?”Another report by Greater Kashmir, published on April 21, 2022, says that the installation of smart electricity meters has triggered protests at Chanapora locality in Jammu and Kashmir. It quoted one Manzoor Ahmed, a resident of the area, saying: “Everyone is not rich enough to pay the huge bills of electricity. Most of us pay a flat rate which is affordable for everyone. There should be some provision for poor people, so that they can also get some respite.”We also found a report of the Jammu & Kashmir State Electricity Regulatory Commission from 2006-07, that spoke about the existing tariff and the proposed rise in tariff.Hence, we can ascertain that the viral claim is fake.If you want to fact-check any story, WhatsApp it now on +91 11 7127 9799Your nameYour emailSubjectYour message (optional)ΔClick here for Latest News updates and viral videos on our AI-powered smart news

content: Fact Check: Viral Video Of Man Saving Two Children From Flash... A video showing a man rescuing two children from drowning in a flood is being widely shared on social media with a claim that this is how a father rescued his two children who being were washed away by flood waters.The video is being shared on Facebook with the caption, “(A Fathers love for his Children) Watch this viral video of how a father tries to save his two kids from flood waters”.Here’s the link to the above post.FACT CHECKNewsMobile fact-checked the above claim and found it to be MISLEADING.Using the InVid Tool, we extracted keyframes from the viral video and performed a Reverse Image Search. This search directed us to a news report published on June 26, 2022, that carried the same viral video. According to the article, the children were saved by someone else, and not their father. The rescuer was identified as Ali bin Nasser al-Wardi, a photographer who was present at the time of the incident in Oman. Father of the children was also there when the incident took place.Ali bin Nasser al-Wardi also made it clear in another news article that both the children are safe. The article also reported that Ali bin Nasser al-Wardi was hailed by the people and the government in Oman.Thus, it is evident from the above information that the viral video does not show a father saving his two drowning children. Therefore, the claim is misleading.If you want to fact-check any story, WhatsApp it now on +91 11 7127 979l9Your nameYour emailSubjectYour message (optional)ΔClick here for Latest News updates and viral videos n our AI-powered smart news

content: Fact Check: 2019 Video Of Kashmiri Woman With Rahul Gandhi Shared... A video of a woman narrating her ordeal to Congress leader Rahul Gandhi on board a flight is being shared on social media with a claim that Kashmiri Pandits living abroad were questing the Congress leader as to why he opposed the Modi government in matters concerning Kashmir.The video is being shared with the Hindi caption, “विदेश में रह रहे कश्मीरी पंडितों ने हवाई जहाज में यात्रा के दौरान Rahul Gandhi को घेर कर सवाल पूछे कि वो कश्मीर के मामलों पर मोदी का विरोध क्यों करते हैं। इसका कोई जवाब राहुल गांधी नहीं दे पाया, राष्ट्रीय मीडिया शायद ही ये न्यूज़ दिखा पाए।”(English: Kashmiri Pandits living abroad surrounded Rahul Gandhi while travelling on an aeroplane and asked questions about why they oppose Modi on Kashmir matters. Rahul Gandhi could not answer this, national media could hardly show this news.)Here’s the link to the above post.FACT CHECKWe fact-checked the post and found the claim to be misleading.A simple keyword search led us to multiple media reports published in August 2019 which covered the same incident.According to a report by India Today, dated August 25, 2019, a ‘Kashmiri woman started narrating her ordeal to Rahul Gandhi and other Opposition leaders onboard the flight they were travelling back to Delhi from Srinagar, after Rahul Gandhi and a delegation of Opposition were denied entry to the city’.In the video, the woman can be seen narrating how the lives of people had been affected after the abrogation of Article 370 and lockdown in the Valley. “Our children have not been able to move out of their houses. My brother is a heart patient. He could not see the doctor for 10 days. We are in trouble,” she can be heard saying.Similar reports were also published by Outlook India and The Indian Express in 2019.Congress leader Priyanka Gandhi Vadra shared the same video On Twitter in August 2019 with the caption, “How long is this going to continue? This is one out of millions of people who are being silenced and crushed in the name of “Nationalism”. For those who accuse the opposition of ‘politicising’ this issue”Hence, based on the above information, we can conclude that the incident took place on a Srinagar to Delhi flight and the woman was talking about the abrogation of Article 370 and lockdown in the Valley. Thus, it is clear that the video is being as with a misleading claim.If you want to fact-check any story, WhatsApp it now on +91 11 7127 9799Your nameYour emailSubjectYour message (optional)ΔClick here for Latest News updates and viral videos on our AI-powered smart news

content: Fact Check: Old Video Viral To Suggest Arnab Goswami Danced Post... A video of journalist Arnab Goswami dancing has gone viral on social media with a claim he was dancing after Uddhav Thackeray’s resignation from the post of Maharashtra Chief Minister.The video is being shared with the caption, “उधब ठाकरे के इस्तीफे के बाद अर्नब गोस्वामी”(English translation: Arnab Goswami after Uddhav Thackeray’s resignation)Here’s the link to the above post.FACT CHECKNewsMobile fact-checked the post and found the video to be old.We extracted keyframes of the video and put them through a Reverse Image Search. The search led us to the same video uploaded on Twitter in June 2017 with the caption, “One of the most enterprising videos posted on Facebook. Arnab dancing to desi tunes on a table! #tbt #ArnabGoswami.”We also found that the same video was shared on YouTube multiple times. The videos can be seen here and here.On searching further, we found the same clip in another longer YouTube video uploaded on Feb 11, 2010, with the title, “Times Now Launch Party July 05.flv.” In the video, the viral clip can be seen at 3:21 minutes.Arnab Goswami worked with Times Now news channel from 2006 to 2016. Times Now was launched in January 2006.Hence, from the above fact check, it is clear that the video is old and is NOT related to Uddhav Thackeray’s resignation.If you want to fact-check any story, WhatsApp it now on +91 11 7127 9799Your nameYour emailSubjectYour message (optional)ΔClick here for Latest News updates and viral videos on our AI-powered smart news

content: Fact Check: Old Video From Odisha Falsely Shared As ‘Agnipath’ Protest... A video has surfaced on social media platforms showing a group of men attacking police personnel and their vehicle. The post claims that the video is from Bihar and is linked to recent protests against the ‘Agnipath’ scheme launched by the Centre.The video is being shred with the text, “अग्निपथ वापसी लो नहीं तो अईसे हीं होंगा बिहार में आपका स्वागत है. जिया हों बिहार के लाला”(English Translation: Take back Agnipath or else this will continue to happen.. Welcome to Bihar. Live the son of Bihar [song lyrics])Here’s the link to the post.FACT CHECKNewsMobile fact-checked the above post and found it to be shared with a false claim.With the help of a relevant keyword search on Google, we found a video uploaded by ONA Khabar on January 14, with the title, “Protest over the man’s death At Bhadrak.”Similar visuals were recorded from a different angle and were also found in a report by Kanak News. As per the report, the incident is from Bhadrak, Odisha where locals had attacked and torched a police vehicle over an alleged suspect’s death after his body was found floating in a pond in the village.A comparison between the keyframes of the viral video and news report reveals that they show the same incident.Sambad English also reported the incident stating that Bapi Mahalik of Hatuari village was detained by police for questioning in connection with the case. However, his body was later found floating in a pond in the village.‘Irate locals torched a vehicle in which cops had come to the locality. They also blocked Bhadrak-Chandbali road at Alinagar by placing the body on road’, the report further adds.NewsMobile debunked the same video in May 2021, when it was linked to post-poll violence in West Bengal.https://newsmobile.in/articles/2021/05/04/fact-check-old-unrelated-video-from-odisha-falsely-shared-as-that-of-post-poll-violence-in-west-bengal/Therefore, we can conclude that an old video from Bhadrak, Odisha, dating back to January 2021, is falsely being linked to protests over ‘Agnipath’ Scheme.If you want to fact-check any story, WhatsApp it now on +91 11 7127 9799Your nameYour emailSubjectYour message (optional)ΔClick here for Latest News updates and viral videos on our AI-powered smart news

content: Fact Check: Old Video Of Bihar CM Nitish Kumar’s Remark Against... A video of Bihar Chief Minister Nitish Kumar is being widely shared on social media, in which he can be heard saying that BJP is a ‘bad liar party’. A large number of social media users claim that this is a recent video. Nitish Kumar of JDU, in alliance with BJP, runs the government in Bihar.The video is shared on Facebook with a Hindi caption: “BJP के सहयोग से सरकार चला रहे माननीय मुख्यमंत्री BJP का मतलब बता रहें। जरूर सुनिए और साझा करके सबको सुनाइए” (English translation: Honourable chief minister, who is running the government with BJP support, is telling the meaning of BJP. Must listen and share with everyone)Here’s the link to the above post.FACT CHECKNewsMobile fact-checked the above claim, and found it to be MISLEADING.We did a keyword search and traced a news report, published by NDTV on August 10, 2015, on a similar incident. The article’s headline, in its English version, says: “Nitish’s reply to PM Modi, BJP means — big false party”. According to the report, on August 9, 2015, Prime Minister Narendra Modi held a rally at Gaya in Bihar, where he had told that the JDU party mean oppression and oppression of the people. In response to PM’s statement, while speaking to press, Nitish Kumar had also said that the meaning of BJP was a big liar party. Check similar news reports here and here.The assembly elections were held in Bihar in 2015. In connection with the campaigning for the same, Prime Minister Modi held a meeting in Gaya. And the PM had commented on the coalition government of Nitish Kumar’s Janata Dal — United (JDU) and Lalu Prasad Yadav’s Rashtriya Janata Dal (RJD).Searching further, we also found that in July 2017, Nitish Kumar’s JDU broke the grand alliance with RJD and Congress and formed the government in Bihar with BJP support.Thus, it is evident from the above information that the viral claim is misleading.If you want to fact-check any story, WhatsApp it now on +91 11 7127 979l9Your nameYour emailSubjectYour message (optional)ΔClick here for Latest News updates and viral videos n our AI-powered smart news

content: Fact Check: Video Of Kanyaka Parameswari Temple Decorated With Notes Viral... content: Fact Check: मोहन भागवत से नहीं मिली द्रौपदी मुर्मू , एडिटेड तस्वीर वायरल विश्वास न्यूज की पड़ताल में संघ प्रमुख मोहन भागवत और द्रौपदी मुर्मू की वायरल तस्‍वीर फर्जी साबित हुई। वायरल तस्वीर एडिटेड है। दो अलग-अलग तस्‍वीरों को एडिट करके वायरल तस्‍वीर को बनाया गया है।नई दिल्ली (विश्वास न्यूज)। सोशल मीडिया के विभिन्‍न प्‍लेटफार्म पर राष्‍ट्रीय स्‍वयंसेवक संघ (आरएसएस) के प्रमुख मोहन भागवत की एक तस्वीर वायरल हो रही है। तस्वीर में मोहन भागवत के साथ एनडीए (NDA) की राष्ट्रपति पद की उम्मीदवार द्रौपदी मुर्मू को भी देखा जा सकता है। इस फोटो को शेयर करते हुए सोशल मीडिया यूजर्स दावा कर रहे हैं कि द्रौपदी मुर्मू ने नागपुर स्थित आरएसएस मुख्यालय का दौरा किया और आरएसएस प्रमुख मोहन भागवत से मुलाकात की है। विश्‍वास न्‍यूज ने वायरल पोस्‍ट की जांच की। पड़ताल में वायरल दावा गलत साबित हुआ। वायरल तस्वीर एडिटेड है। दो अलग-अलग तस्‍वीरों को एडिट करके वायरल तस्‍वीर को बनाया गया है।क्या है वायरल?सोशल मीडिया यूजर ‘Peter Fernandes’ ने वायरल तस्वीर (आर्काइव लिंक) को शेयर करते हुए लिखा है, ”Smt Draupadi Murmu visits RSS headquarters to meet Mohan Bhagwat at Nagpur to seek his blessings for her candidature. Have we got any more doubts as to where we are being led from?We are led from the RSS headquarters.”हिंदी अनुवाद : श्रीमती द्रौपदी मुर्मू अपनी उम्मीदवारी के लिए आशीर्वाद लेने के लिए नागपुर में मोहन भागवत से मिलने के लिए आरएसएस मुख्यालय जाती हैं। क्या हमें और संदेह है कि हमें कहाँ से ले जाया जा रहा है? हम आरएसएस मुख्यालय से नेतृत्व कर रहे हैं।फेसबुक पर यूजर इस तस्वीर को मिलते-जुलते दावों के साथ शेयर कर रहे हैं। पोस्ट के आर्काइव वर्जन को यहां देखा जा सकता है।पड़तालविश्‍वास न्‍यूज ने वायरल तस्वीर की सच्चाई जानने के लिए फोटो को क्रॉप कर गूगल रिवर्स इमेज के जरिए सर्च किया। इस दौरान हमें मोहन भागवत और द्रौपदी मुर्मू की तस्वीर अलग-अलग जगह प्राप्त हुई। जिसके बाद ये साफ हो गया कि दोनों की तस्वीर को एडिट कर एक साथ जोड़ा गया है।मोहन भागवत की तस्वीर को जब हमने क्रॉप कर गूगल रिवर्स इमेज के जरिए सर्च किया, तो हमें वायरल तस्वीर से मिलती-जुलती तस्वीर 11 मार्च 2022 को RSS के ऑफिशियल ट्विटर हैंडल से किये एक ट्वीट में मिली। ट्वीट की गई तस्वीर में मोहन भागवत को हाथ जोड़े फोटो के सामने खड़े हुए देखा जा सकता है, पर असली तस्वीर में मोहन भागवत के साथ द्रौपदी मुर्मू नहीं है, बल्कि आरएसएस महासचिव दत्तात्रेय होसबोले मौजूद हैं। मुर्मू की तस्वीर को अलग से जोड़ कर फोटो को फ्लिप कर दिया गया है।राष्ट्रीय स्वयंसेवक संघ की अखिल भारतीय प्रतिनिधि सभा की बैठक आज गुजरात के कर्णावती में प्रारम्भ हुई। बैठक का शुभारम्भ पू. सरसंघचालक डॉ. मोहनजी भागवत और मा. सरकार्यवाह श्री दत्तात्रेय होसबाले जी ने भारत माता के चित्र पर पुष्पार्चन करके किया। बैठक 13 मार्च को सम्पन्न होगी। pic.twitter.com/gWNk7KwpwZ — RSS (@RSSorg) March 11, 2022मोहन भागवत की यह तस्वीर हमें 11 मार्च 2022 को aninews.in की वेबसाइट पर प्रकाशित एक रिपोर्ट में प्राप्त हुई। रिपोर्ट में दी गई जानकारी मुताबिक,”विस्तार योजनाओं पर विचार-विमर्श के लिए आरएसएस की वार्षिक बैठक गुजरात में शुरू। बैठक की शुरुआत आरएसएस प्रमुख मोहन भागवत और महासचिव दत्तात्रेय होसबले द्वारा भारत माता को श्रद्धांजलि देने के साथ हुई।” असली तस्वीर में मोहन भागवत को आरएसएस महासचिव दत्तात्रेय होसबोले के साथ देखा जा सकता है।पड़ताल को आगे बढ़ाते हुए हमने द्रौपदी मुर्मू की तस्वीर को क्रॉप कर गूगल रिवर्स इमेज के जरिए सर्च किया, तो हमें असली तस्वीर हेमंत सोरेन के आधिकारिक ट्विटर हैंडल से 29 दिसंबर 2020 को किये गए ट्वीट में ये तस्वीर शेयर मिली। हेमंत सोरेन ने 2020 में झारखंड की पूर्व राज्यपाल द्रौपदी मुर्मू से मुलाकात की थी। इस फोटो में से द्रौपदी मुर्मू की तस्वीर को क्रॉप कर वायरल तस्वीर में जोड़ दिया गया है।आज झारखण्ड सरकार के एक साल पूरे होने के अवसर पर राजभवन में राज्यपाल श्रीमती द्रौपदी मुर्मू जी से मुलाकात की। pic.twitter.com/Si262ts95D — Hemant Soren (@HemantSorenJMM) December 29, 2020आगे हमने ये सर्च करना शुरू किया क्या दोनों ने हाल-फिलहाल में मुलाकात की है। हमने गूगल पर कई कीवर्ड्स के जरिए सर्च किया, लेकिन हमें दोनों के मुलाकात की कोई विश्वसनीय मीडिया रिपोर्ट प्राप्त नहीं हुई। नीचे दिए गए कोलाज में दोनों तस्वीरों की तुलना को साफ-साफ देखा जा सकता है।अधिक जानकारी के लिए हमने हेडगेवार स्मारक समिति के व्यवस्था प्रमुख विकास तेलंग से सम्पर्क किया। उनके साथ वायरल पोस्ट के लिंक को शेयर किया। उन्होंने हमें बताया कि तस्वीर एडिटेड है और वायरल दावा गलत है।ANI नागपुर कॉरेस्पॉन्डेंट सौरभ जोशी ने भी वायरल तस्वीर को एडिटेड बताते हुए कहा, ‘द्रौपदी मुर्मू मोहन भागवत से नहीं मिली हैं और वायरल दावा भी गलत है।पड़ताल के अंत में विश्‍वास न्‍यूज ने फेक दावे को शेयर करने वाले यूजर Peter Fernandes की सोशल स्कैनिंग की। स्कैनिंग से हमें पता चला कि यूजर के फेसबुक पर 4.2K फ्रेंड हैं। यूजर को फेसबुक पर 425 लोग फॉलो करते हैं।निष्कर्ष: विश्वास न्यूज की पड़ताल में संघ प्रमुख मोहन भागवत और द्रौपदी मुर्मू की वायरल तस्‍वीर फर्जी साबित हुई। वायरल तस्वीर एडिटेड है। दो अलग-अलग तस्‍वीरों को एडिट करके वायरल तस्‍वीर को बनाया गया है।Claim Review : Smt Draupadi Murmu visits RSS headquarters to meet Mohan Bhagwat at Nagpur to seek his blessings for her candidature.Claimed By : Peter FernandesFact Check : झूठ झूठ फेक न्यूज की प्रकृति को बताने वाला सिंबल सचभ्रामकझूठपूरा सच जानें... किसी सूचना या अफवाह पर संदेह हो तो हमें बताएं सब को बताएं, सच जानना आपका अधिकार है। अगर आपको ऐसी किसी भी मैसेज या अफवाह पर संदेह है जिसका असर समाज, देश और आप पर हो सकता है तो हमें बताएं। आप हमें नीचे दिए गए किसी भी माध्यम के जरिए जानकारी भेज सकते हैं...Contribute to Vishwas News कॉरपोरेट और राजनीतिक दबाव से मुक्त होकर सत्ता को हमेशा आइना दिखाने वाली फैक्ट चेक जर्नलिज्म सिर्फ और सिर्फ आपके सहयोग से संभव है। इस मुहिम में हमें आपके साथ और सहयोगी की जरूरत है। फर्जी और गुमराह करने वाली खबर के खिलाफ जारी इस लड़ाई में हमारी मदद करें और कृपया हमें आर्थिक सहयोग दें।टैग्स

content: શું ખરેખર થાઈલેન્ડ ખાતે આવેલું ઝરણું ૐ ના ઉચ્ચારણથી ઉપર આવે છે…? જાણો શું છે સત્ય…. તાજેતરમાં સોશિયલ મીડિયા પર એક વીડિયો વાયરલ થઈ રહ્યો છે જેમાં ૐ નું ઉચ્ચારણ કરવાથી પર્વતમાંથી પાણીનો ધોધ પર ઉઠી રહ્યો છે. આ વીડિયો સાથેના લખાણમાં એવો દાવો કરવામાં આવી રહ્યો છે કે, થાઈલેન્ડ ખાતે એક પર્વત પર ૐ નું ઉચ્ચારણ કરવાથી નીચેથી પાણીનું ઝરણું ઉપર આવી રહ્યું છે. પરંતુ ફેક્ટ ક્રેસેન્ડોની પડતાલમાં આ દાવો ખોટો અને પાયાવિહોણો હોવાનું સાબિત થાય છે કારણ કે, પોસ્ટમાં ફુવારાનો જે વીડિયો મૂકવામાં આવ્યો છે એ થાઈલેન્ડનો નહીં પરંતુ ઉત્તર ચીનના શાંક્સી પ્રાંતના કેંગશાન પર્વતોમાં બનાવવામાં આવ્યો છે અને તે કોઈપણ અવાજથી ઉપર આવે છે. આ વીડિયોને સોશિયલ મીડિયા પર ખોટી અને ભ્રામક માહિતી સાથે લોકોને ગેરમાર્ગે દોરવા વાયરલ કરવામાં આવી રહ્યો છે.શું દાવો કરવામાં આવી રહ્યો છે.?City Spotlight નામના ફેસબુક યુઝર દ્વારા 02 જુલાઈ, 2022 ના રોજ એક પોસ્ટ શેર કરવામાં આવી હતી. પોસ્ટમાં મૂકવામાં આવેલા વીડિયોના શીર્ષકમાં એવું લખવામાં આવ્યું છે કે, ૐ વિડીયો થાઇલેન્ડનો છે.. પર્વત પરથી ૐ નું ઉચ્ચારણ કરવાથી નીચેથી ઝરણાનું પાણી છેક ઉપર સુધી આવી જાય છે… પોસ્ટમાં મૂકવામાં આવેલા વીડિયો સાથેના લખાણમાં એવો દાવો કરવામાં આવી રહ્યો છે કે, થાઈલેન્ડ ખાતે એક પર્વત પર ૐ નું ઉચ્ચારણ કરવાથી નીચેથી પાણીનું ઝરણું ઉપર આવી રહ્યું છે.Facebook Post | ArchiveFACT CHECKઉપરોક્ત પોસ્ટમાં કરવામાં આવેલા દાવાની સત્યતા તપાસવી જરૂરી જણાતાં અમે અમારી પડતાલ/તપાસ કાર્યવાહી શરૂ કરી હતી. તપાસની શરૂઆતમાં અમે પોસ્ટમાં મૂકવામાં આવેલા વીડિયોનો એખ સ્ક્રીનશોટ લઈને સર્ચ કરતાં અમને ‘usclip‘ નામની વેબસાઇટ મળી હતી, જેમાં એક વીડિયો શેર કરવામાં આવ્યો હતો. આ વીડિયો અન્ય ભાષામાં હોવાને કારણે અમે ગૂગલ ટ્રાન્સલેટરમાંથી ભાષા બદલીને જોતાં તેના અંગ્રેજી અનુવાદમાં વર્ણનમાં લખ્યું હતું કે, ‘This Girl Shouts in Front of the Trumpet Then Unexpected Things Happen’. આ વીડિયોમાં 0:55 થી 0:58 અને 01:08 થી 01:26 વચ્ચેનો ભાગ, જેમાં ધોધ ઉપરના દાવાના વીડિયો જેવો જ છે.આ ભાગમાં વીડિયોના નીચેના હિસ્સામાં આવેલ ‘HIMALAYA MUSIC FOUNTAIN’ ને વીડિયોના તે ભાગ માટેનું શ્રેય આપ્યું છે અને બીજા ભાગમાં ‘OVER.DISCOVER’ ને વીડિયોના તે ભાગ માટે શ્રેય આપવામાં આવ્યું છે.અમારી વધુ તપાસમાં અમને ‘Chinamusicfountain‘ નામની વેબસાઈટ મળી. આ વેબસાઈટના ‘Products‘ વિભાગની મુલાકાત લેવા પર, અમને તેમના દ્વારા વૉઇસ કંટ્રોલ્ડ ફાઉન્ટેન વિશે જાણવા મળ્યું, જેને કોઈપણ પ્રકારના અવાજથી નિયંત્રિત કરી શકાય છે.પછી અમે ગૂગલ પર ‘voice control fountain in china’ શબ્દો સર્ચ કરતાં અમને નીચે આપેલા પરિણામો પાર્પત થયા હતા.ઉપરોક્ત સંશોધનમાં અમને બે વીડિયો પ્રાપ્ત થયા હતા.પ્રથમ વીડિયો14 નવેમ્બર 2018ના રોજ ન્યૂ ચાઈના ટીવી દ્વારા અપલોડ કરવામાં આવેલા આ વીડિયોના વર્ણનમાં લખવામાં આવ્યું છે કે, ઉત્તર ચીનના શાંક્સી પ્રાંતના કેંગશાન પર્વતોમાં આ ફુવારો બનાવવામાં આવ્યો છે. અવાજથી ચાલતો આ ફુવારો પોતાનામાં એક અનોખું આકર્ષણ છે.બીજો વીડિયોહિમાલય મ્યુઝિક ફાઉન્ટેન દ્વારા 10 એપ્રિલ, 2018ના રોજ અપલોડ કરવામાં આવેલા આ વીડિયોના વર્ણનમાં લખવામાં આવ્યું છે કે, ચાંગશા હિમાલયન મ્યુઝિક ફાઉન્ટેન કોર્પોરેશને હાન ટૂરિસ્ટ ડેવલપમેન્ટ કોર્પોરેશન સાથે હજાર-બુદ્ધ ગુફાના શાઉટ ફાઉન્ટેનના નિર્માણ માટે સફળતાપૂર્વક કરાર કર્યો છે.આ પછી અમે ગૂગલ પર ‘Cangshan Mountain in north China’s Shanxi Province’ શબ્દો સાથે સર્ચ કરતાં નીચેના પરિણામો પ્રાપ્ત થયા હતા.અમારી વધુ તપાસમાં અમને ‘China Xinhua News’ નામની ન્યૂઝ ચેનલની ફેસબુક પેજની પોસ્ટ મળી. આ પોસ્ટ અનુસાર, આ ફુવારો ઉત્તર ચીનના શાંક્સી પ્રાંતના કેંગશાન પર્વતોમાં બનાવવામાં આવ્યો છે.Facebook Post | Archiveપરિણામઆમ, અમારી પડતાલમાં ઉપરોક્ત પોસ્ટમાં કરવામાં આવેલો દાવો ખોટો અને પાયાવિહોણો હોવાનું સાબિત થાય છે કારણ કે, પોસ્ટમાં ફુવારાનો જે વીડિયો મૂકવામાં આવ્યો છે એ થાઈલેન્ડનો નહીં પરંતુ ઉત્તર ચીનના શાંક્સી પ્રાંતના કેંગશાન પર્વતોમાં બનાવવામાં આવ્યો છે અને તે કોઈપણ અવાજથી ઉપર આવે છે.
label: truth
