' എന്നുള്ള പോസ്റ്റിന്റെ പൂര്‍ണ്ണരൂപം താഴെ കാണാം.എന്നാല്‍, പ്രചരിക്കുന്ന വാദം തെറ്റിദ്ധരിപ്പിക്കുന്നതാണെന്ന് ഇന്ത്യാ ടുഡേയുടെ ആന്റി ഫേക്ക് ന്യൂസ് വാര്‍ റൂം(AFWA) കണ്ടെത്തി. കേരളത്തിലെ സ്‌കൂളുകളില്‍ ഇപ്പോഴും ഉച്ചഭക്ഷണ പദ്ധതി സ്‌കൂളുകള്‍ വഴി തന്നെയാണ് നടത്തുന്നത്.AFWA അന്വേഷണംപ്രചരിക്കുന്ന പോസ്റ്റിനെക്കുറിച്ച് അന്വേഷിക്കുന്നതിന് സ്‌കൂള്‍ ഉച്ചഭക്ഷണ(മിഡ് ഡെ മീല്‍-MDM) പദ്ധതിയെപ്പറ്റിയാണ് ഞങ്ങള്‍ ആദ്യം അന്വേഷിച്ചത്. കേന്ദ്ര സര്‍ക്കാരിന്റെ സഹായത്തോടെ അതത് സംസ്ഥാന വിദ്യാഭ്യാസ വകുപ്പാണ് പദ്ധതിയുടെ മേല്‍നോട്ടം വഹിക്കുന്നത്. ഈ അധ്യയന വര്‍ഷം മുതല്‍ പിഎം പോഷന്‍(PM Poshan) എന്ന് പുനര്‍നാമകരണം ചെയ്ത പദ്ധതിക്കായി 10,233.75 കോടി രൂപയാണ് ഇത്തവണ ബജറ്റില്‍ വകയിരുത്തിയിട്ടുള്ളത്.ഉച്ച ഭക്ഷണത്തിനുള്ള പണം കുട്ടികളുടെ അക്കൗണ്ടില്‍ നിക്ഷേപിക്കുന്നതിന് കേന്ദ്രം തീരുമാനമെടുത്തിരുന്നോ എന്നകാര്യമാണ് പിന്നീട് തിരഞ്ഞത്. ഇതുസംബന്ധിക്കുന്ന മാധ്യമ വാര്‍ത്തകള്‍ കണ്ടെത്താനായി. 2021ലാണ് ഈ വാര്‍ത്തകള്‍ വന്നിട്ടുള്ളത്. ഇതു പ്രകാരം കോവിഡ് സാഹചര്യത്തില്‍ സ്‌കൂള്‍ അടച്ചിട്ടിരുന്നതിനാല്‍ ഉച്ചഭക്ഷണ പദ്ധതി കൃത്യമായി നടപ്പാക്കാനായിരുന്നില്ല. അതിനാല്‍ ഇതിനുള്ള പണം കുട്ടികളുടെയോ രക്ഷിതാക്കളുടെയോ അക്കൗണ്ടിലേക്ക് എത്തിച്ച് നല്‍കാന്‍ കേന്ദ്രം തീരുമാനമെടുത്തിരുന്നുവെന്ന് പറയുന്നുണ്ട്.എന്നാല്‍ ഇപ്പോള്‍ കോവിഡ് നിയന്ത്രണങ്ങളില്‍ ഇളവ് വന്നതോടെ സ്‌കൂളുകള്‍ തുറന്ന് വിദ്യാഭ്യാസം സുഗമമായി നടക്കുന്നതിനാല്‍ ഇത്തരമൊരു സാഹചര്യം ഉണ്ടാകാനിടയില്ല എന്ന സൂചനയിലാണ് ഞങ്ങള്‍ അന്വേഷണം തുടര്‍ന്നത്. ഇതിനായി ചില അധ്യാപകരെ ബന്ധപ്പെട്ടു. ഈ അധ്യയന വര്‍ഷം ആരംഭിച്ച് ഒരു മാസം പിന്നിടുമ്പോള്‍ സ്‌കൂളുകളില്‍ ഉച്ചഭക്ഷണം നല്‍കുന്നുണ്ടെന്ന് വിവിധ സ്‌കൂളുകളില്‍ നിന്ന് ഉറപ്പിക്കാനായി.തുടര്‍ന്ന് കൂടുതല്‍ വിശദീകരണത്തിനായി ഡെപ്യൂട്ടി ഡയറക്ടര്‍ ഓഫ് എഡ്യുക്കേഷന്‍(DDE Tvm) എസ്. സന്തോഷ് കുമാറിനെ ബന്ധപ്പെട്ടു. അദ്ദേഹം നല്‍കിയ വിവരം അനുസരിച്ച് പ്രചരിക്കുന്ന സന്ദേശം തെറ്റിദ്ധരിപ്പിക്കുന്നതാണ്. 'സ്‌കൂള്‍ തുറന്നിരിക്കുന്ന സമയത്ത് ഉച്ചഭക്ഷണം സ്‌കൂളില്‍ നിന്ന് അല്ലേ നല്‍കുന്നത്. ഇപ്പോള്‍ കോവിഡ് സാഹചര്യം ഒക്കെ മാറിയല്ലോ. സ്‌കൂളില്‍ ഭക്ഷണം നല്‍കുന്നുണ്ട്. അതുകൊണ്ട് വിദ്യാര്‍ഥികളുടെ അക്കൗണ്ടിലേക്ക് പ്രത്യേകമായി ഒന്നും കൊടുക്കേണ്ടതില്ല. കഴിഞ്ഞ അധ്യയന വര്‍ഷം സ്‌കൂള്‍ അടച്ചിരുന്നതുകൊണ്ടാണ് ഉച്ചഭക്ഷണത്തിനുള്ള തുക കുഞ്ഞുങ്ങള്‍ക്ക് നല്‍കാന്‍ തീരുമാനിച്ചത്. എന്നാല്‍ കേരളത്തില്‍ ഇത് പണം ആയിട്ടല്ല കൊടുത്തത്. അനുവദനീയമായ ഭക്ഷ്യ ധാന്യങ്ങള്‍ സ്‌കൂളില്‍ നിന്ന് നല്‍കുകയായിരുന്നു. ചില സാധനങ്ങള്‍ വാങ്ങാനുള്ള കൂപ്പണ്‍ സപ്ലൈക്കോയിലേക്ക് നല്‍കുകയും ചെയ്തിരുന്നു. പണമായിട്ട് കുട്ടികളുടെ അക്കൗണ്ടില്‍ നല്‍കിയിരുന്നില്ല. ' ഡിഡിഇ പറഞ്ഞു. Advertisementഇക്കാര്യങ്ങള്‍ എംഡിഎം വെബ്‌സൈറ്റിലും ലഭ്യമാണ്. ഇത്തവണ സ്‌കൂള്‍ തുറക്കുന്നതിനു മുന്നോടിയായി കേന്ദ്രം എല്ലാ സംസ്ഥാനങ്ങളുമായും നടത്തിയ റിവ്യൂ മീറ്റിംഗിലെ മിനിട്‌സ് ഞങ്ങള്‍ കണ്ടെത്തി. കേരളത്തിലെ റിവ്യു മീറ്റിംഗ് നടന്നത് 2022 മെയ് 13നാണ്. കഴിഞ്ഞ അധ്യയന വര്‍ഷത്തെ ഉച്ചഭക്ഷണ പദ്ധതിയെപ്പറ്റി വിശദീകരിക്കുമ്പോള്‍ കോവിഡ് സാഹചര്യം എടുത്ത് പറഞ്ഞിട്ടുണ്ട്. സ്‌കൂള്‍ തുറക്കാത്ത സാഹചര്യത്തില്‍ ഭക്ഷ്യധാന്യങ്ങള്‍ കുട്ടികള്‍ക്ക് കൈമാറിയ വിവരം ഉള്‍പ്പെടുന്ന ഭാഗം താഴെ കാണാം.ഇതില്‍ നിന്ന് കേരളത്തിലെ സ്‌കൂള്‍ വിദ്യാര്‍ഥികള്‍ക്ക് ഭക്ഷ്യധാന്യമാണ് നല്‍കിയിരുന്നതെന്നും പണമല്ലെന്നും വ്യക്തമായി. ഇതുകൂടാതെ 2022 ജൂണില്‍ ആരംഭിച്ച നടപ്പ് അധ്യയന വര്‍ഷത്തില്‍ സ്‌കൂളില്‍ വച്ച് തന്നെയാണ് ഉച്ചഭക്ഷണം നല്‍കുന്നതെന്ന കാര്യവും വ്യക്തമാക്കുന്നുണ്ട്. ഇക്കാര്യത്തെപ്പറ്റി വിശദീകരിക്കുന്ന പ്രസക്തഭാഗം താഴെ കാണാം.ലഭ്യമായ വിവരങ്ങളില്‍ നിന്ന് സ്‌കൂള്‍ ഉച്ചഭക്ഷണത്തിനായി കുട്ടികളുടെ അക്കൗണ്ടിലേക്ക് നേരിട്ട് പണം എത്തിക്കുമെന്ന പ്രചാരണം തെറ്റിദ്ധരിപ്പിക്കുന്നതാണെന്ന് വ്യക്തം. കോവിഡ് സാഹചര്യത്തില്‍ കഴിഞ്ഞ വര്‍ഷത്തേയ്ക്ക് മാത്രം ഇത്തരത്തിലൊരു പദ്ധതി നടപ്പാക്കാന്‍ ആലോചിച്ചിരുന്നു. എന്നാല്‍ കേരളത്തില്‍ പണം ആയിട്ടല്ല നല്‍കിയത്, ഭക്ഷ്യധാന്യമായിട്ടായിരുന്നു. ഇത്തവണ സ്‌കൂള്‍ തുറന്നതിനാല്‍ സ്‌കൂളില്‍ നിന്ന് തന്നെയാണ് ഉച്ചഭക്ഷണം നല്‍കുന്നത്.ഫാക്ട് ചെക്ക്                                           വാദം സ്‌കൂള്‍ ഉച്ചഭക്ഷണത്തിനായുള്ള പണം ഇനി വിദ്യാര്‍ഥികളുടെ അക്കൗണ്ടിലെത്തിക്കാന്‍ കേന്ദ്ര സര്‍ക്കാര്‍ തീരുമാനം.നിഗമനം കോവിഡ് സാഹചര്യത്തില്‍ കഴിഞ്ഞ വര്‍ഷം ഇത്തരമൊരു പദ്ധതി ആലോചിച്ചിരുന്നെങ്കിലും കേരളത്തിലെ വിദ്യാര്‍ഥികള്‍ക്ക് പണം ആയിട്ടല്ല, ഭക്ഷ്യധാന്യമായിട്ടാണ് ഇത് നല്‍കിയത്. ഈ വര്‍ഷം സ്‌കൂള്‍ തുറന്നതിനാല്‍ ഉച്ചഭക്ഷണം സ്‌കൂളില്‍ തന്നെയാണ് നല്‍കുന്നത്.          കാക്കകളുടെ എണ്ണം കളവിന്റെ തീവ്രത സൂചിപ്പിക്കുന്നു    ഒരു കാക്ക : അർദ്ധ സത്യം  രണ്ട് കാക്കകൾ : ഏറിയപങ്കും അസത്യം  മൂന്ന് കാക്കകൾ : തികച്ചും അസത്യംവസ്തുതാ  പരിശോധനക്കായി ഞങ്ങളെ ബന്ധപ്പെടാൻ ആഗ്രഹിക്കുന്നുവോ? content: Fact Check: ഉദയ്പ്പുർ കൊലപാതകത്തിൽ കേരള മുഖ്യമന്ത്രി മൗനത്തിലല്ല രാജസ്ഥാനിലെ ഉദയ്പൂരിൽ പ്രവാചകനിന്ദ വിഷയത്തിൽ നൂപുർ ശർമയെ അനുകൂലിച്ച് സമൂഹ മാധ്യമങ്ങൾ പ്രതികരിച്ച തയ്യൽക്കാരനെ രണ്ട് വർഗീയവാദികൾ ചേർന്ന് കൊലപ്പെടുത്തിയത് രാജ്യത്തെ നടുക്കിയിരുന്നു. അറസ്റ്റിലായ പ്രതികളുടെ പാകിസ്ഥാൻ ബന്ധമടക്കം അന്വേഷണം തുടരവേ വിഷയം സമൂഹമാധ്യമങ്ങളിലും വൈറലാണ്.ഇതിനിടയിൽ, ചില ബിജെപി-അനുകൂല പ്രൊഫൈലുകൾ മുഖ്യമന്ത്രി പിണറായി വിജയൻ വിഷയത്തിൽ പ്രതികരിക്കാൻപോലും തയ്യാറായിട്ടില്ല എന്ന വാദവുമായി രംഗത്തെത്തിയിട്ടുണ്ട്. "രാജ്യദ്രോഹി സർക്കാർ" എന്ന തലക്കെട്ടോടുകൂടിയ പോസ്റ്റ് "ട്രെയിനിലെ സീറ്റ് തർക്കത്തിൽ കൊല്ലപ്പെട്ട ജിഹാദിക്ക് പത്ത് ലക്ഷവുമായി ചെന്ന പിണറായി വിജയന്, രാജസ്ഥാനിലെ കൊലപാതകത്തിൽ ഒന്നും പറയാനില്ലേ?," എന്ന കുറുപ്പിനൊപ്പമാണ് പലരും പ്രചരിപ്പിക്കുന്നത്. ഇത്തരത്തിലുള്ള ഒന്ന് ചുവടെ കാണാം.ഇന്ത്യാ ടുഡേ ആന്റി ഫേക്ക് ന്യൂസ്‌ വാർ റൂം (AFWA) നടത്തിയ അന്വേഷണത്തിൽ വാദം തെറ്റിദ്ധരിപ്പിക്കുന്നതാണെന്ന് കണ്ടെത്തി. ജൂൺ 28ന് ട്വിറ്ററിലും ജൂൺ 29ന് ഫേസ്ബുക്കിലും പിണറായി വിജയൻ കടുത്തഭാഷയിൽ ഉദയ്പ്പുർ കൊലപാതകത്തെ അപലപിച്ചിരുന്നു.AFWA അന്വേഷണംപോസ്റ്റിനൊപ്പം പ്രചരിക്കുന്ന ചിത്രത്തിൽ പിണറായി വിജയന് ഒപ്പമുള്ള കുടുംബം ആരാണെന്നാണ് ആദ്യം അന്വേഷിച്ചത്. പരിശോധിച്ചപ്പോൾ ഇത് ജുനൈദിന്റെ കുടുംബം തന്നെയാണെന്ന് കണ്ടെത്താനായി. 2017 ആഗസ്റ്റ് 6ന് 'ദ് ന്യൂസ് മിനിറ്റ്' നൽകിയ ഒരു റിപ്പോർട്ടിൽ സമാനമായ ചിത്രം ഉപയോഗിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നത് കണ്ടെത്താനായി.ഹരിയാനയിൽ ട്രെയിനിൽ സഞ്ചരിക്കവേ ആൾക്കൂട്ട ആക്രമണത്തിൽ കൊല്ലപ്പെട്ട പതിനാറുകാരനാണ് ജുനൈദ് ഖാൻ. കേരള ഹൗസിൽ വച്ചാണ് മുഖ്യമന്ത്രി പിണറായി വിജയൻ ജുനൈദിന്റെ മാതാപിതാക്കളെയും സഹോദരന്മാരെയും കണ്ടതും 10 ലക്ഷം രൂപ ധനസഹായമായി കൈമാറിയതെന്നും ഈ റിപ്പോർട്ടിൽ പറയുന്നുണ്ട്.പിണറായി വിജയൻ ഉദയ്പുർ വിഷയത്തിൽ പ്രതികരിച്ചിട്ടുണ്ടോ എന്നാണ് അടുത്തതായി പരിശോധിച്ചത്. ലളിതമായ ഒരു ഗൂഗിൾ സെർച്ചിൽ പോസ്റ്റിലെ വാദം അടിസ്ഥാനരഹിതമാണെന്ന് കണ്ടെത്താനായി. കനയ്യ ലാലിന്റെ കൊലപാതകം നടന്ന ദിവസംതന്നെ ട്വിറ്ററിലൂടെ പിണറായി വിജയൻ വിഷയത്തെ അപലപിച്ചിരുന്നു. ഇത്തരം കൊലപാതകങ്ങൾ സമാധാനപരമായ ജീവിതാന്തരീക്ഷം ഇല്ലാതാക്കുമെന്നും ഇതിനുപിന്നിൽ പ്രവർത്തിച്ചവർക്കെതിരെ കടുത്ത നടപടി എടുക്കണമെന്നും പിണറായി വിജയൻ ഇംഗ്ലീഷ് ട്വീറ്റിലൂടെ ആവശ്യപ്പെട്ടിരുന്നു. ഇതിന്റെ പൂർണ്ണരൂപം താഴെ കാണാം.Strongly condemn the barbaric murder in #Udaipur. Request the authorities to take stern action against those responsible. Such heinous acts would only serve to upset our harmonious living. Appeal to everyone to maintain peace and calm and let the law take its course.

Please Try Again                             മലയാളം വാർത്ത ഫാക്റ്റ് ചെക്ക്          Feedback   Fact Check:  വെള്ളക്കെട്ടില്‍ നിന്ന് കുട്ടികളെ രക്ഷിക്കുന്ന അച്ഛന്‍- സത്യമിതാണ്  പ്രചരിക്കുന്ന വാദം തെറ്റിദ്ധരിപ്പിക്കുന്നതാണെന്ന് ഇന്ത്യാ ടുഡേയുടെ ആന്റി ഫേക്ക് ന്യൂസ് വാര്‍ റൂം(AFWA) കണ്ടെത്തി.recent video from Oman.            Sreejisha Laila    തിരുവനന്തപുരം, 03 Jul 2022, (Updated 03 Jul 2022, 1:17 AM IST)                                              Follow us:അപ്രതീക്ഷിതമായി ഉണ്ടായ വെള്ളക്കെട്ടില്‍ അകപ്പെട്ടുപോയ മക്കളെ അതിസാഹസികമായി രക്ഷപെടുത്തുന്ന അച്ഛന്‍ എന്ന പേരില്‍ ഒരു വീഡിയോ ഇപ്പോള്‍ സമൂഹമാധ്യമങ്ങളില്‍ വ്യാപകമായി പ്രചരിക്കുന്നുണ്ട്. ലോകത്തിലെ തന്നെ ഏറ്റവും മികച്ച പിതാവാണദ്ദേഹം എന്ന രീതിയിലാണ് പോസ്റ്റുകള്‍ പ്രചരിക്കുന്നത്.' റിയല്‍ ഹീറോ, അച്ഛന്‍ മാത്രം'' Father of the world' എന്നൊക്കെയുള്ള തലക്കെട്ടില്‍ പ്രചരിക്കുന്ന വീഡിയോയുടെ പൂര്‍ണ്ണരൂപം താഴെ കാണാം.എന്നാല്‍, പ്രചരിക്കുന്ന വാദം തെറ്റിദ്ധരിപ്പിക്കുന്നതാണെന്ന് ഇന്ത്യാ ടുഡേയുടെ ആന്റി ഫേക്ക് ന്യൂസ് വാര്‍ റൂം(AFWA) കണ്ടെത്തി. കുട്ടികളെ രക്ഷപെടുത്തിയത് അവരുടെ പിതാവല്ല.AFWA അന്വേഷണംപ്രചരിക്കുന്ന വീഡിയോയില്‍ ഒഴുക്കുള്ള വെള്ളക്കെട്ടില്‍ അകപ്പെട്ടുപോയ രണ്ട് കുട്ടികളെ ഒരാള്‍ രക്ഷിച്ചുകൊണ്ട് വരുന്നതാണ് കാണാനാകുന്നത്. നല്ല കുത്തൊഴുക്കുള്ള സ്ഥലമായതിനാല്‍ വളരെയേറെ പണിപ്പെട്ടാണ് അദ്ദേഹം കുട്ടികളുമായി കരയ്ക്കടുക്കുന്നത്. കരയ്ക്കടുത്തപ്പോള്‍ കുറെയേറെപ്പേര്‍ ഓടിയെത്തി കുട്ടികളെയും അവരെ എത്തിച്ച മുതിര്‍ന്ന ആളെയും കൈപിടിച്ച് കയറ്റുന്നുണ്ട്. ഭൂപ്രകൃതിയും ദൃശ്യങ്ങളില്‍ കാണാനാകുന്നവരെയും നിരീക്ഷിക്കുമ്പോള്‍ ഏതോ ഗള്‍ഫ് രാജ്യമാണെന്ന തോന്നലുണ്ടാകും.കൂടുതല്‍ വിശദീകരണത്തിനായി വീഡിയോയുടെ കീഫ്രെയ്മുകള്‍ റിവേഴ്‌സ് ഇമേജില്‍ തിരഞ്ഞു. അറബ് രാജ്യമായിരിക്കാം എന്ന സൂചന പോലെ തന്നെ ഇത് ഒമാനില്‍ നിന്നുള്ള സമീപകാല വീഡിയോ ആണെന്ന് മനസിലാക്കാനായി. ഇതേ കീഫ്രെയ്മുകള്‍ ഉപയോഗിച്ച് നല്‍കിയ വാര്‍ത്താ റിപ്പോര്‍ട്ടുകള്‍ ലഭ്യമായി. Alwatan.com എന്ന അറബ് മാധ്യമത്തില്‍ ജൂണ്‍ 25ന് നല്‍കിയിട്ടുള്ള വാര്‍ത്ത പ്രകാരം സംഭവം നടന്നത് ഒമാനിലെ ബഹ്‌ലനഗരത്തിലാണ്.പെട്ടെന്നുണ്ടായ മഴയില്‍ ബെഹ്‌ല താഴ്‌വരയില്‍ വെള്ളം നിറഞ്ഞു. സന്ദര്‍ശകരായി എത്തിയ കുട്ടികള്‍ ഒരു പാറയുടെ മുകളില്‍ പിടിത്തമിട്ടെങ്കിലും വെള്ളത്തിന്റെ ഒഴുക്ക് കൂടിയതോടെ അവര്‍ക്ക് കരയിലേക്ക് എത്താനായില്ല.മഴ- ചിത്രങ്ങളെടുക്കാനെത്തിയ ഫോട്ടോഗ്രാഫര്‍ അലി ബിന്‍ നാസര്‍ അല്‍-വാര്‍ദിയാണ് കുട്ടികള്‍ക്ക് രക്ഷകനായത്. അദ്ദേഹത്തിന്റെ കമെന്റ് ഉള്‍പ്പെടുത്തിയിരിക്കുന്ന വാര്‍ത്തയാണിത്. ' മഴയുടെ ചിത്രങ്ങള്‍ പകര്‍ത്താനാണ് അച്ഛനോടൊപ്പം ഞാന്‍ ബഹ്‌ലയില്‍ എത്തിയത്. പടം എടുക്കുന്നതിനിടെയാണ് പാറക്കെട്ടില്‍ അകപ്പെട്ട കുഞ്ഞുങ്ങളെ കണ്ടത്. പെട്ടെന്ന് തന്നെ ക്യാമറ അച്ഛനെ ഏല്‍പ്പിച്ച് ഒരു കയറും എടുത്ത് ഞാന്‍ അവരെ രക്ഷിക്കാന്‍ ഇറങ്ങി. അല്ലാഹുവിന്റെ അനുഗ്രഹം കൊണ്ട് രണ്ട് കുഞ്ഞുങ്ങളെയും കരയ്‌ക്കെത്തിക്കാന്‍ സാധിച്ചു. ഇത്തരം സാഹചര്യങ്ങളില്‍ കുഞ്ഞുങ്ങളെ കൊണ്ടുപോകുന്ന മാതാപിതാക്കള്‍ വേണ്ടത്ര മുന്‍കരുതല്‍ എടുക്കണമെന്ന് ഞാന്‍ ഈ അവസരത്തില്‍ ഓര്‍മിപ്പിക്കുകയാണ്. ' അല്‍-വാര്‍ദി മാധ്യങ്ങളോട് പറഞ്ഞു. Advertisementസമാനമായ വാര്‍ത്ത Sabah TV എന്ന മാധ്യമവും നല്‍കിയിട്ടുണ്ട്. വീഡിയോ ഉള്‍പ്പെടെയാണ് അവര്‍ റിപ്പോര്‍ട്ട് നല്‍കിയിട്ടുള്ളത്.ഈ രക്ഷാ പ്രവര്‍ത്തനം നടക്കുമ്പോള്‍ അപകടത്തില്‍പ്പെട്ട കുഞ്ഞുങ്ങളുടെ അച്ഛന്‍സ്ഥലത്ത് ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു എന്നാല്‍ അദ്ദേഹമല്ല കുട്ടികളെ രക്ഷിച്ചതെന്ന് വാര്‍ത്തകളില്‍ നിന്ന് വ്യക്തം.ഫാക്ട് ചെക്ക്                                           വാദം വെള്ളക്കെട്ടില്‍ അകപ്പെട്ടുപോയ മക്കളെ അതി സാഹസികമായി രക്ഷിക്കുന്ന പിതാവ്.നിഗമനം ഇത് ഒമാനിലെ ബഹ്‌ലയില്‍ അടുത്തിടെ നടന്ന സംഭവമാണ്. കുട്ടികളെ രക്ഷിക്കുന്നത് അവരുടെ പിതാവല്ല, സ്ഥലത്തുണ്ടായിരുന്ന ഫോട്ടോഗ്രാഫറാണ്.          കാക്കകളുടെ എണ്ണം കളവിന്റെ തീവ്രത സൂചിപ്പിക്കുന്നു    ഒരു കാക്ക : അർദ്ധ സത്യം  രണ്ട് കാക്കകൾ : ഏറിയപങ്കും അസത്യം  മൂന്ന് കാക്കകൾ : തികച്ചും അസത്യംവസ്തുതാ  പരിശോധനക്കായി ഞങ്ങളെ ബന്ധപ്പെടാൻ ആഗ്രഹിക്കുന്നുവോ? സത്യം അറിയാൻ, ഞങ്ങളുടെ 73 7000 7000 എന്ന നമ്പറിലേക്ക് അയയ്ക്കുക.ഞങ്ങളുടെ factcheck@intoday.com  എന്ന ഇ-മെയിൽ ഐഡിയിലേക്കും  അയക്കാംTAGS: Fact Check          Advertisement          കൂടുതല്‍ വാര്‍ത്തകള്‍      Fact Check: എകെജി സെന്റര്‍ ആക്രമണ കേസില്‍ സിപിഎമ്മുകാരനെ പിടിച്ചോ? വാസ്തവമറിയാം       ഏറ്റവും പുതിയത്‌      AdvertisementPUBLICATIONSIndia TodayBusiness TodayIndia Today-HindiTIMETELEVISIONIndia Today TVAaj TakGood News TodayEVENTSAgenda AajTakIndia Today ConclaveSahitya AajTakRADIOIshq FMAajTak RadioGAMINGIndia Today GamingWorld Esports CupUSEFUL LINKSSitemapNewsPrivacy PolicyPRINTINGThomson PressWELFARECare TodayDISTRIBUTIONRate CardSYNDICATIONSHeadlines TodayWEBSITESIndia TodayIndia Today NEBusiness TodayDailyOAajTakLallantopBanglaGNTTViChowkReader’s DigestCosmopolitanHarpers's BazaarBrides TodayEDUCATIONVasant ValleyBest CollegesBest UniversitiesFollow Us On:ABOUT USCONTACT USTERMS AND CONDITIONSARCHIVESCopyright © 2025 Living Media India Limited. content: Fact Check: AKG സെന്റര്‍ ആക്രമണ കേസില്‍ CPMകാരനെ പിടിച്ചോ? Please Try Again                             മലയാളം വാർത്ത ഫാക്റ്റ് ചെക്ക്          Feedback   Fact Check: എകെജി സെന്റര്‍ ആക്രമണ കേസില്‍ സിപിഎമ്മുകാരനെ പിടിച്ചോ? വാസ്തവമറിയാം  പ്രചരിക്കുന്ന വാദം തെറ്റിദ്ധരിപ്പിക്കുന്നതാണെന്ന് ഇന്ത്യാ ടുഡേയുടെ ആന്റി ഫേക്ക് ന്യൂസ് വാര്‍ റൂം(AFWA) കണ്ടെത്തി.Fake News Card           Sreejisha Laila    തിരുവനന്തപുരം, 02 Jul 2022, (Updated 02 Jul 2022, 7:38 PM IST)                                              Follow us:സിപിഎം സംസ്ഥാന കമ്മറ്റി ഓഫിസായ എകെജി സെന്ററിലേക്ക് സ്‌ഫോടക വസ്തു എറിഞ്ഞ സംഭവം ഏറെ ചര്‍ച്ചയായ വിഷയമാണ്. കേസില്‍ ഇതുവരെ പ്രതികളെ ആരെയും അറസ്റ്റ് ചെയ്തിട്ടില്ല. ഈ സംഭവത്തെ വിമര്‍ശിച്ചും, പരിഹസിച്ചും സമൂഹമാധ്യമങ്ങളില്‍ പോസ്റ്റുകള്‍ സജീവമാണ്. അതിനിടെ പ്രതിയെ അറസ്റ്റ് ചെയ്‌തെന്നും വെഞ്ഞാറമ്മൂട് സ്വദേശിയായ സിപിഎമ്മുകാരന്‍ തന്നെയാണ് പ്രതിയെന്നുമുള്ള ഒരു വാര്‍ത്താകാര്‍ഡ് സജീവമായി പങ്കിടുന്നുണ്ട്. മീഡിയ വണ്‍ ചാനലില്‍ വന്ന വാര്‍ത്ത എന്ന രീതിയിലാണ് പോസ്റ്റ് വൈറലായിരിക്കുന്നത്.'സിപിഎം സംസ്ഥാന കമ്മിറ്റി ഓഫീസായ എ.കെ.ജി സെന്റര്‍ നിലവില്‍ സ്ഥിതി ചെയ്യുന്ന സ്ഥലം സര്‍ക്കാര്‍ പതിച്ച് നല്‍കിയ ഭൂമിയാണ്. എ.കെ.ജി സ്മാരക കമ്മിറ്റിയ്ക്ക് എ.കെ ആന്റണി സര്‍ക്കാര്‍ 1977 ല്‍ പതിച്ചു നല്‍കിയ ഭൂമിയിലാണ് ഈ മന്ദിരം നിലകൊള്ളുന്നത്. ' പോസ്റ്റിന്റെ പൂര്‍ണ്ണരൂപം താഴെ കാണാം.എന്നാല്‍, പ്രചരിക്കുന്ന വാദം തെറ്റിദ്ധരിപ്പിക്കുന്നതാണെന്ന് ഇന്ത്യാ ടുഡേയുടെ ആന്റി ഫേക്ക് ന്യൂസ് വാര്‍ റൂം(AFWA) കണ്ടെത്തി. മീഡിയ വണ്‍ ഇത്തരമൊരു വാര്‍ത്ത നല്‍കിയിട്ടില്ല.AFWA അന്വേഷണംപ്രചരിക്കുന്ന പോസ്റ്റില്‍ മീഡിയ വണ്ണിന്റെ ലോഗോ കാണാനാകുന്നുണ്ട്. എന്നാല്‍ പോസ്റ്റ് സൂക്ഷ്മമായി നിരീക്ഷിച്ചപ്പോള്‍ മീഡിയ വണ്‍ ഉപയോഗിക്കുന്ന ഫോണ്ടല്ല അക്ഷരങ്ങള്‍ക്ക് എന്ന കാര്യം വ്യക്തമാണ്. സാധാരണയായി സമൂഹമാധ്യമങ്ങളിലാണ് ഇത്തരം വാര്‍ത്താ കാര്‍ഡുകള്‍ മാധ്യമങ്ങള്‍ പങ്കിടുന്നത്. ഇതേക്കുറിച്ച് കൂടുതല്‍ അന്വേഷിക്കുന്നതിനായി മീഡിയ വണ്ണിന്റെ ഫേസ്ബുക്ക് പേജ് ഞങ്ങള്‍ പരിശോധിച്ചു. ഇപ്പോള്‍ പ്രചരിക്കുന്ന വാര്‍ത്താകാര്‍ഡിന് സമാനമായി മീഡിയ വണ്‍ നല്‍കിയ വാര്‍ത്താ കണ്ടെത്താനായി. 'എകെജി സെന്റര്‍ ആക്രമണം അക്രമിയെ ഇനിയും കണ്ടെത്താനായില്ല, ഇരുട്ടില്‍തപ്പി പൊലീസ് ' എന്നാണ് ഈ കാര്‍ഡില്‍ എഴുതിയിട്ടുള്ളത്.കൂടുതല്‍ വിശദീകരണത്തിനായി മീഡിയ വണ്‍ വെബ് ഇന്‍ചാര്‍ജ് മുഹമ്മദ് ഷാഫിയുമായി ഞങ്ങള്‍ സംസാരിച്ചു. ' ഇത് വ്യാജ വാര്‍ത്തയാണ്. ഞങ്ങള്‍ വിശദീകരണം നല്‍കിയിട്ടുണ്ട്. ' ഷാഫി ഇന്ത്യാ ടുഡേയോട് പറഞ്ഞു. ഇത് വ്യാജമാണെന്ന് വ്യക്തമാക്കി മീഡിയ വണ്‍ നല്‍കിയ വിശദീകരണ സന്ദേശം അദ്ദേഹം ഞങ്ങളുമായി പങ്കിട്ടു. ഇത് താഴെ കാണാം.അതേസമയം, എകെജി സെന്റര്‍ ആക്രമിച്ച കേസിനെപ്പറ്റിയുള്ള വിശദാംശങ്ങളും ഞങ്ങള്‍ പരിശോധിച്ചു. എകെജി സെന്ററിന് നേരെ കല്ലെറിയുമെന്ന് ഫേസ്ബുക്കില്‍ പോസ്റ്റിട്ട തിരുവനന്തപുരം അന്തിയൂര്‍ക്കോണം സ്വദേശിയെ കഴക്കൂട്ടം പൊലീസ് ചോദ്യം ചെയ്തിരുന്നു. എന്നാല്‍ ഇയാള്‍ സിപിഎമ്മുകാരനാണെന്ന് റിപ്പോര്‍ട്ടില്ല. മാത്രമല്ല ഇയാളെ അറസ്റ്റ് ചെയ്തിട്ടില്ല. കൂടാതെ പ്രതികളെ പിടിക്കാനാവാത്തത് പൊലീസിനെ സമ്മര്‍ദ്ദത്തിലാക്കിയെന്ന വാര്‍ത്തയുമുണ്ട്. Advertisementഅതായത്, ഈ വാര്‍ത്ത പ്രസിദ്ധീകരിക്കും വരെ എകെജി സെന്ററില്‍ സ്‌ഫോടക വസ്തു എറിഞ്ഞതുമായി ബന്ധപ്പെട്ട് ആരെയും പൊലീസ് അറസ്റ്റ് ചെയ്തതായി റിപ്പോര്‍ട്ടുകളില്ല.ഫാക്ട് ചെക്ക്                                           വാദം എകെജി സെന്റര്‍ ആക്രമിച്ച സംഭവത്തില്‍ വെഞ്ഞാറമ്മൂട് സ്വദേശിയായ സിപിഎമ്മുകാരന്‍ അറസ്റ്റിലായതായി മീഡിയ വണ്‍ റിപ്പോര്‍ട്ട്.നിഗമനം ഈ വാര്‍ത്താ കാര്‍ഡ് വ്യാജമാണെന്ന് മീഡിയ വണ്‍ സ്ഥിരീകരിച്ചിട്ടുണ്ട്. കൂടാതെ സംഭവവുമായി ബന്ധപ്പെട്ട് ഈ വാര്‍ത്ത പ്രസിദ്ധീകരിക്കും വരെ ആരെയും അറസ്റ്റ് ചെയ്തിട്ടില്ല.          കാക്കകളുടെ എണ്ണം കളവിന്റെ തീവ്രത സൂചിപ്പിക്കുന്നു    ഒരു കാക്ക : അർദ്ധ സത്യം  രണ്ട് കാക്കകൾ : ഏറിയപങ്കും അസത്യം  മൂന്ന് കാക്കകൾ : തികച്ചും അസത്യംവസ്തുതാ  പരിശോധനക്കായി ഞങ്ങളെ ബന്ധപ്പെടാൻ ആഗ്രഹിക്കുന്നുവോ? content: There is no GST on using toilets; the posted receipt was called ‘fake’ by related authorities in 2017 itself A photo of a receipt is being shared on social media with a claim that now GST is also being imposed for using toilets. The receipt is reportedly from Punjab where one extra rupee is collected as GST on a toilet usage charge of five rupees. Let’s fact-check the claim made in the post.Claim: Now there is also GST for using toilets. The photo shows a receipt as an example from Punjab. Fact: No, there is no GST on using toilets. The GST is NIL on “Services by way of public convenience such as provision of facilities of bathroom, washrooms, lavatories, urinal or toilets.” Also, the posted receipt photo is an old one that was already called ‘fake’ back in 2017 by related authorities. Hence the claim made in the post is FALSE.When we checked on the CBIC-GST website for information related to the claim made in the post, it was found that there is no GST on using toilets. It can be read that the GST is NIL on “Services by way of public convenience such as provision of facilities of bathroom, washrooms, lavatories, urinal or toilets.”The posted receipt photo is an old one. The same photo is viral on the internet since July 2017 as a receipt of the Sulabh toilet at Ludhiana Bus stand. As the photo went viral, ‘The Indian Express’ reported in 2017 that – “AK Singh, Controller of Sulabh International Social Service Organisation in Punjab, said that they don’t even have a centre at the said bus stand in Ludhiana. Gursewak Rajpal, Ludhiana bus stand manager, also agreed with Singh and said it’s fake.” Also, the extra rupee GST collected on the five rupees toilet usage charge in the posted receipt translates to 20% GST, which is not one of the GST tax slabs.To sum it up, there is no GST for using toilets. The posted receipt was called ‘fake’ by related authorities in 2017 itself.
label: truth

content: APJ Abdul Kalam hasn’t stated that Network Marketing is the fastest growing business of 21st century A quote attributed to the late former President APJ Abdul Kalam is widely shared on social media claiming that Kalam had stated that Network Marketing is the fastest growing business of 21st century. This quote attributed to Abdul Kalam reads, “Network Marketing is the final growing business of 21st century which must be joined by every young man and women globally otherwise you can never get the best of your youth age”. A few users shared a video clip of Abdul Kalam while making the same claim on social media. Let’s verify the claim made in the post.Claim: APJ Abdul Kalam’s statements praising Network Marketing. Fact: Abdul Kalam did not make any such statement stating Network Marketing as the fastest growing business of 21st century. Sharing an edited video clip of Abdul Kalam’s conversation with students on 15 August 2006, several multi-level marketing sites and their associates misled the public that APJ Abdul Kalam had recommended every young man to join Network Marketing. Hence, the claim made in the post is FALSE.When we searched to check whether former Indian President APJ Abdul Kalam had made any such statement about Network Marketing, we could not find any news reports confirming that this statement was made by Abdul Kalam. If APJ Abdul Kalam had made such a statement, several mainstream news websites would have reported that information.Several social media users shared a video clip of Abdul Kalam while making the same claim on social media. We found the extended version of this video on a Facebook page. The extended version of the video shows Abdul Kalam responding to a student’s question, “How do you assess the last four years of your Presidency?”. Responding to this question, Abdul Kalam said, “I targeted two things. Number one that India as a developed nation before 2021 mission. I will say this marketing process is going in full steam and definitely I am happy with the outcome”. Abdul Kalam mentioned the word ‘marketing’ referring to his 2021 mission campaign. The student did not pose any questions related to Network Marketing for Abdul Kalam to answer about it.The video shows Abdul Kalam’s conversation with students on Independence Day in 2006. A few other video clips from Abdul Kalam’s conversation with students on 15 August 2006 can be seen here and here. Several digital marketing and business consultancy pages published videos clarifying that Abdul Kalam had not made any such statement stating Network Marketing as the fastest growing business of 21st century.Srijan Pal Singh, the former OSD to Abdul Kalam and who co-authored several books with him, confirmed to Factly that this statement about Network Marketing was not made by former President APJ Abdul Kalam.To sum it up, APJ Abdul Kalam hasn’t stated that Network Marketing is the fastest growing business of 21st century.
label: truth

content: These 3 Hindu persons were not arrested for offering Namaz in UP’s Lulu Mall; they were arrested in a different case Update (21 JULY 2022):In a recent development on the ‘Lulu Mall’ Namaz recital incident, Lucknow police arrested four men and have taken them into custody. The names of the arrested men are Mohd Rehan, Atif Khan, Mohd Lukman Ali and Mohd Nauman Ali, of Laharpur, Sitapur. Lucknow Police though a tweet has also confirmed the arrest of the individuals.Published (19 JULY 2022):Amid the controversy around a few people offering namaz inside Lulu mall in Lucknow, and reports speculating their religious identity, a post is being widely shared on social media claiming that three Hindus were arrested for offering namaz. Few other similar posts with a police press note are also being shared. Let’s fact-check these claims.Claim: Three Hindu persons were arrested by the UP police for reciting Namaz inside the Lulu Mall. Fact: These three men, Sarojnath Yogi, Krishna Kumar Pathak, and Gaurav Goswami along with Arshad Ali were arrested by the UP police for trying to perform religious rituals in the mall on 15 July 2022. These arrests are not related to the original incident where eight persons reportedly offered namaz inside the Lulu Mall on 12 July 2022. Hence this post is MISLEADING.Upon searching the internet with relevant keywords, we found an article published in the ‘The Hindu’ related to the same incident. The report states that the UP police clarified that no non-muslims offered Namaz inside the Lulu mall.The article further reads, ‘Saroj, Krishna, and Gaurav, were allegedly trying to perform a puja while Arshad was allegedly trying to offer Namaz on the premises. Sources said the eight people who allegedly offered Namaz on 12th July were yet to be traced.’The same was reported by other media outlets too stating that the press note released by the police clarified that ‘Misleading news was circulated on social media claiming that three out of the four people arrested on 15 July 2022 were the namazis in the July 12 incident.’ The screenshot of the press note can be found in this tweet made by DCP South Lucknow.To sum it up, these 3 Hindu persons were not arrested for offering Namaz in UP’s Lulu Mall; they were arrested in a different case on a different day.

content: There is no evidence to prove that the Detox pads which are shown in this video have health benefits A post is being shared on social media with a video that shows a white pad that can reduce fat, remove toxins from the body among various other benefits. Let’s fact-check these claims.Claim: A white adhesive pad called Detox pad, which can be attached to the sole of a leg, has various health benefits like removing toxins from the body. Fact: There is no scientific evidence to prove the effectiveness of Detox pads in removing toxins from the body, which are confirmed based on independent tests. Hence the claims made in the post are FALSE.A reverse image search on Yandex with the screenshots of the video confirmed that the white pads shown in the video are known as Detox Pads. It is also understood that the marketers of Detox Pads claim that the product when attached to sole of a person’s leg, will remove harmful toxins and heavy metals from their body. It is also claimed that it causes weight loss and reduces anxiety and depression, among other benefits.To further understand the Detox pads and their benefits, we looked at scientific journals and various tests and analyses done by doctors and news organisations. We found multiple articles about the effectiveness of detox pads that counter the claims made in the video of the post. According to a research article published in imedpub.com, no scientific evidence was found which proves that the Detox pads remove harmful toxins through the feet.A Judge in the USA has banned Kinoki Foot Pads at the request of FTC. The reasons given by FTC were ‘The defendants falsely claimed to have scientific proof that the foot pads removed toxic materials from the body.’ ABC news reported that in their testing of the Detox pads, they did not find any heavy metals. NPR has performed an independent lab test in which they found no difference in the levels of metals in the used and the unused pads.The central claim made by the marketers of the Detox pads is that they turn black after use which they say indicates that the Detox pads work. To check the truth behind it, the journalists at NPR held the Detox pad over a boiling pot, and it tuned black.Stephen Barrett, M.D. author, and co-founder of the National Council Against Health Fraud, also runs quackwatch.org. He said in an article ‘The Detox foot pad scam’ that the pads turning black because of steam indicates that a chemical inside the pads causes that after it reacts with moisture. He also writes, ‘Real detoxification of foreign substances takes place in the liver…Sweat glands in the feet can excrete water and some dissolved substances. However, its minor role in ridding the body of unwanted substances is not changed by applying foot pads.’USA Today and Rappler published fact-check articles on the Detox pads debunking similar claims. More information about Detox Pads can be found in these articles (here and here).To sum it up, there is no scientific evidence to state that the Detox pads have various health benefits like removing toxins from the body and reducing body fat.
label: truth

content: This photo doesn’t show a 1895 car accident involving the only two cars in the US state of Ohio A photo is being shared on social media claiming it is a picture that shows an accident which took place between the only two cars in the US state of Ohio in 1895. Let’s verify the claim made in the post.Claim: Photo showing an 1895 car accident involving the only two cars in the US state of Ohio. Fact: The photo shared in the photo shows an accident that took place in 1932 in the Back Bay neighbourhood area of Boston in the US State of Massachusetts. This photo was captured by an American photographer named Leslie Jones. The photo does not show an 1895 car accident in the US state of Ohio. Hence, the claim made in the post is FALSE.On reverse image search of the photo shared in the post, the same photo was found in an article published by a website in 2012. This article reported it as a series of vintage photos of auto accidents in Boston between the 1920s and 1950s.When we searched for further details using these keywords, we found the same photo on the Digital Commonwealth website. This website mentioned that the photo was taken from the Boston Public Library in the US state of Massachusetts. Also, the website credited the photo to the US-based photographer Leslie Jones.On searching for further details of this photo, we found the same accident picture on the official ‘Flickr’ handle of the Boston Public Library. Leslie Jones published this photo in his ‘Accidents-Auto’ collection with the title ‘Back Bay’. According to the description of the photo, this photo was from March 1932. The same photo was found in the portfolio of Leslie Jones. The ‘Business Insider’ published a photo showing another view of the same accident with a description, “Car and truck collide, Back Bay, 1932 (Photo: Leslie Jones)”. From all these pieces of evidence, it can be confirmed that the photo shared in the post was taken in the Back Bay neighbourhood area of Boston in the US state of Massachusetts.When we searched further to check whether any such accident occurred between the only two cars in the US state of Ohio in 1895, we could not find any news reports confirming such an accident in Ohio. According to the fact-check article published by ‘Snopes’, this story probably would have originated from an advertisement for Mobile gasoline that was published in Life Magazine in 1967. But the photo included in this advertisement was different from the picture shared in the post. Also, there is no historical documentation available to confirm such an accident in Ohio.To sum it up, this photo doesn’t show an 1895 car crash involving the only two cars in the US state of Ohio.
label: truth

content: Nupur Sharma’s old speech video at the Vanvasi Kalyan Ashram in Maharashtra is shared as a recent one A video is being shared on social media claiming it was a recent speech of Nupur Sharma after her alleged controversial remarks against Prophet Muhammad. This video shows Nupur Sharma raising questions about the midnight Supreme Court hearings for terrorists, and making statements against Triple Talaq, Burqa and the marriage system in Islam. Let’s verify the claim made in the post.The archived version of the post can be seen here.Claim: Nupur Sharma’s recent speech after her alleged controversial remarks against Prophet Muhammed. Fact: The video shared in the post shows the clippings of Nupur Sharma’s old speech at the ‘Vyakhyan’ program organised by the Vanvasi Kalyan Ashram in Maharashtra. This event took place on 24 May 2018. It is not a recent video. Hence, the claim made in the post is MISLEADING.On reverse image search of the screenshots in the video, we could not find any credible sources related to this video. When we searched for the details of the video using relevant keywords on the internet, similar visuals were found in a collage of images tweeted by Nupur Sharma on 25 May 2018. Nupur Sharma’s tweet reads, “Spoke on “Women in Nationalism” at ‘Vyakhyan’ organised by Vanvasi Kalyan Ashram at Nagar, Maharashtra today. It was also a privilege to have interacted with some very enterprising Nagar women who are contributing to the society in various ways”.Spoke on “Women in Nationalism” at ‘Vyakhyan’ organised by Vanvasi Kalyan Ashram at Nagar, Maharashtra today.It was also a privilege to have interacted with some very enterprising Nagar women who are contributing to the society in various ways. pic.twitter.com/6NYx5wSwoE — Nupur Sharma (@NupurSharmaBJP) May 24, 2018When we searched for further sources using these keywords on the internet, a video showing Nupur Sharma’s speech at the ‘Vyakhyan’ program was found to be posted by a Facebook user on 24 My 2018. From 3:45 minutes of the video, we could see Nupur Sharma making the same statements as shown in the post. The video shared in the post was created by editing some portions of Nupur Sharma’s full speech at the ‘Vyakhyan’ event held in Vanvasi Kalyan Ashram.Following the protests from Muslims and Islamic countries over Nupur Sharma’s remarks on Prophet Muhammed, on 05 June 2022, the BJP suspended Nupur Sharma from the party stating that her views are contrary to the Party’s position on various matters. Following the suspension from the party, Nupur Sharma issued an apology and unconditionally withdrew her remarks on Prophet Muhammed, saying that it was not her intention to hurt anyone’s religious feelings. Amidst death and rape threats to Nupur Sharma over her comments on Prophet Muhammed, on 07 June 2022, Delhi Police granted her police security. Lately, there are no reports of her attending any public event and speaking anything about Supreme Court trials, or her views related to Islam and Hinduism.To sum it up, a video showing Nupur Sharma’s old speech at the Vanvasi Kalyan Ashram in Maharashtra is being shared as a recent one.
label: rumor

content: Scripted videos shot for informative purposes are being shared as real incidents Update (21 August 2024):Another video circulating on social media shows a man laughing at his partner’s torn skirt, while a farmer comes to her aid at a bus stand (here, here, and here). Let’s verify the claim made in the post.The Archived post can be seen here.Claim: A girl’s partner laughs at her torn skirt while a farmer helps her by offering his clothesFact: It’s a scripted video. The channel included a disclaimer in the description, stating that the video was created for entertainment and social awareness purposes. Hence, the claim made in the post is FALSE.Upon reviewing the full video, we observed that towards the end, it clearly states that the video is not real and was created solely for educational purposes. A reverse image search of the viral video’s keyframes led us to a YouTube channel named ‘3RD EYE,’ which published the same video under the title ‘A Sequence of Greatest Videos On The Internet! See What This Farmer Did At The Bus Stop.’ The video description on this channel reads, “Please be aware that this channel features scripted dramas and parodies to raise awareness about different situations. These short films are intended for entertainment purposes only!” This channel has produced many similar scripted videos (here, here, and here).Update (20 October 2023):Another video is being shared on social media claiming it shows visuals of a couple harassing a woman imprisoned in a cage. Let’s verify the claim made in the post.Claim: Video of two people assaulting a woman imprisoned in a cage.Fact: The video shared in the post is a scripted one. The video was made for entertainment and educational purposes. The video does not show a real incident. Hence, the claim made in the post is False.On observing the video carefully, towards the end of the video, one could see a disclaimer at the bottom of the video. The disclaimer displayed in the video states- “The content made in this video should be considered for entertainment purpose only. Information contained herein is not intended to be source of advice or credit analysis with respect to the information presented.” There are many such scripted videos published by a few digital creators on social media. A few of those videos can be seen here and here. Though we could not ascertain the original creator of the video, it can be concluded that the video shows a scripted drama, but not a real incident as claimed in the post.Update (05 October 2023):Another video is being shared on social media claiming it is the visuals of a man demonstrating the hazardous properties of cool drinks. The video shows a man keeping eggs inside a pot and filling it with Coca-Cola. The man extracted egg yolks without the outer layer a few minutes after dipping Coco-Cola and Mentos gums into the pot. Let’s verify the claim made in the post.Claim: Video of a man demonstrating an experiment with eggs, mentos Coco-Cola. Fact: The video shared in the post is a scripted one. A Facebook page named Social Message published many such scripted videos for public awareness purposes. Beverages have no such properties as taking out the outer layer of the egg without boiling. Hence, the claim made in the post is False.On reverse image search of the screenshots of the video, a video with similar visuals was found published by a Facebook page named ‘Social Message’. This Facebook page published the video describing it as a demonstration of removing the peel of an egg using cool drinks. In the Intro description of the ‘Social Message’ Facebook handle, they mentioned that they create scripted videos for public awareness purposes. This Facebook page published many such unrealistic experiment videos on its handle. Beverages have no such properties as taking out the outer layer of the egg without boiling.Update (03 October 2023):Another video is being shared on social media claiming that the visuals show a driver attempting to escape in his car while a civic police volunteer steering the car with his hand. As per the post, the driver allegedly attempted to flee when a civic police volunteer tried to take out the keys of the car for breaking rules. A few users shared the same video mentioning that the video is from West Bengal.However, on reverse image search of the screenshots of the video shared in the post, we found an article revealing the details of the video. This news site reported it as a scripted video created by a comedy page named “Comedy Processing Unit”. ‘Doinandin News’ and many other news channels too confirmed it as a scripted drama. The members who created the video issued a clarification stating that the video was a scripted drama and said they had deleted the video from their channel.This Facebook page published many such scripted videos on Facebook and on their YouTube channel. A disclaimer provided in one of the video states- “This video is made for only entertainment purpose. All characters and events depicted in this film rely fictious. Any similarity to actual events or living or dead is purely coincidental.”Update (20 September 2023):A video showing a farmer administering unknown substances to crops is circulating, accompanied by a claim that farmers are injecting harmful chemicals into the plants. This video is being shared as a warning to inform people about such incidents.The viral video is actually a segment taken from a scripted video created for the purpose of raising awareness. After conducting a keyword search, we discovered a Facebook page that shared the extended version of the viral video. The video’s description on this page clarifies that it is scripted and was produced to educate people about the use of yield-enhancing drugs for crops. Additionally, in the introduction section of the page, it explicitly states, “All the videos posted on this page are fully scripted, created for the sole purpose of spreading awareness.”Furthermore, this page contains numerous other scripted videos designed to inform the public. This evidence solidifies the fact that the viral footage does not depict a real incident but rather a carefully scripted one.Update (13 September 2023):Another video shows a woman customer insulting a physically handicapped delivery person by throwing away the food he brought. Let’s verify the claim made in the post.A reverse image search of the viral video led us to the original video published on the YouTube channel ‘3RD EYE’ on 01 April 2023. However, in the video description, the channel states that it features scripted dramas and parodies of aware people in different situations. Moreover, at the end of the video, a disclaimer clarifies that it is reel footage created for the purpose of educating the public and not a real-life incident.Update (06 September 2023):A video is being shared on social media, which shows a young girl married to a relatively older man. The text on the video describes the girl as a gold digger. Let’s verify the authenticity of this video through this article.Firstly, we observed two watermarks on the video: one is ‘Prajapatixyzfact’, and the other is ‘Credit: Sachin Sharma Video.’ Taking these as hints, we performed a keyword search on the internet to find more details about the video. This led us to the Facebook pages under their respective names (Prajapatixyzfact and Sachin Sharma Video). Both pages upload videos made for entertainment purposes. We could not find the original video on Sachin Sharma’s page and his YouTube channel. But, we noticed that the same people featured in the viral video also appeared in several other videos he uploaded. The old man is seen in these videos (here, here, and here). The girl is featured in these videos (here, here, and here).All this clearly indicates that the viral video of the young girl getting married to a relatively older man is also a scripted video.Update (18 August 2023):A video is being shared on social media claiming that it shows visuals of an old man marrying a young girl. Let’s verify the claim made in the post.On reverse image search of the screenshots of the video and by using relevant keywords, the same video was found published on a Facebook page named ‘Comedy Entertainment’. This Facebook page published the video on 12 July 2023. ‘Comedy Entertainment’ published many such similar scripted dramas using the same actors as seen in the video. A few such scripted videos published on Comedy Entertainment Facebook page can be seen here and here.Update (07 August 2023):A video of traffic police making a man pay compensation to a street-side food vendor after his wife spills a food container is being shared on social media, praising the act of the Traffic police. Let’s check the veracity of this video through this fact-checking article.Upon clearly going through the footage, we have observed a few similarities (the blinking red circle, and red arrow, the time code on the top right, and the yellow with black-bordered font) with videos made by a YouTube channel named ‘3rd Eye,’ which we debunked earlier when they were shared as real videos. 3rd Eye makes scripted videos for entertainment purposes (find this disclaimer in this video).Taking this as a hint, we looked for this video on 3rd Eye’s official YouTube channel and Facebook but could not find it. But, during this search, we found that the actors in the viral video are also in some of the other videos produced by 3rd Eye. We can find them here, here, and here. They also made a sketch similar to the viral video in which the couple playing the tole of vendors are featured along with the man who pays them money in it. You can find them on the right-side screengrab in the following collage.This makes it clear that the viral video is a scripted drama featuring actors who frequently appear in 3rd Eye’s videos and is being falsely shared as a real one on social media.Update (13 July 2023):Due to the recent sharp increase (in 2023) in tomato prices, a video depicting a man smuggling tomatoes cleverly concealed within the bandages wrapped around his leg has gained significant traction. The video captures the moment when the police unveil the truth by cutting the bandage.Upon careful observation of the viral video, at 2:55 time stamp, we found a disclaimer that states that it is a scripted video, made for entertainment purposes. This makes it clear the visuals do not depict any real incident.Further, we traced the roots of the original video on a Facebook page called ‘Social Junction’, on which the same video was uploaded on 04 July 2023. Even this video carried a disclaimer at the same time stamp stating that it is a fictitious video. The intro section of this page reads “The videos posted on this page are scripted, made for the purpose of awareness”. And there are multiple such scripted videos shared on this page. Hence, this establishes that the viral visuals are not related to a real incident but are shot for entertainment purposes.Update (12 July 2023):A video of an alleged marriage of an old man with a relatively young woman is being shared on social media. It is claimed that this video shows a twisted tale of Nikah Halala. In Islam, a man cannot remarry his ex-wife after their divorce unless she marries someone else and gets a divorce. This video is being circulated with a claim that it shows a Nikah Halala, which is a marriage done under a pre-agreement that the man who marries a woman will divorce her so that she can remarry her ex-husband. In the viral video, it is claimed that the ex-husband of the woman seen in this video asked his grandfather to marry her (a Nikah Halala wedding), but the woman preferred the old man instead of her ex-husband.Firstly, we observed that the language spoken in the video is Bengali. Taking this as a hint, we performed a search on the internet which led us to a video titled ‘Halala – Bangladeshi Muslims! Grandfather Married Grandson’s Wife!’ which is almost the same length as the viral clip. A further search by including “Bangladesh” in the keywords in Bangla led us to the full version of the viral clip uploaded on a YouTube channel named ‘Sharmin Shakil’ in November 2022. The visuals in the viral video appear at the 7:10 mark.Based on the video’s description in Bangla, this is a video made for the sake of entertainment. Sahil mentioned in the description that the stories of his channel are taken from real life and that they are not responsible if it matches anyone’s life. This clearly means that they make these videos for entertainment purposes. Moreover, the male actor who plays the husband in this video is also seen in a few other videos uploaded on the same channel (here and here). This makes it clear that a scripted video is being shared as an actual incident.Update (27 June 2023):Another video is being shared on social media in which a seemingly odd couple is seen speaking with a man behind the camera. The man in the video is allegedly a Hindi school teacher of the young girl. According to the video description, the girl is three months pregnant with his child. Let’s verify this claim through this article.We searched the internet to learn more details about the video, which led us to a Facebook video uploaded by a video creator named Sourabh Verma. This is a longer version of the viral clip, which is 7 minutes and 26 seconds long. In the introduction section of his page, Sourabh mentioned, ‘Only Entertainment Purpose,’ indicating that he creates fictional content for entertainment. This reasoning was further solidified when we looked at Sourabh’s YouTube channel, which has 103K subscribers. There, he uploads similar content.Furthermore, we found the same couple in another video with a similar concept on a channel named Kausar Khan. According to the channel description, Kausar creates comedy and prank videos. In this video, the girl is seen wearing a different school uniform. A disclaimer stating that this video was made purely for entertainment purposes appears at the 27-second mark. With this evidence, we can conclude that the viral video is fictional and does not depict an actual incident.Update (11 May 2023):A video showcasing a brawl at a wedding is gaining significant traction on social media. It is accompanied by allegations that the father-in-law assaulted his son-in-law with slippers, sparked by the latter’s demand for a motorcycle as dowry. Let’s verify the claim made in the post.By conducting a reverse image search using keyframes from the viral video, we were able to trace the original footage. This full video, featuring identical visuals, was uploaded on the ‘Maithili Bazar’ YouTube channel on 08 May 2021. The channel characterises itself as a platform for comedy and entertainment. Furthermore, the video description provides the names of the artists featured in this short film. Consequently, it’s evident that the viral video is a staged performance, not a depiction of a real-life incident.Update (17 April 2023):A video is going viral on social media in which a police officer can be seen confronting a group of young people who, according to him, were drinking alcohol in a cool drink bottle. Let’s verify the authenticity of this video through this article.However, this is a scripted video. Performing a keyword search on the internet led us to a 2-minute 20-sec version of the same video in which the cop refers to himself as ‘Amar Kataria.‘ Taking this as a hint, we looked for Amar Kaaria’s social media profiles on the internet and found his Facebook page, which has around 67K followers. Amar uploaded a longer version of the viral video on this page on 4th April 2023. It matched with the viral video from 3:39 seconds to 4:09 seconds. It is mentioned in the description of the video that it is a scripted video which is made to generate social awareness.Update (10 April 2023):A video of a woman and an army officer making a politician to place the national flag on his car correctly is being shared on social media as an actual incident.Upon performing a keyword search, we found an extended version of the viral clip published by a Facebook page called ‘STVnewes’ in August 2022. We realised this video could be a scripted one made by a YouTube channel named ‘3rd Eye.’ They make scripted videos (here) to bring awareness among the common public. In the past, the videos produced by 3rd Eye were shared as real incidents and Factly debunked them. The Rec. text, the red arrow and the cam timer looked similar to the videos ‘3rd Eye’ generally produces. We took these as hints, searched their YouTube Channel, and found the video on it, which was uploaded on 17 Aug 2022. This video even carries a disclaimer at the end, which says it is fictional.Update (17 March 2023):A video of a man thrashing a burqa clad man , accusing him of child theft is being widely circulated. The video is being shared with a communal spin, as it shows areal incident.However, the viral video does not show any real incident, but a scripted video, shot with actors. Reverse image search of the screenshots of the viral video, led us to YouTube short video on a channel titled ‘Ankur Jatuskaran Vlog’. This channel contains multiple videos of the same man, who can be seen thrashing the burqa clad man in the viral video. In most of these videos, he can be seen thrashing other people.Further, he shared a full-length video on one of his Facebook page. This video contains a clear disclaimer stating that is a fictional work done for entertainment purpose.Upon analysing the content made available on these YouTube channels and Facebook pages, it appears that this channel could be uploading videos shot with the help of actors. The viral video could be one such creation, made for informative purpose.Another YouTube channel of the same person, with 1.3 million subscribers, also uploaded similar scripted videos. Thus, it can be concluded that, the viral visuals do not show any real incident but a scripted drama.Update (14 March 2023):A video purportedly showing a beggar slapping a police officer and fleeing the scene is being shared widely on social media as a genuine incident. Let’s verify the authenticity of the claim made in the video.Upon careful examination, we discovered that the video includes a credit that reads “Written & Directed by Anurag Shukla” at the end, which suggests that it is a short film. Additionally, the Facebook page that initially shared the video has posted various short videos on different topics, and their channel description states, “Team Anurag We have created our videos with a purpose to make people laugh and be stress-free.” Given that numerous social media users are sharing a scripted video as a real incident, this post is misleading.Update (13 March 2023):A video, in which two girls can be seen burning the clothes of a beggar is being shared as if the visuals show a true incident.This video of girls burning the clothes of a beggar is going viral on social media. The video shows, how a girl misconstrued a beggar for a thief and burnt his clothes in anger only to realise later that the beggar tried to return her money. However, the video does not show any real incident, but is a scripted video made for informative purpose. At the end of the video, there is a clear display of a disclaimer, stating the same. Despite this disclaimer, social media users are sharing the video as a real incident.Update (13 February 2023):Another video is being shared on social media claiming it to show visuals of an Ayyappa devotee rescuing a Muslim woman from eve teasers at a bus stop. Let’s verify the claim made in the post.Claim: Video of an Ayyappa devotee rescuing a Muslim woman from eve teasers. Fact: The video shared in the post is a scripted one. The video was created by ‘Eagle Eye’ YouTube channel for entertainment and educational purposes. Hence, the claim made in the post is False.On reverse image search of the screenshots of the video and by searching using relevant keywords on the internet, a video with similar visuals was found published by ‘Eagle Eye’ YouTube channel on 03 April 2022. This YouTube channel described it as a motivational video created to portray how Muslims and Hindus can live together. A disclaimer provided in the video description states, “Thank you for watching! Please be aware that this Channel features scripted dramas and parodies as well. These short films are for entertainment & educational purposes only!”Update (27 December 2022):Another video is being shared on social media claiming it as visuals of an old man marrying a young girl. Let’s verify the claim made in the post.Claim: Video of an old man marrying a young girl. Fact: The video shared in the post is a scripted one. A prankster named Karan Kotnala published this video and provided a disclaimer informing it to be a scripted video created for entertainment purposes. The video does not show a real incident. Hence, the claim made in the post is FALSE.On reverse image search of the screenshots of the video, a video with similar visuals was found published by a YouTube channel named Karan Kotnala. An 8:13 minutes extended version of the video was published on this YouTube channel describing it as visuals of a 62-year-old man marrying a 17-year-old girl. At 0:38 minutes of the video, one could see a disclaimer informing it was a scripted video created for entertainment purposes. Karan Kotnala described himself as a prankster and a video creator on his social media handles. Several scripted and prank videos were found published on Karan Kotnala’s YouTube channel. A few of them can be seen here and here. From all these pieces of evidence, it can be concluded that the video is scripted and does not show a real incident.Update (19 December 2022):Another video is being shared on social media titled ‘a 52-year-old lady marries a 21-year-old young boy.’ This is being shared as love marriage. Let’s fact-check this claim through this article.Claim: A love marriage between a young 21-year-old boy and a 52-year-old woman. Fact: The visuals shared in the post are from a scripted video. An Instagram page called ‘techparesh’ has published many more such scripted videos related to weddings. The people who appear as a couple in this video have also acted as couples to other people in other scripted videos uploaded on ‘techparesh’. Hence, the claim made in the post is FALSE.We ran a reverse image search using a few keyframes from the viral video. This led us to a YouTube post containing the same video. This video was credited to an Instagram handle, ‘techparesh’. ‘techparesh’ uploaded this video on 03 December 2022. Many such videos related to weddings have been uploaded on this page.The people who appeared as a couple in the viral video have also posed as couples to other people in some other videos published by the ‘techparesh‘ Instagram page. Hence, it is certain that the visuals shared in the post is from a scripted video.Update (12 December 2022):Another post sharing a video link claims it to be visuals of a beggar misbehaving with a woman on the road. Let’s verify the claim made in the post.Claim: Video of a beggar misbehaving with a woman. Fact: The link provided in the post is a clickbait. The video shared in the linked article is a scripted drama created for educational and entertainment purposes by the ‘Eye Focus’ YouTube channel. The video does not show a real incidents. Hence, the claim made in the post is FALSE.Upon watching the full video carefully, one could see that the mad beggar was not seen misbehaving with any woman in the video. The video shows a little school-going girl rescuing a beggar from a boy teasing him. The video was published by the ‘Eye Focus’ YouTube channel with the title, “SALUTE TO THIS LITTLE GIRL”, with a hashtag “#Social Awareness”. A disclaimer provided towards the end states, “Please be aware that this Channel features scripted dramas and parodies to Aware People in Different Situations. This Channel Brings Social Awareness Videos. These short films are for entertainment purposes only!” From this, it can be concluded that the video shared in the post is scripted and does not show a real incident.Update (07 December 2022):Another video is being shared on social media claiming it is the CCTV footage exposing a beggar faking as a handicapped man with no legs. This video shows a man removing his fake attire as a beggar and escaping on a vehicle after finishing his work. Let’s verify the claim made in the post.Claim: CCTV footage exposing a fake handicapped beggar. Fact: The video shared in the post is a scripted one. At the end of this video shared in the post, a disclaimer was provided stating it was a video created for entertainment and educational purposes. Hence, the claim made in the post is FALSE.On observing the video carefully, one could see a disclaimer at the end few seconds of the video. The disclaimer provided in the video states, “The reel life video footage published only for the purpose of educating the public by making them understand how the real world situations will be and picturized to educate public. Characters in this video are entertainment and education purposes.” A few other Facebook users have also shared this 3:17-minute scripted video on their Facebook page. Also, the same video can be found on the ‘3RD EYE’ YouTube channel, which regularly posts scripted videos.Update (29 MARCH 2022):A video of a family being helped by two army men is being shared widely on social media. In the video, the army men can be seen offering their bike to the stranded family. People are believing that the visuals show a real incident. Let’s fact-check the claim made in the post.Claim: Video of army men helping a stranded family by giving them their bike. Fact: The posted video is a scripted one. In the extended version of the video, there is a disclaimer at the end saying that it was made for educational purposes. Hence the claim made in the post is FALSE.The extended version of the same video can be found to be uploaded by actress Hamsa Nandini on her official Facebook page in March 2021. In that video, there is a disclaimer at the end saying that it was made for educational purposes. She also wrote the following in the description – “Please be aware that this page features scripted dramas and parodies as well. These short films are for entertainment & educational purposes only!”. A similar scripted video from the same location can be seen here.Update (23 MARCH 2022):A video of two children helping a fruit seller move her cart uphill is being shared widely on social media. Many people are believing that the visuals show a real incident. Let’s fact-check the claim made in the post.Claim: Video of two children helping a fruit seller move her cart uphill. Fact: It is a scripted video. The extended version of the video has a disclaimer at the end saying that it was made for educational purposes. Hence the claim made in the post is FALSE.Actress Poonam Bajwa has posted the extended version of the same video on her official Facebook page. At the end of the video, there is a disclaimer saying that it was made for educational purposes. Also, in the description, it was written – “Thank you for watching! Please be aware that this page features scripted dramas and parodies as well. These short films are for entertainment & educational purposes only!”. The same video can be also found on the ‘3RD EYE’ YouTube channel, which regularly posts scripted videos.Update (11 MARCH 2022):Another similar video is being shared on social media with the tag – ‘Respect Army’. However, we found the same video on the ‘3RD EYE’ YouTube channel, which regularly posts scripted videos for social awareness. This video was also posted with the title – “THIS IS HEART TOUCHING💖🙏 | Army Person Helped alone Girl | Social Awareness Video By 3rd Eye“. So, it is also a scripted video.Published (08 MARCH 2022):Of late, many videos are being shared on social media with a claim that they show CCTV visuals of real incidents. Most of them are shared with generic titles like – ‘Respect Women’, ‘Respect Army’. They have been viewed and liked by millions of users on social media. In the comments section of videos, one can see that the people are believing them to be real incidents. Let’s fact-check the claims made in the posts.Post 1:Claim: Video of an army man helping a woman by changing her car tyre. Fact: It is a scripted video. The video does not show a real incident. Hence the claim made in the post is FALSE.At the bottom of the video, it can be seen that it is written – ‘COPYRIGHT BY 3RD EYE’. The extended version of the same video can be found on the ‘3RD EYE’ YouTube channel. In the title, it is written that it is a social awareness video. Also, at the end of the video, there is a disclaimer saying – “This reel life video footage published only for the purpose of educating the public by making them understand how the real-world situations will be and picturized to educate public. Characters in this video are entertainment and education purpose.” Many such scripted videos can be seen on the ‘3RD EYE’ YouTube channel.Post 2:Claim: Video of a burqa-clad woman helping another woman who was having periods on road. Fact: This video was also posted by the ’3RD EYE’ YouTube channel with a disclaimer. It is a scripted video. Hence the claim made in the post is FALSE.The extended version of the same video can be seen on the ’3RD EYE’ YouTube channel with the same disclaimer as above.Other posts:Previously, when similar scripted videos were shared as real incidents, FACTLY debunked those videos and written fact-check articles, which can be read below:To sum it up, scripted videos shot for informative purposes are being shared as real incidents.

content: This photo of BJP leaders is from the recent BJP Parliamentary party meeting in Delhi, not from Goa A photo is being shared on social media claiming it is a picture of BJP leaders partying in Goa. This photo shows BJP Telangana leader G. Kishan Reddy posing along with Shandilya Giriraj Singh, Kailash Choudhary and other BJP leaders. Comparing this image with a few other pictures showing TRS party leaders interacting with the flood victims, this post claims it as the difference between the BJP and the TRS when it comes to the concern over the flood victims. Let’s verify the claim made in the post.The archived version of the post can be seen here.Claim: Recent photo of BJP leaders partying in Goa while many parts of the country are reeling in floods. Fact: The photo shared in the post was captured during the recent BJP Parliamentary party meeting held on 16 July 2022, in New Delhi. The photo does not show BJP leaders in Goa. Hence, the claim made in the post is MISLEADING.When we searched for this photo using relevant keywords on the internet, we found the same photo on the official Twitter handle of BJP leader and Union Minister G. Kishan Reddy. Kishan Reddy tweeted this photo describing it as a selfie taken with Shandilya Giriraj Singh, Kailash Choudhary, SS Ahluwalia and other prominent BJP leaders during the BJP Parliamentary party meeting held on 16 July 2022, in New Delhi.With Hon’ble Ministerial & MP colleagues Shri @girirajsinghbjp ji, Shri @KailashBaytu ji, Shri @SSAhluwaliaMP ji at the @BJP4India Parliamentary party meeting in New Delhi. pic.twitter.com/dACSBkIwDN — G Kishan Reddy (@kishanreddybjp) July 16, 2022BJP MP SS Ahluwalia retweeted this tweet by Kishan Reddy. Several other BJP leaders who participated in the BJP Parliamentary Party meeting have also shared the pictures taken by them at the meeting. They can be seen here, here and here. A photo tweeted by BJP MP Pratap Simha shows the same visuals of Shandilya Giriraj Singh and Kailash Choudhary sitting together in the last row of the meeting hall.Amid the ongoing continuous & heavy rainfall in several parts of Telangana, BJP leaders Bandi Sanjay and Dharmapuri Aravind have also visited rain-affected regions and interacted with the flood victims.Visited Charlabhutkur village in my Constituency & inquired about problems people were facing due to rains. Urged people to be more careful as it is raining incessantly. pic.twitter.com/00ZTV15vnR — Bandi Sanjay Kumar (@bandisanjay_bjp) July 12, 2022To sum it up, a photo taken during the BJP Parliamentary Party meeting in Delhi is shared as BJP leaders partying in Goa while many parts of the Telangana are reeling under floods.

content: Video of a couple falling into a drain in Aligarh is being shared as that from Siliguri, West Bengal A video which shows a couple riding a two-wheeler falling into a drain is being shared widely on social media claiming that the incident occurred in Siliguri, West Bengal. Let’s verify the claim made in the post.Claim: Video of a couple on two-wheeler falling into a drain is from Siliguri, West Bengal. Fact: This incident took place in Aligarh, Uttar Pradesh on 18 June 2022. A couple fell into an inundated drain while visiting a hospital. Locals rescued them and the couple sustained minor injuries. Hence, the claim made in the post is MISLEADING.We searched the web with relevant keywords and found several news articles reporting the same incident. They can be seen here, here and here. According to these articles, a cop named Dayanand Singh, and his wife fell into an inundated drain in Aligarh while visiting a hospital on 18 June 2022.An interview with Dayanand Singh can be seen here. Dayanand explains how he and his wife along with the bike on which they were travelling fell into the drain during their visit to a hospital. Dayanand states that people nearby helped them come out of the drain but both him and his wife had sustained some injuries.To sum it up, video of a couple falling into a drain in Aligarh, Uttar Pradesh is shared as that from Siliguri, West Bengal.

content: Video of giant waves sweeping away people in Oman beach is being linked to Mumbai’s Bandra beach A video is being shared on social media claiming it as recent visuals of two women being washed away by strong waves in Mumbai’s Bandra beach. A few other social media users have posted this video mentioning it as an incident that took place at a seacoast in Maharashtra or Gujarat. Let’s verify the claim made in the post.Claim: Video of two women being washed away by deadly waves on Mumbai’s Bandra beach. Fact: The video shared in the post shows a recent incident that took place at the Salalah Al Mughsail beach in Oman. On 10 July 2022, eight members of an expat Indian family were swept away by high tides on Salalah Al Mughsail beach. Five people reportedly lost their lives in this tragic accident. The incident did not take place at the Bandra beach in Maharashtra. Hence, the claim made in the post is FALSE.On reverse image search of the screenshots in the video, a video with similar visuals was found in a tweet made by ‘Al Arabiya’ news channel on 12 July 2022. ‘Al Arabiya’ reported it as visuals of giant waves sweeping away eight members of a family at the Salalah Al Mughsail beach in Oman. The tweet states, “Watch: A family is swept away by a giant wave on #Oman’s Mughsail beach after eight members reportedly crossed the beach’s boundary fence”.Watch: A family is swept away by a giant wave on #Oman's Mughsail beach after eight members reportedly crossed the beach's boundary fence.https://t.co/2KHqOMobdD pic.twitter.com/w2auuYfUku — Al Arabiya English (@AlArabiya_Eng) July 12, 2022Reporting the details of the tragic incident, ‘Al Arabiya’ and a few other Arab news websites published articles. They can be seen here, here and here. According to these reports, on 10 July 2022, eight members of an expat Indian family were swept away by high tides on Salalah Al Mughsail beach. The family is reportedly from Maharashtra and have been living in Dubai. As per the latest news reports, five people lost lives in this tragic accident.Several Indian news websites have also published articles and videos reporting this tragic accident that took place in Oman. A few of these news reports can be seen here and here. From all these pieces of evidence, it can be concluded that the video shared in the post shows a tragic accident that took place in Oman, not at the Bandra beach in Maharashtra.To sum it up, a video showing deadly waves sweeping away people in Oman beach is shared as women drowning in Mumbai’s Bandra beach.
label: truth

content: This purported Google Pay website alluring cash rewards up to 1999 is fraudulent A link of a purported ‘Google Pay’ website is being shared on social media claiming that Google Pay was offering rewards up to 1999 upon scratching a reward card displayed on this website. Let’s verify the claim made in the post.The archived version of the post can be seen here.Claim: A purported website of Google Pay alluring cash rewards up to 1999 rupees. Fact: The website link shared in the post is a fraudulent one. After scratching the reward card, when you click the blue button provided on this website, it will direct you to the Google Pay application on your mobile and ask you to pay the reward amount to an unknown bank account. Google Pay or any other digital wallets will not ask their customers to pay money or enter a UPI pin for accepting money or receiving cash rewards. Hence, the claim made in the post is FALSE.This purported online website link shared by multiple users on social media is not the official website link of ‘Google Pay’. Google Pay did not announce any such rewards on its official website. Google Pay is a digital wallet and online payment platform that enables users to make in-person contactless payments using mobile phones, in-store, and on supported websites, tablets and watches. The UPI transactions on Google Pay are completely online. Google Pay does not ask their customers to collect cash rewards physically in their banks.Upon scratching the reward card displayed on this purported ‘Google Pay’ website, we could see a reward amount revealed inside this scratch card. After scratching the reward card, when you click the ‘CLAIM YOUR REWARD IN BANK’ button provided on this website, it will direct you to the ‘Google Pay’ application on your mobile and ask you to pay the same reward money displayed in the scratch card to an unknown bank account.Google Pay or any other digital wallets will not ask their customers to pay money or enter a UPI pin for accepting money or for receiving cash rewards. Describing the scam of these purported websites of Google Pay, a few bloggers published videos on their Facebook pages in 2020. From all these pieces of evidence, it can be concluded that the purported Google Pay website alluring rewards up to 1999 is a fraudulent one. Also, ‘Google Pay’ official Twitter handle has also responded to a few tweets that described these fraudulent websites.Thanks for reaching out! Here's something that might help if you’re a possible victim of fraud ➡️ https://t.co/hpMISRuwat. Appreciate it. – Saira — Google Pay India (@GooglePayIndia) July 15, 2022To sum it up, this purported Google Pay website link alluring cash rewards up to 1999 is a fraudulent one.
label: truth

content: The man circumambulating around Kedarnath temple in this video is Kedarnath temple priest Santosh Trivedi, not PM Modi A video is being widely shared on social media claiming it as the visuals of PM Narendra Modi circumambulating around the Kedarnath temple when he was 26 years old. Let’s verify the claim made in the post.The archived version of the post can be seen here.Claim: Video showing the visuals of PM Narendra Modi circumambulating around the Kedarnath temple. Fact: The man circumambulating around the Kedarnath temple in the video is Kedarnath temple priest Santosh Trivedi, not PM Narendra Modi. Protesting the Uttarakhand government’s decision of enacting the Char Dham Devasthanam Management Board act, Santosh Trivedi circumambulated the Kedarnath Temple on his hands. The video has nothing to do with PM Narendra Modi. Hence the claim made in the post is FALSE.On reverse image search of the screenshots in the video, a video with similar visuals was found published by a Facebook page named ‘Sri Kedarnath Jyothirling’, on 23 June 2021. This Facebook page reported it as the visuals of a Kedarnath priest circumambulating around the Kedarnath temple. Reporting the same, a few other YouTube channels have also published the same videos in 2021. They can be seen here and here.When we searched for further sources on the internet, we found a similar video in an article published by the ‘ETV Bharat’ news website on 21 June 2021. ‘ETV Bharat’ reported that the man circumambulating in the video was Kedarnath temple priest Santosh Trivedi. Protesting the Uttarakhand government’s decision of enacting the Char Dham Devasthanam Management Board act, Santosh Trivedi circumambulated around the Kedarnath Temple on his hands. A few other news articles that reported Kedarnath priests’ protest against setting up of the Char Dham Devasthanam Management Board can be seen here and here.While receiving the first copy of the ‘Sadhu Se Sevak’ book, written by ‘Aaj Tak’ Correspondent Manjit Negi, Narendra Modi shared his association with multiple spiritual places in Uttarakhand. Narendra Modi reportedly said he used to regularly go to Kedarnath Temple and offer water to the god when he lived in Garudchatti.To sum it up, the man circumambulating around the Kedarnath temple in the video is Kedarnath temple priest Santosh Trivedi, not PM Narendra Modi.
