content: Video of a mad lover with a knife in hand viral as “love jihadi”, read fact check A video is going viral on social media sites. By sharing this video, users are claiming that “Love Jihadi” is luring girls into their trap by intimidating them.A user named Yogi Yogesh Agarwal (Dharmsena) captioned, “Look at this! How love jihadis lure Hindu girls into their trap by intimidating them. If anyone threatens any child in this way, then there is no need to be afraid, immediately inform your family members and file a report to the police, then these people will not be able to succeed in their purpose.” and tweeted a video.In this video, it can be seen that a man with a knife in his hand is scarifying the girl and pressuring her for marriage, while the girl is seen hiding behind her friend.https://twitter.com/yogeshDharmSena/status/1552121377016057856At the same time, a user named Banty Rajput posted the same video on Facebook with the exact same caption.Similarly, the same video has been posted on other social media sites including Twitter and Facebook with a similar claim.Fact Check:Using the InVid tool, a reverse image search of some key frames of the viral video found the same video by the DFRAC team, from the Twitter handle of Nai Duniya, one of the leading newspapers in Madhya Pradesh, with the caption, “Indore Crime News: इंदौर में गर्दन उड़ाने की धमकी देकर शादी का दबाव बना रहा था सिरफिरा प्रेमी” (A girl was pressurized for marriage by a mad lover who was threatening with a knife to cut her neck in Indore, MP.) has been tweeted a video.Nayi Duniya has also published a report on July 26, 2022 which states that according to MIGTI Ajay Verma The name of the intimidator with the knife is Piyush alias Shanu son Bharat Kachhawa resident of LIG Colony. He is friends with a girl for three years and he was pressurizing her to get married because the girl had refused to marry Shanu, who runs a noodles shop. The girl refused to report to the police due to fear, although the police arrested Shanu and sent him to jail for possessing illegal weapons.Meanwhile, News18 has also covered it under the headline, ,“Indore: शादी के लिए चाक़ू की नोक पर युवती को धमकाया, सनकी आशिक गिरफ्तार” (Indore: Girl threatened at knife-point for marriage, and lover arrested.)Conclusion:This fact check of DFRAC makes it clear that there is no communal angle in the viral video, hence the sharing of the video by users as “love jihadi” is a misleading claim.Claim: How love jihadis trap Hindu girls by intimidating themClaimant: Yogi Yogesh Agarwal and other social media usersFact Check: Misleading
label: truth

content: FactCheck: Fake article on Joe Biden by the name of the Atlantic got viral A screengrab of a news article by the Atlantic is going viral on social media platforms. The heading of the article was “The quiet Courage of Biden’s Negative Growth Economy.” And, subheading was, “In an era of unchecked economic prosperity, one man had the moxie to pump the brakes to save us from ourselves.”Further, sharing the screengrab on his Twitter handle author, filmmaker, and host of the Dinesh D’Souza Podcast., Dinesh D’Souza wrote, ‘This is NOT a parody @TheAtlantic.”Similarly, Chairman of the Republican Party of Texas, Matt Rinaldi wrote, “The Atlantic: Causing poverty is stunning and brave.”Many other social media users have shared the screengrab with a similar claim.Fact CheckTo know the reality of the viral screengrab we first check the official website of the Atlantic with the related keywords but we did not find any article with the same heading.Moreover, the name of the author shown in the screengrab is Tim Nichols. We searched for him on the website but this time also we did not find any article by this author.Moreover, we also did keyword search the official Twitter account of The Atlantic(@TheAtlantic) but there is no such article present there.ConclusionTherefore, from this DFRAC fact check it is clear that there is no such article present on the site of the Atlantic. Hence, users are sharing a fake articleClaim: The quiet Courage of Biden’s Negative Growth Economy published by The AtlanticClaimed by: social media users.Fact check: Fake
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Will the tax be applied to Ganga Aarti and Pandits in Varanasi? A newspaper cutting is going viral on social media. On which it is written, “Ganga aarti and pandits will be charged.” Describing this paper cutting as recent on social media, users are claiming that tax has started on the worship of Hindus under the BJP government.A user on Facebook writes, “Tax will be imposed on the rituals of Hindus under the rule of the so-called great Hindu Hriday Samrat Shri Yogi Adityanath Ji and Shri Narendra Modi Ji….! Lawyers said it is unfair to charge pando #taxjeev.”(English Translation)Fact Check:To know the reality behind the viral claim, DFRAC reverse searched the image on Google. We found this paper cutting was shared by many users on Facebook and Twitter in the year 2020.A user on twitter writes, “@narendramodi @AmitShah @myogiadityanath @Dev_Fadnavis @OfficeofUT you all are seeing how wrong is happening It is not the fault of any Abdul when Shyam is bent on destroying his house. (English Translation)https://twitter.com/sanatanshastrii/status/1286526458987335680?s=20&t=EMOmQX_Z0ST2p1X2BaRCRAwe too found many news sites covering this report in the year 2020 like Hindustan times under the headline, “Varanasi Municipal Corporation will also charge fees from Ganga Aarti and Pandits.”(English Translation)Conclusion:The newspaper cutting going viral is of year 2020 and not from the recent year.Claim Review: tax to be applied to Ganga Aarti and Pandits in Varanasi.Claimed by: social media users.Fact Check: misleading

content: Did Ayyappa devotees chant for Allah at the Vavar mosque in Sabarimala? – Read the FactCheck A video is doing rounds on the internet with the claim that Ayyappa devotees are chanting Islamic prayers in the Vavar mosque in Sabarimala. Further, sharing the video a Twitter user Puncturewala wrote, “South India for you. These Ayyappa devotees are chanting praises for Allah at Vavar mosque in Sabarimala. The same Sabarimala where Sanghis tried to instigate riots in Kerala.”Similarly, another user gave the caption, “Culture and history is often messy. It is said that when the British first took religion and caste census many Indians did not know whether to call themselves Hindu or Muslim. Ayyappa devotees are chanting praises for Allah at Vavar mosque in Sabarimala.”Culture and history is often messy. It is said that when the British first took religion and caste census many Indians did not know whether to call themselves Hindu or Muslim.Ayyappa devotees are chanting praises for Allah at Vavar mosque in Sabarimala. pic.twitter.com/w7xS33bsNH — दिल्ली दूर नहीं (@DelhiIsNotFar) July 29, 2022Fact CheckUsing InVID tool and reverse image search on the different frames of the video we got the original video on the YouTube channel of SBR news1. The video was uploaded on Jul 24, 2019, with the title, “La ilaha illallah ayyappa swamula songs SBR news1.The man in the video is identified as Balaji swami. We found another video with the same song on the YouTube channel of N.balajiswami ayyappaswami bhajanalu. The title of the video was “Vavar swami song. Pedana Balaji swami songs. ayyappa swami devotional songs.”https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pOiQ9OVJUeAIn the description, it was written that this is a Vavar swami song. According to Wikipedia, Vavarswami is a legendary figure from Kerala. He is the celebrated Muslim acquaintance of the Hindu deity Ayappan. There is a shrine dedicated to Vavaraswami at Sabarimala, as well as Vavaraswami’s mosque at Erumely opposite an Ayyappan temple. This shows the religious and cultural harmony in India.Further, digging into the matter we found another video on YouTube with the title, “chalasani gardens ayyapaswami padi puja HD”Then, searching chalasani gardens on google, we got a picture of the hall on the site of chalasanigardens. Moreover, the address on site was written, “Mini Bypass Road, Vatluru, Eluru, Andhra Pradesh 534002, IndiaSimilarility between the background of viral video and the chalasani gardens can be seen below.ConclusionTherefore, the viral video is not of at Vavar mosque in Sabarimala but it is of chalasani gardens. Hence, users are sharing the video with misleading claims.
label: truth

content: Know the truth behind the picture of Raghav Chada asking for water for the rights of Delhi and Haryana- Read Fact Check A picture of Raghav Chadha, a Rajya Sabha member of the Aam Aadmi Party from Punjab is going viral on social media. In the viral image, he can be seen standing in front of a Mahatma Gandhi statue outside the Parliament House.He is holding banners in both of his hands. On one of the banners, Punjabi is written stating, ‘Allow Kejriwal to go Singapore.’On another, it is written, 'Delhi and Haryana should get equal water rights.’Social media users are sharing it with the claim that Raghav is asking for water rights for the people of Delhi and Haryana.A user on Facebook shared the image and wrote, “Is the Raj Sabha member of Punjab asking for justice for the interests of Punjab? Just look at the photo.”Fact Check:DFRAC reverse searched the Image and found the same image on the official Facebook account with the caption, ‘Keep the rights of farmers here!’The official Twitter account of AAP (Aam Admi Party) also debunked the fake news under the caption, ‘FAKE NEWS ALERT BJP Congress leaders posted a fake – photoshopped image of placards held up by AAP MP @raghav_chadha Legal Action will be initiated against fake news peddlers.’FAKE NEWS ALERT ‼️BJP Congress leaders posted a fake – photoshopped image of placards held up by AAP MP @raghav_chadhaLegal Action will be initiated against fake news peddlers pic.twitter.com/7Et42RzYZg — AAP Punjab (@AAPPunjab) July 23, 2022Conclusion:The edited picture is being circulated on social media sites.Claim Review: Raghav Chada asking for water for the rights of Delhi and Haryana.Claimed by: social media users.Fact Check: misleading
label: truth

content: Pakistani politician Shireen Mazari spreads misleading news against India- Read the Fact Check Former Pakistani Federal Minister for Human Rights, Shireen Mazari of PTI posted a screengrab of a news screen of Pakistani media channel SAMAA TV on her verified Twitter account. On the news plate, it was written in Urdu which can be nearly translated into English that Imran Khan’s win is India’s loss.Further, along with the picture she wrote, “One more agenda item of US regime change conspiracy will be undone when IK with the nation behind him wins elections. Will end move towards US subservience & signal failure of conspiracy & the local conspirators & will save Pakistan. No wonder US & India fear IK & his Absolutely Not!”Soon her tweet got viral with more then four thousand retweets and seven thousand likes. Similarly, many other PTI supporters have posted this news.FactCheckOn DFRAC fact check analysis, our team found that the article of India Today which was referred in the post is old. The article was of 23 July 2018.ConclusionTherefore, the claims of the post shared by Shireen Mazari and other PTI supporters is misleading.

content: Fact-Check- Video of the bridge collapse in Madhya Pradesh got viral as Bundelkhand Expressway￼ A video is going viral on social media sites. By sharing this video, users are claiming that the Bundelkhand Expressway, which was inaugurated by Prime Minister Narendra Modi a few days ago, collapsed within a few days. By sharing this video, people are slamming PM Modi and the Yogi government of UP.Further, sharing this video, a Facebook user named, Manoj Chaudhary Lankesh wrote- “The condition of Bundelkhand Expressway … just a few days ago, Prime Minister has inaugurated this expressway. , Fake man’s fake work!!”Similarly, many other users have shared the video targeting Modi and Yogi government.Fact Check:To know the reality of the viral video, we first did a reverse image search of some of the frames of the video. On searching, we found a video uploaded on the official YouTube channel of News- 24. According to this video of News-24, it is of the damaged bridge connecting Hoshangabad-Bhopal in Madhya Pradesh , when a part of the bridge collapsed in the very first rain. This bridge was built at a cost of crores.At the same time, many other media houses have covered the Bundelkhand Expressway. The Times of India has covered it and has not used a picture of a bridge in its report. According to the report, the Bundelkhand Expressway collapsed and got damaged at some places only after the first rain.According to the report of Dainik Bhaskar, Gawar Company of Rajasthan has constructed 296 km of Bundelkhand Expressway at a cost of 14800 crores. Due to the collapse of the expressway at 195 km, on Wednesday night, many vehicles were victims of the accident. On the other hand, on the four-lane expressway moving from Jalaun to Chitrakoot, only one lane is in use.Further, Congress leader Supriya Shrinate wrote in the caption , “Development through Narmada Canal , Gujarat , Bundelkhand Expressway , Uttar Pradesh , Uttarakhand has now collapsed on the bridge of Bhopal and Hoshangabad in Madhya Pradesh. I got indigestion from Rewari , not Modi ji ? With this video has been tweeted.”(“नर्मदा नहर, गुजरात बुंदेलखंड एक्स्प्रेसवे, उत्तर प्रदेश पुल, उत्तराखंड से होता हुआ विकास अब मध्यप्रदेश में भोपाल और होशंगाबाद के पुल पर आ कर ढह गया। रेवड़ी से अपच हो गयी, नहीं मोदी जी?”)नर्मदा नहर, गुजरातबुंदेलखंड एक्स्प्रेसवे, उत्तर प्रदेशपुल, उत्तराखंडसे होता हुआ विकास अब मध्यप्रदेश में भोपाल और होशंगाबाद के पुल पर आ कर ढह गया।रेवड़ी से अपच हो गयी, नहीं मोदी जी? pic.twitter.com/ZJqbjvKWq1 — Supriya Shrinate (@SupriyaShrinate) July 25, 2022Conclusion:Hence, it is clear from this fact check of DFRAC that this video is not of Bundelkhand Expressway, but it is Mandideep bridge of National Highway connecting Bhopal-Hoshangabad in Madhya Pradesh which collapsed in first rain itself and these two different news Therefore, users are sharing this video with the misleading claim,
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Know the truth about Smriti Irani’s daughter Zoish Irani’s engagement photo Recently, Union Minister Smriti Irani and her daughter Zoish Irani have been in the news for the Goa bar controversy. He was accused of operating the bar on the basis of a fake license.Meanwhile, a picture was shared on social media claiming that Smriti Irani says that her daughter is 18 years old and is still pursuing education. But Smriti Irani shares the engagement photo of her daughter on 25 December 2021. That is, she is committing a crime by doing child marriage of the daughter and running the licensed bar in the name of the dead person.Source: FBSharing the picture, a user wrote that ‘Smriti Irani today on the clarification of her daughter says that she is just 18 years old and is taking education….! So on Saturday 25 December 2021, Smriti Irani expresses happiness by sharing her daughter’s engagement photo, it means Smriti Irani is getting her daughter married. Crime is committed both in child marriage and also in running a bar with a license in the name of a dead person. Now it is for Narendra Modi ji to think whether he will take action against Smriti Irani or not….!Source: FBFact Check:DFRAC did a reverse search image of the viral image to check the above claim. During this our team found a post on Instagram from Smriti Irani’s official account. In which the viral picture was also shared.Source: InstagramSharing the picture, she wrote, ‘This is for the man who now has our heart. Arjun Bhalla Welcome to our crazy family. Bless you for the fact that you have to deal with a madman as father-in-law and worse me as a mother-in-law. (Warning you officially) God bless you.Apart from this, we also got a report from TV9Hindi. In which it was told that Shanelle Irani, daughter of Smriti Irani, has got engaged. Smriti Irani has given this information through one of her social media posts on the evening of 25 December. Smriti Irani’s daughter Shanelle is engaged to her long-time boyfriend Arjun Bhalla.Source: TV9HindiIn the pictures shared by Smriti Irani on her Instagram, Shanel and Arjun are seen at a very beautiful location. In one of these pictures, Arjun was seen kneeling and wearing an engagement ring to Shaneel. At the same time, the second picture is a selfie, in which Shanel looked very happy with Arjun and also flaunted her engagement ring.conclusion:Hence the claim of Zoish Irani’s engagement is fake. Because the viral picture is of Shaneel Irani and Arjun Bhalla’s engagement.Claim Review: Smriti Irani’s daughter Joish Irani’s engagement picClaimant: Facebook UserFact Check: Fake
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Babasaheb did not say– reservations should be abolished after a tribal woman becomes president A graphical poster is going viral on social media. This poster has a picture of Babasaheb Dr. Bhimrao Ambedkar and a statement has been written quoting him,- “The day a tribal woman will reach the highest office of President of India. India’s reservations should be abolished. Many users are sharing this graphical poster.At the same time, there are many users who are sharing only the text written on the poster.Further, there are also some users who are demanding from the President of India Draupadi Murmu by sharing this text that reservation should be abolished.https://twitter.com/Ajay_Tiwari_/status/1551220055706181633?s=20&t=S57Fk2iSDE4DJhyfkLcvOQFact Check:We did a simple Google search to find out the reality of the viral graphical text. We could not find any such statement or article quoting Babasaheb, in which could prove that he had talked about abolishing reservation after becoming the Adivasi President.After this we contacted senior journalist and editor of ‘ Dalit Dastak ‘ magazine Ashok Das. Describing this graphical poster as fake, Ashok Das questioned that those who made such a claim by quoting Baba Saheb should also tell where did he make such a statement ? Ashok Das said that seeing the ‘surname’ of those who post such claims will one can get an idea of why this fake poster is being shared. He gives correct information in this context that Babasaheb has neither written such thing anywhere, nor has he made any such statement in any public meeting or seminar etc. So this claim is completely false.Ashok Das also said that it is not a conspiracy , because being the first from the tribal community to be elected to the highest office of the country, it becomes easy for the opponents of reservation and the opponents of the constitutional rights of the deprived sections to spread this propaganda. That now there is no need of reservation in the country. He also said that when such messages are made viral, it is not the work of any one person but it happens institutionally. Therefore, these institutions should be exposed , which keep promoting such fake content.Conclusion:Therefore, DFRAC fact check proves that the claim being made by quoting Babasaheb is completely false. Hence, the claim of social media users is fake.Claim- Babasaheb had said- reservation should be abolished after a tribal woman become presidentClaimed by– Social media usersFact Check – Fake
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Know the truth behind the viral video of police beating the people bathing in the waterfall A video of police beating the people bathing in the Waterfall is getting rounds on the internet. In the video, one can hear the sound of water and the shouting of the youths also the young people bathing in the stream below and take pictures. The police can also be seen beating the people.It is claimed in the viral video is from Anakkampoyil and Tusharagiri which is located in the Kerala state.The user on Facebook writes, “This will be the experience if you go to places like Anakkampoyil and Tusharagiri for bathing.”A similar claim was made by a user on Twitter.Fact Check:To investigate the reality of the video DFRAC heard the video and found that the language used in the video is not Malayalam, but Hindi which is not the most commonly used language in Kerala state.We too looked for any news report of the above-mentioned incident that is claimed to have taken place from Anakkampoyil and Tusharagiri, but found no reports as such.Then we reverse searched the image of the waterfall and found the same waterfall with the name Rautwadi Waterfall on Google which is located in Maharashtra.We found a report related to the same waterfall proving the incident took place in Maharashtra and not Kerala stated by News18.Conclusion:Hence, the incident took place in Maharashtra and not Kerela as being by claimed by social media users.Claim Review: Viral video of police beating the people bathing in the waterfall is from Anakkampoyil and Tusharagiri.Claimed by: social media users.Fact Check: misleading
label: truth

content: Did Panchayat Shachiv in Rewa got beaten up by BJP MLA? – Read the Fact Check A video is going viral on social media sites. Users are sharing this and claiming that when the “Panchayat Secretary” did not give the part in the Rewa district of Madhya Pradesh, the BJP leader beat him up. Sharing, the video Facebook user Rakesh Patel wrote, “Rewa, M.P, the “Panchayat Secretary” did not give his share of money, then the BJP MLA beat up and punished him.”( “म.प्र. रीवा में “पंचायत सचिव” ने हिस्सा नहीं पहुंचाया तो भाजपा के जोशीले नेता जी ने धून दिया,, पंचायत सचिव को उठक बैठक लगवाई और मुर्गा बनाकर रखा।।” )Similarly, many other users have posted the video with the similar claim.Originally tweeted by Rana Yashwant (@RanaYashwant1) on April 24, 2022.Fact Check :On reverse image search of some frames of the video going viral, we found several reports published by different media houses regarding this video.Etv Bharat has published a report on 17th April 2022 with the headline, “Young man was cocked and thrashed with police sticks, video viral”.Further, DFRAC team also fund a tweet from the official Twitter account of Shahjahanpur Police that, “Mr. Sanjay Kumar, Additional Superintendent of Police, Nagar, regarding “the video of a person beating another person with a stick went viral and action” in the Sadar Bazar police station.”Further, Dainik Bhaskar has covered it the incident under the headline, “Police could not reach Dabang who beat up young man: The man who tweeted video of beating in Shahjahanpur, police is seeking information from him”.Conclusion :Therefore, his fact Check From that the viral Video is old. And, this incident is not of the Rewa district og Madhya Pradesh but of Shahjahanpur, U.P . Hence, the claims of the users is misleadingClaim : Panchayat Shachiv in Rewa got beaten up by BJP MLAClaimed by: Social Media usersFactCheck : Misleading
label: rumor

content: Is the removal of restrictions on Ganesh Pooja by the Shinde government Hindutva government encouraging Hindutva?- Read the Fact  Check A piece of news is getting viral on the internet that, the Shinde government have removed all the restriction on celebrating Ganpati pooja. Further, a user named Jeet Mehra posts that “All the restrictions imposed by the Uddhav government on Ganesh Chaturthi Puja were removed by the Shinde government. This is the difference between the formation of a Hindutva government.”Similarly, many other users have shared this similar claim on their social media handles.Fact CheckIn our fact-check analysis, we found many media reports covering the incident. Furthermore, from an article of Jagran, we got to know that the Shinde government removed all restrictions imposed on festivals, no ban on Ganesh Pooja, Dahi Handi, and Muharram.Further, it was also mentioned Maharashtra Chief Minister Eknath Shinde on Thursday announced that the restrictions imposed on festivals during the coronavirus pandemic have been lifted. There is no restriction on upcoming Ganesh Chaturthi, Dahi Handi, and other religious events. He said that when the procession is taken out, there will be no restriction on celebrating Muharram.ConclusionTherefore, the restriction is being removed restriction from all the festivals that were imposed during corona times. Hence, the claim of the social media users is misleading.
label: truth

content: Did Maulana give arms training to students in a madrassa? Read, Fact-Check A video went viral on social media. Questions are being raised through this video that Maulana is giving training to students to use weapons in the madrasa. People are also raising questions on the education of madrasas what kind of education is being given here?Caption on YouTube channel HR India, “जिहादी मदरसों में छात्रों को दे रहा था, ढाय ढाय वाला ज्ञान! पुलिस घसीट कर लाए थाने!” (Jihadi was giving armed training to students in madrasa! Police arrested them.) A video of about three minutes with the same has been uploaded on 23 July 2022.In this video, a screenshot of Swatva News website is being shown saying that a video is going viral from the madrassa of Pratapgarh, as soon as this video went viral on social media, when the police came to know, the police immediately went there and arrested the Maulana. You can see what kind of education is being conducted inside the madrasa. Similar studies take place in a madrasa.https://youtu.be/RIICcUC5a5YOn the other hand, on website of Swatva Samachar, news has been written under the headline, “बच्चों को Firing सिखा रहा था मौलाना, बकरीद के दिन का वीडियो Viral, दबोचा गया” (Maulana was teaching children to fire, the video of Bakrid day is viral, nabbed). There is written in ntro, “Like Patna Terror Module in Bihar in neighbouring state UP also. Terrorist’s training exposed. In Pratapgarh, a Maulana is teaching Muslim children to fire rifles on the day of Bakrid. After the video went viral, the police swung into action and arrested Maulana Intezaar as soon as the matter was found to be true.Further in this, news it has been claimed that- “Maulana has been infamous for objectionable antics in the past as well. People have been coming and going to him in the past to learn how to fire a rifle. Security agencies are questioning him.”Fact Check:To investigate this news, first we did a simple search on Google with the help of keywords. We got many reports published on this.Dainik Jagran titled it, “प्रतापगढ़ में बुजुर्ग लोड कर रहे रायफल और नाबालिग कर रहे तड़ातड़ फायर, वीडियो वायरल; प्रतापगढ़ पुलिस लेगी कानूनी एक्शन” (Elderl are loading rifle and minors doing quick fire in Pratapgarh, the video went viral; Pratapgarh Police will take legal action) There is no mention of a madrasa or a Maulana in this entire story.According to Dainik Jagran, a person named Intezaar had come to the wedding ceremony in Pratapgarh’s village Kandhai in the dress of Sheikh, who gave training to the people to use rifles. Its video has gone viral on the internet.Similarly Navbharat has also covered it. According to Navbharat, the video is going viral for two-three days, now the police have arrested two people named Intezar and Gulzar.At the same time, the police has also not mentioned any madrasa or Maulana in its statement. The police statement can be heard here.Conclusion:It is clear from this fact check of DFRAC that the video going viral is not of a madrasa or a Maulana training children to use rifles, but a wedding ceremony. The arrested people are not Maulana, hence the video is being viral with misleading claim by YouTube channel HR India, website Swatva News and other social media users.Claim: Maulana gave firing training to students in madrasaClaimant: HR India, Swatva News and other social media usersFact Check: Misleading
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Is Russian President Putin Watching News of Imran Khan’s Victory? A picture is getting viral on social media in which Russian President Vladimir Putin can be seen watching the news of Pakistan’s ex-Prime Minister Imran Khan.Social media users are sharing this picture with utmost excitement and Boasting caption related to Imran Khan.A user named @MechailBoriss writes, “Russian President Vladimir Putin is watching the news of the major breakthrough in Pakistan on July 17. He expressed his satisfaction over Imran Khan’s victory and described Imran Khan as a surprising personality.”Russian President Vladimir Putin is watching the news of the major breakthrough in Pakistan on July 17. He expressed his satisfaction over Imran Khan's victory and described Imran Khan as a surprising personality.👇 pic.twitter.com/fIfFUkw7G8 — Muhammad Jaffar Ali (@MJK_121472) July 19, 2022Many other users too shared the same picture under different captions.A Facebook user writes, “Russian President Putin listening to the news of Imran Khan’s victory. (#copied)#byelection2022 #ImranKhan.”Fact Check:@MechailBoriss is an old fake account created by Pakistan that always tweets in favour of Imran Khan. We have earlier suspended his fake account.https://dfrac.org/en/2022/02/26/analysis-of-the-dirty-game-played-by-pakistan-social-media-troll-army/but, now a new account is created by the same name which is following the same pattern.We too noticed many Pakistani accounts have tweeted on this.So to investigate the viral picture, we reverse searched the image on Google and found the same picture of Putin but on screen in front of him was, many people and it was seemingly an image from a video conference.Then we also found a report on euronews.com the same image can be seen there, in which the caption under the picture states, “Russian President Vladimir Putin chairs a meeting with Italian businessmen via videoconference at the Novo-Ogaryovo residence outside Moscow, Russia, Wednesday, Jan. 26, 2022.”Conclusion:Therefore, the image of Putin watching Imran khan news was in reality morphed as the actual image was of the video conference.Claim Review: Russian President Putin Watching News of Imran Khan’s Victory.Claimed by: Most Pakistani accounts.Fact Check: Misleading
label: rumor

content: Is India offering  Pakistan 5 billion USD in exchange for supporting UNSC permanent membership?- Read the FactCheck A piece of news is doing rounds on the internet these days. The news is that India is offering Pakistan an economic package of 5 billion USD. Further, a Twitter user named Drfarooq tweeted, “India-Pakistan back-channel talks: Source from Institute for Defence Studies & Analyses (IDSA) India revealed that India is offering Pakistan an economic package of 5 billion USD. In exchange, India wants Pakistan to support its permanent membership at UNSC.”https://twitter.com/drfarooq/status/1536625830444548096Similarly, many other social media users have shared the same claim.ReportedlyIndia-Pakistan back channel talks:Source from Institute for Defence Studies & Analyses (IDSA) India revealed that India is offering Pakistan an economic package of 5 billion USD.In exchange, India wants Pakistan to support its permanent membership at UNSC, — H A S E E B ❤️ 🇵🇰 (@HaseebDurrani88) June 14, 2022India-Pakistan back channel talks:Source from Institute for Defence Studies & Analyses (IDSA)India revealed that India is offering Pakistan an economic package of 5 billion USD.In exchange,India wants Pakistan to support its permanent membership at UNSC,shutdown#BajwaTraitor — Pakistani🇵🇰❤️ (@AtifNajma) June 13, 2022Fact CheckPakistan has been constantly blocking India’s bid of getting a permanent seat in the UNSC. And, Pakistan has been a constant hurdle in India’s diplomatic effort for a permanent seat in the UN security council. There was recent speculation that Paki might support India for UNSC permanent membership. But, we got a tweet of 10th July, 2022 from the verified account of @ForeignOfficePk Slamming all these rumours. In the tweet it was mentioned that, Spokesperson @Asimiahmad on rumors alluding to Pakistan’s position on Indian bid for permanent UNSC membership. “Let me tell you this is totally baseless absolute fiction. We categorically reject any such statement that is being wrongly attributed to FM @BBhuttoZardari”Spokesperson @Asimiahmad on rumors alluding to 🇵🇰s position on Indian bid for permanent UNSC membership.💬 “Let me tell you this is totally baseless absolute fiction.We categorically reject any such statement that is being wrongly attributed to FM @BBhuttoZardari”. pic.twitter.com/mtxVDbztAY — Ministry of Foreign Affairs – Pakistan (@ForeignOfficePk) June 10, 2022Further, to check the veracity of the viral claim that India is offering an economic package to our neighbour, we did simple keyword search on google. But, the DFRAC team has not found any such information from any credible source. Moreover, we checked the official website of theManohar Parrikar Institute for Defence Studies and Analyses(IDSA). But, there is no such news available on the website.Further, our team also found that most of users spreading this fake news are from Pakistan and PTI supporters.ConclusionTherefore, the viral is without any base. As of now, there is no such credible information that India is offering Pakistan an economic package of 5 billion USD. And, in exchange, India wants to support its permanent membership at UNSC.”
label: truth

content: Video of PM Modi ignoring Ram Nath Kovind’s greeting at his farewell ceremony gone viral- Read the Fact Check A video is doing rounds on the internet. Sharing the video users are sharing that, PM Modi ignored former President Ram Nath Kovind at his farewell ceremony. Further, sharing the video Sanjay Singh of AAP wrote, “Such an insult Very Sorry Sir These people are like this, your term is over, now they will not even look at you.”ऐसा अपमान Very Sorry Sirये लोग ऐसे ही हैं, आपका कार्यकाल ख़त्म अब आपकी तरफ़ देखेंगे भी नही। pic.twitter.com/xaGIOkuyDM — Sanjay Singh AAP (@SanjayAzadSln) July 24, 2022Karti P Chidambaram also shared the viral video with the caption, “offered without any comments.”Offered without any comments pic.twitter.com/zOfLFupBe6 — Karti P Chidambaram (@KartiPC) July 24, 2022Similarly, many other social media users have shared this video.Fact CheckUsing the InVID tool and applying reverse image search on different keyframes of the viral video, the DFRAC team found it on YouTube on Sansad TV. The title of the video is, “President Kovind’s departure from the Central Hall of Parliament I Farewell function.”In the 8:57 minutes long video, at 1.09 minutes we can the clip that has gone viral. Further, after delivering his farewell speech, Kovind was greeting the attendees with folded hands. In the video, it can be seen that Kovind has greeted Modi. But, the social media users have cropped that part from the viral video and have shared the video with misleading claims.ConclusionTherefore, from our fact check it is clear that social media users are sharing the viral video with the misleading claim.
label: truth

content: “A strange child born to a Muslim in Shamli! Throat was cut and buried”,read Fact-Check A picture of a newborn went viral on social media. It is being claimed through this picture that this newborn who looked like an alien was born to a Muslim and did not die even after giving 50 injections of poison, then was buried by slitting his throat.Abhay Thakur wrote the caption, “Weird baby born to a Muslim today in village KD near Shamli! Didn’t die even after 50 injection of poison, when was buried after slitting his throat.Fact Check:After doing a reverse image search of the viral image on the internet, we found the same image on Aaj Tak website published a report under the headline, “MP: Alien-like baby born in Ratlam! Know the reason”. It has been said in the report that the skin has not developed on the body of the newborn, due to which all the veins of his body are clearly visible. Not only this, due to lack of skin, his eyes, lips etc. are also swollen. At first glance, the child looks like an alien.At the same time, according to the news published on the website of Nai Duniya, a woman resident of Baravada in MCH on Friday evening gave birth to a baby at 3.45 pm in MCH. Now not fully developed, it is not known whether the baby is a boy or a girl, weighing 2.200 grams. In-charge Dr. Naved Qureshi said that a woman resident of Baravada has given birth to this child. In medical language, such babies are called collodion babies.Conclusion:It is clear from this fact check of DFRAC that the newborn is not born in Shamli, but in Ratlam, and whether Hindu or Muslim is not mentioned anywhere. At the same time, it is also clear that this newborn is not an alien or strange but a collodion baby, so what the users are doing is a misleading claim.Claim: “A strange baby born to a Muslim in Shamli village!”Claimant: Social Media UsersFact Check: Misleading
label: rumor

content: Pakistani Accounts Spreads Fake News on Rahul Gandhi A statement of Congress leader Rahul Gandhi is going viral on social media sites. It states that, “Modi should explain to the nation why he spents billions of USD to purchase expensive weapons in the name of fighting Pakistan, when whole of the Pakistan can be bought in less than 1 Billion USD.”People are sharing this statement of Rahul Gandhi while criticizing the Modi government. A Twitter user tweeted the statement of Rahul Gandhi with a taunt on Modi.https://twitter.com/Hamzalovely12/status/1550550081392283649Fact CheckTo investigate this statement we searched the official Twitter handle of Rahul Gandhi where we found no such statement. Moreover, we searched the same statement on Google but found no evidence of Rahul Gandhi’s viral statement. On further investigation, we ran a keyword search on Twitter and found that the same statement with the same claim went viral in the month of April.Fake news posts on Rahul GandhiMoreover, majority of tweets done on this news were done by Pakistani accounts. Tweets can be seen here, here, here.Pakistani Accounts Who TweetedConclusionDFRAC found the claim of social media users as fake, because no such statement has been made by Rahul Gandhi.Claim Review: Rahul Gandhi said that whole Pakistan can be bought under 1 billion dollars.Claimed by : Social media usersFact Check: Fake
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Zee News spreads misleading news on Sonia Gandhi in ED summons case Congress President Sonia Gandhi has been recently issued a third summons for questioning by the Directorate of Mountains (ED) in the money laundering case and has been asked to appear before it. Congress has staged protests across the countryagainst this.In this regard, Zee News ran a news on the basis of a video clip and claimed that Sonia Gandhi while responding to the summons said, ‘I am Indira ji’s daughter-in-law, I am not afraid of anyone’Fact Check:Source: The Indian ExpressTo verify the above claim, DFRAC converted the video clip into multiple keyframes with the help of the InVID tool. On the reverse image of the keyframe, we found a video report by The Indian Express dated December 08, 2015, titled “I am Indira Gandhi’s daughter-in-law. I am not afraid of anyone. I am not worried.”Apart from this, another report of NDTV was found. In which it was told that in a special conversation with NDTV in the National Herald case, Sonia Gandhi said,“In the morning your colleague asked me if I was afraid. I replied that I am the daughter-in-law of Mrs. Indira Gandhi and I am not afraid of anyone or anything.”Conclusion:So the news by Zee News about Sonia Gandhi is misleading .
label: truth

content: A mockery video of Boris Johnson is shared as a real video- Read Fact Check. A video showing Ex- British Prime Minister Boris Johnson is going viral on social media, where he is being questioned about the corruption and social media users are claiming it as an actual footage Johnson being questioned on the accusations of corruption.A user on twitter shared the viral video and suggested other countries as well as India to take a lesson. He writes, “*INVESTIGATION OF BORRIS JOHNSON – Ex. PRIME MINISTER OF UNITED KINGDOM* *CAN’T IMAGINE…. THIS HAPPENING IN INDIA or Somewhere else..* *Salute to Brave Police & Investigation Officers of UK* *Other countries & their investigation agencies must take a lesson from this?Fact Check-DFRAC firstly noticed the footage closely and found that it is showing questions filled with dramatic effects, including background music and highly dramatised shots.Furthermore, we recognised the people conducting the questioning as British actors Vicky McClure, Martin Compston and Adrian Dunbar. All three actors are part of a television drama called Line of Duty.We then searched for keywords ‘Line of Duty questioning boris johnson’ and found a video by The Guardian, which spoke about a similar mockery video made using actual footage of public appearances by Johnson, mixed with clips from Line of Duty by a satirical art group called Led by Donkeys.Conclusion:-Hence the video is in real a mockery video and not a real one.claim Review:- Ex- British Prime Minister Boris Johnson questioned about corruption.Claimed by- social media users.Fact Check- misleading
label: rumor

content: No 18% GST on crematorium services – Read the Fact Check A piece of news is going viral on the internet that the government is imposing 18% GST on crematorium services. Meanwhile, a social media user Satyam Singh shared a screenshot of Business Standards with ‘crematorium and other by 18 percent’ underlined. Further he gave the caption, “18% GST on Crematorium Services too.”18% GST on Crematorium Services too🙂🙂 pic.twitter.com/fZsxIRcx3C — Satyam Singh (@Satyamsingh6947) July 20, 2022Similarly, many other users have tweeted a similar claim.https://twitter.com/LinBiYao/status/1549738260024664065/18% GST on crematorium?Whither India? — S.M.Shetty (@smshetty) July 20, 2022Another Gem from you…..😀PM Modi provides an opportunity of serving the Nation even after the Death :18% GST on Crematorium Services too.#NayaBharat #AbJeetegaIndia pic.twitter.com/QJrlZ72QgB — Syed Rafi – నేను తెలుగు 'వాడి'ని. (@syedrafi) July 20, 2022Fact CheckAccording to the PIB press release of recommendation of the 47th GST council meeting, the GST levied on work contracts for bridges, roads, metros, effluent treatment plants, and crematoriums increased from 12% to 18%.Apart from this, as per CGST-Act-2017-amended-01012022.pdf, Services of funeral, burial, crematorium or mortuary including transportation of the deceased are included under the ACTIVITIES OR TRANSACTIONS WHICH SHALL BE TREATED NEITHER AS A SUPPLY OF GOODS NOR A SUPPLY OF SERVICES.Further, in this reference we also got reports of many media houses including livemint.ConclusionTherefore, the viral claim that Government have levied 18% GST on crematoriums is misleading.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Old picture of CM Mann being hospitalized went viral An old picture of CM Man being hospitalized went viral on social media. Users are appealing to pray for him.Deepakdeep Deep wrote in the caption of the picture on Facebook, “CM Bhagwant Mann’s health deteriorated, admitted to Apollo Hospital, Delhi, News of stomach infection came out, Write two heartfelt words for Mann Saab.”Fact Check:To investigate this picture and news, we did some specific ‘keyword’ search in this context on Google. We got many reports about the deteriorating health of CM Mann.Hindustan Times has published the report under the headline, ‘Punjab CM Bhagwant Mann admitted to hospital in Delhi: Report’. It has been told in this report that Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann was tested for abdominal pain, after which he was treated by doctors.Meanwhile, India Today uploaded a video report on its YouTube channel under the headline, “Punjab CM Bhagwant Mann Hospitalised After Drinking Water From Kali Bein River At An Event”.It is worth noting that the picture of CM Mann which went viral on social media is from 2018. A video uploaded by the verified YouTube channel Punjabi Lok Channel on August 1, 2018, reported that Delhi CM Kejriwal and Deputy CM Manish Sisodia inquired about Bhagwant Mann’s health after his health deteriorated.It can be seen in the above video that the picture being viral as of recent times is old.At the same time, we found a report published by India Today in 2018, titled “AAP MP Bhagwant Mann hospitalised in Delhi”.Conclusion:It is clear from this fact check of DFRAC that the viral picture of CM Mann is old, hence this picture is being shared misleadingly by the social media users.Claim: CM Mann hospitalizedClaimant: Social Media UsersFact Check: Misleading
label: truth

content: Fact Check-Did central government have applied tax on the printed school books? A post is getting viral on social media with a claim that the central government has imposed tax on school books.Many social media users are sharing the claim.Fact Check:-To investigate the viral claim DFRAC team run a search on google using the keywords and found a report on hindubusinessline.com, according to their report there is no GST on books, but prices may tend to rise.We found more reports on this on different websites we found, while there is no exact mention of GST on school books or textbooks, GST on ‘Printed books, including Braille books’; and on ‘Children’s picture, drawing or colouring books’ is zero, whereas the GST on ‘Exercise book, graph book, & laboratory note book and notebooks’ is 12%. The Authority of Advance Ruling (AAR) held that 12% of GST is applicable to printing and supply of textbooks to government departments which are registered under Goods and Services Tax (GST) Acts, 2017.Conclusion:-Hence, our factcheck proves that there is no tax on printed school books, there is tax on their printing and supply.Claim Review:-central government have applied tax on the printed school books.Claimed by- social media users.Fact Check- Misleading
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Viral video of students’ protest is not from Andhra Pradesh but from Sri Lanka! A video of students protesting is going massively viral on social media platforms. It was claimed that this video is of the recent protests in Andhra Pradesh.A user @JaiLokeshTDP wrote, “Madanapalli resounded with Jai Balayya Jai Telugudesam slogans. @JaiTDP.”TweetTweetIt was also claimed that the protesters also raised slogans of “Jai Balaia , Jai Telugu Desam” during the protest.Fact CheckLatest protest against the corrupt government in Sri Lanka. Presidential Palace is over taken by the protesters.Will there be such demonstrations in Pakistan against powers behind state-run corruption and death squads? #SriLankaProtests #SriLankaEconomicCrisis pic.twitter.com/gOVQNHiqca — Dr Taimur Ali Syed (@Taimur_Ali_Syed) July 9, 2022DFRAC first converted the viral video into keyframes with the help of the InVid tool for the analysis. On reverse search image of keyframe,we found another similar videoon a website named ‘Bit Chute’Giving information about the video on the website, it was told that it shows the protesters occupying the Rashtrapati Bhavan during the economic crisis in Sri Lanka .Apart from this, our team also got a news report from ‘ CNN ‘ . In which it was said that some protesters carrying flags and helmets entered the President’s residence in Sri Lanka. Thousands of protesters marched along the sea The doors of the President’s Secretariat were broken.conclusionSo it is clear that the viral video is misleading. Because it is not of the protests in Andhra Pradesh but of Sri Lanka.
label: truth

content: KTR’s claim that the centre denied for flood relief fund under NDRF to Telangana is deceptive- Read the Fact check Minister for Municipal Administration & Urban Development, Industries & Commerce, and Information Technology of Telangana, Kalvakuntla Taraka Rama Rao, aka KTR claim that not a single rupee was granted to Telangana under NDRF since 2018!On 19th July 2022, the son of Telangana’s chief minister, KTR tweeted, “Hon’ble @PMOIndia Is this what ‘Sabka Saath, Sabka Vikas’ & Co-operative federalism means? Telangana has been reeling under heavy floods but not a single rupee granted under NDRF since 2018! Neither did you offer relief to the 2020 Hyderabad floods nor the 2022 Godavari floods. Why?”Soon his tweet went viral with thousands of retweets and likes.Fact CheckTo verify the claim DFRAC team looks thoroughly at the government documents. According to a report of India Today in which was mentioned that, the claim by KTR is factually true as the table shared by KTR is the same as presented by MOS Home Affairs Nityanand Rai presented in the Lok Sabha on July 19 while responding to a question from Assam MP Prodyut Bordolui. And, according to the table Chhattisgarh, Goa, Haryana, Punjab, Mizoram, Jammu and Kashmir, Uttarakhand, and Telangana have not received any funds from ADRF since 2018!Is it right for KTR to put the onus on centre?According to an MHA report, since FY 2018-19, Telangana asked for funds under the NDRF only once. In FY 2020-21 Telangana asked for Rs. 698.87 crores and the committee approved Rs. 245.96 crores.But as per the laid down procedure, it is expected that the state would not seek relief from the Centre if there are already sufficient balanced lying unused under its own State Disaster Response Funds. If there are already funds lying under the SDRF, the Centre will deduct 50 per cent of the unused SDRF fund (at the beginning of the financial year) from the approved amount.For example, if the Centre approves Rs. 100 and the SDRF already has Rs. 50, then the Centre will deduct Rs. 25 and the state would be eligible only for Rs. 75.However, there is one more condition to be met. If the SDRF already has more than double the amount for which it is eligible (after the above calculation), it will not get any funds at all. This is what happened in the case of Telangana in 2020-2021.The amount finally approved by the Centre was Rs.245.96 crore. But on April 1, 2020, Telangana’s SDRF already had crores in its kitty. This was almost four times the approved amount. As a result, it did not get any funds from the Centre.ConclusionTelangana has not received any relief fund from NDRF since 2018. But, the targeting centre for it is misleading.
label: truth

content: Will Draupadi Murmu declare India as a Hindu Rashtra as soon as she becomes the President? Read Fact Check A post in the name of Draupadi Murmu is becoming fiercely viral on social media. Users sharing this post are claiming that Draupadi Murmu has declared that her first duty after becoming the President is to declare India as a Hindu Rashtra. The user is writing quoting Draupadi Murmu- “After becoming the President, my first duty will be to make this nation a Hindu Rashtra. Long live Rama”This post is being shared fiercely on social media. There are some accounts in which Draupadi Murmu’s photo is attached, she has been named Draupadi Murmu. Although the spelling of their username is different. We are giving links of many such posts here.Accounts in the name of Draupadi Murmu-https://twitter.com/DraupdiMurmu__/status/1548157194549354498?s=20&t=r16XKlMNUAKxtkMKgfermwराष्ट्रपति बनने के बाद मेरा प्रथम कर्तव्य इस राष्ट्र को हिंदू राष्ट्र बनाने का होगा।जय श्री राम 🙏🚩 — काजल राजपूत हिंदू शेरनी 🦁 (@Hindu_Kajal_) July 16, 2022At the same time, many users are sharing this statement of Draupadi Murmu.राष्ट्रपति बनने के बाद मेरा प्रथम कर्तव्य इस राष्ट्र को हिंदू राष्ट्र बनाने का होगा।द्रोपदी मुर्मूजय श्री देव 🙏🚩 pic.twitter.com/FlpJawWhGE — Sushil Kumar Jha (@Dr_kashyap11) July 17, 2022Fact Check:To check this news, we did some keyword searches on Google. But we did not get any news in this regard from any media organization. After this, we started checking the official handle of Draupadi Murmu on Twitter. During this, we got many handles, but all handles are parodies or fake handles. Murmu has no handle on these.At the same time, all BJP leaders including Prime Minister Narendra Modi, Home Minister, JP Nadda, Rajnath Singh congratulated Murmu for being made the Presidential candidate, but no one mentioned Murmu’s account.At the same time, the account from which this tweet has been made, that account is currently not present on Twitter.Conclusion:Our fact check proves that after Draupadi Murmu became the President, the statement of declaring India as Hindu Rashtra has not been made. Hence the claim being made by social media users is fake.Claim- Draupadi Murmu said the first duty to declare India a Hindu nationClaimant- Social media usersFact Check – Fake
label: rumor

content: Did 100 Hindus run away in fear of 5 Muslims? – Read the Fact Check A video is getting viral on the internet in which five, or six people are chasing out some people from the truck. Meanwhile, many social media users are sharing this video with the claims that Hindus got frightened away by Muslims. Further, sharing the video a Twitter user names Sanni Mathur wrote the caption, “This is the situation now, even 2047 has not come. 100 Hindus ran away in fear of 5 Muslims.”Similarly, many other users have shared this video with the same claim.Fact CheckOn our fact-check analysis, we found that the same video was uploaded by the official Twitter account of Karnataka State Police Factcheck on May 11, 2022. Further, the near translation of the Kannada caption of the video is, “True facts about the video clip: Muslims chased away the Hindus who came to chant in front of the Hubli mosque.”Moreover, we also found the same video on the YouTube channel named No1 News Bd. They uploaded the video on May 5, 2022.Further, on simple keyword research, we found many articles on this topic. We also found an article related to this incident on the site of Karnataka state Police Factcheck.ConclusionTherefore, from this DFRAC factcheck, it is clear that the context in which the video is being shared on social media platforms is deceptive. Hence, the caption of the users along with the video is misleading.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Old video of the plane landing in the flood waters in Karachi got viral again A video of a plane in Pakistan is going viral on social media. In the video , the plane can be seen landing on the runway which is submerged under water. It was claimed that the viral video is of recent times.Facebook user, ZK Productions shared the viral video and wrote: Live from Karachi AirportThis video was also shared by the former Pakistan Information Minister and PTI leader Fawad Chaudhry . In his tweet, he criticized the Sindh government, PPP, and its leader Asif Ali Zardari.Fact Check:During the DFRAC investigation of the viral video, we found that the Pakistan Civil Aviation Authority (CAA) confirmed that the video is three years old.An old video is being flushed around on social media that shows an airplane moving on a runway covered in water. Please note that this is an old video, nearly 3-year old, and does not depict the present situation at Karachi's JIAP, which is normal, with drains working normally. pic.twitter.com/wcM5VmQbFg — PCAAOfficial (@official_pcaa) July 11, 2022In the tweet, it was written that ” An old video is being flushed around on social media that shows an airplane moving on a runway covered in water. Please note that this is an old video, nearly 3-year old, and does not depict the present situation at Karachi’s JIAP, which is normal, with drains working normally..”Apart from this, we also got a report from Duniya News . In which it was mentioned that this video is of August 27 , 2020 . It was also told that the record of 319.2 mm of rain fell, breaking the record of Karachi 1979 . The airport was flooded as a result.Conclusion:Therefore, the viral video is deceptive.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Did Foreign Muslim women come in support of Nupur Sharma over the prophet controversy A picture is doing rounds on the internet on the internet with the claim that Muslim Women in foreign are supporting Nupur Sharma. In the picture, a Hijab- clad woman is holding a placard in which it is written, “’कोर्ट/मदरसा/मौलवी बताएं आखिर ‘आयशा’ की शादी किस उम्र में हुई? मुझे नूपुर शर्मा को गलत साबित करना है.’ लड़की के पीछे कुछ दूसरे लोग भी नजर आ रहे हैं”English Translation – “Tell ‘Court / Madrasa / Maulvi At what age did ‘Ayesha’ got married? I have to prove Nupur Sharma wrong. Some other people are also seen behind the girl.”Similarly, many other users have shared this picture with a similar claim.Also Read: Analysis of hate against Hamid Ansari after the claims of Pakistani journalist Nusrat Mirza.Fact CheckOn a simple keyword search, we found no such news. Further, on reverse image search, we found the picture of the same Hijab clad woman in several articles including, Dawn, Aljazeera and The Tribune.Furthermore, to verify that this picture, we took the help of fotoforensic.ConclusionTherefore, DFRAC fact check proves that the viral image is doctors. The content of the placard is different on the original image. Hence, the piece of news attached to the picture that foreign women coming in support of Nupur Sharma is fake.
label: rumor

content: Muslim man died by a truck carrying Kanwar Yatris – Read Fact Check. Social Media is flooded with videos of a truck carrying Kanwar yatris. The videos are getting viral with the claim that a Muslim man committed suicide by coming in front of a truck full of Kanwar yatris and the police immediately arrested the accused.Many people on social media are sharing videos with different captions.Madhu Purnima Kishwar, an Indian academic and a commentator, writes, “Is this true @myogiadityanath This morning in ‘Deoband’ a ‘Muslim’ person dies under the ‘truck’ of ‘Kavadis’, due to which a ruckus has arisen that the ‘Kavadis’ have deliberately killed this person. Started proceedings by registering a case against. (English Translation)Is this true @myogiadityanathआज सुबह "देवबन्द" में "कावड़ियों" के "ट्रक" के नीचे एक "मुस्लिम" शख्स की मौत हो जाती हैं जिसको लेकर बवाल खड़ा हो गया कि "कावड़ियों" ने जानबूझ कर इस व्यक्ति को मारा हैं पुलिस ने सभी "कावड़ियों" के खिलाफ केस तुरत दर्ज कर कार्यवाही शुरू कर दी — Madhu Purnima Kishwar (@madhukishwar) July 20, 2022Another user writes, “After all, why did the dying ‘Muslim’ person choose the truck of ‘Kavadis’ to commit suicide? Was this some well thought out conspiracy?! This morning a ‘Muslim’ person dies under the ‘Truck’ of ‘Kavadis’ in ‘Deoband’ which is (the most vulnerable place)” (English Translation)https://twitter.com/BharatiyaHeart/status/1549742240452706305?s=20&t=6cZoa5Mwtk13v0qwbb110QFact Check:To investigate the truth behind the viral video, we found a tweet from Saharanpur police’s official Twitter account that states, “A false news is being spread through certain social media that “a Muslim committed suicide under a truck of kavadis in the morning at police station Deoband”. Saharanpur Police denies this untrue and misleading news.”Futher, UP Police Fact Check also denied any such incident.It states, “The matter is related to the year 2017 and necessary legal action has been taken at that time. @saharanpurpol has denied the misleading post.”Conclusion:From the above-mentioned tweets, it is clear that an old video from the year 2017 is being viral on social media with the claim of a recent video.Claim Review: Muslim man committed suicide in front of a truck full of Kanwar yatris truck and the police immediately arrested the accused.Claimed by: social media users.Fact Check: Misleading
label: truth

content: Fact-Check: Video of tanker blast in Afghanistan viral as Pakistan A video is going viral on social media sites. Users are sharing this video with the claim that Pakistan has lost billions.A verified Twitter user named Saif Awan tweeted a 23-second video with the caption, “Guddu Power Plant is set on fire or set, but Pakistan has lost 15 billion”.گڈو پاور پلانٹ کو آگ لگی یا لگائی گئی،لیکن پاکستان کا 15 ارب کا نقصان ہوگیا۔ pic.twitter.com/cwGXoU5SRY — Saif Awan (@saifullahawan40) July 14, 2022Another user Major Tahir Zaman Raja Rtd Ex SSG captioned, “#We_Support_PM_Imran_Khan *1762 MW capacity Guddu power plant is totally destroyed by burning.The action was absolutely necessary to sell solar panels* *Not a single media channel broadcasted this news* *It’s really surprising.*”https://twitter.com/tahircdo/status/1547994715769171969It has also been shared by other social media users with a similar claim.Fact Check:To know the reality of viral claim, we did a simple search on the internet with the help of certain “keywords”. During this we got a report published by Geo News. It has been told in this report that due to the fire at Guddu Power Plant during the Bakrid holidays, there has been a loss of 15 billion rupees to the government exchequer.According to the report, the senior engineer says that it will take about a month to restore the operation of the plant. Sources said the power plant did not have fire extinguishers. A four-member team led by the Chief Engineer has started an investigation.Pakistan Today also covered this news with the headline “Fire at Guddu power plant causes Rs15b loss”.It is worth noting that the photo that was used while giving the news about Guddu Power Plant is very different from the video that is going viral, so we did a reverse image search on the internet for some frames of the video. After that we found that a video tweet from a verified account named BILAL SARWARY was found. This video has been captioned, “#AFG fuel tankers exploding. Investors losing their money in a matter of seconds. Financial tragedy on the Afghan – Iran border. No one knows what started the fire. No reports of casualties or fatalities at this stage. Video shared with me.In this video it can be seen how fierce the fire is. Balls of fire are rising in the sky.#AFG fuel tankers exploding. Investors losing their money in a matter of seconds. Financial tragedy on the Afghan – Iran border. No one knows what started the fire. No reports of casualties or fatalities at this stage. Video shared with me. pic.twitter.com/hb127UqSv5 — BILAL SARWARY (@bsarwary) February 13, 2021At the same time, CNN has covered it under the headline, “500 vehicles in flames after fuel tanker explodes on Afghanistan-Iran border”The same video can be seen uploaded on YouTube channel Mix Clips on 13 February 2021.Conclusion:This fact check by DFRAC makes it clear that there was a fire at Guddu plant in Pakistan, but users are misleadingly sharing videos of Afghanistan in the name of Guddu plant.Claim: Video of fire at Guddu Power Plant (Pakistan)Claimant: Social Media UsersConclusion: Misleading
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Know the truth behind the viral video of cloudburst in Karachi These days a large number of videos related to rain and floods are becoming viral on social media. Meanwhile, a video of a cloudburst has surfaced. It was claimed that this video is from Karachi in the neighboring country of Pakistan.A user shared the video on Twitter and wrote in Urdu that the scene of cloudburst in Karachi today (*کراچی میں ادل نے نی CLOUD BURSTING مناظر* #مجبور_عوام_عیاش_حکمران)Several other users have also shared this video with similar claims. Which can be found here, here and here.This video has been viewed and shared thousands of times.Fact Check:To check the viral video, the DFRAC team first converted the video into keyframes with the help of the Invoke tool. After doing a reverse search image of the keyframe, the team found a similar video on YouTube.This video was posted on July 21, 2019, by American photographer Kyle Beene on his YouTube channel.Giving details about the video, Bene stated that he filmed the video during a cloudburst on August 23, 2018, just north of Sky Harbor International Airport in Phoenix, Arizona.Conclusion:Hence the viral video of cloudburst in Karachi is misleading.Claim Review: Cloudburst in KarachiClaimed by: social media users.Fact Check: Misleading
label: rumor

content: Video of a Muslim Woman breaking the Ganpati idol gone viral with the misleading claim- Read the Factcheck A video is doing rounds on the internet in which a Burqa-clad woman is breaking Ganpati idols in the shop. Further, social media users are sharing the claim that this video is from Kerala. Meanwhile, a Facebook user named Apurva Rastogi, shared the video with the caption which can be nearly translated into English, “watch this video from Kerala and forward it as much as you can….if u keep quiet today we will be at a loss…because after 6 months there will be no use to forward it…wiggle fingers and move on now.”(केरल के इस विडियो को देखें और इसे जितना हो सके उतना फॉरवर्ड करें …. अगर आप यू आज चुप रहते हैं तो हमें नुकसान होगा … क्योंकि 6 महीने के बाद इसे आगे बढ़ाने का कोई फायदा नहीं होगा … उँगलियाँ घुमाएँ और इसे आगे बढ़ाएँ अभी)Similarly, many other users have shared this video with the similar claim.Fact CheckUsing InVID tool and reverse image search on different frames of the video, we got a many articles related to this incident. We found that this incident is of Bahrain, not of Kerala. And, the incident occurred in August 2020.The viral video shows a burqa-clad woman in a supermarket in Bahrain slamming Ganpati idols, kept on display ahead of the upcoming Ganesh Chaturthi festival, on the floor and shattering them into pieces.Furthermore, we also got a tweet from the official account of the Ministry of Interior of the Kingdom of Bahrain on August 16. 2020. In the tweet, it was stated that “Capital Police took legal steps against a woman, 54, for damaging a shop in Juffair and defaming a sect and its rituals, in order to refer her to the Public Prosecution.”Capital Police took legal steps against a woman, 54, for damaging a shop in Juffair and defaming a sect and its rituals, in order to refer her to the Public Prosecution. — Ministry of Interior (@moi_bahrain) August 16, 2020Also Read: Economist Steve Hanke shared Pakistani video as Sri Lankan Crisis- Read the fact checkConclusionTherefore, the viral video is old and it is of Bahrain not of Kerala. Hence, social media users are sharing the video with the misleading claim.
label: truth

content: Rishi Sunak is not yet elected as the Prime Minister of Britain- Read Fact Check A post is being shared on social media claiming that Indian-origin Rishi Sunak has been elected as Britain’s new Prime Minister. Many social media users are also congratulating Rishi Sunak on becoming the new PM of Britain by sharing the picture.A Facebook user writes, “Rishi Sunak became the Prime Minister of Britain! Rishi Sunak is the son-in-law of Narayana Murthy and Sudha Murthy. The UK which ruled India for two hundred and fifty years, today its PM has become an Indian. Congratulations.”Many other social media users shared the pictures with captions.Fact Check:To investigate the viral claim, we searched on Google through keywords. During this, we received a report published recently on the website of BBC. According to the report, Rishi Sunak got 115 votes in the third round of voting held on Monday. After which he has come to the fore in the race for Prime Minister.No valid news Sites have covered the news which confirms Rishi as the new elected Prime minister.We further searched the official Twitter account of Rishi Sunak. In which he has shared a video and thanked all the people who voted for him in the third round.I want to thank all the colleagues who supported me tonight.Together we can rebuild our economy, keep Brexit safe & defeat Labour.Join our team: https://t.co/3cXn1rFhca pic.twitter.com/COBUttJxKH — Rishi Sunak (@RishiSunak) July 18, 2022Conclusion:The process of choosing a new UK prime minister is underway and the new name will be announced in September. Until then Boris Johnson will remain the caretaker PM of Britain.Claim Review: Rishi Sunak is not yet elected as the Prime Minister of Britain.Claimed by: social media users.Fact Check:fake
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Photoshopped image of Antarctica glacier from space went viral A picture is going viral on social media sites. By sharing this picture, users are claiming that the glaciers of Antarctica are visible from space.A user named حيدرة Space 8K captioned, “Antarctica seen from space!” and tweeted a picture in which that shows an incomplete globe and a large part of it is seen with a sheet of ice.Antarctica seen from space! pic.twitter.com/V0AD2LpfiL — حيدرة Space 8K (@uhd2020) July 16, 2022Fact Check:To know the reality of this viral picture, we searched the internet in this context. We found the image uploaded on the NASA website on September 21, 2005. In this picture it is written that the original photo of Antarctica was found from space. This picture is completely different from the picture going viral. The image of NASA is visible directly on the globe. While the viral picture has been tarnished.At the same time, some users have also given sarcastic feedback on this. Bomber Bayl wrote, “Don’t look like it’s melting to me as some reports say.”Horace Granero wrote, “Don’t see any melting polar cap there, plenty of ice. Global warming? No.”Conclusion:It is clear from this fact check of DFRAC that the picture going viral is edited/photoshopped, hence the claim being made by the users is fake.Claim: Glaciers of Antarctica visible from spaceClaimed by: Social Media UsersFact Check: FakeRead also:(Follow #DFRAC on Twitter, Facebook, and YouTube.)
label: rumor

content: Fact Check: Video of 5 people being washed away in flood waters in MP viral as Telangana A video is becoming very viral on social media. In which 5 people can be seen floating in the flood waters. It is being claimed that the viral video is from the South Indian state of Telangana.Sharing the video, a user wrote in Telegu that “High alert, heavy rain in Telugu states.”Fact Check:https://www.youtube.com/c/WildFilmsIndiaTo check the viral video, DFRAC first converted the video into keyframes with the help of Invoke tool. After doing a reverse search image of the keyframe, our team found a video on YouTube in this regard. The viral video was uploaded on YouTube with the title “Patalpani incident Indoree”. The video can be viewed below.Apart from this, we did some keyword searches on Google to get more information related to the video. During this, we got a report from NDTV. It was told that this incident came to the fore in Indore in 2011. Due to the flood caused by rain in Patalpani, five members of the same family who had come for a picnic were washed away in the flood.ConclusionHence the viral video is misleading.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Did NDA declare Ranjan Gogoi as its Vice Presidential Candidate? A post is being shared on social media claiming that the NDA has declared Ranjan Gogoi as the Vice Presidential candidate.Facebook user Vijay Thakker shared Ranjan Gangoi’s picture and wrote, “Judge Shri Ranjan Gogoi ji, who gave the Ayodhya Shri Ram Mandir verdict, has been declared the NDA’s Vice Presidential candidate * Advance congratulations to Gogoi ji .. Jai Shri Ram ..sprinkling salt on the burn, then someone should learn from Modiji…buy a spoonful of Barnaul.”(Translates Hindi)Fact Check:To investigate the viral claim, we searched Google through keywords and found a report published on Dainik Jagran on 16 July 2022. According to the report, the Governor of West Bengal Jagdeep Dhankhar has been made the candidate from the NDA side. This decision was taken in the meeting of the BJP Parliamentary Board. After which BJP President JP Nadda announced the name of Jagdeep Dhankhar.On further investigation we found a tweet of Amit Shah, from his official Twitter account where he was congratulating Jagdeep Dhankhar on being elected as the NDA’s Vice Presidential candidate.श्री @jdhankhar1 जी को NDA के उपराष्ट्रपति पद का प्रत्याशी चुने जाने पर मुँह मीठा कराकर बधाई दी।साधारण किसान परिवार में जन्में धनखड़ जी का जीवन जनकल्याण व समाज के उत्थान को समर्पित रहा।मुझे विश्वास है कि जमीनी समस्याओं पर उनकी समझ व संवैधानिक ज्ञान का देश को बड़ा लाभ मिलेगा। pic.twitter.com/kP1pDBXaPx — Amit Shah (Modi Ka Parivar) (@AmitShah) July 17, 2022News agency ANI has also shared the pictures of the nominations on its official Twitter handle.Delhi | Jagdeep Dhankhar files his nomination for the Vice Presidential elections, as the candidate of NDA.Prime Minister Narendra Modi, HM Amit Shah, Defence Minister Rajnath Singh, Union Minister Nitin Gadkari, BJP national president JP Nadda and other BJP leaders present. pic.twitter.com/iBRfuXC0pO — ANI (@ANI) July 18, 2022Conclusion:DFRAC found the viral claim of NDA declaring Ranjan Gogoi as the Vice Presidential candidate to be false. West Bengal Governor Jagdeep Dhankhar has been made the Vice Presidential candidate from the NDA side and not Ranjan Gogoi.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Lulu Mall hired Muslim boys and Hindu girls for Love Jihad? Read Fact Check The grand opening of Lulu Mall has taken place in Lucknow. The mall was inaugurated by CM Yogi Adityanath. Lulu Mall, built on 11 acres at a cost of 2 thousand crores, is also being called the biggest mall in UP. At the same time, with the opening, a controversy has also erupted regarding Lulu Mall. After some youths offered Namaz in the mall, there was a dispute over Hindu organizations reading Sundarkand in the mall.Amidst all this, a post about Lulu Mall is going viral on social media. It is being claimed in this post that 90 percent of the employees of Lulu Mall are Muslim boys, while 100 percent of the female employees are Hindu girls. One user wrote – “90% boys *Muslim* and 100% girls working in 11 acres of North India’s largest and country’s fifth *Lulu Mall* opened 3 days ago in Lucknow at a cost of two thousand crores “Hindu “Lulu is owned by M A Yusuf Ali of Kerala l #Love_Jihad @Lawyer_Kalpana @iSinghApurva @HJSHindi”(Translates Hindi)Another user claimed that Lulu Mall has a total of 2000 employees. In which there are 1800 Muslim boys and 200 Hindu girls.At the same time, many other users have made similar claims.Fact Check:To check if this post going viral, we did a simple search on Google. We found reports published on the matter by several media channels and newspapers. According to these reports, clarification has been given by the management committee of Lulu Mall regarding the employees.According to media reports, Lulu Mall management told that 80 percent of their employees are Hindus. The remaining 20 percent of the employees are people of other religions including Muslims, Sikhs, Christians, and Buddhists.Conclusion:Our fact check is proving that 80 percent of the employees working in Lulu Mall are not Muslims but from the Hindu community. While 20 percent of the employees include people of other religions including Muslims. That’s why social media users are making fake claims on Lulu Mall by giving it a communal angle.Claim Review- 90% Muslim employees and 10 Hindu girls in Lulu MallClaimed by- Social media usersFact Check – Fake
label: rumor

content: The reality of the viral picture of a child who survived the earthquake in Afghanistan- Read the Fact Check A picture of a very young kid amid the rubble is doing rounds on the internet. Social media users are claiming the child survived a massive earthquake in Afghanistan. Meanwhile, sharing the picture a user named @Zabih_Uallah wrote the caption, “Afghanistan was buried in the rubble for about 24 hours after the earthquake and was found alive by the grace of God.”Similarly, many other users have shared this picture with the same claim.Fact CheckOn reverse image search we found the same picture on the website of almasdaronline. The article was published on December 10, 2015, with the title, “Yemeni activists send a message to the participants in the Yemeni negotiations: Stop the war.” Therefore, this picture is old and is not related to the earthquake in Afghanistan.Moreover, we also found a Facebook post with a similar picture of January 6, 2015. Further, the caption of the picture was in Arabic which can be nearly translated into English, “I had a home here. They destroyed it and made me homeless.”ConclusionTherefore, from our fact-check analysis, it is clear that this picture is not of Afghanistan but of Yemen. And, users are sharing the picture with the misleading claim.
label: truth

content: Muslim girls of Kerala are learning Hindu warfare ? Read Fact Check A video is going viral on social media. In this video, some Muslim girls wearing hijab can be seen taking martial arts training. Social media users are claiming this video that Muslim girls are learning Kalaripayattu, the martial arts of Kerala from the Hindu community.Sharing this video, a user wrote – ” #Kalaripayattu is the ancient #war lore of #Hindus of Kerala state ! #Muslims are teaching this weaponry to their daughters , and #Hindus are teaching dance to their daughters! Its result will be visible in future. #wake_up_hindus @ABVPVoice @nidhitripathi 92 @Aishwaghpatil @AnkitaP0598”At the same time, this video has been shared by many other users with a similar claim which can be seen here, here and here.Fact CheckTo check the video going viral, we first checked the video. The logo of AsiaNetNews was on this video. We started checking the video on the official YouTube channel of AsiaNetNews. This video was uploaded on July 27, 2015.According to the title and description of this video, 21-year-old martial arts trainer Arifa is training her students. To search more about Arifa, we found a report from newindianexpress.com. In this report, Arifa describes in detail how a Muslim girl has learned the Kalaripayattu martial art while facing societal challenges. Now she herself is training the girl students by becoming a trainer.The same time, we found an article from The Hindu to know more about Kalaripayattu. According to this article, the Union Sports Ministry has included 4 Indian martial arts including Kalaripayattu in the “Khelo India Youth Games”.The training of this martial art is not only received by Muslims but women and men of all communities of Kerala. Gurukuls are run for this purpose.ConclusionOur fact check proves that Kalaripayattu is an ancient martial art of Kerala. Like judo and karate, it also has competitions and championships. It is a martial art of Kerala. That’s why social media users are making the 2015 video viral with a misleading claim.Claim- Muslim girls of Kerala are learning Hindu warfareClaimant- Social media usersFact Check – Misleading
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Smriti Irani did not insult Goddess Durga, old video viral with misleading claim A video clip of Union Minister Smriti Irani is going viral on social media sites. On the basis of this video clip, users are claiming that Smriti Irani has made controversial and derogatory remarks about Goddess Durga.user named ‘Sourav Adhikary’ posted on Facebook the caption in Bengali, “Friends! Don’t forget to comment on #Smriti_Irani regarding #Ma_Durga !! Smriti Irani #when #in #what_situation made ugly comments about Maa Durga which no one other than Smriti Irani knows!!” (English translation)Fact CheckTo verify the video going viral, we did a reverse search of the frames of the video. During this it came to light that this video of Smriti Irani is a part of a statement given in Parliament. The situation becomes clear after watching this video in its entirety. The controversy has been covered on India TV. A report was published by India TV under the headline, “Irani’s statement on Mahishasur issue, I also worship Durga, it was a pamphlet of JNU” (translates in English).According to the report of India TV and News18, this case is from 2016. When the issue of Dalit student Rohit Vemula’s suicide and alleged anti-national sloganeering in JNU was being discussed in Parliament.
