content: A protest video from Bangladesh is viral as booth capturing and mob attack on Army convoy in West Bengal Spread the truth:A video of an aggressive mob protesting and blocking the roads is being circulated on different social media platforms. The people in the crowd are easily identifiable as Muslims. The video is going viral on the internet with claim that it is from West Bengal. The video was shared on twitter, Facebook and WhatsApp with several shocking claims.TwitterThe video shows a mob armed with sticks stopping an army convoy, including an ambulance, while shouting slogans.The video was widely shared with the caption, “पश्चिम बंगाल में मुसलमानों की गुंडागर्दी देखिए सरकार,पुलिस, फौज सबको इनसे जान बचानी मुश्किल है।”(Translation: “See the hooliganism of Muslims in West Bengal, it is difficult even for the government, police and army to save their lives from them.”)पश्चिम बंगाल में मुसलमानों की गुंडागर्दी देखिए सरकार,पुलिस, फौज सबको इनसे जान बचानी मुश्किल है। क्या यह दृश्य आप अपने शहर या गली में देखना चाहते हो…… फिर कहतो हो आप हिन्दू, मुस्लिम करते हो अब आप ही बता दीजिए इसको कौन नियंत्रण कर सकता है बीजेपी या टीएमसी। pic.twitter.com/vJfWXhAGX5 — 🇮🇳 शेषधर तिवारी 🇮🇳 (@sdtiwari) April 10, 2021A twitter user @sdtiwari with nearly 50k followers shared the video with same caption as discussed earlier. The video has 149 retweets and 1.5k views. More twitter users are sharing the video with similar captions.पश्चिम बंगाल में मुसलमानों की गुंडागर्दी देखिए सरकार,पुलिस, फौज सबको इनसे जान बचानी मुश्किल है।जहाँ भी यह 40-50%होंगे वहाँ यह होने की पूरी सम्भावना रहती हे अब यह तुम भी सोचो कि..क्या यह दृश्य आप अपने शहर या गली में देखना चाहते हो…… pic.twitter.com/PJ2iZZTHxP — Rajesh (@Rajesh50092355) April 8, 2021FacebookThe 2 minute 53 second long video of the same event was shared on facebook by सुभाष शर्मा भगवाधारी which has now 7,000 views.The caption is “मुसलमानों की गुंडागर्दी देखिए सरकार,पुलिस, फौज सबको इनसे जान बचानी मुश्किल है।👇👇 क्या यह दृश्य आप अपने शहर या गली में देखना चाहते हो…… जागो हिन्दूओं ”https://fb.watch/4NiZO2E3Sf/Another fb user shared the video with the caption “पश्चिम बंगाल में गुंडागर्दी देखिए …”(Translation: Look at the hooliganism in West Bengal)WhatsappThe video was heavily forwarded on whatsapp. Interestingly, the claim on whatsapp was a bit different. The video started circulating with the following viral text.“Polling situation West Bengal Muslim Dominated areas”TruthThe video is from Hathazari in Bangladesh and not West Bengal. The video was shot when Bangladeshi’s were protesting arrival of Modi in Bangladesh on 28th March.The number plate on one of the army vehicles present is not in Indian Format, it was found to be in Bangla, in Bangladeshi format.According to the Quint the red logo with the two crossed swords on the ambulance and the army men’s uniform indicates that they belong to the Bangladesh army.Source: The QuintAfter segmentation of key frames of the video and Reverse image search it was found that the video was a clip from longer version of the video uploaded by user HM Al Amin as a Facebook Live on 28 March, with the caption, “হাটহাজারী সড়কে সেনাবাহিনী” (Translation: “Army at Hathazari Road”).One of the boards visible in the videos gave further evidence that this place was in Bangladesh as the board read ““আল হেরা তাহফিজুল কুরআন ইসলামি একাডেমী”(Translation: “Al Hera Tahfizul Quran Islamic Academy”)Source: The QuintAfter facebook and google search the location of the academy was found in Rangamati Road in Isapur, Fayzia Bazar in Chittagong’s Hathazari.Through google maps it was proved that this video was from Hathazari.Source: The QuintRelated
label: truth

content: A ten month old video of alcohol distribution goes viral as twitteraties link it to farmers protest Spread the truth:A shocking video in which unidentified individuals sitting inside a car can be seen distributing free alcohol to a group of poor looking people. This video is viral on social media platforms since the past week. It is evident from the audio that the crowd of people collecting the alcohol in small utensils and the individuals are speaking in Punjabi.This video has been linked with the ongoing farmers protest. It has been said that the group of people collecting alcohol from the individuals inside the vehicle are farmers protesting at the Delhi borders. Although it was not mentioned if these “alleged” farmers were from Singhu, Tikri or Ghazipur border. Twitter users shared this video accusing the farmers of consuming alcohol in the name of Langar during the protest.TwitterRenuka Jain a popular twitter user who has 58.8 thousand followers shared the video tweeting ” Farmer Protests. Free liquor distribution.”The video has over a 100 thousand views over 2000 retweets. Renuka Jain claims that she is followed by the Prime Minister himself.Another account with 105 thousand followers calledf Exsecular shared the video with the caption ” Daru Langar”. The tweet has over 1200 retweets.A twitter handlle called No Conversion which has more than 188k followers shared the same video with the caption “Langar for farmers”.Langar for farmers —-pic.twitter.com/ZiLxEMez2e — No Conversion (@noconversion) February 6, 2021The post got more than 1700 RTs and 53.9k views.A twitter account which went by Barkha Trehan having more than 30k followers shared the video with“Sharing without comments”Sharing without comments 🤣🤣 pic.twitter.com/LKFeCBrbye — Barkha Trehan / बरखा त्रेहन (@barkhatrehan16) February 6, 2021Her post was retweeted more than 800 times.A twitter user which goes by the name of Keh Ke Peheno share the video. The twitter handle has more than 250k followers.He tweeted the video saying “आंदोलन की गाडी को आगे बढ़ाने के लिए पेट्रोल भरवाते हुए तथाकथित अन्नदाता”This video got over 23k views and more than 400 RTs. Many twitter users posted the same video with different captions most of them linking it to farmers protest in Delhi. Those tweets are linked at the end of this post.TruthThe controversial video was originally shared online 10 months ago. The original source is unknown but the video is in no way related to the ongoing farmers protest.The video surfaced on twitter this past week but social media hoax slayer team found that the video was already shared on certain Facebook groups last year. A Facebook group called FaCe BoOK Ka ChOKIdAr had posted the video on 18th of April 2020 which can be verified by looking at the time stamp of the post.Another Facebook page which goes by the name बाबा की बातें also has the 10 months old video on their timeline.Uploaded on 18th April 2020Related
label: truth

content: Did the soldier visit Delhi border to meet his protesting farmer father ? Spread the truth:A set of photos is viral showing an elderly man with two soldiers going through an emotional moment. It’s claimed as a soldier came rushing to meet his father who is protesting tat the Delhi border as soon as he got his leave approved.Priyanka Gandhi Vadra tweeted the photos but deleted later.She wrote –“छुट्टी मिलते ही अपने पिता से दिल्ली बॉर्डर पर मिलने आए जवान की आँखे भर आयीं। 75 दिनों से इनके पिता अपने अस्तित्व की लड़ाई लड़ रहे हैं। और पूँजीपतियों की सरकार की यह हिमाक़त कि उन्हें आतंकवादी, देशद्रोही, षड्यंत्रकारी कहते हैं? शर्म आनी चाहिए मौक़ापरस्त बेईमानों की सरकार को।”Translation: “Just as he got leave approved, the soldier cried when he met his father protesting at Delhi border. For 75 days, his father has been fighting for his existence. And the government of the capitalists dared calling them terrorists, traitors and conspirators. Such opportunist dishonest government should be ashamed”https://twitter.com/priyankagandhi/status/1358258848969052163archiveManjinder Singh Sirsa (President, Delhi Sikh Gurdwara Management committee | National Spokesman, @Akali_Dal_) tweeted –archiveCharanjit Singh Brar, (Political Secretary S. Sukhbir Singh Badal MP & President Shiromani Akali Dal.Office Secretary & Spokesperson of India’s 2nd oldest Party Shiromani Akali Dal.) posted on his verified Facebook page –archiveVerified Facebook Page of Punjab Spectrum postedarchiveRohitt Saxena (CEO & Managing Editor https://parliamentarybusiness.com, Sr. Advisor- http://mescindia.org,राष्ट्रनीतिज्ञ,प्रादर्श,Chairman-http://taekwondoindia.co.in (Media)) tweeted –Following tweet by a Dr. Monika Singh has been retweeted for more than 4500 timesफ़ौजी छुट्टी आया तो सीधा बोर्डर पर पहुँच गए अपने पिताजी से मिलनें तो जवानों की आखों में पानी आ गया क्योंकि उनके पिताजी 75 दिनों से बॉर्डर पर किसान आंदोलन में रुके हुए है। शर्म नहीं आती किसानों को खालिस्तानी कहने वालों को pic.twitter.com/TCx1alTEjE — Dr Monika Singh – ਮੋਨਿਕਾ ਸਿੰਘ (@MonikaSingh__) February 6, 2021WhatsAppTruthThe viral message is misleading, the photo is from Ludhiana, not Delhi border.While checking replies to the tweets we found someone claiming this place to be Ludhiana ISBT. First we observed the image carefully, checked the names/signboardss/banners in the background and then started looking for images on Google. Well, it didn’t help much so we switched to Google Maps where we actually found the matching imageWe found a matching photo clicking on which led us to precise results.Click for Google Map photosYou can see the same shops etc in both the images, the one which is viral and the one we found in mapsFurther we searched on Facebook and found a video reporting the situation of the Ludhiana bus stand during COVID 19 epidemic, July 2020Many learned their post/tweet to be wrong and tweeted accepting their mistakeI apologize if place is mentioned wrong in picture… however i endorse my quote… https://t.co/zyQVZXzQYv — Rohitt Saxena 🇮🇳🇮🇳🇮🇳🇮🇳 (@merohittsaxena) February 9, 2021मेरे ध्यान में लाया गया है कि फौजी अपने किसान पिता से मिलते हुए की ये फ़ोटो दिल्ली बॉर्डर की नहीं बल्कि लुधियाना की है पर जहाँ की भी है किसान पिता और उसके फ़ौजी बेटे की वतनपरस्ती जगज़ाहिर है किसानों की देशभक्ति पर सवाल उठाना घटिया सोच और कितनी बार साबित करें जै जवान जै किसान! https://t.co/xkmbCg0mEp — Manjinder Singh Sirsa (@mssirsa) February 8, 2021Related

content: Sambit Patra and many others shared an edited video of Delhi CM Kejriwal claiming he supports Farm Bill. Spread the truth:A small 17 sec clip of an Interview of Delhi CM Arvind Kejriwal is viral claiming he supports Farm bill and calls it a first revolutionary step taken in agriculture sector in last 70 yearsNational Spokesperson of BJP, Sambit Patra tweeted the video with the following text“तीनो farm bills के लाभ गिनाते हुए …Sir जी:”Translation: “Sir Ji counting the three benefits of farm bills”His tweet has been retweeted by approx 22K people, the video has been seen by approx 5 Lakh people alreadyarchiveTwitterArvind Kejriwal led Aam Aadmi Party comes out in support of Farm Laws pic.twitter.com/8JkFnP1uOA — J (@Sootradhar) January 30, 2021जब संसद में नए कृषि कानून पास हुए उसके ठीक अगले दिन केजरीवाल सरकार ने नए कृषि कानूनों को नोटिफाई किया। और फिर एबीपी न्यूज़ से बात करते हुए नए कृषि कानूनों की शान में खूब कसीदे पढ़े और मोदी सरकार को एक क्रांतिकारी कदम बताया। लेकिन आज यह @ArvindKejriwal दोगला पलट गया आखिर क्यों? pic.twitter.com/yjFsR6Vmls — श्रीष त्रिपाठी 🇮🇳 (@Shrish_1987) January 30, 2021FacebookPost by Facebook Page “Growing India” has been shared by approx 500 people by nowTruthThe viral video is edited, Delhi CM wasn’t supporting Farm Bill in this interview.The Interview by Dilep Tiwari on Zee Salam was broadcasted on 15th January 2021Do listen carefully from 6.25 minutesHe is saying that there is no benefit to the farmers from this farm bill, despite many big ministers making speeches, couldn’t explain any benefit to the people, the only benefit this bill can bring is to 4-5 capitalists.Kejriwal is saying what ministers said in their speeches, followed by why it is not OK which has been cut.From 9:58 minutes –He praised Swaminathan comission and called it revolutionary but Swaminathan part is cut and only his scentence of “revolutionary is kept in the viral video”Edited clipThe 17 sec Viral video shows Kejriwal Saying –“आपकी ज़मीन नहीं जाएगी, आपका MSP नहीं जायेगा, आपकी मंडी नहीं जाएगी.अब किसान अपनी फसल पुरे देश मैं कहीं भी बेच सकता है, अब किसान को अछे दाम मिलेंगे, वो मंडी के बहार कहीं भी बेच सकता हैदिलीप जी, ये ७० साल के अन्दर सबसे बड़ा क्रांतिकारी कदम होगा कृषि शेत्र में”Translation:“You won’t loose your land, your won’t loose your MSP, you won’t loose your market. Now a farmer can sell his crop any where in entire country, he will get good price, he can sell anywhere outside the market. Dileep Ji, this is such a revolutionary step for agriculture in 70 years”Original Interviewइनके सारे बड़े मंत्री, मुख्यमंत्री मैदान में उतरे लोगो को ये समझाने के लिए की ये बिल किसानो के फायदे में है, मैंने इन सबके भाषा सुने हैंउन भाषणों में क्या कहते है ये, भाषण में कहते है जी इस बिल से आपकी ज़मीन नहीं जाएगी, तो ये तो फायदा नहीं हुआ, वो जमीन तो थी ही ,आपका MSP नहीं जायेगा, तो ये तो फायदा नहीं हुआ, ये तो था ही, आपकी मंडी नहीं जाएगी, ये तो फायदा नहीं हुआ . फायदा क्या होगा ये एक भी नेता नहीं गिना पा रहा . जब बहुत ज़्यादा कुरेदो तो फायदे के नाम पर कहते हैं, अब किसान अपनी फसल पूरे देश में कहीं भी बेच सकता है. यही फ़ायदा गिनाते हैं न ये! अब किसान को अच्छे दाम मिलेंगे, वो मंडी के बाहर कहीं भी बेच सकता है. मैं उनसे केंद्र सरकार से पूरी विनम्रता से पूछना चाहता हूं. आज पंजाब में और हरियाणा में मंडी में MSP 1800 रुपये क्विंटल है गेंहू की. बिहार में मंडी नहीं है वहां 800 रुपये में किसान बेच रहा है. वो जो 800 रुपये में किसान बेच रहा है उसे ये बता दो कि वो पूरे देश में कहां जाके मंडी के बाहर बेचे कि उसे साढ़े 1800 रुपये से ज़्यादा का दाम मिल जाये?”From 9:58 minutes –“एक तो ये तीनों किसान बिल वापस हो. और दूसरा MSP का जो ये मांग कर रहें है की MSP की गारंटी का कानून लाया जाये. MSP स्वामीनाथन आयोग के हिसाब से 50% प्रॉफ़िट के हिसाब से जितनी कॉस्ट है उसका 50% ऐड करके MSP तय की जाये. अगर ये आ गया. दिलीप जी, ये 70 साल के अंदर सबसे बड़ा क्रांतिकारी कदम होगा कृषि क्षेत्र में.”Translation:“Their many big Ministers, Chief Ministers came on the ground to explain that the bill is in favor of farmers. I’ve heard all their speeches.In their speech, they say, you won’t loose your land, but this is not a benefit, land is already yours, your MSP wont go down, but this again is not a benefit, this already was there, you won’t loose your market, but then again, this isn’t any benefit. What exact benefit the farmers will get, none of them are able to explain”From 9:58 minutes –“Firstly, all these three bills should be cancelled, and secondly the MSP Guarantee law should be brought. According to Swaminathan comission, the 50% profit should be added on the cost. If this is passed, Dileep Ji, this is such a revolutionary step for agriculture in 70 years“So in the interview, he was against the farm bill, not in favor.Related
label: rumor

content: Years old tradition of @MumbaiPolice, paying respect at Mahim Dargah is viral falsely relating it to politics. Spread the truth:Years old tradition of @MumbaiPolice, paying respect at Mahim Dargah is viral falsely relating it to politics.A video clip is viral in which few men in police uniform are seen saluting Pir Makhdoom Ali Mahimi at Mahim Dargah in Mumbai.Following text is viral with the video –“मुंबई पोलीस ये क्या कर रही है?😡😡पीर हजरत मकदूम शाह को सलामी..👇👇👇यकीन करिये शिवसेना(शवसेना) अब अपने अंतिम पड़ाव पे है..👇👇👇”Translation – “What is Mumbai Police doing ? Saluting Pir Hazrat Makhdoom Shah. Believe me, Shivsena (corpse army) is on last stage.”WhatsAppTwitterFacebookTruthAlthough the video is real, but this ritual by ‘Mahim‘ Police is decades old, not new and is not related to any party or politics.“Once a year on Mahimi’s Urs, thousands from around the city, not least the Mumbai police force, come to pay their respects and seek his blessings. The Mumbai police force has the privilege of laying the first chadar, or decorative tomb covering, of the Urs in Mahimi’s respect.The Mahim police station, about 200 metres away from the dargah, has been built on the site where Mahimi is said to have lived. A green steel cupboard in the Senior Inspector’s room is said to contains the saint’s possessions. During the ten days of the fair held each year to honour Mahimi, the office is thrown open for devotees.” – The ScrollFollowing videos are from years before Shiva Sena came in power –Times of India –So it’s the Mahim Police, not entire Mumbai Police, who had been paying respect to the Pir for decades, so it’s not related to any Party or politics.Related
label: truth

content: Old photos of a function by Delhi government is being questioned for absence of masks. Spread the truth:A photo is being tweeted by Delhi BJP prominent people, questioning it, as while Delhi government has names Rs. 2000 as penalty for not wearing a mask for common man, and allowed only gathering of 50 people, why they themselves have invited 100s of children in a function without masks, making them prone to catch COVID19 virus.TwitterOfficial @twitter Profile of Naveen Kumar Head Media Dept. @bjp4delhi #Spokesperson tweeted –“दिल्ली सरकार के मंत्री @kgahlot जी कम से कम सिविल डिफेन्स के बच्चों के चेहरे पर मास्क तो लगवा देते #COVID19 को बिलकुल हलके में ले रखा हैं आपने तो ,न तो कोई सोशल डिस्टेंस हैं न किसी के चेहरे पर मास्क हैं | 2000 रु का चालान क्या सिर्फ आम जनता को परेशान करने के लिए हैं क्या..?“Translation: “Delhi Government Minister K Gahlot should at-least have put masks on children of civil defense. You have taken COVID19 very lightly, neither maintained social distance, nor is there a mask on anyone’s face. Is Rs. 2000 fine only to annoy common people ?”archiveKhemchand Sharma, Spokesperson:@BJP4Delhi ।।Member BJP National IT/SM Campaign Committee 2019।। Software Architect।। ExCon. Samvadcell, tweeted –“दिल्ली सरकार के मंत्री @kgahlot जी सिविल डिफेन्स के वालंटियर्स को #COVID__19 से बीमार कर #coronavirus को दे रहे हैं बढ़ावा! मीटिंग में न तो #SocialDistancing थी न किसी के चेहरे पर मास्क हैं। @DelhiPolice :2000 रु का चालान सिर्फ आम जनता के लिए नही है मंत्री जी पर कार्यवाही करें।”Translation: “Delhi Government’s Minister, K Gahlot is making civili defense volunteers sick and promoting coronavirus. In the meeting, neither is there any social distancing, nor a mask on any one’s face.Delhi Police, Rs 2000 penalty is not only for common people, kindly take action on the minister.”archiveBarkha Shukla Singh, Vice President @bjp4delhi | Former President,@DelhiPMC | Former Chairperson, Delhi Commission for Women | Ex-MLA, R.K. Puram | Women Rights Activist tweeted –“Delhi AAP minister @kgahlot flouting all norms of COVID 19 while giving speech to self defence volunteers, no one can be seen wearing masks, no social distancing, the capacity of the hall is full! Request Delhi police to take strict action against this! @blsanthosh“Delhi AAP minister @kgahlot flouting all norms of COVID 19 while giving speech to self defence volunteers, no one can be seen wearing masks, no social distancing, the capacity of the hall is full!Request Delhi police to take strict action against this! @blsanthosh pic.twitter.com/KTgOb7vSv2 — Barkha Shukla Singh (@barkhasingh45) December 6, 2020FacebookarchiveTruthThe photo in question is more than a year old. i.e. Before Corona pandemic spread in India.The Delhi Minister they are blaming, K Gahlot, himself tweeted these photos on 28th October 2019.He wrote “Historic Day for Delhi. With Hon’ble CM @ArvindKejriwal inaugurated the Training & Orientation of Newly Inducted Bus Marshals in DTC & Cluster Buses & announced for Free Travel for Women in buses from 29.10.19. This is the first of its kind model of Bus Marshals in the world“Historic Day for Delhi. With Hon’ble CM @ArvindKejriwal inaugurated the Training & Orientation of Newly Inducted Bus Marshals in DTC & Cluster Buses & announced for Free Travel for Women in buses from 29.10.19.This is the first of its kind model of Bus Marshals in the world pic.twitter.com/JDMDd9HAIt — Kailash Gahlot (@kgahlot) October 28, 2019archiveHe tweeted the same photos again 2 days ago as International Volunteers Day, remembering that event and thanking all civil defense volunteers. So people questioning these photos, took from this tweet without checking.Related

content: A yoga video shot before PM Modi was born is viral claimed to be his. A video of a man performing various asanas of yoga is viral claimed to be a rare video of PM Modi.“एक दुर्लभ अद्भुत विडीयो नरेन्द्र मोदीजी का…।आप भी आश्चर्यचकित रह जाएंगे। उच्च स्तर की योग साधना” is viral on WhatsApp along with the video.Translation: “A rare and astounding video of Narendra Modi. You will also be astonished. High level Yoga”The viral video shows a young man in a black and white which is 8.24 minute long with shlokas/mantras being chanted.WhatsappTwitterManoj Goel, National Executive Member BJP Youth Wing tweeted –archiveThe secret of @narendramodi ji’s health at this age is that he did meditation, yoga, pranayama and hard exercise. pic.twitter.com/yUIOB4hFXm — Puneet Sharma 🇮🇳 (@iPuneetSharma) November 23, 2020FacebookTruthThis video was shot in 1938, the man in the video is BKS Iyenger, not PM Modi who was born in 1950.We found that this video was earliest uploaded on YouTube in 2006So we started looking for Iyenger and Yoga and found that he was one of the earliest mast of modern day yoga and have founded an organization recognized and helping people globally.On his portal we found a DVD on sale which also had a screenshot from the viral video named 1938 PracticeSourceAbove is a comparison of a screenshot from India Today (Left) and the viral video (on right)Both are BKS Iyenger and not PM Modi

content: A 15 year old spoof of a suicide bomber in a car is viral now as a real ‘ad’ by Volkswagen. Spread the truth:A video is viral which shows a man (Suicide Bomber) drives a Volkswagen Polo to a market with people around, presses a button resulting in an explosion but the car contained it, the tag line in the end read “Small but tough” with a logo of Volkswagen.TwitterBJP’s Delhi Spokesperson Tajinder Pal Singh Bagga tweeted“Terrorist Commercial Ad by Volkswagen” Interesting ?“The tweet by now has been retweet by more than 1100 people, seen by approximately 40K people, liked by 5.7K people"Terrorist Commercial Ad by Volkswagen" Interesting ? pic.twitter.com/AYs98BmMYE — Tajinder Pal Singh Bagga (@TajinderBagga) November 24, 2020archiveFollowing man, Sudhir’s tweet has been retweeted 720 times . He wrote“जर्मनी की ऑटोमोबाइल कंपनी फॉक्सवैगन ने इन शांति दूतों का जमकर मजाक उड़ाया है शांतिदूत आतंकी फॉक्सवैगन की कार में बम लेकर ब्लास्ट करना चाहता है लेकिन कार इतना मजबूत है कि ब्लास्ट नहीं होता अगर ऐसा ऐड किसी भारतीय कंपनी ने बनाया होता तो अब तक इस्लाम खतरे में आ गया होता”Translation: German Automobile company Volkswagen made good fun. Peaceful Terrorist was trying to explode in a Volkswagen car but the car is so strong that it didn’t explode. If such ad was made by any Indian company, Islam might have been in danger.जर्मनी की ऑटोमोबाइल कंपनी फॉक्सवैगन ने इन शांति दूतों का जमकर मजाक उड़ाया है शांतिदूत आतंकी फॉक्सवैगन की कार में बम लेकर ब्लास्ट करना चाहता है लेकिन कार इतना मजबूत है कि ब्लास्ट नहीं होता अगर ऐसा ऐड किसी भारतीय कंपनी ने बनाया होता तो अब तक इस्लाम खतरे में आ गया होता pic.twitter.com/tFGSPlGnjE — सुधीर श्रीवास्तव उर्फ सोनू (@SonuSri795) November 23, 2020archiveThis is why one should by German Cars now.. pic.twitter.com/Dukniv3lBB — Harshal Purohit (@iPurohitHarshal) November 23, 2020FacebookBJP Spokesperson Delhi, Tajinder Pal Singh Pagga posted on his verified page –archiveTruthThe viral video is not a real ad but a 15 year old spoof.The Guardian reported on 23rd Jan 2005 –Suicide bomber sells VW Polo – hoax ad takes internet by stormThe spoof ad opens with the suicide bomber leaving his home and jumping into his VW Polo. The bomber parks at a busy London restaurant where carefree diners crowd the pavement. Cut to the terrorist sitting in his car as he pushes the button to detonate his bomb. The blast is contained within the car, saving the diners. The ad ends: ‘Polo. Small but tough’. It has to be a candidate for the sickest advert of all time, but also one of the most deceptive. Despite the high quality production values, real Volkswagen logo and the free publicity it is attracting around the world, the commercial was not made by the car giant. Indeed, the firm has expressed disgust at the spoof depiction of a suicide bomber blowing himself up in a VW Polo, and tomorrow it will consider legal action against its creators. The advert was not made for TV but to be flashed around the world on the internet. It is part of a phenomenon of ‘viral emails’ – not to be confused with computer viruses – that is so popular that this month saw the first ‘viral awards’. Most are official efforts by companies and advertising agencies. The VW hoax, however, marks a worrying new trend for them – bogus ads which can be made by one individual that can wreck a firm’s reputation.Ford had to distance itself last year from a viral email showing a cat’s head being cut off by a car’s sunroof. Paul Buckett, a VW spokesman, said: ‘Two creatives known to our advertising agency, DDB London, sent in this work on spec. The agency wouldn’t have anything to do it. I can only assume the people who made it put it on the web.‘We were horrified. This is not something we would consider using: it is in incredibly bad taste to depict suicide bombers.‘It gives the impression we’ve condoned or supported it, and is potentially very damaging to Volkswagen. Our legal department is planning an action and we will decide tomorrow.’The ad is believed to be the work of a duo experienced in spoof ads, known as Lee and Dan, who also make real commercials.Dan told the digital newsletter of media experts Brand Republic: ‘The ad got out accidentally and spread like wildfire.’It reflected ‘what people see in the news every day. The car is the hero that protects innocent people from someone with very bad intentions. We’re sorry if it has caused any offence.’Further, one of the world’s oldest Fact Checker “Snopes” also debunked this in 2005 i.e. 15 year ago.This old Volkswagen "terrorist" commercial isn't what you think it is http://t.co/X9xnnZBpEz pic.twitter.com/dsSAzkYPdF — Jalopnik (@Jalopnik) May 7, 2015Related
label: truth

content: Maharastra Gov is being questioned to demolish a Mosque in Madhya Pradesh claimed being in Mumbai. A viral aerial photo of a mosque surrounded by roads is viral with people claiming it to be from Mumbai asking Maharashtra Government, why haven’t they demolished it yet, following actress Kangana Ranaut’s Office demolition.TwitterThe tweet by retired IAS, Mr. Sanjay Dixit, claiming the photo from Bandra, Mumbai, has been retweeted more then 2200 times. –“A legal construction in Bandra. When is the BMC going to notice this monstrosity in plain sight? Wait. It only insults ordinary public, not the penguins and UTs.”archiveTweet by BJP Spokesperson, Ashwini Upadhyay has been retweeted approx 9000 times (deleted now) –“इस अवैध निर्माण को कब तोड़ेंगे उद्धव जी? @ OfficeofUT @ AUThackeray“archiveFollowing tweet by Yogi Devnath (Hindu Yuva Vahini Incharge Gujarat Pradesh Member, All India Sadhu Samaj, President Sant Samaj Kutch) with 1.2 Million followers have been retweeted by more than 4100 times –“ये भी अवैध निर्माण हैं इसे कब तोड़ेंगे उद्धव“archiveFacebookVinit Hindu‘s Post has been shared by more than 3100 people on Facebook –archiveTruthThe mosque in the photo is from Katra Market, Sagar, Madhya Pradesh, not Mumbai.We found many results in reverse image search, we selected the filter “before 1st September 2020” and found following tweet made on 2nd Aug 2020, which called it Katra Market, Sagar, MPWith Katra added to the image we found few blogs with the same image with link back to a Dainik Bhaskar news. The article claimed this photo is from Katra Bazar, Sagar, MP, opened after Lockdown.Further we searched for it on Google Maps and found the same mosque, Jama Masjid.On the left below is a clipped part of the Mosque from the viral image while the right one is the photo of the Mosque itself in Sagar, MPFollowing is the video of the same Mosque –Screenshot from the video –More False Tweets and Facebook posts –यह मस्जिद बिल्कुल बैध है इसको BMC और शवसेना ने बनवाया है क्या? नक्सा भी बैध है जगह भी बैध है सरकार की मंजूरी है जनता भी खुस है पूरे मुम्बई में तो बस कंगना का आफिस ही अबैध था ?? जबाब दो मुम्बई pic.twitter.com/iU45jgmuGF — साध्वी आंकाक्षा 💯 #फॉलो (राष्ट्र सेविका समिति) (@iakankshamishr) September 10, 2020बॉम्बे म्युनिसिपल कारपोरेशन ( BMC ), संजय राउत जी, उद्धव ठाकरे जी इसे भी तोड़ के दिखाईए । क्या ये अवैध निर्माण नही है ?यह मस्जिद मुंबई के बांद्रा में बीच रोड पे बनी हुई है ।क्या महाराष्ट्र सरकार और BMC ये करने का साहस कर सकती है । इससे बाला साहेब को अवश्य शांति मिलेगी | pic.twitter.com/LFalRuE117 — sonisanatani #प्रशासक_समिति✊🚩 (@sonirak08338549) September 10, 2020नॉटी_कालिया अगर 2 साल पहले नोटिस दिया था तो इतने दिन Bmc पेंगुई की पोट्टी साफ कर रही थी जो सोई हुई थीमुम्बई में ऐसे लाखो घर बिल्डिंग अनलीगल है उसपे BMC कोई एक्शन क्यो नही लेतीयह मस्जिद मुंबई के बांद्रा मे बीच रोड पे बनी हैक्या BMC उद्धव को यह नही दिखी दम है इसपे एक्शन लेनेका pic.twitter.com/B2DLserVMi — केशव राजपूत #limit (@keshu_777) September 10, 2020https://www.facebook.com/photo/?fbid=3111319612330741&set=a.3111319565664079https://www.facebook.com/groups/2314825615402743/permalink/2727920204093280/
label: truth

content: An idol of Kalia Maa burnt accidentally in a Temple in WB is viral with a communal angle. Spread the truth:A set of photos of a burnt idol of Godess Kali Maa is viral claimed as it’s done by an outsider. Some claim it’s done by an “unkown” or “miscreants” others claim it’s done by “Jihadis”.TwitterArjun Singh, Vice President,@BJP4Bengal, | Member Of Parliament, Barrackpore Lok Sabha tweeted –“The jihadi nature of Didi’s politics is now hell bent on destroying Hindu religion and culture. See how one religious group has attacked and destroyed a temple and burned the idol of Maa Kali in Murshidabad area of West Bengal. Shameful.“The jihadi nature of Didi's politics is now hell bent on destroying Hindu religion and culture.See how one religious group has attacked and destroyed a temple and burned the idol of Maa Kali in Murshidabad area of West Bengal. Shameful. pic.twitter.com/lTnyiV9ctV — Arjun Singh (@ArjunsinghWB) September 1, 2020A tweet by “Facts” has been retweeted around 3.6K timesSome 'unknown' person burnt the idol Kali Maa in Murshidabad.Before After pic.twitter.com/oaJyaizTj6 — Facts (@BefittingFacts) September 1, 2020archiveDesi Mojito quoted above tweet asking actor Jaaved Jaaferi which led to approx 2K retweets of his tweetarchiveThe miscreants set fire to an Kali idol at an Kali temple in Alampur vill of Naoda PS in Murshidabad late last night.Earlier,gold ornaments of idol were stolen from d same temple.Alampur is a Mslm majority area. At different times Hnds face obstacles in practicing their religion pic.twitter.com/UbgMtPBkO0 — Raju Das 🇧🇩 (@RajuDas77136393) September 1, 2020WestBengal Police is after my life as I am consistently raising the Voice for Deprived&Tortured Hindus.Another incident- this time Mooslem majority District MURSHIDABAD.Idol of Maa Kali Burnt at Alampur, Ps Naoda.Hapless disciples was compelled to get the Burnt Murti Visarjan pic.twitter.com/0DE5izqGFM — Devdutta Maji (@MajiDevDutta) September 2, 2020FacebookarchiveWhatsAppWebsitesTruthThe idol of Kali Ma did burn but it was accidental, no one did it intentionally.We first started with reverse search image but didn’t get any result which led us to believe that this incident is recent.The second thing we noted was West Bengalo BJP Vice President, Arjun Singh mentioning the location as “Murshidabad” which gave us a clue.So we looked for Murshidabad Police on twitter and found a tweet clearing the issue. They replied to Arjun Singh.As stated by mandir committee it was a fire accident. Temple authorities are taking necessary action. Local police and administration coordinating.Do not share to anyone without verifying personally.You may contact mandir committee for further details. pic.twitter.com/YTZJFwjWiE — Murshidabad Police (@MurshidabadPol1) September 1, 2020archiveBut then again, this twitter handle claiming to be Murshidabad Police was not verified and have a small number of followers so we called up them up and talked directly to the Superintendent of Police IPS Sabari Rajkumar.He clearly said it was an accident and not intentional harm done by anyone. He told us that the reason was a lamp burning at the feet of the idol. He also cleared that the handle was theirs and not fake, they are working on it to get verified.They also tweeted a letter by Temple Committee on Temple’s Letterhead“Alampur Kali Maa Nimtala Kalimandir”SP, Murshidabad sent us Hindi translation of the letter above“एक विशेष आवेदन,मेरा आप सबसे एक सविनय निवेदन है कि मैं काली माता निमतला मंदिर का संपादक हूं और मेरा नाम है सुखदेव बाजपाई, पिता अर्जित बाजपाई, ग्राम आलिंपुर, पो सरतानगर, थाना नऊदा, जिला मुर्शिदाबाद।31.8.2020 तारीख को रात में हमारे मंदिर में काली मां कि मूर्ति में आग लग गई। मंदिर में मैं कार्यरत्त हूं, और मैं यह बताना चाहता हूं कि हमारे इलाके में हिन्दू और मुस्लिम के बीच के संबंध काफी मधुर है। यह केवल एक दुर्घटना मात्र है। इस इलाके के हिन्दू मुस्लिम ऐसा काम नहीं कर सकते। गौरतलब है कि मंदिर का ताला तोड़ा नहीं गया, और किसी भी प्रकार की चोरी नहीं हुई, यह सिर्फ एक दुर्घटना मात्र है। कुछ लोग इसको साम्प्रदायिक रूप देकर उसका दुष्प्रचार करने की चेष्टा कर रहे हैं। मेरा सभी से यह अनुरोध है कि किसी भी प्रकार की अफवाहों पर यकीन ना करे, एवम् किसी प्रकार की अफवाह ना फैलाए।सुखदेव बाजपाई,संपादक, काली मंदिर”On asking SP cleared Sampadak in Bengali is a word for SecretaryWe also talked to the Secretary Mr. Sukhdev Bajpayee above who told us that there was no damage, no theft, Lock was intact too. He told us further that they keep a burning lamp under the idol every-night which might be the reason for this unfortunate incident.He emphasized on the point that all the religions in the community lives in total harmony and their is no communal angle involved, especially when even their lock was intact.West Bengal Police have also cleared the issueRelated
label: truth

Jai Hind pic.twitter.com/iSSb6cZloA — Gaurav Pradhan 🇮🇳 (@OfficeOfDGP) August 14, 2020********************************************************Update – 6th Aug 2021R P Singh: National Spokesperson, BJPFrom 1992 to 2021.In 1992 Murli Manohar Joshi ji & @narendramodi ji hoisted National Flag amidst gun fire in Valley at Lal Chowk. Today every roof top in Kashmir proudly hoist Tricolor.#NewJammuKashmir pic.twitter.com/on7yaxYRZ5 — R P Singh: National Spokesperson BJP (@rpsinghkhalsa) August 6, 2021archiveGajendra Chauhan –archiveNavin Kumar Jindal, Media Head @bjp4delhi #Spokesperson, BJParchive****************************************************************FacebookUttar Pradesh Org –archiveFollowing post has been shared for more than 5100 timesFollowing post has been shared for more than 4200 timesWhatsAppNews houseNewspaper Jagran posted an article based on same imagearchiveFront Page of Dainik JagranSource for above photoNew Kashmir! BJP MP shares viral image of Tricolour at Srinagar's Lal Chowk#IDay2020 #IndependenceDay https://t.co/fPELJhVdqO — Jagran English (@JagranEnglish) August 15, 2020Tweet archiveNews ArchiveNews Nation, a news channel, published and article based on fake image –Tweet ArchiveNews ArchiveTruthThe photo is edited with Flag added on it digitally. The original photo is a decade old, Year 2010The blog posted in 2010 published the same photo.archiveWe have contacted the author of the article, Mr. Mubasshir Mushtaq, a freelance journalist. He claimed he himself took the photo and emailed us the original photo from which we found the photo was taken on 22nd June 2010 by Canon PowerShot S5 IS.You can see complete EXIF data of the original photo hereThe same photo has been used by few News houses 3 years ago, i.e. 2017.News – “Shiv Sena sends a team to hoist Indian flag on Lal Chowk”ABPNews 18You can see a comparison between the now viral photo and the original old photo below which proves that the viral photo is edited, not real.You can see the same vehicles on same position, a man walking with bag in his hand. The red rectangle on top in viral image shows a light blue strip is added digitally to fit the flag.The photo below is part of forensics of images and is an ELA (Error Level Analysis) of the viral image. Link of analysisAs shown in the red rectangle on the viral image above, you can see that it’s a flat color in the ELA screenshot below. The top part of the image is flat single color with flag on it. SO the original image was extended vertically (a light blue strip matching sky color) to fit the flag on it.Further, the flag has been taken from a photo which only shows the blue sky.SourceCompare the flag parts of the original photo vs the one in viral imageLeft is original, same has been used in the fake viral imageComplete Original photoFurther, the viral image is old. The building behind the tower has been renovated, canopies on the roof changed, entire building has been painted white.Source for right image: Getty Images (rectangle added by SMHoaxSlayer)The Tribune posted an article 2 days ago and shows the building in white color too.2 days old video of a search operation by Army for safety on independence day also shows the same building in White Color, SourceBelow is an year old ABP news video clip from Lal Chowk which also shows the renovated building is in white colorTweeted on 7th August, you can see the building is in white color matching recent photos
label: truth

content: RIP Pranab Mukherjee trends on twitter, even noted journalists fell for this fake news. Spread the truth:On 13th August the unverified news of the demise of the former president Dr. Pranab Mukherjee due to Covid19 went viral social media. A hashtag #ripPranabMukherjee started trending on thursday morning and rised to number one the twitter trending hashtag list.TwitterThe rumours of the demise of the former president of India went viral and many journalist also tweeted this unverified news on their twitter account. Rajdeep Sardesai the consulting editor of India Today tweeted that “Breaking: Former president Pranab Mukherjee has passed away.. farewell Pranab da.. many many fond memories of a dyed in the wool true Indira generation politician who lived and breathed politics..”Many other journalists and popular accounts tweeted the unverified viral news.The trends24 website shows that the #ripPranabMukherjee was actually trending on twitter.FacebookThe rumors spread quickly on Facebook as people started sharing the rumor like this pageTruthThe news of the demise of former President Pranab Mukherjee was found to be a fake news as clarified by his son.Former president Pranab Mukherjee tested positive for COVID-19 on August 10 according to media reports. Mukherjee tweeted about contracting the virus.On a visit to the hospital for a separate procedure, I have tested positive for COVID19 today.I request the people who came in contact with me in the last week, to please self isolate and get tested for COVID-19. #CitizenMukherjee — Pranab Mukherjee (@CitiznMukherjee) August 10, 2020Pranab Mukherjee’s son cleared the air about his father’s health. He dismissed the rumours by refuting claims of demise of his father. He tweeted Abhijit Mukherjee who took to Twitter to clarify, “My Father Shri Pranab Mukherjee is still alive & haemodynamically stable! Speculations & fake news being circulated by reputed Journalists on social media clearly reflects that Media in India has become a factory of Fake News.”My Father Shri Pranab Mukherjee is still alive & haemodynamically stable !Speculations & fake news being circulated by reputed Journalists on social media clearly reflects that Media in India has become a factory of Fake News . — Abhijit Mukherjee (@ABHIJIT_LS) August 13, 2020Also Clarified by his daughterRumours about my father is false. Request, esp’ly to media, NOT to call me as I need to keep my phone free for any updates from the hospital🙏 — Sharmistha Mukherjee (@Sharmistha_GK) August 13, 2020Journalists and popular personalities deleted their tweets apologizing to the common people.My deep deep apologies for falling for fake news being circulated on Pranab Mukherjee passing away. I am deeply distraught for falling for this fake news.. it was unprofessional of me to not reconfirm it before tweeting. Apologies to all.. and prayers with the family.. 🙏🙏🙏 — Rajdeep Sardesai (@sardesairajdeep) August 13, 2020Pranab Mukherjee is currently recovering after brain surgery at New Delhi’s Army Research and Referral hospital. “The condition of former President Pranab Mukherjee remains unchanged this morning. He is deeply comatose with stable vital parameters and continues to be on ventilatory support: Army Research & Referral (R&R) Hospital, Delhi,” tweeted ANI.The condition of former President Pranab Mukherjee remains unchanged this morning. He is deeply comatose with stable vital parameters and continues to be on ventilatory support: Army Research & Referral (R&R) Hospital, Delhi https://t.co/JPhaOOoEvL — ANI (@ANI) August 13, 2020Related
label: rumor

content: A digitally edited billboard wishing Happy Republic Day is viral. Spread the truth:A photo of a huge billboard on a building roof is viral showing an alleged ad of Congress, MP with photos of Kamal Nath and Nakul Nath wishing Happy Republic Day.WhatsApp“ये हालत है कांग्रेस की, स्वतंत्रता दिवस और गणतंत्र दिवस के बीच का फर्क भी नहीं पता। 😆😆सबको पता चलना चाहिए, कर दो सब को फारवर्ड”TwitterClaim – “कांग्रेसियों ने फिर करायी फ़ज़ीहत, नकुल नाथ और उनके समर्थकों ने दी ‘गणतंत्र दिवस’ की शुभकामना। One more Pappu ka Paplu”कांग्रेसियों ने फिर करायी फ़ज़ीहत नकुल नाथ और उनके समर्थकों ने दी ‘गणतंत्र दिवस’ की शुभकामना। One more Pappu ka Paplu pic.twitter.com/LhdXV3q58m — Suresh Nakhua 🇮🇳 ( सुरेश नाखुआ ) (@SureshNakhua) August 13, 2020archivearchiveWe are living in 2020 while Kamalnath’s son is living in January 2021 and is wishing us Happy Republic day. 😂 pic.twitter.com/RDKJNeyS65 — Smoking Skills (@SmokingSkills_) August 13, 2020You can see many other tweets at the end of this article.AnalysisThe image is digitally edited, the billboard actually has an advertisement of a Bank on it.On studying the image in detail, we observed it might be edited, details of which will follow.The first thing we noted, to move our investigation forward was the name of the building on top and the different commercial set ups in it whose names were hanging outside. we searched for the names on Google, the building came out to be KK Plaza, MP Nagar, Bhopal, MP.Following this, we looked for all the names on google, got hold of their contact number, called them up. Coaching classes came out to be closed due to Lockdown so we couldn’t get any reply from them, but were helped by a shop in the same building. The owner while online over the phone stepped out, checked the Billboard and told us it’s of “Bandhan Bank” and on asking for something specific, said it has a photo of a small tempo.Then we searched for KK Plaza on Google maps. The rectangle shows the huge billboard on it’s roof facing a chowk.We looked for shops and other commercial set ups opposite to the building and got hold of a Hotel. The man who picked up the phone checked from the window and said the same what previous one did – “Bandhan Bank”He also sent us the photo over WhatsApp (below)We also contacted the advertising agency which owns the billboard, RK Publicity (Thanks to Vinay Singhal) and they clarified that they put up this “Bandhan Bank” hoarding two days ago, before which it had only the number of the agency to contact (for advertising).We also contacted the founder of Wittyfeeds/Nukkad, Vinay Singhal, who arranged other photos of the same building taken today.Later he sent four photos from a little different angleNow about editing, following are the things we noted first in the viral image below –1. The image viral is only one, same photo from same angle, cropped differently i.e. different sizes. Only one photo.2. The image was way to bright to be real, real one has to be darker, grayish. The one above looked whiter.3. The edges of the billboard is a give away. A billboard has to have a frame on all sides on which the banner is wrapped. Look below for a comparison of the viral one with the real one.Taken from Viral Image –Below are the zoomed part taken from the photos we received today –Few things are common in the images below which is not present in the viral image.The shade of white, how dark it is, The edges of banner, the points used to tie the banner (small red circles), the bottom part of the frame where the banner is wrapped on so is darker.Further we also edited the viral image and added a landscape photo is the same shape as the wrong one was added. It’s easy to change shape, skew any image to make it fit on something.More false tweets –कोंग्रेस ने बोला है तो हम भी 15 अगस्त को स्वतंत्रता दिवस की जगह गणतंत्र दिवस मनाएंगे फिर तो 🤣 pic.twitter.com/7hDRpoZ1qt — प्रोफेसर Raja babu 🥳🌈 (@GaurangBhardwa1) August 13, 2020Nashe : Saste nashe : Congress wale nashe 🤦🤦😂😂 pic.twitter.com/YIaNA76dUx — Neha Singh ☺️☺️🤗 (@Neha68326953) August 13, 2020https://twitter.com/Nazir_Mudassar1/status/1293832660398346240https://twitter.com/FunKeyBaat/status/1293796454343913472Related
label: truth

content: Boris Johnson, Prime Minister of UK, did not perform Shri Ram Abishek on 5th August, bhumi poojan day. Spread the truth:A photo of the Prime Minister of United Kingdom, Mr. Boris Johnson is viral on social media claiming that he was captured doing “Abishek” of an idol of Lord Ram on 5th August the day of Bhumi poojan .The picture is being circulated heavily on WhatsApp, Facebook and Twitter in which Boris Johnson can be seen performing rituals according to Hindu customs. Viral text with the photo claims that Boris did Ram abishek as he respects Hindu culture.TwitterThe tweet posted on 7th August displaying photo with the same caption claiming that Boris Johnson said he respects Hindu culture and which is why he did abishek of Lord Ram on 5th August got above 15,500 Retweets and 67,000 Likes.I'm a big fan of Indian Culture So I Did "SHRI RAM ABHISHEK" With Our Home minister at my Residence On 5th of August. pic.twitter.com/fYlfzpZNnl — Boris Johnson (@BorisUKJohnson) August 7, 2020archiveI'm a big fan of Indian Culture So I Did "SHRI RAM ABHISHEK" With Our Home minister at my Residence On 5th of August. Boris Johnson NZ PM This is big 👋 in the mouth of secular Hindus pic.twitter.com/XMvxrzu0Ki — Dev kumar yadav (@Devkuma05058164) August 8, 2020#PetaIndia Boris Johnson @BorisUKJohnson · I'm a big fan of Indian Culture So I Did "SHRI RAM ABHISHEK" With Our Home minister at my Residence On 5th of August.And back in India an anti Hindu gang called PETA spews venom against Hindus. pic.twitter.com/CYwiVG87PC — guruswamy (@guru956) August 7, 2020WhatsappThese pictures are viral on whatsapp along with the text –VIRAL TEXT–“गर्व की बात है। भूमि पूजन के दिन इमगलैंड के प्रधानमंत्री बोरिस जॉनसन ने उनके आफिस में “श्री राम अभिषेक” किया। जय श्री रामये हर हिन्दू तक पहुंचना चाहिए, करो फारवर्ड 🙏🏻”TRANSLATION–“Something to be proud of. England’s Prime Minister, Boris Johnson did Shree Ram Abhishek on 5th August, day of Bhumi Pujan, in his office. This should reach all hindus, do forward.”FacebookThe same picture being shared by several groups and accounts on Facebook with the caption –” I’m a big fan of Indian Culture So I Did “SHRI RAM ABHISHEK” With Our Home minister at my Residence On 5th of August.”Boris Johnson, PM, UK” ·A Facebook page called The Wise Indian with above 80,000 likes has also shared the same pictureTruth:The photo is a year old, not related to 5th August Bhumi Pujan.The viral photo with several claims is actually from a ceremony which was held last year.The tweet which is viral on twitter is originally tweeted by a fake account claiming to be UK Prime Minister Boris Johnson.The picture is originally of a temple in north-west London which Boris visited in December 2019.The photos posted on 8th Dec 2019 said“Last night Boris Johnson visited the Hindu temple of Neasden in north-west London with Priti Patel.“This temple is one of the greatest gifts to our country. It is brought to life by the amazing community spirit that inhabits it. You are giving back to our society through the great charitable work that you do. London and the UK are lucky to have you.” – Boris.”Related
label: truth

content: No it’s not Rhea Chakraborty with Aditya Thackeray in this viral picture. Spread the truth:A photo of Aditya Thackeray with a girl is viral on Facebook and Twitter. In the picture he can be seen driving while the girl on the passengers seat is alleged to be the actress Rhea Chakraborty. This photo along with the allegation below is spreading like wild-fire right now.Viral – “जब उद्धव ठाकरे का बेटा #सुशान्त_सिंह की गर्ल फ्रेंड #रिया_चक्रवर्ती के साथ घुम रहा है तब कहा से सुशांत सिंह की हत्या की #CBI जांच होगी“Translation: “When son of Uddhav Thackrey is roaming with girlfriend of Sushant SIngh, then how can CBI investigate Sushant Singh’s murder”Sushant Singh Rajput’s death has shook the nation. Since the demise of the Bollywood star a humongous amount of claims pertaining to his death are generating buzz on social media. Sushant’s girlfriend actress Rhea Chakraborty is accused of conspiring his death. The court shall decide the legitimacy of these numerous claims and rumors.FacebookA post by Rohit Sardana Fans club claimed that Rhea Chakraborty has close relations with Aditya Thackeray which is the reason Maharashtra government and Udhav Thackeray are not handing over the case to CBI. This post got 2 thousand likes and nearly 3 thousand shares on facebook.http://archive.is/cNWn6TwitterThe same picture with netizens demanding CBI inquiry as well as the arrest of Rhea Chakraborty is being shared on Twitter. The following tweet by a twitter handle Ankita Dave currently has got the maximum no. of retweets with over 10k likes and 4600+ retweets.http://archive.is/CsGIHA tweet sharing the same picture by account of Umanand Mishra accusing the state govt. of inaction. This tweet also got nearly 4 thousand retweets which are increasing every hour.http://archive.is/98VG6A fake twitter handle by the name of Arnab goswami also got above 3k tweetsBhavesh K Pandey who’s twitter profile claimed that he is affiliated with BJP and RSS also shared the picture with identical claim.We found several other accounts that shared the picture on twitter which you can find at the end of this article.TruthThe actress with Aditya Thackeray is Disha Patani and not Rhea Chakraborty.The above screenshot is from article published by PinkvillaThe above screensho is from an article published by Times of India.The alleged photo is from early June last year, when Aditya Thackeray and Disha Patani were spotted together going on a lunch. A picture from that news report is now going viral under the claim that Aditya Thackeray and Rhea Chakraborty are close. The photo is being shared with wrong captions and false claims.Below are links to all tweets we found which make allegations and false claims without verifying the picture.Aditya Thakrey With Rhea Chakrworty , Aditya thakrey has some connection this case , mumbai police and maharastra gov hiding it .#UddhavResignOrCBI4SSR pic.twitter.com/Er91aILJb1 — A fan of Kangana Ranaut🙏🙏 (@KanganaKi) August 1, 2020Every thing is crystal clear , Aditya Thakrey With Rhea Chakrworty , Aditya thakrey has some connection this case , mumbai police and maharastra gov hiding it ….#UddhavResignOrCBI4SSR pic.twitter.com/6DVRDnb9Th — Sajan (@Sajan_golu_k) August 1, 2020Shame on cm Mumbai pic.twitter.com/K0sAKqcfDt — Rtkvikas (@Rtkvikas1) August 1, 2020Folllow Smhoaxslayer on Twitter, Facebook, Instagram for more such fact-check.Related
label: truth

content: Ayush Ministry’s statement about Coronil, a Ramdev Baba’s product was given a fake communal angle Spread the truth:On 24th of June a tweet claiming that doctor Mujahid Hussain has been removed from the Ayush Ministry because he had put a ban on ‘coronil’ medicine made by Patanjali was tweeted from the handle @RealPushpendra. It got 5931 retweets and 18k likes.TwitterOriginal post by the handle @RealPushpendra which was later deleted.TruthThe claim made in the tweet was later identified as as fake by Press Information Bureau (PIB) Fact Check.PIB Fact check also clarified that there was no such panel of doctors in the Ministry of Ayush which was alleged as system jihad.This was the official statement made by Ministry of Ayush on twitter. https://twitter.com/moayush/status/1276057805678501893?s=20Related
label: truth

content: AAP uses Mumbai’s Covidbed facility photos calming to be from Pragati Maidan, Delhi. A set of photos are viral showing an isolation unit being built up with beds and other amenities. With the images, the viral claim states this photos to be from Pragati Maidan.Aam Aadmi Party Jharkhand Offical Facebook Page posted 2 photos claiming it to be 2700 beds being prepared in Pragati Maidan, Delhi“दिल्ली सरकार समर्पित है। आम जनता की सेवा के लिए प्रगति मैदान में तैयार हो रहा है। 2700 करोना बेड जिसमें लोगों को सुविधा मिलेगी।————————————-मानव सेवा से बढ़कर कुछ नहीं होता।”archiveTwitterWork in progress to make Pragati Maidan into a large hospital space. content: No, Jyotiraditya Scindia did not remove “BJP” from his Twitter profile bio Spread the truth:Claim: “Jyotiraditya Scindia has removed “BJP” from his Twitter bio. He might now quit the BJP too after leaving Congress in March this year.”On 6th June, #JyotiradityaScindia was the top 5 trends on Twitter, with netizens claiming that he has removed “BJP” from his Twitter bio and that he might quit BJP as well after leaving Congress in the month of March. While many claimed he might be joining Congress again.As per GetDayTrends, #JyotiradityaScindia was in the Top 5 trends in India, on 6th June.TWITTERArchiveTruthAt present, J.Scindia Twitter profile bio is “Public servant, cricket enthusiast”To begin with, Jyotiraditya Scindia never added “BJP” to his Twitter bio. Firstly, we went to an online tool that tracks Twitter profile changes named, Spoonbill.J. Scindia had last changed his Twitter bio on November 17, 2019, while in Congress.J. Scindia had significantly removed the designation of former MP and former Union minister to “Public servant, cricket enthusiast”. After the change on Nov 17, 2019, Scindia never changed his Twitter bio. He changed his profile picture when he joined the BJP in March 2020.We also found an archive of Scindia’s Twitter profile saved on May 17, 2020, in the digital archive tool “Wayback Machine”, which proves that he did not change his bio even after joining BJP. The bio read the same, “Public servant, cricket enthusiast”He also confirmed that he never added: “BJP” to his Twitter profile by retweeting a tweet that read, “श्री @JM_Scindia जी के बारे में मीडिया में चल रही खबरें पूरी तरह से निराधार है। सिंधिया जी ने अपने टि्वटर बायो में कोई चेंज नहीं किया है, पहले भी उनके बायो में क्रिकेट प्रेमी और जनसेवक ऐड था और आज भी वही है।” (translation: The ongoing news in the media about Mr @JM_Scindia is completely baseless. Scindia ji has not made any changes in his twitter bio, even before his bio was a cricket lover and public servant and it is the same today.”)Archive Hence it is established that Jyotiraditya Scindia never added “BJP” to his Twitter Bio, the claims are absolutely false.It is to be noted that Jyotiraditya Scindia, former MP from Guna in Madhya Pradesh, had joined the BJP on March 11 this year after an 18-year-long term with the Congress. The move had toppled the Kamal Nath government in MP as 22 MLAs loyal to Scindia resigned from Congress and joined BJP. This paved the way for the Shivraj Singh Chouhan-led BJP government to return to power.Related
label: rumor

content: Was the White House stormed in by protestors amidst the death of African-American George Floyd? Spread the truth:A video is doing the rounds on social media that allegedly shows protestors breaking into a huge white building with claims that it is the White House. This video has popped up amidst increasing protests in the United States of America seeking justice for African-American man George Floyd who had died as a result of police brutality in Minnesota, USA. The entire video can be viewed here and screenshots of the same are as follows:FacebookOn Facebook, the video was shared along with the caption, “Yooooooo this crazy they stormed the White House they are on the west lawn, at the door. Babylon is burning.”PostArchivePostArchiveTwitterFor the first time in American History, Protestors broke in and down the #WhiteHouse … #WhiteHouseProtests #WhiteHouseDown pic.twitter.com/3mqYS3NDUl — A Humanist (@ZaheerHumanist) June 1, 2020ArchiveYouTubeArchiveTruthThe protests outside The White House turned violent with the authorities declaring the condition ‘red’ and taking the US President to a bunker for protection amidst the death of George Floyd.The entire article for the same can be read here on The Print. A screenshot of the same is as follows:However, the building in question that can be seen in the video is not the White House.A report filed by NBC4i, a Columbus based news website stated that “Protest in downtown Columbus broken up after demonstrators breach Ohio Statehouse”. A video from the protest as posted under this article can be viewed here. Screenshots of the same is as follows:A Google Reverse Search Image showed that the building shown in the video closely represents the Ohio Statehouse.A close comparison of the building as obtained from a screenshot in the video to the Ohio Statehouse as taken from Google Maps shows the following common points of identification:Hence the building from the video was not the White House but the Ohio Statehouse.Related

content: Viral picture claiming Aditi Singh has joined BJP is old Spread the truth:Claim: “अदिति सिंह कांग्रेस पार्टी छोड़कर 5 विधायकों सहित भाजपा ज्वाइन किया ।दिल से अभिनंदन ,बहुत-बहुत बधाई हो। भाजपा पार्टी में आपका स्वागत है।”Translation: “Aditi Singh has left the Congress Party, and joined the Bhartiya Janata Party with five other people. BJP welcomes you.”The photo of Aditi Singh has gone viral with the claims that she has joined the Bhartiya Janata Party after quitting the Congress party. The photo has been shared extensively over social mediaFACEBOOKArchiveArchiveThe posts have been shared widely over Facebook,TWITTERArchiveArchiveTruthAfter doing a Google Reverse Image Search of the viral picture, we found that the picture was posted by Aditi Singh on Mother’s Day, which is 10th May 2020 on Twitter. The picture was one in the series of photos she posted.ArchiveHere is the full image,Note that Aditi Singh was suspended from the Congress’s Women Party Wing. The news report by Times Now Digital on 21st May, 2020 read, “Congress suspends Aditi Singh from women’s wing, after Raebareli MLA slammed party for ‘fraud’”.The suspension came days after she posted the viral picture on Twitter.To be more clear we did a Google search with the keywords to see if there are any media reports of Aditi Singh joining the Bhartiya Janata Party, we did not come across such reports neither are there any official confirmations about the same.Hence, it is established that Aditi Singh has not joined the Bhartiya Janata Party after being suspended from Congress, it is also to be noted that the viral picture is an old picture that she posted on Mother’s Day. The viral claims are absolutely false.Related
label: truth

content: Tripura CM Biplab Deb used Bora Bora island picture to wish Goa on statehood day Spread the truth:Tripura’s Chief Minister Biplap Deb tweeted French Polynesia’s picture to wish goa on statehood day. The picture included text and a graphic of Bora Bora islands with seaside shacks and a hill in the background. This post was curated for residents of Goa to wish them on their big day.While he wrote quite enough on the picture itself, he also added a caption to it which read “Greetings to the beloved people of #Goa on their statehood day. May the state prosper more.”In the tweet, two more twitter handles got tagged who further retweeted them as a mark of respect and celebration. Both these twitter handles are of Goa’s CM Pramod Sawant. One is his personal account and the other is the official account for Goa’s current Chief Minister.Twitter:The above-mentioned tweet is the original one that was posted by the official account of CM Biplab Kumar Deb on twitter. This is howbeit an archived version of the same as the original one was taken down after a while.You can view the archived tweet here.The retweets and other tweets have been taken down as the original one was removed.TruthA reverse image search was used to find out the true story of the image CM Biplab used on the poster. We found out that the graphic he used on the poster was of Bora Bora islands in French Polynesia and not Goa.Below mentioned is the image he used on the picture. This graphic has been taken from a website called Pixabay and the image used in the poster is the same as this one:You can view it here.This image was shot in June 2011. It was uploaded on this website in 2017.Related

content: Old image of Congress party member Alka Lamba viral with false claims Spread the truth:An old photo of Congress party member Alka Lamba has gone viral with the claim that she was attacked for abusing PM Modi in one of her videos which went viral on social media recently.CLAIMAn old photo of Alka Lamba went viral on social media claiming that she was attacked by supporters of Bhim Army (dalit rights organisation). The photo went viral with the following caption-बहनजी पर अभद्र टिप्पणी करने वाली अलका लम्बा को माफी न मांगने पर भीम शेरनीयो ने घर में घुसकर ठोक दियाऔर उसने अपने पिटाई की भड़ास बीजेपी पर जा निकाली😂😂😂मैं इस बात पर उनकी कड़ी निंदा करता हूंTranslation–Supporters of Bhim arm trashed Alka Lamba after the latter did not ask for forgiveness. And she removed that frustration on BJP. I strongly condemn this.FACEBOOKarchiveThe following post was uploaded by facebook user ‘कुँ. रूपेश सिंह बौद्ध’ (Kumar Rupesh Singh) on 25th May. This post has garnered 107 shares.The same photo went viral in around April claiming that Alka Lamba was beaten up by a 16 year old girl.archiveThe following post was uploaded on April 7th, by facebook user ‘शिवम् कुशवाहा‎’ (Shivam Kushwaha) and garnered 98 shares and 765 likes.TWITTERarchiveA twitter handle under the name ‘प्रदीप अम्बेडकर’ tweeted this photo along with the caption- ऐसा होना भी जरूरी था, साथियों सुनने में आ रहा कि कुछ लोग #Alka_Lamba को उसके घर मे घुस कर खूब धोया।। निन्दनीय है।। (Translation- This was necessary, it has come to notice that Alka Lamba was beaten up in her house. It’s condemn-able.)The following photo was not much viral on twitter.TRUTHThe claim is false. This is an old photo of Alka Lamba fom 2015 of an attack during her teams Anti-drug drive near Rajghat and is now viral with false claims.Alka Lamba, the then AAP MLA, was attacked during an Anti-drug drive from Yamuna to Bazar in Kashmere Gate area around 5 a.m. The following Newspapers wrote about the incident- India Today , Hindustan Times and DNA.Screenshot Hindustan times articleAAP's fight Ag Drug will be intensified. AAP MLA Alka Lamba was attacked by drug cartel. Our fight will continue. pic.twitter.com/bhafOXxzG8 — ashutosh (@ashutosh83B) August 9, 2015Co-founder of Satyahindi ( Hindi News portal) Ashutosh tweeted this image on 9th August 2015. content: No, Murli Manohar Joshi did not offer sweets to PM Modi after the start of Ram Mandir construction Spread the truth:Claim: “#राम मंदिर निर्माण की प्रथम #ईट रखे जाने पर #मुरली_जी जोशी हिन्दू हृदय सम्राट #मोदीजी का मुँह मीठा करवाते हुऐ #वाह रे हिन्दू राजा #नरेंद्र_मोदी..450 #साल का कलंक सिर्फ 6 #साल में ही मिटा दिया…सच्चा सनातन संस्कृति का #मूर्तिपूजक हिन्दू आपको साधुवाद देता है.”Translation: “Since the Ram Mandir construction has started, on the occasion of the first brick laid, Murli Manohar Joshi offered sweets to PM Narendra Modi. Narendra Modi, you wiped down the blur in 6 years. Sanathan culture embraces you.”The picture has been shared extensively on social media claiming that BJP veteran Murli Manohar Joshi offered sweets to PM Modi after the start of the Ram Mandir construction, which is after the first brick was laid down in the construction process.FACEBOOKArchiveArchiveThe post was shared widely over Facebook,TWITTERThe photo was also shared widely on Twitter,ArchiveThe picture was shared widely on Twitter as well,TruthUpon doing a Google Reverse Image Search of the viral image, we came across a few news reports, of the day when PM Narendra Modi visited the Bhartiya Janata Party veteran Murli Manohar Joshi, after winning the Loksabha Elections in 2019.We found a report by The Hindu, from May 25, 2019, where a similar picture as that of the viral picture was published with the caption, “Sweet tidings: Prime Minister Narendra Modi being offered sweets by BJP veteran Murli Manohar Joshi as party president Amit Shah looks on in New Delhi on Friday.”Notice that the background setting, the attire is very much similar to the viral picture.India Today also published the image in the timeline report of the Loksabha Elections Results 2019,As we looked for the exact viral photo, we came across a tweet by Murli Manohar Joshi where he posted the exact photo on PM Narendra Modi’s birthday last year, captioning it as, “प्रार्थयामहे भव शतायु: ईश्वर सदा त्वाम् च रक्षतु। पुण्य कर्मणा कीर्तिमार्जय जीवनम् तव भवतु सार्थकम् @narendramodi“ArchiveHence, it is established that the image is from May 2019, when PM Modi met the BJP veteran Murli Manohar Joshi after the Loksabha Election results in 2019. Murli Manohar Joshi also posted the viral picture on PM Modi’s birthday last year.The viral claims that Murli Manohar Joshi offered sweets to PM Modi after the first brick of Ram Mandir construction was laid down are absolutely false.Related

content: Viral video shared as inefficiency of Delhi Govt, is actually of KEM Hospital, Mumbai The viral video shared as inefficiency of Delhi Govt, is actually of KEM Hospital, MumbaiViral: “केजरवाल कुछ तो शर्म करो……. हद हो गई भाई। नहीं समलता तो बताओ राष्ट्रपति शासन लागू करने का अनुरोध करें”Translation: “Kejriwal, you should be ashamed. All limits have been crossed. If you can’t handle the situation, tell us. We will request for President’s Rule in Delhi.”The video has been shared extensively over social media.FACEBOOKThis particular post by one Rajendra Sharma, who claims to be District Vice President of Bhartiya Janta Party (BJP) has been shared for over 28,000 times and has been viewed for 7,65,000 timesArchiveThe video has been shared widely over FacebookThe video has been shared on Twitter as wellकेजरवाल कुछ तो शर्म करो……. हद हो गई भाई। नहीं समलता तो बताओ राष्ट्रपति शासन लागू करने का अनुरोध करें Unlimited videos free download! Dont miss the chance to get to know the App which 10000000+ person love the most https://t.co/9QkUVTUu1P pic.twitter.com/zdBqjgKI7T — Pramod Kumar (@PramodK72506489) May 29, 2020ArchiveArchiveTruthOn looking and hearing the video closely, at about 11 seconds into the video, the man in the video says, “इनको लेके नहीं जा रहे, KEM हॉस्पिटल है” (translation: They are not taking them, this is KEM hospital), and at about 1 minute 20 seconds to 1 minute 24 seconds in the video, you can hear the lady say, “बाहर जा और अपलोड कर, फ़ेस्बुक पे डाल KEM को टैग कर” (translation: “Go out, upload it on Facebook and tag KEM hospital)This is one of the major proofs that the video is not from Delhi, but from KEM Hospital, Mumbai. KEM (King Edward Memorial) Hospital is a teaching and medical care hospital in Mumbai.Later on, we searched for news reports which have reported on the video.We found a video by Brut India, the headline read, “COVID-19 is Bleeding Mumbai Hospitals Dry”, and the description read, “ Mumbai’s doctors are working out of their skin to save lives. But as cases multiply, these hospital wards are turning into a nightmare. “ArchiveHere are the screen grabs from the news report, which mention KEM Hospital, Mumbai, saying, “The video showed the condition of an emergency ward in Mumbai’s state-run KEM Hospital on May 26, 2020.We also found a report by Times Now, reporting on the video shot at KEM Hospital, Mumbai.#Breaking | Watch: Patient films ‘horror’ in a Maharashtra hospital. Dead bodies, without even being wrapped up are found lying in rooms where patients are accommodated. Details by TIMES NOW’s Aruneel. | #RahulDumpsMaharashtra pic.twitter.com/LJycZ5hMQk — TIMES NOW (@TimesNow) May 27, 2020ArchiveBelow is the screenshot of the news report, wherein KEM Hospital, Mumbai is mentioned.The official Twitter handle of ‘Aam Aadmi Party’ also clarified that the video is not from Delhi, they said, “This video is not from Delhi. It’s Mumbai’s KEM Hospital, this video was first posted by BJP Leader Ram Kadam on 27th May. Please don’t mislead the people in this hour of crisis.”This video is not from Delhi. It's Mumbai's KEM Hospital, this video was first posted by BJP Leader Ram Kadam on 27th May. Please don't mislead the people in this hour of crisis. https://t.co/XUSsMhHf4J pic.twitter.com/nb3tel93Ad — AAP (@AamAadmiParty) May 29, 2020ArchiveHence, it is established that the video was shot in KEM Hospital, Mumbai, and NOT in Delhi as claimed in the viral posts. The viral claims are absolutely false.

content: An old image of Chinese troops linked to the recent standoff in Ladakh Spread the truth:An image of few people who appear to be soldiers with flags and a banner, near a lake with a vehicle is going viral on social media. Claims are that these are Chinese soldiers who are displaying the Chinese flag in Galwan Valley, near Pangwan lake in Ladakh. This post came became viral amidst the tension between India and China near the Line of Actual Control (LAC) in Ladakh.Several posts with the image was captioned, “Chinese army displaying their flag in Galwan valley near pangwan lake Ladakh As per Indian media China pitched more than 100 tents & thousands of troops in Galwan valley…”A Facebook Profile named Moosa Manzoor posted the image with a caption on the similar lines and received around 140 shares and was liked around 500 times.ArchiveSeveral Facebook users posted the image and caption with a similar narrative.Several tweeted the image with a similar caption on Twitter. A twitter handle named “Hanief Manzoor Dar” also tweeted the post and garnered around 500 likes.Archive A Twitter profile named “yassar emani” tagged the PM Narendra Modi, the PMO, few journalists and the United Nation with the image and caption. Archive Truth The claim is False. The image was seen in the website called “Tibet Sun” which published an article of Times News Network on July 13, 2019. The headline of the article read, “China objects Dalai Lama’s birthday celebration close to border in Ladakh”. The caption below the image read “A purported photo of Chinese troops in civilian clothes planting a Chinese flag on Indian territory as residents of a village in Ladakh close to the border celebrate the 84th birthday of the Dalai Lama on 6 July 2019. The banner read “Ban all activities to split Tibet”, according to Indian officials in New Delhi”. “The Statesman” also used the viral image in its article uploaded on July 13, 2019 that titled,”Congress expresses concern over Chinese incursion into Indian territory”. Therefore it is clear that the viral image is not about the recent standoff between India and China in Ladakh but is an old image.Related
label: truth

content: Coffins of soldiers who died in Pulwama Attack goes viral with a false claim that 75 jawaans were killed by China. Spread the truth:Claim: A last year’s photo is viral that shows coffins wrapped in Indian flag. The false claim is that it is coffins of 75 Indian jawaans who were killed by China in Ladakh amidst the growing tension between India and China.The message attached reads as follow:“75 indian troops reached hell,a silent messege from China in ladakhRaam raam satty ha”FacebookThe claim has more than 1000 shares.ArchiveArchiveArchiveTwitterFew people also shared it on Twitter.75 indian troops reached hell,a silent messege from China in ladakhRaam raam satty ha😂😂😂💣 pic.twitter.com/cdwTnOE7ZR — Bhat Shahid (@BhatSha29313459) May 25, 2020ArchiveAmid tensions between India and China along the Line of Actual Control (LAC), a picture showing dozens of tricolour-draped coffins has gone viral on social media with the claim that Chinese troops killed 75 Indian jawans in Ladakh. pic.twitter.com/ongYXc68F1 — Aurangzeb Khan Niazi (@AurangzebKhanN1) May 27, 2020ArchiveAmid tensions between India and China along the line of Actual control (LAC),a picture showing dozens of tricolour-draped coffins has gone viral on social media with the claim that Chinese troops killed 75 Indian soldiers in ladakh , well done China@TeamISPOfficial@_SGD1 pic.twitter.com/PbS2v3jQu0 — ⚡Ali_Sargodian⚡ (@_SGD1) May 27, 2020ArchiveTruthThe viral claim that has been floating around is false. The image is not of 75 Indian soldiers who were killed by China in Ladhak. When the viral photo was run through a simple reverse image search, it was found that the image is of CRPF soldiers who died in the Pulwama Attack. The search showed multiple articles by various publications that featured the viral photo in articles about the Pulwama Attack. The photo is of tricolor draped coffins of CPRF personnel who lost their lives in Pulwama terror attack during the wreath laying ceremony that took place at the CPRK camp in Budgam, Jammu and Kashmir on 15th February 2019.Attached below are the screenshot and links of the articles featuring the original picture by “The Hindu” and “The Hindustan Times”.Source: The Hindustan Times Thus, it is proved that it is a case where an old picture is used with the wrong caption to fool the public. it is not the first time that images wrapped in tricolor are used to spread fake news. A old photo of dead soldiers was going viral few weeks ago with the claim that it is images of coffins of soldiers martyred in Handwara, Jammu and Kashmir. Click on the link below to read the whole article.Related
label: truth

content: Pakistan Government’s Covidtracker does not show the entire J&K region as a part of India Spread the truth:News claiming that “Pakistan has finally accepted Kashmir as a part of India” has been going around on social media since the last two days. This has been supported by various news articles published by several media agencies claiming the same.This particular map was embedded in Pakistan Government’s official website for Covid-19. It is a Bing map that has since been pulled off the website. It can still be found on the official Bing Covid-19 tracker.FacebookThis piece of news can be seen circulating on Facebook with several claims revolving around the fact that Pakistan has given up on Kashmir.TwitterThe same claim can be seen circulating on Twitter as well.Pakistan surrenders on #Pok…Accepts entire Jammu and Kashmir and PoK as part of India at Map published by Pakistan. — Karanjit 🇮🇳 (@connect2karanji) May 21, 2020Pakistan accepts entire Kashmir as part of India. Ghabrana Bilkul Nai..#Covid19 #ghabranabilkulnaihai pic.twitter.com/PMuWubAxdW — Rohitashw Trivedi – Astro logically Yours… (@jyotishkart) May 21, 2020Various reputed news agencies have published several news articles supporting the claim that Pakistan has shown Jammu and Kashmir, including Pakistan-occupied Kashmir (PoK) as a part of India.This news article can be read here.This news article can be read here.TruthThe Bing map shows the entire region of J&K as a part of India only when it is accessed from India.The Government of Pakistan did not create this particular map. It is a Bing map that was embedded in their website. Bing has a feature where it shows the country boundaries based on the country it is accessed from.All the residents of India accessed this map from India, and thus they could see a map that looks like this:Since Kashmir has been part of India but currently is under talks, the entire boundary of Jammu and Kashmir is incorporated within India.We merely turned on the Proxy and selected the accessing country as Canada, refreshed the Map, it changedSimultaneously, when a citizen of Pakistan was contacted in order to verify this claim, he sent a screenshot of the map which looks like this:Here, we can clearly see that a major chunk of J&K has been incorporated in the map of Pakistan. This supports the statement that Bing maps show territories and boundaries based on the country they are accessed from.For a clearer view, a person from UAE was contacted to send a screenshot of what the map accessed from there looks like.Jammu and Kashmir is showcased in dotted lines in this map. The map when accessed from any country apart from India and Pakistan shows J&K in dotted lines. Dotted lines are indicators of a disputed territory.Hence, the claim that Pakistan accepted the incorporation of the entire region of J&K as a part of India is False.Related
label: truth
