(@ShefVaidya) September 26, 2017archive2020Shefali Vaidya tweeted the same photo with the following text on 26th June 2020“Rare historical pic of family servant Ramukaka holding a box containing 100 crore rupees from the taxpayer’s money to be donated to Rajiv Gandhi Foundation as Shehzada and the Dowager Empress mingle with the commoners!”Rare historical pic of family servant Ramukaka holding a box containing 100 crore rupees from the taxpayer’s money to be donated to Rajiv Gandhi Foundation as Shehzada and the Dowager Empress mingle with the commoners! pic.twitter.com/57VlhHGxhi — Shefali Vaidya. (@ShefVaidya) June 26, 2020archiveTruthEx PM Manmohan Singh was holding the sweet box to gift to kids himself, not for anyone elseThe viral photo is juts a part of an event, Rahul Gandhi gave the girl box already which he had and Ex-PM Manmohan Singh is holding his own box which he is about to give.The photo is 5 years old, 2015Congress President Smt.Sonia Gandhi,VP Rahul Gandhi & Former PM Dr Manmohan Singh distributing sweets to children pic.twitter.com/8F011fXcAy — Congress (@INCIndia) August 15, 2015Is No. 3 a proof that Manmohan singh is Gandhi Family’s ‘Loyal servant” “वफादार नौकर”? No. It’s a twisted lie.Was MMS made to stand holding a Mithai box in hand like a servant ?All, Sonia, Rahul and Manmohan were holding their own sweet boxes, it’s just about the timing of photo & selection of one photo out of a lot.This event, celebration of 69th Independence day, was held at All India Congress Committee Headquarters and was attended only by Party workers and kids were theirs too. Sonia Gandhi, being the President of the party stands first followed by Rahul Gandhi who was a Vice President, followed by ExPM Manmohan Singh.Following is the set of photos –1. Sonia Gandhi offering the sweet box to the kid2. Rahul Gandhi offering the sweet box to a different girl3. Rahul Gandhi Bending and talking to the same girl4. Ex PM Manmohan SIngh offering the box he was holding to the girlAt times Photos can be deceiving, just last month, media, congress and AAP guys made a photo of Parikar viral claiming he was sleeping during parade. Many of you asked me whether it was the truth or not. I looked for the video clip on youtube and unfortunately the scene changed as soon as Parikar looked down.It had two possibilities,1- he just looked down for a while,2 – he really fell asleepOnly way to confirm was whether he looked up again or remained like that, which was not in video.But here in this case, only one photo was shown to prove Manmohan as servant of Gandhis.Earlier Fake News tweeted by Shefali VaidyaIs No. 3 a proof that Manmohan singh is Gandhi Family's 'Loyal servant" "वफादार नौकर"? No.… https://t.co/fsFn3ZmZJH pic.twitter.com/6mUU23ocss — SM Hoax Slayer (@SMHoaxSlayer) February 20, 2017
label: rumor

content: Woman beaten and stripped is not from West Bengal. Spread the truth:Viral in Dec 2016, debunked by #SMHoaxSlayer in Jan 2017, the fake image is back with different name.These photos were viral in Dec 2016 also and was debunked thenThat time it said“Mamta Banerjee’s TMC’s Muslim leaders stripped Hindu Women, beat them and chanted Hindu Muradabad”झूठ: ममता के TMC के मुस्लिम नेताओं ने हिन्दू बेहेन बेटियों को पश्चिम बंगाल में नंगा कर के मारा और हिन्दू मुर्दाबाद के नारे लगायेUpdated on 6th Sep 2018The following Facebook post by a profile “Hindu Akhilesh Gupta” had been shared by more than 15000 people –This time it claims “In Bengal, Congress volunteers chased and beat up a Hindu Lady. Her only fault was that she shouted BJP Zindabad and Modi Zindabad. Share this and bring back true face of Congress in front of all”Truth:The victim woman is a tribal, her name is Laxmi Oraon. These photos are from Guwahati, Assam. The unfortunate incident happened 11 years ago i.e. 2007The Telegraph reported on Tuesday, November 27, 2007“Guwahati, Nov. 26: A young Adivasi woman ran down a Guwahati street naked, stripped by ethnic rioters, while leering city youths clicked away with their cellphone cameras.As television today brought to Assam homes one more scene of SaturdayÂ’s street horror Â— when hundreds of tribals were attacked over a 3.5km stretch of the city Â— police arrested the womanÂ’s three tormentors.“The three had pounced on her like a pack of dogs and started stripping her. All her pleas fell on deaf ears till they had stripped her naked. Only then did they let her go,Â” said a police officer quoting eyewitnesses to the mob retaliation to a violent Adivasi studentsÂ’ march.The woman sprinted away from a large group of jeering men and ran on in panic till somebody threw her a piece of clothing.The sight left homemaker Ananya Baruah dumbfounded on her second-floor balcony at Beltola, the epicentre from where the rioting spilled over several localities.Â“She was running like mad. Some people were clicking pictures with their cellphones. It was one of the worst crimes any civilised society could have committed. I felt so helpless just watching. The girl disappeared into one of the by-lanes.Â”The victim was probably a participant in the armed Adivasi procession in demand of Scheduled Tribe status that had turned violent and damaged private and public property, including cars.As the police began dispersing the tribals, angry local mobs chased down the stragglers among them. Adivasi men, women and children were dragged across streets and mercilessly beaten up with the police refusing to intervene. The violence left some 300 injured and a 12-year-old boy dead.The ethnic conflict claimed a second life this morning. Santosh Kumar, 17, was dragged out of a vehicle on a highway for Â“defyingÂ” an Adivasi-enforced bandh that was yet to begin, and hacked to death.Chief minister Tarun Gogoi announced the arrests of the trio who had stripped the woman and offered the victim Rs 1 lakh in compensation. Prasenjit Chakravarty, Sandip Chakdar and Ratul Barman were nabbed on the basis of video footage and eyewitness accounts.Ratul, a waiter at Mahalaxmi Hotel in Beltola, is barely 18. The main accused is Prasenjit, 28, owner of Dainty Fast Food restaurant in the same locality. Sandip, 20, owns a paan shop near the hotel where Ratul works.The charges against them range from outraging a womanÂ’s modesty to attempt to murder.Gogoi announced a judicial probe into the violence by the All Adivasi StudentsÂ’ Association of Assam as well as the mob backlash. The state government has announced a compensation of Rs 3 lakh for the families of the dead.”The Tribune reported in 2017 –2 years later BBC reported –“A tribal woman who was stripped and assaulted in India’s north-eastern state of Assam is to contest the parliamentary elections.Laxmi Oraon has been nominated by the regional Assam United Democratic Front (AUDF).She was stripped by locals when she took part in a rally in 2007 demanding better tribal rights.Pictures of Ms Oraon running naked across a market in Assam’s capital Guwahati caused outrage in India. “Times of India ArticleAnother false –Coming back to the profile who posted this fake news recently. it’s observed that, that profile usually post Fake News –A Photoshopped/edited image –Truth –2. The green flag is not Pakistan’s. Pakistan flag has one vertical white strip also.3. The monk beant is from BangladeshTruth –3. The man touching feet is not Manmohan, he is some volunteer, Debunked last yearTruth –Related

साथ सोशल मीडिया पर एक वीडियो वायरल हो रहा है. वीडियो में मुंह पर कपड़ा बांधे एक युवक हरे रंग के पानी में हार्पिक वाली बोतल से कुछ मिलाते हुए दिख रहा है. थोड़ी देर बाद पुलिस की वर्दी पहने एक व्यक्ति मिलावट करने वाले युवक को पकड़ता है और सवाल-जवाब करने लगता है. साथ ही वीडियो में एक और आदमी है, जिसकी बैकग्राउंड में आवाज आ रही है और उसका दावा है कि उसने शिकायत कर पुलिस बुलाई है. ट्विटर यूज़र ᴠɪꜱʜ कोर्ट ने बीजेपी से निलंबित नूपुर शर्मा को खूब खरी-खोटी सुनाई है. कहा कि नूपुर को टीवी पर देश से माफी मांगनी चाहिए. कोर्ट ने उदयपुर (Udaipur) की घटना के लिए भी नूपुर शर्मा को जिम्मेदार बताया है.सुप्रीम कोर्ट ने ये टिप्पणियां नूपुर शर्मा का केस ट्रांसफर करने वाली याचिका की सुनवाई के दौरान कीं. नूपुर की मांग थी कि देश के कई राज्यों में उनके खिलाफ जो FIR दर्ज हुई हैं उन्हें दिल्ली ट्रांसफर कर दिया जाए. लेकिन जस्टिस सूर्यकांत और जस्टिस जेबी पारदीवाला ने मामले की सुनवाई करते हुए नूपुर शर्मा की याचिका को ख़ारिज कर दिया है.याचिका ख़ारिज होने के बाद सोशल मीडिया पर जस्टिस पारदीवाला को लेकर एक दावा जमकर वायरल हो रहा है. इसमें एक स्क्रीनशॉट चस्पा है, जिसमें अंग्रेजी में जस्टिस पारदीवाला को लेकर कुछ लिखा गया है. इस स्क्रीनशॉट को आधार बनाकर दावा है,जस्टिस जेबी पारदीवाला कांग्रेस के विधायक रह चुके हैं.ट्विटर यूज़र SamDelhi ने स्क्रीनशॉट ट्वीट कर लिखा, (आर्काइव)जस्टिस जे.बी. पारदीवाला जिन्होंने नूपुर शमा को उदयपुर की घटना के लिए जिम्मेदार बताया, वह 1989 से 1990 के बीच कांग्रेस विधायक थे. #SupremeCourtट्वीट का स्क्रीनशॉट.ट्विटर से इतर फेसबुक पर भी ऐसे ही दावे किए जा रहे हैं. लेकिन इनकी सच्चाई क्या है?पड़ताल'दी लल्लनटॉप' ने जब जस्टिस पारदीवाला से जुड़े दावे की पड़ताल की तो दावा गलत निकला.सबसे पहले जिस स्क्रीनशॉट को आधार बनाकर जस्टिस पारदीवाला के कांग्रेस से विधायक रहने का दावा किया जा रहा है, उस स्क्रीनशॉट को हमने गौर से पढ़ा. स्क्रीनशॉट के ऊपर Supreme Court Observer लिखा हुआ है. इसके बाद हमने इंटरनेट पर Supreme Court Observer डालकर सर्च किया तो www.scobserver.in वेबसाइट मिली. इस वेबसाइट पर J.B. Pardiwala सर्च करने पर हमें उनकी प्रोफाइल दिखी. इसी प्रोफाइल के एक पैरा को स्क्रीनशॉट के जरिए वायरल किया जा रहा है. वायरल पैराग्राफ का हिन्दी अनुवाद है-'पारदीवाला का जन्म 12 अगस्त 1965 को मुंबई में दक्षिण गुजरात के वलसाड से संबंध रखने वाले वकीलों के परिवार में हुआ था. उनके परदादा नवरोजजी भीकाजी पारदीवाला ने 1894 में कस्बे में अपनी कानूनी प्रैक्टिस शुरू की. उनके बेटे, कावासजी नवरोजजी पारदीवाला 1929 में वलसाड बार में शामिल हो गए. जस्टिस पारदीवाला  के पिता बुर्जोर कावासजी पारदीवाला अपने पिता के नक्शेकदम पर चलते हुए 1955 में वलसाड बार में शामिल हुए. बाद में वह कांग्रेस विधायक बने. दिसंबर 1989 से मार्च 1990 के बीच, उन्होंने 7वीं गुजरात विधान सभा के अध्यक्ष के रूप में भी कार्य किया.'इस पैराग्राफ में MLA शब्द पर एक इंटरलिंक भी मौजूद है, जब हमने इस पर क्लिक किया तो इंडियन एक्सप्रेस की 9 मई 2022 की रिपोर्ट सामने आई. रिपोर्ट में जस्टिस पारदीवाला के पिता के बारे में जानकारी देते हुए बताया गया है, 'उनके पिता बुर्जोर जी पारदीवाला एक कांग्रेस विधायक थे. उन्होंने मुख्यमंत्री माधवसिंह सोलंकी और अमरसिंह चौधरी के कार्यकाल के दौरान सातवीं गुजरात विधानसभा (1989-1990) के अध्यक्ष के रूप में कार्य किया.'इसके बाद हमने गुजरात विधान सभा की आधिकारिक वेबसाइट का रुख किया. यहां पर हमें स्पीकर्स की लिस्ट में Barjorji Pardiwala का नाम दिखा जो 19 जनवरी 1990 से 16 मार्च 1990 तक गुजरात विधानसभा के स्पीकर रहे हैं.गुजरात  विधानसभा की वेबसाइट पर मौजूद स्पीकर्स की लिस्ट.साफ है जस्टिस पारदीवाला के पिताजी का संबंध कांग्रेस से था, न कि उनका.कौन हैं जस्टिस जेबी पारदीवाला?सुप्रीम कोर्ट की वेबसाइट के मुताबिक, वकीलों के परिवार में जन्मे जस्टिस पारदीवाला ने वकालत की शुरुआत 1989 में वलसाड, गुजरात से की थी. अगले साल ही 1990 में उन्होंने प्रैक्टिस के लिए अहमदाबाद में मौजूद गुजरात हाई कोर्ट का रुख किया. साल 2011 में उन्हें गुजरात हाई कोर्ट में एडिशनल जज के रूप में नियुक्त किया गया और 2013 में स्थायी जज बने. निकले.हमने सबसे पहले नरेन्द्र मोदी को सोशल मीडिया अकाउंट्स को खंगालना शुरू किया. सर्च से हमें मोदी के फेसबुक पेज पर एक पोस्ट मिला, जिसमें वायरल तस्वीरों को देखा जा सकता है. पोस्ट का कैप्शन अंग्रेजी में है, जिसका हिन्दी अनुवाद है- आज सुबह, मुझे नई संसद की छत पर राष्ट्रीय प्रतीक का अनावरण करने का अवसर मिला.नरेन्द्र मोदी के फेसबुक पोस्ट का स्क्रीनशॉट.पोस्ट में दोनों तस्वीरों को गौर से देखने पर पता चलता है कि दोनों में पीएम मोदी के कपड़े एक ही हैं. मोदी ने सफेर कुर्ता-पजामा के ऊपर आसमानी रंग का हाफ जैकेट पहना हुआ है. वायरल तस्वीर में जिसे दूसरा कपड़ा बताया जा रहा है वो असल में भगवा शॉल है. इस पूरे कार्यक्रम के दौरान एक ही ड्रेस में देखा जा सकता है.क्या था कार्यक्रम?प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी ने 11 जुलाई को नई संसद की छत पर बने अशोक चिन्ह का अनावरण कर किया था. कांस्य का बना ये विशाल चिन्ह साढ़े 6 मीटर ऊंचा है और इसका वजन साढ़े 9 हजार किलो है. पीएम मोदी ने पूजा-अर्चना के साथ राष्ट्रीय चिन्ह का अनावरण किया और इसके बाद एक विवाद भी सामने आया. कहा जा रहा है कि राष्ट्रीय चिह्न के साथ (आर्काइव)Epic Moment 🤣😂#AmitShah #Telangana pic.twitter.com/nnwCxsy7lv— SARCASTIC 🔴 SHAHRUKH 🎥 (@FUNNYSRK) July 3, 2022 फेसबुक पर ये वीडियो जमकर वायरल है.फेसबुक पर वायरल वीडियो.पड़ताल 'दी लल्लनटॉप' ने वायरल वीडियो का सच जानने के लिए पड़ताल की. हमारी पड़ताल में वायरल वीडियो पुराना निकला.सबसे पहले हमने वायरल हो रहे वीडियो को गौर से देखा. 14 सेकेंड के इस वीडियो में रिपोर्टर के एक ही सवाल को दो बार लगाया गया है. जवाब के लिए जैसे ही माइक अमित शाह के पास जाता है, वैसे ही वीडियो कट जाता है. ऐसे में ये साफ पता चलता है कि वायरल वीडियो एडिटेड है. साथ ही वीडियो और माइक पर V6 NEWS का लोगो दिखाई दे रहा है. इसके बाद 'V6 NEWS Amit Shah' की-वर्ड्स की मदद से सर्च करने पर हमें वायरल वीडियो का असली वर्जन V6 News Telugu यूट्यूब चैनल पर मिला. 29 नवंबर 2020 को अपलोड हुए इस वीडियो का कैप्शन है. Amit Shah Face To Face Over Hyderabad Floods, GHMC Elections 2020 | Exclusive | V6 News3 मिनट 1 सेकेंड के इस वीडियो में 38 सेकेंड के बाद रिपोर्टर अमित शाह से बाढ़ बारिश से जुड़ा सवाल पूछता है. सवाल - इधर बारिश आई और बाढ़ भी आई मगर केन्द्र से एक पैसा भी नहीं आाया. क्या सूरत दिखाने के लिए दिल्ली से नेता आ रहे हैं? वो (केसीआर) ऐसा बोल रहे हैं, आपका क्या कहना है?जवाब - हमने सबसे ज्यादा पैसा हैदराबाद को दिया है. मगर मैं इतना कहना चाहता हूं कि सात लाख लोगों के घर में पानी भर गया. श्री ओवैसी और केसीआर कहां थे? एक के भी घर में नहीं गए, आप दिखाई नहीं दिए. घर में पानी था और हमारे सांसद, हमारे कार्यकर्ता, हमारे मंत्री लोगों के बीच में रहे. पानी क्यों भरा? जिस प्रकार से अतिक्रमण को ओवैसी की शह पर बढ़ावा मिला है. इसके कारण यहां पानी भरा गया है. हम हैदराबाद की जनता को आश्वस्त करना चाहते हैं कि अगर नगर निगम बीजेपी के पास आती है तो सारे अतिक्रमण को हटाकर कभी भी पानी न भरे, ऐसे हैदराबाद का निर्माण करेंगे. विश्व भर में हैदाराबाद आईटी हब बने, इस प्रकार की एक मॉर्डन सिटी का निर्माण करेंगे.दरअसल, वायरल वीडियो साल 2020 में संपन्न हुए हैदराबाद नगर निगम में प्रचार के दौरान का है. दैनिक भास्कर में 29 नवंबर, 2020 को पब्लिश हुई रिपोर्ट के मुताबिक,'गृह मंत्री अमित शाह रविवार को हैदराबाद पहुंचे. नगर निगम चुनाव में प्रचार करने पहुंचे शाह ने सिकंदराबाद में रोड शो किया. इसके बाद उन्होंने प्रेस कॉन्फ्रेंस कर राज्य की तेलंगाना राष्ट्र समिति (TRS) सरकार पर तीखा हमला बोला.'नतीजाकुल जमा बात ये है कि अमित शाह के जिस वीडियो को हालिया बताकर शेयर किया जा रहा है वो लगभग दो साल पुराना और एडिटेड है. बाढ़-बारिश के सवाल पर अमित शाह ने करीब 1 मिनट लंबा जवाब दिया था. लेकिन वीडियो के साथ छेड़छाड़ कर अमित शाह का जवाब हटा दिया गया और फिर इसे अमित शाह की चुप्पी बताकर शेयर किया गया.पड़ताल की वॉट्सऐप हेल्पलाइन से जुड़ने के लिए इस लिंक पर क्लिक करें. ट्विटर और फेसबुक पर फॉलो करने के लिए ट्विटर लिंक और फेसबुक लिंक पर क्लिक करें.AdvertisementAdvertisement()
label: truth

content: द्रौपदी मुर्मू को RSS से जोड़कर बुरे फंसे प्रशांत भूषण, मांगनी पड़ी माफी! द्रौपदी मुर्मू को RSS से जोड़कर बुरे फंसे प्रशांत भूषण, मांगनी पड़ी माफी! - The Lallantop साइन इन करेंहोमशोज़देखिएबिहार चुनावAdvertisementHomeFact CheckPrashant Bhushan tweeted edited photo of Draupadi Murmu and Mohan Bhagwat द्रौपदी मुर्मू को RSS से जोड़कर बुरे फंसे प्रशांत भूषण, मांगनी पड़ी माफी!जब ट्वीट वायरल हुआ तो प्रशांत भूषण को अपनी गलती का अहसास हुआ.Advertisementट्वीट की गई तस्वीर का स्क्रीनशॉट.अंशुल सिंह5 जुलाई 2022  (Updated: 5 जुलाई 2022, 07:27 PM IST)SmallMediumLargeSmallMediumLargeदावाबीजेपी की राष्ट्रपति पद की उम्मीदवार द्रौपदी मुर्मू ने नागपुर में आरएसएस मुख्यालय में मोहन भागवत से मुलाकात की! क्या इसमें कोई संदेह है कि वह सिर्फ एक रबर स्टाम्प होंगी और स्वतंत्र रूप से काम नहीं कर पाएंगी?ये शब्द हैं वरिष्ठ वकील प्रशांत भूषण के जो उन्होंने अपने ट्वीट में लिखे हैं. 5 जुलाई को दोपहर 1 बजकर 46 मिनट पर किए गए इस ट्वीट का कैप्शन अंग्रेजी में है और इसके साथ एक फोटो भी है. फोटो में  द्रौपदी मुर्मू और संघ प्रमुख मोहन भागवत भारत माता की तस्वीर के सामने हाथ जोड़े हुए खड़े हैं. साथ ही फोटो के नीचे कैप्शन है, श्रीमती द्रौपदी मुर्मू ने आरएसएस मुख्यालय नागपुर का दौरा किया और श्री मोहन भागवत से मुलाकात की.प्रशांत भूषण के ट्वीट का स्क्रीनशॉट.थोड़ी देर बाद जब ट्वीट की इंगेजमेंट बढ़ने लगी तो प्रशांत भूषण ने ट्वीट डिलीट कर दिया. अब सवाल ये है कि आखिर प्रशांत भूषण ने जिस फोटो को ट्वीट किया था उसकी सच्चाई क्या है? इसी सवाल का जवाब जानने के लिए 'दी लल्लनटॉप' ने पड़ताल की.पड़तालसबसे पहले हमने प्रशांत भूषण के दावे से जुड़ी मीडिया रिपोर्ट्स को इंटरनेट पर खोजा. इंटरनेट पर हमें एक भी ऐसी रिपोर्ट नहीं मिली जिसमें राष्ट्रपति उम्मीदवार बनने के बाद द्रौपदी मुर्मू की मोहन भागवत से मुलाकात का जिक्र हो. अगर द्रौपदी मुर्मू ने संघ प्रमुख मोहन भागवत से हाल-फिलहाल में कोई मुलाकात की होती तो मीडिया में खबरें जरूर छपतीं लेकिन ऐसा नहीं हुआ. अब बारी थी रिवर्स इमेज सर्च टूल की मदद से फोटो की सच्चाई पता करने की. रिवर्स इमेज सर्च से पता चला कि प्रशांत भूषण ने जिस तस्वीर को ट्वीट किया है, उसे दो तस्वीरों को आपस में जोड़कर बनाया गया है.पहली तस्वीर रिवर्स इमेज सर्च की मदद से मोहन भागवत की तस्वीर हमें न्यूज़ एजेंसी ANI की वेबसाइट पर मिली. ANI ने तस्वीर को इस साल मार्च के महीने में गुजरात में हुए RSS की सालाना बैठक का बताया है.ANI की वेबसाइट पर मौजूद तस्वीर.यहां से क्लू लेकर हमने थोड़ा और अधिक सर्च किया तो हमें RSS के ट्विटर अकाउंट पर भी यही तस्वीर मिली. 11 मार्च 2022 को किए गए इस ट्वीट का कैप्शन है,'राष्ट्रीय स्वयंसेवक संघ की अखिल भारतीय प्रतिनिधि सभा की बैठक आज गुजरात के कर्णावती में प्रारम्भ हुई. बैठक का शुभारम्भ पू. सरसंघचालक डॉ. मोहनजी भागवत और मा. सरकार्यवाह श्री दत्तात्रेय होसबाले जी ने भारत माता के चित्र पर पुष्पार्चन करके किया. बैठक 13 मार्च को सम्पन्न होगी.'राष्ट्रीय स्वयंसेवक संघ की अखिल भारतीय प्रतिनिधि सभा की बैठक आज गुजरात के कर्णावती में प्रारम्भ हुई। बैठक का शुभारम्भ पू. सरसंघचालक डॉ. मोहनजी भागवत और मा. सरकार्यवाह श्री दत्तात्रेय होसबाले जी ने भारत माता के चित्र पर पुष्पार्चन करके किया। बैठक 13 मार्च को सम्पन्न होगी। pic.twitter.com/gWNk7KwpwZ— RSS (@RSSorg) March 11, 2022 दूसरी तस्वीरद्रौपदी मुर्मू से जुड़ी दूसरी तस्वीर हमें झारखंड के मुख्यमंत्री हेमंत सोरेन के ट्विटर अकाउंट पर मिली. 29 दिसंबर 2020 को किए गए इस ट्वीट का कैप्शन है, आज झारखण्ड सरकार के एक साल पूरे होने के अवसर पर राजभवन में राज्यपाल श्रीमती द्रौपदी मुर्मू जी से मुलाकात की।आज झारखण्ड सरकार के एक साल पूरे होने के अवसर पर राजभवन में राज्यपाल श्रीमती द्रौपदी मुर्मू जी से मुलाकात की। pic.twitter.com/Si262ts95D— Hemant Soren (@HemantSorenJMM) December 29, 2020 कुल तीन तस्वीरों में से एक तस्वीर के साथ छेड़छाड़ कर द्रौपदी मुर्मू को मोहन भागवत के साथ खड़ा कर दिया.वैसे ऐसा पहली बार नहीं है जब प्रशांत भूषण ने फेक न्यूज़ फैलाई है. इससे पहले प्रशांत भूषण ने शराब पीते हुए कुछ लोगों को बीजेपी की तेलंगाना में राष्ट्रीय कार्यकारिणी की बैठक से जोड़ दिया था. बाद में पता चला कि वीडियो पुराना है. कोरोना काल में वैक्सीन को लेकर उनके द्वारा किए गए भ्रामक दावों को भी कैसे भुलाया जा सकता है. जून 2021 में जब प्रशांत भूषण ने वैक्सीन को 'अनसेफ' बताया था तो ट्विटर ने उनके ट्वीट पर Misleading का टैग चस्पा कर दिया था.नतीजा कुल जमा बात ये है कि प्रशांत भूषण ने द्रौपदी मुर्मू की जिस तस्वीर को ट्वीट किया था, वो एडिटेड है. मोहन भागवत और द्रौपदी मुर्मू की दो अलग-अलग तस्वीरों के साथ छेड़छाड़ कर एक नई तस्वीर बनाई गई है. हालांकि बाद में प्रशांत भूषण को अपनी गलती का अहसास हुआ और द्रौपदी मुर्मू से माफी मांगते हुए अपना ट्वीट डिलीट कर दिया.पड़ताल की वॉट्सऐप हेल्पलाइन से जुड़ने के लिए इस लिंक पर क्लिक करें.  ट्विटर और फेसबुक पर फॉलो करने के लिए ट्विटर लिंक और फेसबुक लिंक पर क्लिक करें.AdvertisementAdvertisement()

content: Fact Check: Old Video Showing Giant Waves Lashing at Gateway of... As Mumbai witnessed heavy rainfall in the past few weeks leading to flooding in several parts of the city, a video of giant waves spilling into the streets is being shared on social media, claiming that it is the view of Taj Mahal Hotel at the Gateway of India during recent rains.The video is widely shared with a caption: “Taj Mahal Hotel, Gateway of India, this morning ( A Viral Video).”Here’s the link to the above post.FACT CHECKNewsMobile fact-checked the post, and found it to be old.We extracted the keyframes of the video and put them through a Reverse Image Search. The search led us to the same video uploaded on YouTube, dated May 19, 2021. content: Fact Check: Does This Video Show Maulana Giving Arms Training In... A video in which a group of children can be seen firing a rifle is widely being shared on social media. In the video, an elderly man can be seen helping the children and teaching them how to load the rifle. Sharing this video, users are claiming that it shows a Madrasa in Pratapgarh of Uttar Pradesh where a maulana is giving arms training to students.The video is being shared on Facebook with a long caption in Hindi: Parts of the caption read, “आपको बता दें कि कंधई थाना क्षेत्र अंतर्गत गोपालपुर में मदरसों में बच्चों को राइफल चलाना सिखाया जा रहा है। वीडियो में आप साफ तौर पर देख सकते कि हैं कि हबीबी किस तरह से राइफल को लोड करके बच्चों के हाथों में थमा रहा है और हर्ष फायरिंग करने का आदेश दे रहा है इससे यह साफ साबित होता है कि अपराध और अपराधियों का बढ़ चढ़कर बोलबाला है।”(English translation: Let us tell you that in Gopalpur under the Kandhai police station area, children are being taught to operate rifles in madrassas. In the video you can clearly see how Habibi is loading the rifle and handing it over to the children and Harsh is ordering them to fire, this clearly proves that crime and criminals are on a high)Here’s the link to the above post.FACT CHECKNewsMobile fact-checked the above claim and found it to be MISLEADING.Using the InVid Tool, we extracted keyframes from the viral video and performed a Reverse Image Search with relevant keywords. This search directed us to a news report published by Jagran on July 21, 2022, that carried similar visuals. According to the article, a man dressed like a Sheikh came to the wedding ceremony held in Gopalpur village of Kandhai, Pratapgarh district, Uttar Pradesh, and trained the youth to operate rifles.Searching further, we found many other news articles that reported the same incident. According to the reports, the video is from the day of Bakri Id. We could not find any news report that stated that the viral video shows any maulana giving arms training to students in madrasa.We also found an official statement by Pratapgarh ASP on the same case. The tweet text reads, “In connection with the viral video of air firing in Ibrahimpur, Gopalpur village of Kandhai police station area of Pratapgarh district, prompt action was taken by the police station Kandhai under the strict direction of Superintendent of Police Pratapgarh @satpal_IPS”. It can also be noted in the statement that the police did not mention Madrasa or Maulana angle in the above statement.Thus, it is evident from the above information that the viral claim stating that students are being trained for arms by a maulana in Uttar Pradesh’s madrasa is misleading.If you want to fact-check any story, WhatsApp it now on +91 11 7127 979l9Your nameYour emailSubjectYour message (optional)ΔClick here for Latest News updates and viral videos n our AI-powered smart news

content: Fact Check: Kovind-Murmu’s 2020 Deoghar Image Viral With Misleading Claims Droupadi Murmu recently scripted history by becoming the first-ever woman tribal President of India and the second woman President in the history of the nation. She took over as the 15th President of the country and took charge following the end of Ram Nath Kovind’s term as the President on July 25, 2022.In this backdrop, a viral photo of President Murmu and Ram Nath Kovind is being circulated online claiming that they participated in a Vedic ritual before the official start of her term.A Facebook user posted the image with the caption: सत्ता हस्तांतरण के ये क्षण, इन क्षणों के भाव, अंतर्भाव और वातावरण ही इतिहास लिखते हैं राष्ट्रपति पद का हस्तांतरण देखिए, राजनैतिक औपचारिकताएं होती रहेंगी, वैदिक प्रतिबद्धता प्रथमतः हो रही है..! हमारे राष्ट्र को अब शुभ और लाभ दोनों ही मिलेंगे #NATION_WITH_MODI(English Translation: These moments of transfer of power, these moments of emotion, feeling and atmosphere write history, see the transfer of the presidency, political formalities will continue, Vedic commitment is being done first..! Now our nation will get both good and good #NATION_WITH_MODI)You can find the post here.FACT CHECKNewsMobile fact-checked the viral image and found it to be misleading.We started our investigation by running a Google Reverse Image Search. It led us to various news articles about Kovind’s visit to Deoghar, Jharkhand. Prabhat Khabar, a Hindi news paper, published the image in their Feb 29, 2020 article with a caption: ‘राष्‍ट्रपति रामनाथ कोविंद ने देवघर में की बाबा वैद्यनाथ की पूजा, देश की सुख-समृद्धि की कामना की’Reading the article, we got to know that Ram Nath Kovind visited the famous Baba Baidyanath temple of Deoghar, Jharkhand, in February 2020, during his 2-day visit to the state. He offered prayers to Baba Baidyanath through the Shodashopachar method and wished for happiness and well-being of the country. Ex-Governor of Jharkhand, Droupadi Murmu also accompanied him for the puja.The visit was covered by many prominent media houses including The Telegraph, Amar Ujala, and Jagran, among others.A Google Keyword Search led us to various social media posts about the, then, President’s visit to the holy site. We came across one such video published on Feb 29, 2020, by the official Twitter handle of the District Administration Deoghar.Finally, we came across a Feb 29, 2020, tweet by the official Twitter handle of the President of India (@rashtrapatibhvn). President Kovind can be seen wearing the same set of clothes in the tweeted picture as in the one going viral now, thus, confirming his presence in the temple.Therefore, based on our investigation, we can conclusively say that the viral image, claiming the outgoing President Kovind and President Murmu performed Vedic rituals before the official transfer of power, is misleading.If you want to fact-check any story, WhatsApp it now on +91 11 7127 9799Your nameYour emailSubjectYour message (optional)ΔClick here for Latest News updates and viral videos on our AI-powered smart news

content: Fact Check: Does The Viral Image Show President Droupadi Murmu? Here’s... Droupadi Murmu took oath as the 15th President of India on July 25, 2022. (photo courtesy @sheela2010) The difference between the great and the ordinary is simply this: that the great think they are ordinary and the ordinary think they are great.”We further found that the same image was uploaded by senior journalist Sheela Bhatt on Twitter with a caption which mentioned that the viral image is of Droupadi Murmu’s kitchen. However, it did not mention that it was her.We further found that a YouTube channel, Shakti TV had uploaded a video on July 21, 2022, with a caption that read, “Draupadi Murmu Home Tour Exclusive : Draupadi Murmu Village.”We compared the lady in the viral image with the lady in the video and found them to be the same.Hence we can ascertain that the lady in the viral image is not Draupadi Murmu but the woman who was showing her house to the interviewer. content: Fact Check: No, The Viral Advisory On Monkeypox Outbreak Has Not... content: Fact Check: Spoof Video Viral To Suggest UK Police Interrogating Boris... Following a string of resignations by over 50 members (including 5 cabinet ministers) of the Conservative Party in the UK, Prime Minister Boris Johnson was also forced to step down on July 7, 2022. He however remains the interim Prime Minister till the time a new leader is elected by the party.In this backdrop, a viral video, showing the police interrogating Johnson for breaking the law by taking advantage of his position is doing rounds on social media.A Facebook user posted the video with the caption: INVESTIGATION OF BORRIS JOHNSON – Ex. PRIME MINISTER OF UNITED KINGDOM CAN’T IMAGINE…. THIS HAPPENING IN INDIA or Somewhere else…Salute to Brave Police & Investigation Officers of UK Other countries & their investigation agencies must take a lesson from this Modi ji will make it happen in India.You can watch the video here.FACT CHECKNewsMobile fact-checked the viral video and found the claim to be misleading.On analyzing the video, we noticed the phrase ‘Led By Donkeys’ appear on the screen towards the end. Running a Google Keyword Search for the same we found that Led By Donkeys is a British political campaign group. It is an anti-Brexit group founded in 2018, and they use the medium of satire to target pro-Brexit politicians.Searching further, we were led to the Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, and YouTube accounts of the organisation. We found a shorter version of the viral clip on their YouTube channel posted on January 19, 2022.A full-length clip of the same video was then posted by the channel on April 13, 2022, titled: It’s not just the parties. He lies about everything.We then ran a Reverse Image Search of the keyframes from the viral video. Apart from the videos by ‘Led By Donkeys’, it led us to a YouTube video dated January 19, 2022, titled: Boris Johnson questioned by Line of Duty team in Led by Donkeys video posted by Guardian news.The description of the video reads: The PM is questioned by AC-12 officers about lockdown breaches in a spoof episode of Line of Duty by the satirical artists Led By Donkeys.Thereby claiming that the video is a spoof episode of the famous British police crime drama series, “Line of Duty”. The entire video was made by patching clips from Line of Duty, and some other clips of the Prime Minister’s statements on ‘partygate’.Finally, we found a tweet by the writer of ‘Line of Duty’: Jed Mercurio. The writer tweeted the video on January 18, 2022, appreciating Led By Donkeys and calling it “Brilliant Work.”Therefore, based on our investigation we can conclusively say that the viral video showing Boris Johnson being interrogated by police is misleading.If you want to fact-check any story, WhatsApp it now on +91 11 7127 9799Your nameYour emailSubjectYour message (optional)ΔClick here for Latest News updates and viral videos on our AI-powered smart news

content: Fact Check: Video Of Newborn Infant Goes Viral With False Claims A video of a newborn infant has surfaced on the internet in which the baby looks pale in a sensitive situation and all the veins on the body are clearly visible. Several claims have been made about the child and the location.According to one of the claims, given the infant’s condition, he/she was injected 50 times with poison but the child still survived. Several other posts claimed that the video is recent and from different places like Shamli in UP or Mewat.One of the Facebook posts read: “अजीबोगरीब बच्चा पैदा हुआ जो 50 इंजेक्शन लगाने के बाद भी नही मरा”(English Translation: “Weird baby born who didn’t die even after 50 injections”)The above post can be seen here.FACT CHECKNewsMobile fact-checked the above video and found the claims attached to it to be false.We extracted keyframes of the video through InVid tool and put them through Google Reverse Image Search. The search led us to several news reports with screengrabs of the video in question.According to reports, the infant in the viral video was born on June 3, 2022, at Mother and Child Hospital (MCH) in Ratlam, Madhya Pradesh. The child suffered from a rare genetic condition due to which the infant did not develop skin. These reports can be seen here, here and here.None of the reports mentions injecting the infant with poison. However, an Aaj Tak report quoted Dr Naved Qureshi, in charge of ICU at MCH Ratlam stating that the child was suffering from ‘Harlequin Ichthyosis’ and he passed away 4-5 days after the birth.In conclusion, the above findings establish that the claims attached to the video are baseless.If you want to fact-check any story, WhatsApp it now on +91 11 7127 9799Your nameYour emailSubjectYour message (optional)ΔClick here for Latest News updates and viral videos on our AI-powered smart news

content: Fact Check: Does This Video Show PM Modi Ignoring Kovind At... A farewell ceremony in honour of outgoing President Ram Nath Kovind was organised on July 23, 2022, at the Central Hall of the Parliament. His last working day in the office was July 24, 2022, as newly elected President Droupadi Murmu took charge. The ceremony was attended by the Prime Minister, the Vice-President, and other Members of Parliament.In this backdrop, a viral video, showing the Prime Minister Narendra Modi ignoring President Kovind while he greets him with folded hands, is doing rounds on social media.A Facebook user posted the viral video with the caption: मुझे मोदी जी की ये अदा बहुत पसंद है। सिद्धांतहीन, चाटुकार, मौकापरस्त, नालायकों से ज़्यादा तवज्जो वे हमेशा कैमरा को ही देते हैं। जो अपने समुदाय का न हुआ… जो पूरे कार्यकाल में अपने पद के अनुसार व्यवहार न कर सका… जिसने अपने पूरे कार्यकाल से अपने ही समुदाय की मेधा को कलंकित किया… इससे बेहतर कैमरा ही भला! कभी अम्बेडकर की मेधा को दलित मेधा के आदर्श के रूप में प्रस्तुत किया जाता था। अब हम पर राम नाथ कोविंद जी भी हैं। जब अम्बेडकर जी का नाम लिया जाएगा तो कोविंद की भी याद दिलाई जाएगी। लाइन में मुर्मू जी भी रहेंगी। और हाँ ज़ोर से बोलो….. जय भीम!(English Translation: I really like this style of Modi Ji. He always gives more attention to the camera than the idiot, sycophantic, opportunistic, or incompetent. The one who did not belong to his community…. Who could not behave according to his position throughout his tenure…. Who stigmatized the intellect of his own community throughout his entire tenure…. Better camera than this! Ambedkar’s intellect was once presented as an ideal of Dalit intelligence. Now Ram Nath Kovind ji is also upon us. When Ambedkar’s name is taken, Kovind will also be reminded. Murmu ji will also be in the line. And yes say it out loud….. Jai Bhim!)You can watch the video here.FACT CHECKNewsMobile fact-checked the viral video and found it to be misleadingOn analysing the video, we found the logo of Sansad TV at the top left corner of the frame. Established in 2021, by merging Lok Sabha and Rajya Sabha Television, Sansad TV is the Parliamentary affairs channel of India.Google Keyword Search led us to a video dated July 23, 2022, published on the official YouTube channel of the public broadcaster. The video was titled: President Kovind’s departure from the Central Hall of Parliament I Farewell function.At the beginning of the video, President Kovind can be seen getting down from the stage accompanied by Vice President Venkaiah Naidu. He then walks toward the attendees to greet them. At the 00:59 seconds mark, he meets and greets Prime Minister Modi with folded hands and PM greets him back in the same manner, as opposed to what’s shown in the viral video.The President then walked past him to greet Union Minister Piyush Goyal which is when PM Modi was filmed looking at cameras on the side, at the 01:03 mark.Our search then led us to the verified social media handles of the President of India. Multiple photos from the event were posted on July 23, 2022. One of the photos shows the Prime Minister greeting President Kovind. It was posted on Facebook, Twitter, and Instagram.The image shared online on President Kovind’s handles match exactly to the video frame at 00:59, thereby confirming that the PM greeted him with folded hands.Therefore, based on our investigation, we can conclusively say that the viral video showing Prime Minister Modi ‘ignoring’ outgoing President Ram Nath Kovind is misleading.If you want to fact-check any story, WhatsApp it now on +91 11 7127 9799Your nameYour emailSubjectYour message (optional)ΔClick here for Latest News updates and viral videos on our AI-powered smart news

content: Fact Check: Viral Video Of The Waterfall Is From Maharashtra, NOT... A video showing a couple being chased by the police personnel near a gushing waterfall is widely shared on social media, claiming that police is beating tourists in Anakkampoyil and Thusharagiri, Kerala.The video is shared on Facebook with a caption in the Malayalam: “ഇനി കുളിക്കാൻ ആനക്കാംപൊയിൽ, തുഷാരഗിരി തുടങ്ങിയ ഭാഗങ്ങളിലേക്ക് പോയാലുള്ള അനുഭവം ഇതായിരിക്കും” (English translation: This will be the experience if you go to places like Anakkampoyil and Thusharagiri to bathe.)Here’s the link to the above post.FACT CHECKNewsMobile fact-checked the above claim, and found it to be MISLEADING.We did a keyword search but could not find any credible media report corroborating the viral claim. If such an incident had happened, the mainstream media would have covered it.Using the InVid Tool, we extracted keyframes from the viral video and performed a Reverse Image Search. The search directed us to a news report, published by Lokmat on July 18, 2022, carrying screengrabs similar to the viral video. According to the article, “there was a police crackdown on the rowdy tourists who performed stunts on the edge of the Rautwadi waterfall. Preventive action was taken against seven people this time.” Rautwadi waterfall is situated in Maharashtra.Searching further, we found the same video uploaded by News18 with the description: “Some overzealous tourists were trying to climb the dangerous cliff at Rautwadi waterfall in Radhanagari taluk. Therefore, the police have given a good crackdown on these overzealous tourists.”Thus, it is confirmed that the video from Maharashtra is falsely shared as that from Kerala.If you want to fact-check any story, WhatsApp it now on +91 11 7127 979l9Your nameYour emailSubjectYour message (optional)ΔClick here for Latest News updates and viral videos n our AI-powered smart news

content: Fact Check: Old Video of a Jawan’s funeral Procession Is Viral... Here, we found the full video of the viral clip on YouTube, which was uploaded on December 4, 2021.As per the video description, this video is of 22-year-old martyred jawan Lokesh Kumawat, who was a resident of Mawta village, Kalukheda police station, in Madhya Pradesh.A similar video — uploaded in October 2021 — was also found, claiming that it was the funeral of martyr Harish Parmar from Gujarat’s Kheda district.NewsMobile independently couldn’t verify the location of the video.Hence, it is clear that an old video is being shared with misleading claims.If you want to fact-check any story, WhatsApp it now on +91 11 7127 9799Your nameYour emailSubjectYour message (optional)ΔClick here for Latest News updates and viral videos on our AI-powered smart news

content: Fact Check: Are Only Mayors Invited to the World Cities Summit... Delhi Chief Minister Arvind Kejriwal has been invited to attend the four-day World Cities Summit 2022 in Singapore (July 31-Aug 3, 2022). He complains that the Central government is delaying his request to attend the event and present Delhi model of governance to the world.Against this backdrop, a viral post, claiming that the event is exclusive for mayors and not chief ministers, is doing the rounds on social media.A Facebook user posted images of the attendees of the event with the caption: Kejriwal is attacking Central government for not giving him permission to attend the summit in Singapore. But the summit is of mayors, Kejriwal is a chief minister. If he thinks he is just a mayor, he should announce publiclyYou can find the post hereFACT CHECKWhen NewsMobile fact-checked the viral posts, it was found to be misleading.A Google Keyword Search about the event led us to the official website of the World Cities Summit. The website states: “Join global, business and thought leaders worldwide in person as they share best practices and ideas for cities to emerge more liveable, sustainable and resilient, from prolonged and unpredictable disruptions. This year, the summit centres around the theme Liveable and Sustainable Cities: Emerging Stronger.”Scrolling further, we found a section titled: ‘Who’s coming’. The link leads us to the list of attendees for this year’s event. At the top of the page, we can see a section to filter the list based on the categories of the invited guests. The categories are All, Mayors/City Leaders, Ministers, Moderators, and Speakers. So, it is confirmed that the event is not solely for mayors.Searching further into the history of events, we found that in 2018, N. Chandrababu Naidu, former and then chief minister of Andhra Pradesh, too, attended the World Cities Summit in Singapore. The chief Minister’s visit was covered by many local and national media houses like The Times of India, Business Standard, Financial Express, NTV Telugu, to name a few.Updates on the event were also published on the minister’s personal social media handles as well. A live video on Facebook, whereas a detailed case study was published on his personal LinkedIn handle.Therefore, we can conclusively say that the viral claim about World Cities Summit — an exclusive event for mayors — is misleading.If you want to fact-check any story, WhatsApp it now on +91 11 7127 9799Your nameYour emailSubjectYour message (optional)ΔClick here for Latest News updates and viral videos on our AI-powered smart news

content: Fact Check: Viral Claim On ISRO’s Web Portal ‘Radio Garden’ Is... A post has gone viral on social media claiming that ISRO has developed a web portal called “Radio Garden”, where you can access live radio stations across the globe and listen to any frequency for free.The post reads: “अप्रतिम…आमचा इस्रो खाली दिलेल्या लिंकवर क्लिक करा…..मग तुम्हाला हिरवे ठिपके दिसतील…ते जगभरातील FM रेडिओ स्टेशन आहेत…जेव्हा तुम्ही कोणत्याही हिरव्यावर क्लिक कराल. dot तुम्ही संबंधित भागातील एफएम रेडिओ ऐकू शकता आणि आनंद घेऊ शकता.. आश्चर्याची गोष्ट म्हणजे अशा प्रकारे ऐकण्यासाठी कोणत्याही इअरफोनची गरज नाही…. फक्त अप्रतिम… अभिमान आहे आमच्या ISRO.” (English translation: “Awesome…Our ISRO, click the link below…Then you will see the green spots…These are FM radio stations around the world.. When you click on any green dot you can listen and enjoy the FM radio in the relevant area. Surprisingly, no earphones are needed to listen to this way… Simply amazing… Proud of our ISRO. “Thank you ISRO*”)The link to the post can be seen here.FACT CHECKNewsMobile did the fact-check, and found it to be misleading.On the website of Radio Garden, it is mentioned that it is based in Amsterdam, the Netherlands. The description reads: “Radio Garden invites you to tune into thousands of live radio stations across the globe. By bringing distant voices close, radio connects people and places. From its very beginning, radio signals have crossed borders. Radio makers and listeners have imagined both connecting with distant cultures, as well as re-connecting with people from ‘home’ from thousands of miles away.”According to a website — The Ledger: “The project began in 2016 when it was commissioned by the Netherlands Institute for Sound and Vision. It was supposed to be temporary and only on the web. But by 2018, it was available in an app, and by 2019, the founders had turned it into an independent company.”PIB Fact Check also tweeted to refute the viral claim. The tweet reads: “A message claiming that @isro has developed a radio portal called “Radio Garden” that enables people to listen to stations from across the world is circulating on social media. #PIBFactCheck This claim is #FAKE. No such radio portal has been developed by #ISRO.”Hence, we can ascertain that the viral claim is misleading.If you want to fact-check any story, WhatsApp it now on +91 11 7127 9799Your nameYour emailSubjectYour message (optional)ΔClick here for Latest News updates and viral videos on our AI-powered smart news

content: Fact Check: What Is The Reality Behind Indira Gandhi’s ‘Time Capsule’? An image of late Prime Minister Indira Gandhi burying a metal capsule has gone viral on social media. The image is being shared with a caption asking the government to dig out the ‘time capsule’ and make the contents public. The post claims those documents must be excavated by the current government since they hold secret information about the Congress regime.The caption associated with the image read: “इस घटना की याद सायद ही किसी को होगी। 15 अगस्त 1973 को लाल किले के सामने कुए में भारी भरकम ताँबे और स्टील के कैप्सूल में इंदिरा ने कुछ महत्वपूर्ण पब्लिक दस्तावेज गाड़े थे हिन्दुओ मोदीजी से मांग करो इस स्थल को खोदवाकर दस्तावेज को सार्वजनिक कराये ताकि पता लगे इसमे क्या इतिहास छिपा है ?”(English translation, “People will hardly remember this incident. Heavy metal capsule having some important public documents was burried inside a well in front of Red Fort on August 15, 1973. Hindus ask Modiji to dig this place and make the document public so that we come to know what history is hidden inside it.”)The link to the post can be seen here.FACT CHECKNewsMobile did a fact-check and found the claim to be misleading.On searching on Google with relevant keywords, we found a report dated December 2, 1977, published in The Washington Post. The report stated that “a parliamentary committee was established to supervise the exhumation, open the capsule, and reveal what lies inside. The assumption here is that then Prime Minister Indira Gandhi buried the device; it was packed with laudatory paper about her family and little else. The report further said that the then member of Parliament from the Punjab, Dutt Sharma – who was also a member of the then ruling Peoples Party but formerly a leader of the Hindu nationalist party the Jan Sangh – was the chairman of the Parliamentary Committee for Examination of Time Capsules.”News 18 also reported that on August 15, 1973, Indira Gandhi buried a metal capsule, known as Kaalapatra, in front of Red Fort.The capsule was said to have documentation of the first 25 years of the country and was expected to be excavated after 1000 years so that people would get a closer glimpse of the history of India. However, the project received heavy backlash as people believed that it misrepresented historical facts.However, later in 1977, the Janata Party came to power under the leadership of Morarji Desai and excavated the capsule. A few veteran journalists claimed that the capsule’s content had details about Indira Gandhi’s accomplishments and her father Jawaharlal Nehru. However, not many details are available about what was in it.Thus, we can ascertain that the time capsule has been excavated in 1977, unlike the viral claim which says it is yet to be excavated. Thus, the viral claim is misleading.If you want to fact-check any story, WhatsApp it now on +91 11 7127 9799Your nameYour emailSubjectYour message (optional)ΔClick here for Latest News updates and viral videos on our AI-powered smart news

content: Fact Check: Government Is Not Providing Unemployment Allowance of  ₹6,000 A post with a link to a website is widely circulated on social media, claiming that the Union Government will provide a monthly allowance of ₹6,000 to unemployed youth.The text reads: “सरकार ने लिया बड़ा फैसला. बेरोजगार युवाओं को 6,000 रुपये जीवन यापन के लिए हर महीने देगी सरकार. प्रधानमंत्री बेरोजगार भत्ता योजना 2022 के लिए रजिस्ट्रेशन शुरू हो गए हैं, इस योजना के अंतर्गत सभी बेरोजगार युवाओं को जीवन यापन के लिए 6,000 रूपये हर महीने दिए जा रहे हैं. नअभी मोबाइल से नीचे दी गई लिंक से अपना रजिस्टेशन करें” (English translation: The government took a big decision. It will give ₹6,000 to the unemployed youth every month. Registration has started for the Prime Minister’s Unemployed Allowance Scheme 2022. Under this scheme, ₹6000 will be given to all the unemployed youth for their livelihood every month. Now register yourself from mobile from the link provided below)Here’s the link to the above post. Some users also shared the same message with a registration link.Check the post here.FACT CHECKNewsMobile fact-checked the post, and found it to be fabricated.We opened the link and noticed that the domain name was also not .gov, .org or .in. Moreover, the notice on the site said that the page had been deleted or suspended.We ran a keyword search, but could not find information about any such scheme launched by the government. We also checked the official government website but failed to find any scheme by this name.A tweet by Press Information Bureau (PIB), dated July 15, 2022, has also clarified that the viral message is false.Hence, based on the above fact check, it is clear that the viral post is fake.If you want to fact-check any story, WhatsApp it now on +91 11 7127 9799Your nameYour emailSubjectYour message (optional)ΔClick here for Latest News updates and viral videos on our AI-powered smart news

content: Fact Check: Old Video of Nupur Sharma’s Speech in Maharashtra Viral... Following Nupur Sharma’s alleged controversial comments against Prophet Muhammad, a video has surfaced on social media platforms claiming that it is her most recent speech. In this video, Nupur Sharma challenges the timing of the terrorists’ Supreme Court hearings and expresses her opposition to triple talaq, burqa, and Islamic marital customs.The video is shared on Facebook with a caption in Hindi: “विवादित बयान के बाद नूपुर शर्मा जी का नया वीडियो…सुन लो हिन्दूओं….दही , प्याज , टमाटर खा लेना बाद में” (English translation: After her pungent remarks, Nupur Sharma Ji‘s new video… listen Hindus… Eat curd, onion, and tomato later)Here’s the link to the above post.FACT CHECKNewsMobile fact-checked the above claim, and found it to be MISLEADING.We did a keyword search, but could not find any recent credible media report corroborating the viral claim. Had she made such a claim recently, the mainstream media would have covered it.Further, we extracted keyframes from the video and performed a Reverse Image Search. This search directed us to a tweet published by Nupur Sharma on May 25, 2018, that carried visuals similar to the viral video. The tweet reads: “Spoke on ‘Women in Nationalism’ at ‘Vyakhyan’ — organised by Vanvasi Kalyan Ashram at Nagar in Maharashtra — today. It was a privilege to have interacted with some enterprising women in Nagar, who contribute to society in various ways.”Spoke on “Women in Nationalism” at ‘Vyakhyan’ organised by Vanvasi Kalyan Ashram at Nagar, Maharashtra today. It was also a privilege to have interacted with some very enterprising Nagar women who are contributing to the society in various ways. pic.twitter.com/6NYx5wSwoE — Nupur Sharma (@NupurSharmaBJP) May 24, 2018We also found a video of Nupur Sharma’s speech at the “Vyakhyan” event on May 24, 2018. The claims made by Nupur Sharma in the viral video can be heard around 3:45 in the Facebook video. Nupur Sharma is wearing the same outfit as seen in the recent video.After her controversial remarks against Prophet Mohammad, she had issued an apology on Twitter on June 5, 2022. This was her last tweet and we could not find any report of her attending any public event and speaking anything about Supreme Court trials, or her views related to Islam and Hinduism.Thus, it is confirmed that the viral claim is misleading.If you want to fact-check any story, WhatsApp it now on +91 11 7127 979l9Your nameYour emailSubjectYour message (optional)ΔClick here for Latest News updates and viral videos n our AI-powered smart news

content: Fact Check: No Caste Related Changes In Army Recruitment Specifically For... Following an uproar across the country over the government’s Agniveer scheme for recruitment in the armed forces, a claim has surfaced on the internet informing that the applicants have been asked their caste for recruitment in Army.The claim in Hindi reads: “भारत के इतिहास में पहली बार “सेना भर्ती “ में जाति पूछी जा रही है। मोदी जी आपको “अग्निवीर” बनाना है या “जातिवीर””(English translation: For the first time in the history of India, caste is being asked in “Army recruitment”. Modi ji you have to make “Agniveer” or “Jaativeer”)The above post can be seen here.FACT CHECKNewsMobile fact-checked the above claim and found it to be false.Through a simple Google search with relevant keywords — ‘Army Recruitment’, ‘Caste’, ‘Form’ — we found many news reports covering fake claims. These reports can be seen here, here and here.Defence Minister Rajanath Singh on Tuesday clarified that such claims are just rumours.#WATCH | “It’s just a rumour. Earlier system, existing since pre-independence era, is going on. No change has been made. Old system is being continued,” says Defence Min Rajnath Singh on Opposition’s allegations that caste & religion certificates being asked for Agnipath scheme. pic.twitter.com/gtBJAtaSvP — ANI (@ANI) July 19, 2022Meanwhile, in a tweet dated July 19, 2022, the Press Information Bureau (PIB) has also refuted the claims of caste being asked for Army recruitment.It is to be noted that there is already a provision to show caste certificates for army recruitment, however, it is for administrative and operational requirements.In 2013, the Army had clarified in an affidavit filed before the Supreme Court stating that it was just for administrative and operational requirements and had no role in the selection process.Hence, with the above findings, we can conclude that the claim on social media is false.If you want to fact-check any story, WhatsApp it now on +91 11 7127 9799Your nameYour emailSubjectYour message (optional)ΔClick here for Latest News updates and viral videos on our AI-powered smart news

content: Fact Check: Video Of Kolkata-Deoghar Flight Viral With Misleading Claims On July 17, A Hyderabad-bound Indigo flight from Sharjah had to be diverted to Karachi in Pakistan for emergency landing after the pilot reported a technical snag in the engine. This was the second instance of an Indian flight rerouting and making an emergency landing in Karachi in the past few weeks.Against this backdrop, a video of passengers on a flight chanting ‘Har Har Mahadev’ is being shared on social media with the claim that this was shot inside the aircraft which landed in Karachi.A Facebook page shared the post with the caption: Big Breaking Sharjah #Hyderabad Indigo Flight emergency landed in Karachi due to technical problem, n this was the second Indian flight to land in #Karachi after two weeks. Passenger chanting Har har mahadev Rafael #BajrangiBhaijaan #Pakistan #VoiceOfIndia #indigoairlines #IndiGoflight #emergencylandingYou can find the post here.FACT CHECKNewsMobile fact-checked the video and found it to be misleading.We conducted a Reverse Image Search of the keyframes of the video. Our search led us to various social media posts from July 12, 2022, that carried the same video. Many users had posted the same video claiming that the scenes were from the first ever flight from Kolkata to Deoghar, linking the pilgrimage spot Baidyanath Dham to Kolkata.A Facebook user posted the video and wrote, “As the first flight from Kolkata took off for Deoghar today, the passengers chanted, “Bol Bam”, “Har Har Mahadev”, “Baba Vaidyanath ki jai” and “Jai Shiv”.The video was shared by many other users across Twitter as well.After deep diving into our search results, we found a post by 22scope, a local media house of Jharkhand. The page posted a real-time report, from inside the plane, on the first ever flight to Deoghar.Apart from 22scope, News Nation also presented a report on July 12, 2022, about the Kolkata-Deoghar flight on their YouTube channel.Finally, we conducted a Google keyword search to confirm the flight details. We found that the Deoghar airport was inaugurated by Prime Minister Narendra Modi on July 12, 2022, and the first commercial aircraft landed the same day from Kolkata. Media houses like The Times of India, Zee news, Outlook India, covered the event among others.Therefore, based on our investigation, we can conclusively say that the viral video of passengers chanting ‘Har Har Mahadev’ in an Indigo aircraft from Karachi is misleading.If you want to fact-check any story, WhatsApp it now on +91 11 7127 9799Your nameYour emailSubjectYour message (optional)ΔClick here for Latest News updates and viral videos on our AI-powered smart news

content: Fact Check: Old Video From The US Shared As Cloudburst In... As rains batter several parts of Pakistan, leaving over 180 people dead already, a video of a cloud burst is being widely shared on social media with a claim that the visuals are from Pakistan’s Karachi.The video is being shared on Facebook with a caption in Urdu: بریکنگ نیوز “.کراچی میں آج بادل پھٹنے کا منظر(Translation: BREAKING NEWS…Scene of cloudburst in Karachi today)Here’s the link to the above post.FACT CHECKNewsMobile fact-checked the above claim and found it to be MISLEADING.Using the InVid Tool, we extracted keyframes from the viral video and performed a Reverse Image Search. This search directed us to a YouTube channel that carried the same viral video on July 21, 2019, with the caption, “A time-lapse of multiple microbursts falling just north of Sky Harbor International Airport in Phoenix, Arizona on August 23, 2018.”We checked the website of Kyle Benne, who uploaded the video on his YouTube channel. We found that the same video was also uploaded on his website with the same caption.Searching further, we found similar visuals uploaded on Alamy.com with the caption, “Microburst Over Phoenix, Arizona.” The image was uploaded on August 23, 2018.Though we could not ascertain the exact date of the video, it can be concluded that the viral video is from the USA and not Pakistan. Therefore, the viral claim is misleading.If you want to fact-check any story, WhatsApp it now on +91 11 7127 979l9Your nameYour emailSubjectYour message (optional)ΔClick here for Latest News updates and viral videos n our AI-powered smart news

content: Fact Check: Viral Video Of Woman Smashing Idols Of Hindu Gods... A viral video of a burqa-clad woman breaking idols of Hindu gods in a store is doing rounds on social media. Several users are claiming that the video is from Kerala.A Facebook user posted the video with the caption: केरल के इस विडियो को देखें और इसे जितना हो सके उतना फॉरवर्ड करें …. अगर आप यू आज चुप रहते हैं तो हमें नुकसान होगा … क्योंकि *6 महीने के बाद इसे आगे बढ़ाने का कोई फायदा नहीं होगा* … उँगलियाँ घुमाएँ और इसे आगे बढ़ाएँ अभी(English Translation: Watch this video of Kerala and forward it as much as you can….if u keep quiet today we will be at loss…because after 6 months there will be no use to pursue it… share the video now just from a single tap.)You can find the video here.FACT CHECKNewsMobile fact-checked the viral video and found the claim to be false.Running a Google Keyword Search about the video led us to an August 17, 2020, article titled, ‘Bahrain woman charged with insulting Hindu religious symbol’, published by The Times of India.On reading the article, we found out that the 2020 video is actually from Bahrain. A 54-year-old woman smashed statues of the Hindu god Ganesha inside a souvenir store in the Juffair area of the capital city Manama. She was later summoned by the police and prosecuted for her action. The report was covered by many national and international media houses including The New Indian Express, Gulf News and Morocco World News among others.The Ministry of Interior, Bahrain, too, tweeted about the video on August 16, 2020, informing that the woman was summoned by the police.The link mentioned in the tweet led us to the official website of the Ministry of Interior where they issued an official statement on the case.Searching further, we also found an August 16, 2020 tweet by the advisor to the king of Bahrain, and former foreign minister, Khalid bin Hamad Al Khalifa. The diplomat condemned the actions of the woman and said that it is an intrusive and unacceptable hate crime.Therefore, based on our investigation, we can conclusively say that the viral video of a burqa-clad woman smashing idols of Hindu gods is being shared with a misleading claim.If you want to fact-check any story, WhatsApp it now on +91 11 7127 9799Your nameYour emailSubjectYour message (optional)ΔClick here for Latest News updates and viral videos on our AI-powered smart news

content: Fact Check: Video Of Massive Landslide Is NOT From Goa A video showing a massive landslide is being shared on social media with a claim that it shows the landslide that took place at Anmod Ghat in Goa (Karnataka-Goa border).The text reads: “Landslide at Anmod Ghat, Goa”Here’s the link to the above post.FACT CHECKNewsMobile did the fact-check, and found it to be misleading.On doing a Google Reverse Image Search with one of the screenshots, we found the same video was uploaded by a YouTube channel on June 23, 2022, with a caption: “Footage of a landslide at Silchar — Mizoram Highway (NH 306)”Another YouTube channel, Current Affairs, also uploaded the video on June 23, 2022, claiming that it is a landslide at Silchar — Mizoram Highway (NH-306).A report by local media outlet Tak News also claims that the video is of the Assam landslide. However, NewsMobile independently couldn’t confirm the claim.Earlier, NewsMobile debunked the same post when it was shared as that from Maharashtra’s Rajapur.https://newsmobile.in/articles/2022/07/04/fact-check-viral-landslide-video-is-not-from-maharashtras-rajapur/Hence, it is clear that the viral video is NOT from Goa.If you want to fact-check any story, WhatsApp it now on +91 11 7127 9799Your nameYour emailSubjectYour message (optional)ΔClick here for Latest News updates and viral videos on our AI-powered smart news

content: Fact Check: Old Video Of Bridge Collapsing In Jammu Falsely Shared... Gujarat has been witnessing heavy rain for a couple of weeks, leading to flooding and damage to various structures and roads. Against this backdrop, a video showing a bridge collapsing and washing away in running water is doing the rounds on social media, claiming that the bridge is connecting Akkalkuwa — a town in Maharashtra, and Ankleshwar, a city in Gujarat.The video is shared on Facebook with the caption: “महाराष्ट्र अक्कलकुवा से अंकलेश्वर रोड का पुल पानी के तेज बहाव में बह गया” (English translation: The bridge of Ankleshwar road from Akkalkuwa in Maharashtra washed away in the high flow of water)Here’s the link to the above post.FACT CHECKNewsMobile fact-checked the above claim, and found it to be MISLEADING.Doing a keyword search, we found a bridge that collapsed during the recent floods in Chhota Udaipur, Gujarat. But no credible media report carried the same video as recent.Using the InVid Tool, we extracted keyframes from the viral video and performed a Reverse Image Search. This search directed us to a video tweet uploaded by ANI on August 26, 2020, that carried the same video. The text reads: “Jammu and Kashmir: A portion of a bridge in Jammu’s Gadigarh area collapses, following heavy rainfall in the region.”#WATCH Jammu and Kashmir: A portion of a bridge in Jammu’s Gadigarh area collapses, following heavy rainfall in the region. pic.twitter.com/MPwTGefF8D — ANI (@ANI) August 26, 2020We compared the viral video with ANI video and found many similarities. It can be concluded that the viral video is old.We also found a news report, published by NDTV dated August 26, 2020, that carried visuals similar to the viral video. The headline reads: “Watch concrete bridge on river collapses after heavy rain in Jammu.”Searching further, we found a video news report, published by the Hindustan Times on August 26, 2020, that carried the same viral video with a caption: “A portion of a bridge in Jammu’s Gadigarh area collapsed, following heavy rainfall in the region. As per the visuals, the bridge is located on a stream. Due to heavy rainfall in the area, the water level rose in the stream leading to collapse of a large portion of the bridge.”Thus, it is confirmed that the viral claim that it shows a bridge collapsing in Gujarat is misleading.If you want to fact-check any story, WhatsApp it now on +91 11 7127 979l9Your nameYour emailSubjectYour message (optional)ΔClick here for Latest News updates and viral videos n our AI-powered smart news

content: Fact Check: Video Clip Of Army Personnel Helping People During Heavy... A video is circulated on social media at a fast pace, showing some Army personnel helping people during heavy rain.The video is shared with a caption: “भारी बारिश के चलते राजस्थान श्रीगंगानगर में सेना से मांगी मदद : श्रीगंगानगर में 43 साल का रिकॉर्ड टूटा, कई शहरों में बाढ़ के हालात।” (English translation: Rajasthan seeks help from Army in Sri Ganganagar due to heavy rains: Forty-three years of record broken in Sri Ganganagar, flood situation in many cities”)The link to the organisation can be seen here.FACT CHECKNewsMobile did the fact-check, and found it to be misleading.On doing a Google Reverse Image Search with one of the keyframes, we found the same video uploaded by Amar Ujala on October 19, 2021. According to the report, Army personnel rescued people stuck in a shop due to heavy rainfall in Nainital, Uttarakhand.ABP Live also uploaded the same video on October 19, 2021, claiming that it is of Nainital, Uttarakhand, where Army personnel performed a rescue operation at Mall Road.Thus, based on the above information, it is clear that the viral video is not from Rajasthan.If you want to fact-check any story, WhatsApp it now on +91 11 7127 9799Your nameYour emailSubjectYour message (optional)ΔClick here for Latest News updates and viral videos on our AI-powered smart news

content: Fact Check: Old Video from Himachal Viral as Recent Anmod Ghat... A video of a landslide is being circulated on social media, claiming that it shows a recent landslide at Anmod Ghat at the Karnataka-Goa border.Two incidents of landslide occurred at Anmod Ghat on July 4, 2022, following incessant rain in the region, bringing traffic on the Goa-Karnataka national highway (NH-4A) to a grinding halt.The text read: “#Anmod Ghat #Landslide Video Credits: #Whatsapp.”Here’s the link to the above post.FACT CHECKNewsMobile fact-checked the post, and found it to be misleading.On putting the keyframes of the video through Reverse Image Search, we found the same video uploaded by Hindustan Times on YouTube on July 31, 2021, with a title: “Watch: Road collapses during dramatic landslide in Himachal Pradesh’s Sirmaur”.The video description reads: “Landslide in Himachal Pradesh’s Sirmaur caught on camera on Friday (July 30, 2021). In dramatic visuals, a portion of road collapsed in the Sirmaur region. The road reportedly caved in after incessant rainfall. National Highway 707 was blocked following the landslide. Over 165 people have been stranded in Lahaul-Spiti region. As per reports, three trekkers have been missing. Rescue work is going on in the area.”The same video was also published by The Quint in July 2021, with a title: “Watch | Terrifying visuals of road collapse after landslide in Himachal.”The report mentioned that the incident took place near Nahan town in Sirmaur district of Himachal Pradesh.Hence, it is clear that it is an old video from Himachal and is NOT related to the recent landslide at Anmod Ghat at the Karnataka-Goa border.If you want to fact-check any story, WhatsApp it now on +91 11 7127 9799Your nameYour emailSubjectYour message (optional)ΔClick here for Latest News updates and viral videos on our AI-powered smart news

content: Fact Check: Afghan Video Deceptively Linked to Recent Pak Power Plant... A video of a huge explosion is widely shared on social media. Many social media users claim that it is the recent explosion at a Pakistan power plant.The video is shared on Facebook with a caption: “Guddu power plant blast, loss of 15 billion Pakistani rupees”Here’s the link to the above post.FACT CHECKNewsMobile fact-checked the above claim, and found it to be MISLEADING.Using the InVid Tool, we extracted keyframes from the viral video and performed a Reverse Image Search. This search directed us to a YouTube channel that carried the same viral video on February 13, 2021, with the caption: “Dozens of gas and oil barrels caught fire in Herat Islam Qala port.”More searches led us to a few media accounts from Russia and Turkey that included pictures of the explosion seen in the viral video.According to a report, dated February 14, 2021, the blast took place in Afghanistan after some fuel tanks caught fire.According to another Turkish media report, 18 trucks with Turkish licence plates were destroyed in the explosion. The incident happened in Afghanistan’s “Islamic Kale” (Islam Qala) district, not far from the Iranian border. The same was reported by Associated Press and CNN.The same video was also tweeted by an Afghanistan journalist on February 13, 2021, with the caption: “#AFG fuel tankers exploding. Investors lose their money in a matter of seconds. Financial tragedy on the Afghan-Iran border. No one knows what started the fire. No reports of casualties or fatalities at this stage. Video shared with me.”#AFG fuel tankers exploding. Investors losing their money in a matter of seconds. Financial tragedy on the Afghan – Iran border. No one knows what started the fire. No reports of casualties or fatalities at this stage. Video shared with me. pic.twitter.com/hb127UqSv5 — BILAL SARWARY (@bsarwary) February 13, 2021We then looked if any such incident recently happened in Pakistan. We found that the fire at the Guddu power plant, situated in Sindh province of Pakistan, took place on July 13, 2022. This incident had been reported by many media outlets. The power plant blast has cost the national exchequer 15 billion Pakistani rupees.Thus, it is evident from the above information that an old video from Afghanistan is falsely shared as a recent Pakistan power plant fire.If you want to fact-check any story, WhatsApp it now on +91 11 7127 979l9Your nameYour emailSubjectYour message (optional)ΔClick here for Latest News updates and viral videos n our AI-powered smart news

content: Fact Check: 2020 Video Of A Plane On A Flooded Runway... With the onset of monsoon in several parts of Pakistan, many cities have been put on high alert with a forecast of heavy rains. Rains have battered Pakistan’s financial capital Karachi as well.Against this backdrop, viral video of a PIA passenger plane taxiing on a flooded runway at Karachi airport is doing rounds on social media.A Facebook user posted the video with the caption: Today Karachi Airport due to heavy rain in sindh bhutto zinda hai!.You can find the video here.FACT CHECKNewsMobile fact-checked the viral video and found it to be misleading.Doing a Yandex reverse-image search of keyframes led us to a YouTube video titled: PIA Plane Landing in Deep Water at Karachi Airport | Karachi Rain | TSC1. The video was published on August 27, 2020, on a verified local YouTube channel named Talk Shows Central.Just like this year, Karachi received above-average rainfall in 2020 as well. With several parts of the city inundated, the runway at the Karachi airport too got submerged in floods. The incident was widely reported by various media houses and YouTube channels in August 2020. You can find the links here, here, and here.Diving further into our investigation, we conducted a Google keyword search to find out about any recent incidents of flooding at Karachi airport. While Pakistan is suffering due to the record-breaking monsoon this year, there is no particular news item to corroborate the viral video as a recent occurrence. Our search, further, led us to a July 11, 2022 tweet by The Pakistan Civil Aviation Authority (PCAA). The government body confirmed in their tweet that the video is not recent and that everything is normal at the Jinnah International Airport (JIAP), Karachi.The tweet reads: An old video is being flushed around on social media that shows an airplane moving on a runway covered in water. Please note that this is an old video, nearly 3-year old, and does not depict the present situation at Karachi’s JIAP, which is normal, with drains working normally.Therefore, based on our findings, we can conclusively say that the video doing rounds on social media claiming a PIA passenger plane on a flooded runway at the Karachi airport is from August 2020, and is not recent.If you want to fact-check any story, WhatsApp it now on +91 11 7127 9799Your nameYour emailSubjectYour message (optional)ΔClick here for Latest News updates and viral videos on our AI-powered smart news

content: Fact Check: 2011 Croatian Image Falsely Linked To The Ongoing Farmers’... The ongoing tussle between farmers of Holland and the state is intensifying with each passing day. Over 40,000 farmers are protesting against the government’s proposal to reduce emissions of various harmful pollutants produced by their livestock.Against this backdrop, a viral image claiming that farmers have taken their PM’s private jet, and a fighter plane, is doing rounds on social media.A Facebook user shared the post with the caption: हालैंड में किसान आंदोलन अपने चरम पर है किसान उस प्राइवेट जैट को टोचन कर ले गए हैं जो वहां के पीएम के लिए है! एयर फोर्स के फाइटर जेट को भी टोचन कर लिया है (English translation: The peasant movement is at its peak in Holland, the farmers have taken the private jet which is there for the PM! Air Force fighter jets have also been shot down)You can find the link to the post here.FACT CHECKNewsMobile fact-checked the above claim and found it to be misleading.On running a Reverse Image Search on Yandex, we landed on a website called Jutarnji. Learning more about the website, we found out that Jutarnji is a local Croatian newspaper and that the image was published on May 26, 2011. Another local newspaper, 24sata, too, published similar images.On investigating the news further, we found out that the 2011 photo was taken ahead of the 20th-anniversary celebrations of the creation of the Croatian armed forces. The MIG aircraft was being towed with the help of a tractor, through the streets of Zagreb, to Jarun for a military weapons display in the capital.To confirm the credibility and the existence of the exhibition we, then, looked up the official website of the Ministry of Defence of the Republic of Croatia and found the same image on the website.We also noticed an image on the tail. On looking closely at the image, we found out that it matches the national emblem of Croatia.Therefore based on our research, we can conclusively say that the viral image claiming farmers of Holland taking away PM’s jet and a fighter plane is misleading.If you want to fact-check any story, WhatsApp it now on +91 11 7127 9799Your nameYour emailSubjectYour message (optional)ΔClick here for Latest News updates and viral videos on our AI-powered smart news

content: Fact Check: Viral Video Of Haryana Flood Fury Erroneously Shared As... A video is reaching the wider audience on social media, showing people pushing a car on the flooded road. It is claimed that this is from Sri Ganganagar in Rajasthan.The video is shared on Facebook with a Hindi caption: “श्रीगंगानगर के हालात” (English translation: Sri Ganganagar’s condition)Here’s the link to the above post.FACT CHECKNewsMobile fact-checked the above claim, and found it to be MISLEADING.We carefully checked the video and saw that the initial letter of the car’s number plate reads ‘H’.Also, towards the end of the video, we saw ‘Chopra Electricals’ written on one of the shut shops. Taking this cue, we ran a Google search with ‘Chopra Electricals’ shops in Haryana or Himachal. The top result showed a shop in Haryana’s Rohtak.We searched further and found images in Google Maps that matched the viral video. Thus, it can be concluded that the video is from the Rohtak area of Haryana.AAP Haryana had also tweeted a similar video from the same neighbourhood on July 1, 2022, with a caption: “In Rohtak, Haryana, the whole city was submerged in a boat-like situation. The state government’s inaction came out openly in the first rain of the season. Development work has been hampered due to massive corruption.”Earlier, NewsMobile debunked the same video, where it was being passed off as that from Delhi.https://newsmobile.in/articles/2022/07/04/fact-check-video-of-flooded-roads-in-haryanas-rohtak-falsely-shared-as-from-delhi/Thus, it is now clear that the viral video’s claim is misleading.If you want to fact-check any story, WhatsApp it now on +91 11 7127 979l9Your nameYour emailSubjectYour message (optional)ΔClick here for Latest News updates and viral videos n our AI-powered smart news

content: Fact Check: Viral Video Of Jeep Swept Away In Floods Is... A high alert has been sounded in multiple states across South India along with Maharashtra and Gujarat in view of heavy rainfall. In this backdrop, a viral video of a jeep being swept away in floods is doing rounds online. Many users are claiming that the video is from Nanded in Maharashtra while some are linking it to Telangana.A Facebook user posted the video with the caption: जल्दबाजी हमेशा घातक होती है … घटना कल शाम हिमायतनगर नांदेड़ महाराष्ट्र कि है (Translation: Haste is always fatal… the incident happened last evening in Himayatnagar Nanded Maharashtra)This video can also be seen here.Some users are also linking this video to tragedy that befell Telugu news channel NTV reporter Zameer who was swept away by flood waters while he was travelling in a car with his friend near Ramajipeta village, in Telangana’s Bornapalli.You can find the link here.FACT CHECKNewsMobile conducted a fact-check and found the video to be shared with a misleading claim.On closely monitoring the frames of the video, we noticed a logo on the spare tire cover of the jeep. On zooming in, we could see the logo of Suzuki along with an image of a rhino and POTOHAR 4WD written below it.On running a Google keyword search, we found out that Potohar is a jeep model in Pakistan, manufactured by Suzuki motors from 1985-2006.Taking the cue from this, we, then, ran a reverse image search of the keyframes. Our search led us to a YouTube video from September 7, 2020, titled: Accident of Potohar jeep due to flood|bad accident. The keyframes from the viral video match exactly one of the videos on YouTube.Lastly, we ran a google keyword search on journalist Zameer’s accident in Telangana. We found out that the accident took place on July 12, 2022. Various media houses, including ABP Live, reported the story online.Other reports can be read here, here, and here. Also, the car in which he was travelling, was a red Swift Dezire as opposed to Suzuki Potohar shown in the viral video.Therefore, based on our investigation, the viral video shared online is neither from Maharashtra nor is it linked to the Telangana tragedy. The video is from Pakistan.If you want to fact-check any story, WhatsApp it now on +91 11 7127 9799Your nameYour emailSubjectYour message (optional)ΔClick here for Latest News updates and viral videos on our AI-powered smart news
