But the Red Fort was built hundreds of years before shah jahan’s birth by “Maharaj Anangpal Tomar II“ in order to settle Delhi. Maharaj Anangpal Tomar is none other than Abhimanyu Cont’d of Mahabharata”https://twitter.com/Wings35539354/status/1526439086810009600Rajput’s of India claimed, “The Red Fort was also built by Prithviraj Chauhan’s maternal grandfather Anangpal Tomar ji. We are Rajputs, son, Thare baap #RajputSamratPrithvirajChauhan #राजपूत_सम्राट_पृथ्वीराज_चौहान”Kshatriya Rajputana Pathakpur has posted the same article in camouflage.On the other hand, after searching the sentence written in these tweets on Google, we found that the claim of making Red Fort by Anangpal has also been made in the articles published on many websites.news4social.com “most people know that the Red Fort of Delhi was built by Shah Jahan and is often taught. But that is not the fact and The Red Fort of Delhi was built hundreds of years before Shah Jahan was born. With the discovery of some such old things of the Red Fort, it has also been estimated that it was already built.”Website kreately.in has made the same claim by publishing an article in English.Samrat Anangpal Tomar II (1130-1151): Founder of Red Fort (Lal Quila). – Kreatelyhinduismsanatan.com has raised the question that in the zenith of Indraprastha, Dhillikapuri settled, flourished and continues till date as Delhi, how many people know this?ब्रज बासी लाल – विकिपीडिया (wikipedia.org)Fact check:To investigate the claim being made about the Red Fort, we did a simple search on Google. During this time, we found that the website and text book of the National Council of Educational Research and Training (NCRT), established by the Government of India for the purpose of advising the Central Government and Provincial Governments on matters related to education, contains that Mughal Emperor Shah Jahan worked red fort in New Delhi, India, in 1648. That is, Shah Jahan built the Red Fort in Delhi in 1648.It has also been told by NCRT that the Red Fort has been declared a World Heritage Site by UNESCO.Shah Jahan, the fifth Mughal emperor, was the ruler of vast territories from Kashmir to the Deccan and from the North-West Frontier Province to Bengal. It decided to shift its capital from Agra to Delhi after being in power for 10 years in 1638.Red Fort Complex – UNESCO World Heritage CentreUstad Ahmed Lahori, the architect of the Taj Mahal, was tasked with designing royal buildings in Delhi. Ustad Hameed was his companion. These constructions were given a name, Qila-e-Mubarak, in the fort on the banks of river Yamuna.At the same time, bbc Urdu report cited Inayat Khan’s book ‘Shahjahan Nama’ and said that the construction work of the fort started on Friday 9 Muharram (i.e. 13 May 1638). It took 9 years, 2 months and a few days to complete and cost Rs 60 lakh.Inayat Khan’s father Zafar Khan was Jahangir’s minister.Inayat Khan (historian) – WikipediaNowhere in history is it found that on the basis of which it can be said that The Red Fort was built by Shah Jahan’s Anangpal II.दिल्ली जो एक शहर था… – BBC News हिंदीThe signs of the fort that Anangpal II built are still there. According to the BBC report, “From a political point of view, Delhi got fame under the rule of a Tomar ruler, Anangpal. Anangpal established Lalkot in Delhi, the signs of which can still be seen in Mehrauli, which was later known as Qila Rai Pithora and became the first city of the Delhi Sultanate.”मुंबई बनाम दिल्ली: क्यों दिल्ली को मिले धरोहर का दर्जा – BBC News हिंदीThe distance between Red Fort and Mehrauli in Old Delhi (Shahjahanabad) is about 22 km.Conclusion:It is clear from this fact check of DFRAC that Shah Jahan built the Red Fort in 1648, so the claim being made by users that it was built by Anangpal II 300 years before Shah Jahan is fake and misleading, because Anangpal II built Lalkot (Fort Rai Pithora), not red fort.Claim: Delhi’s Red Fort was built by Anangpal IIClaimed by: Social media user.Fact: Fake and misleading.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Will you now have to pay 18% GST on rent? A claim is becoming very viral on social media. In which it is said that now 18 percent GST will have to be paid on house rent in India.Trinamool Congress leader Saket Gokhale tweeted saying, Note: Your house rent will now increase by 18%. Why? Because the Modi government will now collect GST from the tenants on the rent of their house. Amidst the huge price hike, the ruthless money-grabbing Modi government is determined to squeeze every penny out of the pockets of ordinary Indians.Source: TwitterIn his next tweet, he wrote, “Registered tenant” clause is a clever magic word. This means every freelancer, artist, writer, doctor, lawyer, and others who are not employed full time and have no office. If your main office is also your home, then you are covered under it.On the other hand, another user tweeted that 18% GST on rent for residential property is also an example of Modi Sarkar’s ache din.Fact Check:Claim: 18% GST on house rent for tenants #PibFactCheck▶️Renting of residential unit taxable only when it is rented to business entity▶️No GST when it is rented to private person for personal use▶️No GST even if proprietor or partner of firm rents residence for personal use pic.twitter.com/3ncVSjkKxP — PIB Fact Check (@PIBFactCheck) August 12, 2022During the investigation of the above claim, DFRAC got a fact check of PIB. Refuting the claim, it was stated that the rent of a residential unit is taxable only when it is let out as a commercial unit. Also when it is rented out to a private person for personal use. So no GST is levied. Even if the owner or partner of the firm gives accommodation on rent for personal use.Conclusion:Hence the claim of 18% GST on house rent is misleading.Claim Review: Now you have to pay 18% GST on rent.Claimed by: Saket GokhaleFact Check: misleading
label: rumor

content: Fact Check: Did President Droupadi Murmu banned non-vegetarian food inside Rashtriyaati Bhavan? A post in the name of Draupadi Murmu, the recent president of India is going viral on social media. People on social media are claiming that President Droupadi Murmu had issued orders to completely ban any kind of non-vegetarian feasts or drinks inside the Rashtrapati Bhavan.The post contains a picture of Murmu along with the words, “Full Ban on any kind of non-vegetarian feast or drinks in Rashtrapati Bhawan. The Beginning of our Hindu Rashtra. Every morning our President herself will perform the aarti at Brahma muhurta (4 a.m)”.Many users shared the post along with different captions.A user @Samvad_jod writes, “Ban on any type of Non-veg feast or Drink in Rashtrapati Bhavan.”Fact Check:To investigate the viral claim DFRAC desk used specific keywords and found no such news reports regarding this in any of the mainstream media houses.If the claim would have been true it would have made its way into the news reports.On further investigating about Draupadi Murmu the desk found many reports like one in the newspaper The Print claiming her to be a complete vegetarian who does not even eat onion and garlic.Conclusion:Even though resident murmur is a complete vegetarian, there is no ban on the non-vegetarian food items inside the Rashtrapati Bhavan.Claim Review: President Droupadi Murmu banned on non-vegetarian food inside Rashtriyaati Bhavan.Claimed by: social media user.Fact Check: fake.
label: truth

content: Are there ‘Muslim’ connections in the murder of a Hindu priest in Bihar’s Bettiah? Read Fact Check A priest was killed by beheading in Bettiah, Bihar. The incident is being heavily criticized on social media. People are sharing this incident and connecting it with the return of Jungle Raj in Bihar. People allege that Jungle Raj started as soon as RJD returns to power in Bihar. Actually West Champaran (Bettiah) of Bihar A priest was murdered on Wednesday morning in Bakulhar village of the district. The torso of the priest was in the temple, while his neck was found in the two-kilometre Kali temple.Some social media users are giving a communal angle to the matter. He is adding a Muslim angle to it. A user named Ashok Kumar wrote – “The general public perception in the country about the new pro-Muslim Bihar government is that now atrocities and violence against Hindus will increase in Bihar, which has started – the journalist murder in Jamui and The priest’s throat was slit in Bettiah.”(4) Ashok Kumar on Twitter: “नई मुस्लिम परस्त बिहार सरकार के विषय में देश में आम जन धारणा यह है- कि अब बिहार में हिंदुओं के ऊपर जुल्म और सितम बढ़ेंगे, जिसकी शुरुआत हो चुकी है-जमुई में पत्रकार की हत्या और बेतिया में पुजारी का गला काटा।” / TwitterAt the same time, another user wrote the post – “The news is from Bettiah in Bihar, brutal murder of a priest sleeping in the temple, head found 2 km away. Sometime back 5 MLAs of AIMIM also joined RJD. Muslims know what they have voted for. Hindu is crying for employment, inflation and petrol. #Bihar #MGB”(4) Dr. Exactily on Twitter: “खबर बिहार के बेतिया से है, मंदिर में सोए हुए पुजारी का सिर काट कर बेरहम हत्या, सिर 2 किलो मीटर दूर मिला। कुछ समय पहले AIMIM के ५ MLA भी RJD में शामिल हुए थे। मुस्लिम जानते हैं की उन्होंने किस लिए वोट दिया है। हिंदू रोजगार, महंगाई और पेट्रोल का रोना रो रहा है। #Bihar #MGB” / TwitterAt the same time, many other users are posting this murder by linking it to the ‘Sar Tan Se Judha’ case.Fact Check:To investigate the communal and Muslim angle in this viral news, we did some keyword searches on Google. We got a report from etvbharat.com. It is mentioned in the report that the name of the killer of the priest is Akshay lal Kumar who is arrested by the police. He is a psycho person.]According to the SP, the criminal told that he found an angel with a white beard and cloth late at night and gave him a bag, and ordered that to behead the priest and should take its head to Goddess Kali and offer it to her.After which Psycho Akshay Lal entered the temple late at night and brutally murdered the sleeping priest after beheading he came out of the temple, then took a bath and went to the field and also sacrificed a ghost. After this, he, reached Kali temple 2 km away with the head of the priest and offered prayers at the temple.बेतिया में पुजारी का सिर धड़ से अलग करने वाले ने जो बताया उसे सुन पुलिस भी हैरान (etvbharat.com)Conclusion:It is clear from our fact check that there is no communal angle in the murder of a Hindu priest in Bettiah. The man who killed the priest is a psycho person named Akshaylal Kumar. Hence the claim of social media users is false.Claim- Muslim angle in killing of Hindu priest in Bettiah, BiharClaimant- Social media usersFact Check – Fake
label: truth

content: Is Tejashwi Yadav reneging on the promise of providing 10 lakh jobs?  Read Fact Check A 21-second video of Deputy Chief Minister of Bihar Tejashwi Yadav is going viral on social media sites.In the video, he can be heard saying that he will fulfill what his party promised and will provide 10 lakh jobs when he will become the Chief Minister, as of now he is the Deputy Chief Minister.A verified account of Shandilya Giriraj Singh, MP Begusurai posted this video rather sarcastically and writes, “We will fulfill what we promised to provide 10 lakh jobs when we become the Chief Minister, now we are the Deputy Chief Minister. (Along with a laughing Emoji) (English Translation)10 लाख रोजगार देने का जो हमने वादा किया था वह हम मुख्यमंत्री बनने पर पूरा करेंगे अभी तो हम उपमुख्यमंत्री हैं।😂 pic.twitter.com/X8pbjhxmdH — Shandilya Giriraj Singh (मोदी का परिवार) (@girirajsinghbjp) August 11, 2022Fact Check:To investigate the viral video, the DFRAC desk started searching for the interview telecasted on Zee News and found the full video on its YouTube channel under the caption, “Tejashwi Yadav Exclusive Interview Live.”In the interview, he can be seen saying, “We had promised 10 lakh jobs when I became the chief minister. Right now I am a Deputy Chief Minister But Chief Minister @NitishKumar has discussed this with us and he is serious about this matter and he has given instructions.For further investigation, we scrolled through the comment section of Shandilya Giriraj Singh and found many people claiming the viral video was misleading and uploading the full interview instead.DFRAC desk found a Tweet of Tejaswhi Yadav in which he is denying the claims of Sahndilya as he writes, “Sir, don’t be so shameless. One does not become knowledgeable by having a one-foot-long ponytail as you do. This is the plight of the f BJP only because of these chirpy antics, edited video, and road raid statements of you people. These poor people have no face in Bihar. Enjoy listening to the rest of this video.”(English Translation)श्रीमान जी, इतना बेशर्म मत बनिए। एक फुट लंबी चोटी रखने से कोई ज्ञानी नहीं बन जाता, जैसे आप रखते है। आप लोगों की इन चिरकुट हरकतों, Edited Videos व सड़क छाप बयानों की बदौलत ही भाजपा की यह दुर्दशा है। इन बेचारों का बिहार में कोई चेहरा ही नहीं।बाक़ी इस पूरे Video को सुन ख़ुशी मनाइए https://t.co/AMqEgcG2JX pic.twitter.com/AOtubm91J7 — Tejashwi Yadav (@yadavtejashwi) August 11, 2022Conclusion:Cropped video of Tejaswhi Yadav is being shared with the misleading claim.Claim Review: Tejashwi Yadav promised to provide 10 Lakh jobs, once appointed as CM.Claimed by: @girirajsinghbjpFact Check: misleading
label: rumor

content: Fact check: Nitish Kumar had said – I will get into the soil but a settlement with RJD is not possible?  In Bihar, Nitish Kumar has split up the alliance with THE BJP and joined the grand alliance of RJD and Congress. He took oath as the Chief Minister of Bihar for the eighth time. Earlier, Nitish Kumar broke the grand alliance of RJD and Congress in 2017 and formed an alliance with BJP and formed the government.Meanwhile, a video of Nitish Kumar is going viral on social media. Users who shared this video are criticizing Nitish Kumar saying that “Nitish broke the alliance of RJD and Congress in 2017 and said that I will get into the soil but will not go with RJD”.Sharing this video, a verified user named Puneet Agarwal wrote – “Stay or get into the soil, no agreement with RJD is possible now in the future – @NitishKumar” On checking Puneet’s account, we found that he has written himself as the IT head of BJP Delhi.While sharing this video, BJP leader and former MP Hari Manjhi wrote – “Mit jayenge mitti mein mil jayenge but the question of returning does not arise” Paltu Kumar-Kursi Kumar alias Nitish Kumar had said.At the same time, this video is shared by lot of users.Fact check:To check the verification of the viral video, we searched the keyword “will be found in the soil” on Google. During this time, we received a report published on the website of the newspaper Dainik Jagran on February 18, 2014. The report was titled “Mitti mein mil jayenge par BJP se nahi milenge: Nitish”.This report has mentioned that “Nitish Kumar has denied rejoining the BJP in the assembly and said that ‘he will get into the soil but will not compromise with the BJP.’ It is impossible, this chapter is now closed. ”At the same time, to check the verification of the video, we saw the archive of the assembly proceedings on https://webcast.gov.in . In February 2014. We found a link to the live webcast of the Bihar Assembly proceedings of February 18, 2014 https://webcast.gov.in/events/MjM-/session/NTc- https://webcast.gov.in/events/MjM-/session/NTc-In the duration of this live webcast from 01:20 minutes to 01:21 minutes, the part of Nitish Kumar’s viral video can be heard. Here you can hear That Nitish Kumar was speaking about breaking the alliance with BJP and not aligning with it again.Conclusion:Our fact check shows that the claim being made about Nitish Kumar is misleading. Nitish Kumar’s statement of getting into the soil was not on the RJD-Congress but in the Bihar Assembly after breaking the alliance with the BJP.Claim:Nitish kumar mentioned- Will get soil but won’t go with RJD.Claimed:Social media user.Fact check:Misleading.
label: truth

content: Fact check : Know the truth about the entrance of a train full of Bangladeshis and Rohingyas in Bihar After the split up of the alliance of BJP and JDU in Bihar, once again the grand alliance government has been formed. In which Nitish Kumar has become the Chief Minister and Tejashwi Yadav has become the Deputy Chief Minister.Meanwhile, a video is going viral on social media. A train full of crowds can be seen in the video. It was claimed that this train is full of Bangladeshis and Rohingyas.The user wrote in his tweet -“#BiharPoliticalcrisis after Lalu Prasad Yadav and #नीतीश Kumar joined hands together, happy Bangladeshis and Rohingyas coming to Bihar. #MuradMerali #AnjanaOmKashyap #BiharPolitics #TejasviYadav #JDU_RJD #palturam #बिहार #पलटूरामFact check:To check the viral video, we first converted the video into a keyframe with the help of the InVID tool and then did a reverse search image. During this ,we found one such video on YouTube.The video was uploaded on May 1 on a Bangladesh-based channel called BD Train Express. Giving information about the train seen in the video, it was said that this train was 47 Up Dewanganj. Also, the place was said to be Balashpur overpass Mayman singh.fApart from this, we also received a report from Dail Mail . In which we found screenshots of the video. The report mentioned, thousands of people travelled in Front, side and roof of the train to celebrate Eid in Bangladesh.Conclusion:Viral video is misleading.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Delhi Tourism Department made false claim on Jama Masjid It has been widely accepted in the general Public that Delhi’s Jama Masjid is the largest mosque in India. Located just 500 meters away from the Red Fort, the construction of Jama Masjid was started by Shah Jahan in the year 1650 with red stones and marble and at that time it took 6 years and 10 lakh rupees to build it.At the DTC bus stop in the national capital Delhi, you will see hoardings claiming that Delhi’s Jama Masjid is the largest mosque in India.DTC Bus Stop / Photo ~ Shekhar KumarDargah Hazrat Nizamuddinؒ bus stop has hoardings with beautiful pictures of Qutub Minar, Akshardham, Parliament and others, including Jama Masjid. The hoarding reads,”Do you know? Jama Masjid is the largest mosque in India”.Dargah Hazrat Nizamuddinؒ Bus Stop / Photo ~ Shekhar KumarAccording to the website of Alamy, hoardings describing Jama Masjid as India’s largest mosque are installed at Laxmi Nagar bus stop.Similarly, the website of the Delhi Tourism Department has also claimed about Jama Masjid that Delhi’s Jama Masjid is the largest mosque in India.Delhi Tourism DepartmentFact Check:To find out about Delhi’s Jama Masjid, we searched with the help of certain “keywords” to see if it was the most largest mosque in India. Is there any bigger mosque than Jama Masjid? We found a post on Facebook by historian Sohail Hashmi quoting this. “Dear Delhi government, Jama Masjid is not the largest mosque in India. Bhopal’s Taj-ul-Masjid is 33 per cent bigger.”After Sohail Hashmi’s Facebook post, other media houses including Punjab Kesari, Zee Salaam, Nav Bharat Times and Prabhat Khabar have published reports on this.DFRACPunjab Kesari has said in its report that the Taj-ul-Masjid in Bhopal, the capital of Madhya Pradesh, was built between 1868-1901 by Shahjahan Begum, the third woman ruler of Bhopal. Taj-ul-Masjid means ‘Taj of mosques’.The report further pointed out that Hasan Khan, professor of Darul Uloom of Taj-ul-Masjid, also agrees with Hashmi. “Taj-ul-Masjid is actually the largest mosque in India which is one-third times bigger than Jama Masjid. In fact, in my personal opinion, it is the largest mosque in the world in terms of ‘cover area’. However, combining both the open area and the covered area, Lahore’s Badshahi Mosque built by Aurangzeb is the largest. ”According to Punjab Kesari, no verified dimension is easily available, but many websites like ‘Culture Trip’ and ‘Hello Travel’ claim that the Taj-ul-Masjid has a seating capacity of 1,75,000 people, while according to Britannica.com, the courtyard of Jama Masjid (Sehn) can seat only 25,000 people.It is known that on searching – “Jama Masjid, Delhi” on Google, it is revealed that Jama Masjid is one of the grandest and largest mosques in India.Conclusion:It is clear from this fact check of DFRAC that the hoardings at the bus stop in Delhi and the claim of the website of the Delhi Tourism Department that Delhi’s Jama Masjid is the largest mosque in India are misleading because in reality India’s largest mosque is The Taj-ul-Masajid of Bhopal.Claim: Delhi’s Jama Masjid is india’s largest mosqueClaimed : Delhi Tourism Department, hoardings at bus stops and othersFact Check: Misleading
label: truth

content: Are 61,395 Muslim names written on India Gate? – Read the Fact Check There is a claim on the internet in which people are comparing the participation of Hindus and Muslim communities in India’s freedom struggle. Social media users are claiming that there are 95300 freedom fighters’ names written on India Gate, Delhi out of that 61945 are Muslim names which means 65% of freedom fighters were Muslims. Along with the picture a social media user wrote, “The whole Nation is indebted of #MuslimFreedomFighters if do like it Or dont.”Moreover, there are also several reports on the internet claiming the same.Fact CheckIn the DFRAC analysis, it was found that there are many misleading and untrue facts in the viral image. We have factcheked each claim separately below.False Claim 1:There is a quote written in the viral image that “Indian Freedom struggle is written with Muslim blood.” And, the writer’s name is written Jaswant Singh.FactCheckOn keyword search, the DFRAC desk found that the writer of this line is the famous journalist and writer Khushwant Singh not Jaswant Singh.False Claim 2There are 95300 Muslim freedom fighters’ names written on India Gate, Delhi out of that 61945 are MuslimFact CheckAccording to Commonwealth war graves commission , there are 13220 names are written on India Gate in the memory of soldiers who died in World War 1 and the third Anglo-Afghan war fighting for the British.Hence, the claim that 61945 Muslim freedom fighter names are engraved in the India Gate war memorial is false.Moreover, DFRAC analysis found that this is not the first time this claim got viral. In 2019 also such posts got viral widely on social media.False Claim 3There were zero names of Sanghi from RSS on India Gate.Fact CheckRashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS), was formed by Keshav Baliram Hedgewar in 1925.And World War 1 took place between 1914-18 and the third Anglo Afghan war in 1919.The names written on India Gate was in the memory of the soldier died in WW1 and third Anglo Afghan war. At that time the organization have not even existed. Therefore, claiming the no names from RSS is written then is misleading.
label: truth

content: The real story behind the claim of Muslim population explosion and having many wives- Read the FactCheck After the trailer of the movie, hum do hamare barah, Muslims are being mocked for having lot of kids and many wives all over social media. Sharing a clip of AajTak social media user wrote, “#HumDoHamareBaarah, #HumDoHamareBarah is based on true events.” In the clip, Achor Sweta Singh is telling the story of Rafique Mia having 2 wives and 19 children.https://twitter.com/socialgreek1/status/1556591332361060352Meanwhile, another user wrote, “Odd day: Islam is fastest growing religion, go cry Even day: How can you show Muslim family with many kids, we cry” with #HumDoHamareBaarah hashtag.Odd day: Islam is fastest growing religion, go cryEven day: How can you show Muslim family with many kids, we cry#HumDoHamareBarah — S̶c̶a̶r̶ (@4racs) August 8, 2022Similarly, another user Tweeted, “Muslim population jihad. In the fifties and sixties, Muslims outnumbered Buddhists, Orthodox Christians and Shinto. By 1970–2000, the number of Muslims outnumbered Protestants, Hindus and Catholics. Now the population of Muslims will exceed that of the entire Christian sect.”There are many similar tweets on social media accusing Muslims on population jihad and claiming that soon they will overtake Hindus population in few years.Fact CheckDFRAC team found that there are many misconceptions and misleading news spread about Muslim community and their population growth. We have fact-checked these claims below.Muslims have too many kids and will overtake the Hindu population in a few years.According to a report of siasat and data of the Nation Family Health Survey, the maximum decline in Total fertility rate(TFR), from NFHS1(1992-93) to NFHS5(2019-21) is of Muslims i.e -46.5 %.TFR is the average number of children, a woman gives birth over her lifetime. In view of Muslim, it declined the most i.e from 4.4 children per woman in 1992-93 to 2.3 children in 2019-21.If the TFR is 2.1 then it is called replacement rate. This means in order replace themselves, the number of children that a couple should have. In simple term, if the TFR will be 2.1 then there will be no significant change in the population There has been a sharp decline the TFR of all communities and TFR of Muslim population is also near the replacement rate.Muslim Men have more than one wife.According to the recent NFHS data and a report of TOI, polygyny among Muslims is 1.9%, among Hindus it is 1.3%, and 1.6% among other religious groups. The highest percentage of Polygamy can be seen among ST communities i.e 2.4 %. The data also shows that polygamy is prevalent in backward area which lacks education and it’s not about Muslims only. Moreover, it is declining in every community and has nothing to do with religion.Therefore, the claim that Muslim Men have more than one wife is not correct as the percentage of such Muslim men is only 1.9%.ConclusionAccording of official data of NFHS and several surveys, having more kids is more prevalent in rural areas. Both rural families irrespective of the community used to have a lot of kids. Presently, the number of kids in both rural and urban of all communities including Muslims is declining sharply. Also, there is only a small percentage (1.9%) of Muslims have more than one wife. Over the years the percentage of polygamy has also declined among all communities. Therefore, according to this DFRAC factcheck analysis the claim that Muslim men have a lot of kids and wives is misleading.
label: truth

content: Fact check: Did Nitish Kumar mention terrorist Ishrat Jahan as her daughter? Bihar political climate is hot. only speculation is made about what Nitish Kumar will do. There are media and social media reports that Nitish Kumar can break the alliance with BJP and form the government again with Congress and RJD. At the same time many misleading claims have started going viral on social media regarding Nitish Kumar.It is being claimed on social media about Nitish Kumar that he called Ishrat Jahan, the alleged terrorist killed in a police encounter in Gujarat as his daughter. A user named Janardhan Mishra wrote “when Nitish Kumar Told Ishrat Jahan as her daughter then only BJP should understood that how big a bigoted secular he is.”नीतीश कुमार ने जब आतंकी इशरत जहां को अपनी बेटी बताया तभी भाजपा को समझ जाना चाहिए था की ये कितना बड़ावाला दोगला सेक्युलर है pic.twitter.com/nJq1bCJ50G — Janardan Mishra (@janardanmis) August 8, 2022Janardhan Mishra has also shared a graphical poster with his post. In which various claims have been made about Nitish Kumar. On the other hand, checking the profile of Janardhan Mishra, we found that he has put a picture of PM Narendra Modi in his profile and he has 183 thousand followers.Fact Check:To check the viral claim we did some keyword searches on google. We found the report of Navbharat Times published on 15 February 2016. In this report Nitish Kumar has denied that he never called Ishrat Jahan the daughter of Bihar.Nitish Kumar said I am going through some news clippings and records to know whether I have ever called Ishrat Jahan as the daughter of Bihar. After doing some search in this regard I will take legal actions against those newspapers and channels who put such things in my mouth and say such things. We will take necessary ground preparations and take legal actions against them.Conclusion :After checking the claim of the viral video, we got to know that the claim being made by social media user is false. Nitish Kumar had never mentioned Ishrat Jahan as his daughter.Claim : Nitish Kumar mentioned Ishrat Jahan as her daughter.Claimed by : Janardhan Mishra and social media user.Fact check : Fake.
label: rumor

content: Was the national anthem written in praise of the King of England? Read, fact-check Users are claiming that ‘Jana Gana Mana’ was written in praise of King George V of England. A user named Arun Kumar Gaur posted on Facebook with a picture of a book, “Everyone knows that the Indian national-song was virtually a eulogy anthem written by Rabindranath Tagore in praise of George V. The entire anthem is available in the book “Geet-Panchati” by Rabindranath Tagore published by The Delhi Sahitya Akademi, Delhi. The entire anthem is available in the book “Geet-Panchati” by Rabindranath Tagore which was published by The Delhi Sahitya Akademi, Delhi, and the original copy is presented for all of you to see. Which can be easily read by zooming. I have received this copy courtesy of Brother Krant M L Verma Ji. #GaurYoung”Rameshwar Basene Facebook has shared a letter written by senior BJP leader Subramanian Swamy, in which he has demanded the Prime Minister to change the national anthem. There are mainly three points of this post:On November 26, 1949,the Constituent Assembly adopted the national anthem “Jana-Gana-Mana” without any voting.Swami supported subhash chandra boss ji’s suggestion and without tampering with its tune, 95% of the words should be kept the same, only 5% of the words should be changed which was written in honor of British King George V. From time to time, voices have been raised against the so-called national anthem| One of them was Rajiv Dixit who put the truth of the so-called national anthem in front of the country.Tagore received the Nobel Prize for writing the national anthem praising the British, which was given in the name of Gitanjali.Rajiv Dixit’s speech on YouTube channel Technical Ayurveda has been uploaded on June 4, 2019. This YouTube channel has about four and a half million subscribers.Similarly,there are other social media users who have posted with similar claims.Fact check:To investigate this claim, we did a simple search on Google. We got many reports on this. According to The Lallontop‘s report Rabindranath Tagore wrote the first draft of “Jana Gana Mana” in Santiniketan in 1908.According to thecrediblehistory.com run by historian and author Ashok Kumar Pandey, the controversy over the national anthem “Jana Gana Mana” is almost as old as it is. It was sung before the second day’s work began at the Congress session in Calcutta on December 27,1911.Why did this controversy started?According to thecrediblehistory.com, to understand this, it is necessary to look at the political situation at that time. George V became the new British monarch and in December he travelled to India. Delhi was made the capital instead of Calcutta. Also, the decision to divide Bengal was withdrawn. In such a situation, the second session of the Congress session of Calcutta The day was scheduled to welcome the visit of the British Monarch as a courtesy. It is known that till that time the Congress had not demanded the independence of the country.The controversy over the national anthem was caused by the English media reporting, without understanding, that Tagore had written a song in praise of George V.The reason for this may also be the singing of a song dedicated to George V by Ramanuj Chaudhary soon after Jana-Gana-Mana at the same event.The report states that the basis of this allegation was the reports of the Anglo Indian English Press.For example, on December 28,the newspaper The Englishman reported that the convention began with the singing of a song specially composed by Rabindranath Tagore to honour the emperor.Going a step further, The Statesman Bengali poet Rabindranath Tagore sang a song sung by him to welcome the emperor. Such misleading reports used to be published in the pro-British Anglo-Indian press about the events in India. thecrediblehistory.com has quoted an article in Scroll as saying that The Sunday Times has given Rabindranath the creator of Vande Mataram and Jana Gana Mana called a hindi song.According to the BBC report, this was clearly published in ‘Amrit Bazar Patrika’ the next day. The magazine said the day began with a prayer composed by Gurudev Rabindranath Tagore at the Congress congregation.According to thecrediblehistory.com,the newspaper The Bengalee had published an accurate report on this: “The annual session of the Congress began with a song composed by the great Bengali poet Rabindranath Tagore.Then a resolution was passed expressing credibility to the emperor. Then a troupe of children sang a song expressing reverence to Emperor George V. ”Since then, there has been a controversy over the national anthem whether Tagore wrote the song in praise of the British.There was a demand that “Bharat BhagyaVIDHATA” should be removed from the national anthem because ‘Bharat Bhagya Vidhata’ he has said in praise of George V. However, according to the BBC Hindi report, Tagore made it clear in 1912 that ‘Bharat Bhagya Vidhata’ can have only two meanings: the people of the country, or the almighty upper one — whether he is called God, whetherdev. Tagore wrote a letter in 1939, “I would consider it my insult to answer those who brought me to this stupidity.thecrediblehistory.com has written that Pulin Bihari Sen wrote a letter to Rabindranath in 1937, seeking to know if the song had any connection with George V. Replying to him, Taggar wrote, “That year the arrival of the Emperor of India was being organized. A friend of mine, who is reputed in the government, had made a special request for the emperor’s praise.Along with being awestruck, anger also arose in my mind. In response to that, I announced the victory of that Bharat Bhagya Vidhata in the song Jana Gana Mana, in the fall-abhyudaya-bandhuar-pannatha, the chirasathi of the travelers who have been running from age to age, who are the inner paths of the people. My royal friends also understood that those human destiny chariot drivers of ages could not be the fifth or sixth george under any circumstances. ”How Jana Gana Mana was vocalized:Irish poet James H. Cousins invited Tagore to Andhra Pradesh in 1918-19. Tagore sang Jana Gana at a gathering of students on February 28 on his request. It has been so much liked that Cousins’ wife Margaret later composed its tune. 1930 Tagore recited the song to the orphaned children of pioneers commune in Moscow during a visit to the Soviet Union.In 1937, Subhas Chandra Bose first proposed Jana Gana Mana as the national anthem. On July 5, 1943, the formation of the Azad Hind Fauj was announced and on the same day Jana Gana Mana was sung as the national anthem for the first time.So, this is how Jana Gana Mana was made, national anthem:No decision was taken about the national anthem at the time of independence in 1947. In those days, apart from Jana Gana Mana, “Vande Mataram” and “Saare Jahan Se Achcha” were honored as national songs. Soon after independence, the Indian delegation, which arrived there for a United Nations event, was requested for a national song. The delegation approached the Government of India and advised Jana Gana Mana, which the government accepted. Discussions about the national anthem continued in the country.In the opinion of experts, jana gana mana had the highest singing ability. Moreover, the notion of the country contained in Vande Mataram as a Hindu goddess was not acceptable to many Muslims. It was finally formally recognised as the national anthem in the Indian Constituent Assembly on January 24, 1950. At the same time, it was decided that Vande Mataram will also get the same dignity due to its special role in the freedom movement.Conclusion :अफवाह फैलाई जाती है कि जन गण मन अंग्रेजों की तारीफ़ में लिखा गया है?देखिए सच्चाईLink: https://t.co/0NuTysF420 — Ashok Kumar Pandey अशोक اشوک (@Ashok_Kashmir) August 7, 2022Rabindranath Tagore did not write the national anthem in praise of the King of England, but when requested to write to him by a friend, he got angry in response, and wrote the song Jana Gana Mana with the same mood. After The Jana Gana Mana at the Calcutta session of the Congress, Ramanuj Chowdhury sang a song dedicated to George V after jana gana mana, it was misleadingly publicized by the English media and Tagore opponents of that time.Claim: National anthem was written in praise of George vClaim user: Social media user and othersFact check : Fake and misleading
label: truth

content: Fact Check: did CM MK Stalin demolished Shiva temple? A video is becoming increasingly viral on social media. It can be seen in this video that a temple is being demolished by a bulldozer, while women and devotees standing nearby are crying over the temple being demolished. Users sharing this video are claiming that another temple was demolished by the DMK government of Tamil Nadu.Sharing this video, a user wrote – “Another temple has been demolished by DMK government in Kalapatti, Coimbatore in Tamil Nadu. The CM of TN, who is known as the “Kingdom of Temples”, who is himself a Christian, has demolished many such big and old temples in the state. Women are crying. They have nothing to do more than cry. See.”At the same time, this video has also been shared by many other users.तामिलनाडु में कोयम्बतूर के कालापट्टी में DMK सरकार द्वारा एक और मंदिर तोड़ दिया गया है।"मंदिरों का राज्य" कहलाने वाले TN के CM ने, जो कि खुद ईसाई हैं, राज्य के ऐसे कई बड़े और पुराने मंदिर ध्वस्त कर दिए हैं।औरतें रो रही है.रोने से अधिक करने के लिए कुछ नहीं है इनके पास।देखिए 👇 pic.twitter.com/WYw6qlFQIF — जय ज्वालामुखी (@Jwalamukhi1008) August 5, 2022 https://twitter.com/Jwalamukhi1008/status/1555531545443676161?s=20&t=LVmXkHt_apc2P5QykR_A-AFact Check:To check the veracity of the video going viral, we did some keyword searches on Google. We found a report published on the website of the English newspaper ‘The Hindu’. It was told in this report that the temple was demolished following the orders of the Madras High Court. The report also mentioned that the 50-feet wide Veeriyampalayam road was being blocked due to illegal occupation, following which the Madras High Court, based on a complaint from a local citizen, ordered the removal of the illegal occupation.At the same time, when we did a Google search about knowing the religion of Tamil Nadu CM MK Stalin, the fact came to the fore that Stalin considers himself an atheist.Conclusion:It is coming out from our fact check that the temple has been demolished after the High Court’s decision. Officials said that they are taking action on the order of the High Court. Hence the claim being made by social media users is misleading.Claim Review- Tamil Nadu Christian CM Stalin demolished Shiva templeClaimed by- Social media usersFact Check – Misleading
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Does Owaisi come under the top effective leader in Australian University? A picture is getting viral on social media sites on social media site. In the picture, the President of the All India Majlis-e-Ittehadul Muslimeen Asaduddin Owaisi can be seen and on the top of the picture there is written in capital letters “EFFECTIVE LEADERS”Many users are praising Owaisi while sharing the same picture on social media sites.A user on Twitter writes, “#AIMIM Chief Barrister @asadowaisi Has Been Spotted In Australian University’s Professional Presentation As a Top Best Effective Leaders. #proud #merasadar #meraguroor.”Another user writes, “Proud movement for indian parliment that one of a member has been selected as an effective leader ! V proud of u sir.”Proud movement for indian parliment that one of a member has been selected as a effective leader ! V proud of u sir https://t.co/QG7QRAg5bs — Syed Ifteqar Ahmed (@SyedIfteqarAhm2) January 17, 2020Fact Check:To investigate the above claim DFRAC desk searched on Google using specific keywords and found no news reports related to this in the mainstream media channels and sites.To continue the search DFRAC desk looked for the most effective leaders of the world and again found no mention of Owaisi in it.Conclusion:The picture is fake as there is no mention of Owaisi in any valid searches done by the desk.Claim Review: Owaisi come under the top effective leader in Australian University.Claimed by: social media users.Fact Check: Fake
label: truth

content: Fact check: Did RSS worker burn the Indian National flag?￼ A picture is going viral in social media. In which a person can seen burning the national flag of India. Taking the picture it was claimed that this person is an RSS worker.Originally tweeted by pankaj sharma (@pankaj3033) on August 6, 2022.Sharing this picture on Twitter, the user wrote the blood of the government does not open up after seeing such scene.FACT CHECK:Samayam TamilTo verify the claim,DFRAC did the reverse image search of the viral video. During this we found a similar picture in a report by a Tamil news portal. In which it was told that a teacher named Prabhupati fired up the flag in protest against not setting up the Cauvery Management Board and also made video about it.Conclusion:Therefore, burning of National flag by RSS worker is fake.CLAIM : RSS worker burn the Indian National Flag.CLAIMED BY: Social media user.Fact check: Fake.
label: truth

content: Morphed Image of some students wearing Muslim holy caps is getting viral – Read Fact Check An Image is getting viral n social media sites. In the image, some students can be seen wearing Muslim caps and holding a banner saying, “ISLAM MEANS PEACE” just behind the student holding banner the other student can be seen holding the neck of another student.Social media users are sharing this image of a Muslim boy beating the non-muslim boy sarcastically on the Internet.A user on Twitter writes, “#MuslimLivesMatter after successfully supporting sar tan se juda Now tranding Muslim lives matter. #ulla#MuslimLivesMatterafter successfully supporting sar tan se judaNow tranding muslim lives matter. #ulla pic.twitter.com/L5PiJzo5oy — Arun chetry (@ArunChe36091532) July 29, 2022Many more users shared the same image with different captions.Fact Check:DFRAC Desk to investigate saw the image closely noticed the blur holy caps.On further investigation, we reverse search the image on google and found a tweet related to this on Twitter with the caption, “Campaign.”The tweet is also one month old.Conclusion:The picture is morphed and is getting viral with a misleading claim on the internet.Claim Review: Muslim Boy was beating a non-Muslim boy.Claimed by: social media users.Fact Check: misleading
label: truth

content: Fact check: Jagdeep Dhankhar became the 14th vice president of India not the 16th One of the leading national newspaper of the country published a false news about Jagdeep Dhankhar victory in the presidential election. The article wrote that ”Jagdeep Dhankhar became the 16th vice president, defeating Margate Alwa by 346 votes.”Further it is written in news, Vice president election 2022 live updates:Former west Bengal minister “Jagdeep Dhankhar has became the 16th vice president of India.” The election commission has announced this .He defeated the opposition Margate Alwa by 346 votes.Fact check:The DFRAC visited the official website of vice president’s office to verify the claim of article. Where information received from the section of the former vice president revealed that 13 vice president were elected before Jagdeep Dhankhar. In which current president Venkaiah Naidu is also included.CONCLUSION:Therefore, the article’s claim of Jagdeep Dhankhar became the 16th vice president is fake. As he became the 14th vice president.
label: rumor

content: 1 Muslim was settled in the village by Hindus, now Muslims are dominating, Hindus migrated – Read the fact check A post is becoming viral on social media. Social media users are sharing this post by making 7 threads. In this post, users are claiming that in Kaila Bhatta village of Ghaziabad, earlier there were many families of Yadav caste of Hindu community. Then a Muslim family came there. Gradually the number of Muslims increased and Hindus decreased.Users claim that there was a time in the village when Hindu families, due to the harassment and bullying of Muslim boys, had to leave the village. Not a single Hindu family lives in that village. Users are sharing this post along with many other types of claims.https://twitter.com/Modified_Hindu 8/ status/ 1554876321863536640 ?s= 20 &t=OrwumX 4 Dd 0 DbDN 8 EsjweLgFact Check:To check the veracity of the viral post, we searched on Google about Kaila Bhatta village in Ghaziabad. We found a report published in Dainik Jagran. According to this report- “In the book of historian Vignesh Kumar, it has been written about the construction of other government buildings including Connaught Place from the soil of Kaila kiln. The Kaila Bhatta area of Ghaziabad was settled in the year 1740 during the Mughal period. In this, the land of Kaila village was 52,500 bighas, which extended up to Model Town. Apart from this, Makanpur was the only village in the entire Sahibabad. Residents of Kaila village say that kilns were built outside Kaila village to provide employment to the villagers and to settle in the city.It is also written about this village – “This village had become famous as Kaila Bhatta. The people of Kaila say that they got information about this from their older generations. Local residents say that as the population increased, the kilns coming in the way of development were demolished and their houses were built there. The kilns were built on the land near the Markaz mosque, which was owned by Mirza Saheb who hired Ibbu Khan to oversee Kaila. Later Ibbu Khan was called the owner of the Kaila Bhatta. Even today some members of Ibbu Khan’s family live in Ghaziabad.At the same time, DFRAC Team called up Advocate Mohsin Alvi, a resident of Kaila Bhatta village. Mohsin told that Hindu families still live in the village, which has many castes including Yadavs and Dalits. Therefore the claim on social media is false. On the other hand, former councilor of Kaila Bhatta, Farooq Sethi said that the claim on social media is wrong, as people of the Muslim community have been living here since the very beginning and when it comes to Yadav families, many Yadav families still live here.Conclusion:The claim on social media about Kaila Bhatta village is false. Because Hindu families still live in the village and there were Muslim families even when this village was settled by the Mughals.Claim– 1 Muslim was settled in the village by Hindus, now Muslims are dominating, Hindus migratedClaimed by– Social media usersFact Check – Fake
label: truth

content: Fact Check: ‘Vladimir Putin said – vacate the POK!’ Know the truth A post in the name of Russian President Vladimir Putin is becoming very viral on social media. In which he said that he has asked Pakistan to vacate Pakistan Occupied Kashmir (POK).The user wrote in his Facebook post that empty PoK, Pok is an integral part of India – #Vladimir_Putin_Russia means that something big is going to happen now.Along with this, the user, while answering the question of another user in the comment, said that Putin has given this statement yesterday.Fact Check: To check the above claim, DFRAC did some keyword searches on Google like Pakistan, Kashmir, Vladimir Putin. But there was no news from any media house regarding this.Continuing the investigation when we searched the Kremlin’s official website for press releases related to Pakistan and Kashmir. So there was no press release about this too. So that it can be proved that Putin made no such statement.Conclusion:Hence the viral claim is fake.Claim Review:Claim: ‘Vladimir Putin said – vacate POK, POK is an integral part of India!’Claimant: Facebook UserFact Check: Fake
label: truth

content: Amit Malviya shared a cropped video of Arvind Kejriwal mentioning 14th august. Read Fact Check BJP leader Amit Malviya shared a 16-second video of Delhi’s CM Arvind Kejriwal. In the video, Kejriwal can be heard mentioning that people shall sing the National Anthem by raising the flag on the eve of 14th august (One day before Independence Day).In response to this BJP leader writes on Twitter, “14th August? Arvind Kejriwal is sinister and evil. He is playing to a constituency, knowing fully well that India got its independence on 15th August. But we understand why those who supported ‘Jinnah Wali Azadi’ in Shaheen Bagh would want to celebrate it on 14th August.”14th August? Arvind Kejriwal is sinister and evil. He is playing to a constituency, knowing fully well that India got its independence on 15th August. But we understand why those who supported ‘Jinnah Wali Azadi’ in Shaheen Bagh would want to celebrate it on 14th August. pic.twitter.com/vTlueBUkpy — Amit Malviya (मोदी का परिवार) (@amitmalviya) August 5, 2022 Cropped VideoFact Check:To check the authenticity of the video, the DFRAC desk used specific key frames and found the full video on News 18 India In the entire video Kejriwal can be heard only speaking for India and no sentence of him is against it. In the video at 22 seconds, he clearly mentioned, “14th august an eve before our Independence Day”.Conclusion:The video is getting viral with a misleading claim that Kejriwal only mentioned 14th august to sing the national anthem by holding the flag, whereas, in reality, he mentioned the eve before our Independence Day i.e on 14th august we all shall gather together to sing the national anthem holding our National Flag.Also, a cropped video is shared rather than the real one.Claim Review: Kejriwal only mentioned 14th august to sing the national anthem by holding the flag.Claimed by: Amit MalviyaFact Check: Misleading
label: rumor

content: Fact Check:- Is Nitin Gadkari criticising PM Modi? A video of Nitin Gadkari is getting viral on social media sites.In the video during the interview Nitin can be heard criticising the PM.It is written on the video, for the first time in a press conference Gadkari openly protested against the PM. Why did Gadkari have to give a suggestion to Narendra Modi?Social media users are sharing this video with the claim that Nitin is criticising Modi government.A user on Twitter writes, “@yadavakhilesh BJP President Shiri Nitin Gadkari is raising many questions today PM modi should listen.Because everyone is coming to know that the country is being destroyed.”Many users shared the video with different captions, but similar claim.Fact Check:-To investigate the viral claim, DFRAC desk for used specific keyframe from Google.After searching, the DFRAC desk did a Google reverse image, and found this video on the YouTube channel of Bharatiya Janata Party uploaded on 16 Aug 2011.At that time Nitin Gadkari was national president of BJP and there was a Congress government so, Nitin Gadkari suggested the then Prime Minister Manmohan Singh to look at the statement given by Anna Hazare.Conclusion:As the video was upload in the year 2011, so it is clear that the video is 10 years old and is getting viral with a misleading claim.Claim Review: Nitin Gadkari criticising PM Modi.Claimed by: social media users.Fact Check: Misleading
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Did NSA Ajit Doval predict Yogi Adityanath to become the Prime Minster of India?￼ Fact Check: Did NSA Ajit Doval predict Yogi Adityanath to become the Prime Minster of India?A post is getting viral on social media by the account with the name of national security advisor, Ajit Doval. In which the CM of Uttar Pradesh, Yogi Adityanath is predicted to become the Prime Minister of India.SOURCE: FacebookA user shared the screenshot of Ajit Doval’s alleged tweet writing, “If Yogi Adtiyanath became the future PM of India then how many people would be happy? Jai Shree Ram”FACT CHECK:During the investigation of this claim, our team at DFRAC found its own fact check by which we got to know that there is no official account of Ajit Doval on social media. All tweets and Facebook posts in their name are fake.SOURCE: FacebookIn this regard, a warning was issued by the ministry of external affairs. Which reads, “Important Alert! Shri Ajit Kumar Doval K.C., National Security Advisor has no official account on Facebook. This is to advise caution against impostor or fake accounts under his name.”SOURCE: TwitterOther than this, we got a tweet from spokesperson of Ministry of External Affairs, Arindam Bagchi. In which it was written, “Important Alert! Shri Ajit Kumar Doval K.C., National Security Advisor has no official account on Twitter. This is to advise caution against impostor or fake accounts under his name.”.CONCLUSION:It clarifies from the fact check done on the name of NSA Ajit Doval on prediction of Yogi Adityanath becoming PM of India is fake.Claim: NSA Ajit Doval’s prediction of Yogi Aditynath becoming Prime Minister of India.Claim by: Facebook userFact Check: Fake
label: truth

content: The reality of Naqvi’s claim that 36% of Mudra Yojana & 33% of PM-KISAN funds went to Muslims- Read the Fact Check While addressing a question asked by Rahul Kanwal in India Today Conclave, Former Union Minister of Minority Affairs, Mukhtar Abbas Naqvi said that around 33% of beneficiaries under PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi, and 36% under Mudra Yojana, have been Muslims.”Naqvi was talking about how PM Modi’s schemes have benefited the Muslim community by quoting some numbers from a survey that he said was recently conducted. At 26:40 mins of the above video, he can be heard saying, “33% of Muslims benefited from the PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi Yojna, likewise 36 Cr people were benefited by MUDRA Yojana in which 36% were Muslims.Meanwhile, Author Anand Ranganathan tweeted a thread. In which he praised the work of the Modi government, especially in the context of Muslim minorities. Sharing a clip of Naqvi’s statement, he wrote, “Here is Minister @naqvimukhtar admitting, that while our Muslim population is 14.2%, as many as 31.3% of homes under Awas Yojana, 33% of funds under Kisan Samman Nidhi, and 36% beneficiaries under Mudra Yojana, have been Muslims. BUT MODI IS ANTI-MUSLIM.”Here is Minister @naqvimukhtar admitting, that while our Muslim population is 14.2%, as many as 31.3% of homes under Awas Yojana, 33% of funds under Kisan Samman Nidhi, and 36% beneficiaries under Mudra Yojana, have been Muslims.BUT MODI IS ANTI-MUSLIM. pic.twitter.com/1UX4KndClR — Anand Ranganathan (@ARanganathan72) July 5, 2022Fact CheckIn the answers to the Lok Sabha unstarred Question No. 2364, allocation under PMMY, it is mentioned that Community/Religion-based data under PMMY is not centrally maintained.allcoation under PMMYSimilarly, in the answers to the Lok Sabha unstarred Question No. 2671, PM KISAN beneficiaries, it is mentioned that the Religion of the beneficiaries is not captured in the scheme database. In these documents, it is clearly mentioned that there is no religion-based data for both the scheme which is maintained centrally.PM-KISAN BeneficiariesMoreover, Asaduddin Owaisi have shared Sharing these two pictures with the caption, “Modi sarkar’s lies were caught again. I asked govt for the number of Muslim beneficiaries of Mudra Yojana & PM-KISAN. @naqvimukhtar said that 36% of Mudra Yojana’s funds & 33% of PM-KISAN funds went to minorities. But govt says it has no such data. Kiska saath, kaisa vikas?!”Modi sarkar’s lies caught again. I asked govt for the number of Muslim beneficiaries of Mudra Yojana & PM-KISAN. @naqvimukhtar said that 36% of Mudra Yojana’s funds & 33% of PM-KISAN funds went to minorities. But govt says it has no such data. Kiska saath, kaisa vikas?! pic.twitter.com/LQbpDuJwBG — Asaduddin Owaisi (@asadowaisi) August 3, 2022Also Read: Did 5G spectrum auctions suffer a record loss of Rs. 2.8 lakh Cr?ConclusionNaqvi in the interview also doesn’t give the source of the survey from which he was quoting those numbers. And, there is no record maintained by the center of the numbers quoted by Naqvi about Muslim Beneficiaries of PMMY and PM- KISAN. As such data are not maintained on the basis of religion, the claim of Naqvi is deceptive.
label: rumor

content: Did 5G spectrum auctions suffer a record loss of Rs. 2.8 lakh Cr?- Read the FactCheck A snap of The Times of India is going viral on the internet. There is an article in the newspaper cutting with the title “5G spectrum auctions suffer a record loss of Rs. 2.8 lakh Cr. And, above it Rs. 280000000000000 is written in bigger fonts.Viral imageMeanwhile, a social media user A S K BAALAMURUGA, shared the newspaper cutting with the claim, “₹28,00,00,00,00,00,00,00,00,000 Scam by BJP! Biggest scam in the Indian history! #5G_Scam_Bjp.”Similarly, many other users have shared this claim on their social media handlesFact CheckOn reverse image search, we found a tweet from the verified account of the National editor of Times of India, Pankaj Doval. In the tweet, he shared a picture of a newspaper cutting of TOI with the caption, “That’s how the Business Page looks like when you start the day with record spectrum auctions, and end the day with record auto sales…That’s how the Business Page looks like when you start the day with record spectrum auctions, and end the day with record auto sales… pic.twitter.com/R9Qee59Zfi — Pankaj Doval (@pankajdoval) August 2, 2022From his tweet it is clear that the viral newspaper cutting is fake.Real and captionConclusionFrom this DFRAC fact check it is clear that the claim of the social media users is fake.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Fazil’s murder has nothing to do with the Shia-Sunni conflict. Know the real story. Social media users claimed that the brutal murder of Muhammad Fazil of Mangaluru of Karnataka was due to a love affair with a Shia girl. Because he was a Sunni Muslim.The right-wing website OP India, in its report regarding the massacre, made a sensational claim that preliminary investigations led by the police revealed that the deceased was killed because he was in love with a Shia woman while Mohammad Fazil was a Sunni. The miscreants killed the deceased after coming in a car near the clothes shop owned by him and fled from the spot after the murder.Meanwhile, a report targeting NDTV claimed that the suspected Shia-Sunni love affair was overlooked in NDTV’s video report on the murder of Mohammad Fazil. It was claimed that “NDTV reporting the incident suggested that the suspects may be Hindus and indicated that Mohammad Fazil was killed in retaliation after Islamists killed BJP Yuva Morcha member Pravin Netaru on July 27. NDTV, which established itself by using and selling tapes and equipment stolen from Doordarshan, ignores the suspected Shia Sunni love affair and targets members of the Hindu outfit.”Source: Deccan HeraldA similar claim was made by the Deccan Herald in a report and wrote that preliminary investigation suggests that Fazil was killed because he was in love with a girl from the Shia community. Police sources said that Mohammad is a Sunni Muslim.Source: News TrackThis news was widely shared on social media. Seeing this, many media houses shared this Shia-Sunni color without any investigation.Fact Check:Source: The Indian ExpressDuring the investigation of the above claim, DFRAC team found a report The Indian Express. In which it was told that the police has arrested Suhas Shetty (29) of killing Fazil , Mohan Singh alias Nepali Mohan (26) , Giridhar (23) , Abhishek (25) and Srinivas Katipalla (23) and Dixit Katipalla (21) in the matter.Police Commissioner Sasikumar said, “ Our investigation has revealed that Mohammad Fazil was specifically targeted. They kept an eye on his house, identified him and then targeted him. It was not a case of mistaken identity . ,#Mangaluru police arrest six persons in connection with Mohammed Fazil murder case. #Fazil was killed two days after #BJPYuvaMorcha worker #PraveenNettaru was murdered in #DakshinaKannada. Suhas, Mohan, Giridhar, Abhishek, Srinivas & Deekshit have been held for murder.#Karnataka pic.twitter.com/b9sqTPhQmm — Hate Detector 🔍 (@HateDetectors) August 2, 2022He further said , the group first made a ” pledge to kill someone ” on the evening of 26 July (the same day that Netaru was killed) and started discussing it over the phone. They later met and discussed, and after that a murder was committed. We cannot say whether it (murder) was linked to any other offense. Once we investigate his custody, all the details will come out.”Conclusion:Therefore, the claim that Muhammad Fazil was murdered for having a love affair with a Shia girl .
label: truth

content: Arvind Kejriwal was congratulated for installing mugs in the open toilet. Read Fact Check A poster of Delhi CM Arvind Kejriwal is going viral on social media. Users sharing this viral poster are making fun of Kejriwal. Actually, in this poster, the name of CM Kejriwal and development work has been written in the text to congratulate the development works of the Delhi government and installing mugs in the open toilet.Sharing this poster on Twitter, a user named Kangana Ranaut wrote – “When will this person improve.”https://twitter.com/KanganaR_/status/1552165483880689664?s=20&t=B7jt7shsxTlWlIz9X0DYdgFact Check:To check this graphical poster going viral, we did a reverse image search. During this we found that this poster has already gone viral with a misleading claim. The photoshopped poster was shared from the verified accounts of several BJP leaders. The text on this poster was – “Congratulations! The speed ​​breaker was constructed near Sagarpur Sabzimandi.Several leaders including BJP leaders Gaurav Bhatia, Charu Pragya and Major Surendra Punia had shared this photoshopped poster.At the same time, the truth of this poster is that this poster was put on the repair work of a road. For repair work of road.Is he a CM or what?Only advertisement no work pic.twitter.com/GcgkBKdGrL — Prateek som (@Prateeksom2) November 8, 2020At the same time, the correct poster can also be seen on the official YouTube channel of Aam Aadmi Party, which was uploaded on 6 November 2020. content: Did ‘Har Har Shambhu,’ singer Farmani Naaz adopt Hinduism? – Read Fact Check Farmani Naaz got the limelight after signing the Shiv Bhakti song ‘ Har-Har Shambhu’ and getting caught in the controversy related to it. At the same time, there is a discussion on social media regarding the conversion of her religion.A Twitter account named Farmani Naaz tweeted that- ” My ancestors were Hindu before, that’s why I sang the hymn ” Har Har Shambhu,” and will soon join Hinduism! ,Farmani Naaz viral TweetAt the same time, social media users are also claiming that Farmani Naaz is going to adopt Hinduism. Users are claiming she has said that her ancestors were Hindus, so she too will soon join Hinduism. While sharing her song, a user wrote-https://twitter.com/yogeshDharmSena/status/1554718068533649413At the same time, many other users have also made the same claimhttps://twitter.com/Akhiles32801135/status/1554714552817684481https://twitter.com/Bholana86984035/status/1554447021427159045https://twitter.com/IBitturaj/status/1554389582417838080?s=20&t=82bRK0jK3C1T9TLEia5AAwFact Check:To know the truth behind Farmani Naaz’s announcement of converting to Hinduism, we started investigating Farmani Naaz’s social media accounts. We checked her official verified Facebook account. We found a video here. In this video, Naaz is clarifying that people have made a fake claim by creating a fake ID on her Twitter. content: Did actor Sanjay Dutt convert to Muslim? – Read Fact Check A picture of famous Indian actor Sanjay Dutt is getting viral on social media sites where he can be seen wearing the holy cap of the Muslims with lots of food kept in front of him.The image of the actor is getting viral with the claim that Sanjay Dutt is breaking the fast after accepting Islam. content: Is the LPG Cylinder cheapest in India? Know the complete truth of Puri’s claim. India’s Union Minister for Housing & Urban Affairs & Minister for Petroleum and Natural Gas, Hardeep Singh Puri tweeted, “As a result of the ‘Citizen First’ policies of #ModiGovt the rise in the price of cooking gas in India is much lower than the global level. Cooking gas prices around the world have risen on account of increase in input cost. ”Further, he shared a table showing the LPG cylinder prices of different countries. In the picture, the prices of gas are in India, Pakistan, Sri Lanka, Nepal, Australia, the US, and Canada. It was written there that LPC prices in India continue to be among the lowest in the World.His tweet got viral with hundreds of retweets. Moreover, Zee news also hailed the claim in its show DNA.Fact CheckThe tweet of Puri gives rise to the question about the dimensions needed to be included to compare prices in different countries. Such comparisons have no relevance if the factors like purchasing capacity, per capita income, and inflation are taken into account. Our quest leads us to a YouTube video on the channel of NewsClickin which beautifully explains the parameters of measuring prices.Furthermore according to them India’s per capita monthly income is Rs. 15,152. While the cylinder price is Rs. 1,053. It implies that on average a person in India spends 7% of his monthly income to buy a cylinder. While in the US a person spends 0.19% of his monthly income to buy a cylinder. Similarly, a person in Australia and Canada spends 0.32% of his monthly income to buy a cylinder. India is still better than Pakistan and Nepal but it can hardly be called an achievement.Table1.The mean the cost of cylinder is heavier on the pocket of an average person in India. Let us understand this in simple language by taking an example of two friends A and B. They both live on rent and pay Rs. 10,000 as room rent. The monthly income of A is Rs. 20,000 and that of B is Rs. 1,00,000. The rent for A is 50% of his monthly salary while that for B is only 10%. As the income of A is very less than B, the burden of rent is ore on the pocket of A.ConclusionIf a commodity’s price is high in one country, is it justified that it should be high in another country? These types of comparisons are deceptive as it doesn’t take into account the purchasing capacity of a person from different countries. That is to say, Puri’s claim is misleading.
label: truth

content: Video of a mad lover with a knife in hand viral as “love jihadi”, read fact check A video is going viral on social media sites. By sharing this video, users are claiming that “Love Jihadi” is luring girls into their trap by intimidating them.A user named Yogi Yogesh Agarwal (Dharmsena) captioned, “Look at this! How love jihadis lure Hindu girls into their trap by intimidating them. If anyone threatens any child in this way, then there is no need to be afraid, immediately inform your family members and file a report to the police, then these people will not be able to succeed in their purpose.” and tweeted a video.In this video, it can be seen that a man with a knife in his hand is scarifying the girl and pressuring her for marriage, while the girl is seen hiding behind her friend.https://twitter.com/yogeshDharmSena/status/1552121377016057856At the same time, a user named Banty Rajput posted the same video on Facebook with the exact same caption.Similarly, the same video has been posted on other social media sites including Twitter and Facebook with a similar claim.Fact Check:Using the InVid tool, a reverse image search of some key frames of the viral video found the same video by the DFRAC team, from the Twitter handle of Nai Duniya, one of the leading newspapers in Madhya Pradesh, with the caption, “Indore Crime News: इंदौर में गर्दन उड़ाने की धमकी देकर शादी का दबाव बना रहा था सिरफिरा प्रेमी” (A girl was pressurized for marriage by a mad lover who was threatening with a knife to cut her neck in Indore, MP.) has been tweeted a video.Nayi Duniya has also published a report on July 26, 2022 which states that according to MIGTI Ajay Verma The name of the intimidator with the knife is Piyush alias Shanu son Bharat Kachhawa resident of LIG Colony. He is friends with a girl for three years and he was pressurizing her to get married because the girl had refused to marry Shanu, who runs a noodles shop. The girl refused to report to the police due to fear, although the police arrested Shanu and sent him to jail for possessing illegal weapons.Meanwhile, News18 has also covered it under the headline, ,“Indore: शादी के लिए चाक़ू की नोक पर युवती को धमकाया, सनकी आशिक गिरफ्तार” (Indore: Girl threatened at knife-point for marriage, and lover arrested.)Conclusion:This fact check of DFRAC makes it clear that there is no communal angle in the viral video, hence the sharing of the video by users as “love jihadi” is a misleading claim.Claim: How love jihadis trap Hindu girls by intimidating themClaimant: Yogi Yogesh Agarwal and other social media usersFact Check: Misleading
label: truth

content: FactCheck: Fake article on Joe Biden by the name of the Atlantic got viral A screengrab of a news article by the Atlantic is going viral on social media platforms. The heading of the article was “The quiet Courage of Biden’s Negative Growth Economy.” And, subheading was, “In an era of unchecked economic prosperity, one man had the moxie to pump the brakes to save us from ourselves.”Further, sharing the screengrab on his Twitter handle author, filmmaker, and host of the Dinesh D’Souza Podcast., Dinesh D’Souza wrote, ‘This is NOT a parody @TheAtlantic.”Similarly, Chairman of the Republican Party of Texas, Matt Rinaldi wrote, “The Atlantic: Causing poverty is stunning and brave.”Many other social media users have shared the screengrab with a similar claim.Fact CheckTo know the reality of the viral screengrab we first check the official website of the Atlantic with the related keywords but we did not find any article with the same heading.Moreover, the name of the author shown in the screengrab is Tim Nichols. We searched for him on the website but this time also we did not find any article by this author.Moreover, we also did keyword search the official Twitter account of The Atlantic(@TheAtlantic) but there is no such article present there.ConclusionTherefore, from this DFRAC fact check it is clear that there is no such article present on the site of the Atlantic. Hence, users are sharing a fake articleClaim: The quiet Courage of Biden’s Negative Growth Economy published by The AtlanticClaimed by: social media users.Fact check: Fake
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Will the tax be applied to Ganga Aarti and Pandits in Varanasi? A newspaper cutting is going viral on social media. On which it is written, “Ganga aarti and pandits will be charged.” Describing this paper cutting as recent on social media, users are claiming that tax has started on the worship of Hindus under the BJP government.A user on Facebook writes, “Tax will be imposed on the rituals of Hindus under the rule of the so-called great Hindu Hriday Samrat Shri Yogi Adityanath Ji and Shri Narendra Modi Ji….! Lawyers said it is unfair to charge pando #taxjeev.”(English Translation)Fact Check:To know the reality behind the viral claim, DFRAC reverse searched the image on Google. We found this paper cutting was shared by many users on Facebook and Twitter in the year 2020.A user on twitter writes, “@narendramodi @AmitShah @myogiadityanath @Dev_Fadnavis @OfficeofUT you all are seeing how wrong is happening It is not the fault of any Abdul when Shyam is bent on destroying his house. (English Translation)https://twitter.com/sanatanshastrii/status/1286526458987335680?s=20&t=EMOmQX_Z0ST2p1X2BaRCRAwe too found many news sites covering this report in the year 2020 like Hindustan times under the headline, “Varanasi Municipal Corporation will also charge fees from Ganga Aarti and Pandits.”(English Translation)Conclusion:The newspaper cutting going viral is of year 2020 and not from the recent year.Claim Review: tax to be applied to Ganga Aarti and Pandits in Varanasi.Claimed by: social media users.Fact Check: misleading

content: Did Ayyappa devotees chant for Allah at the Vavar mosque in Sabarimala? – Read the FactCheck A video is doing rounds on the internet with the claim that Ayyappa devotees are chanting Islamic prayers in the Vavar mosque in Sabarimala. Further, sharing the video a Twitter user Puncturewala wrote, “South India for you. These Ayyappa devotees are chanting praises for Allah at Vavar mosque in Sabarimala. The same Sabarimala where Sanghis tried to instigate riots in Kerala.”Similarly, another user gave the caption, “Culture and history is often messy. It is said that when the British first took religion and caste census many Indians did not know whether to call themselves Hindu or Muslim. Ayyappa devotees are chanting praises for Allah at Vavar mosque in Sabarimala.”Culture and history is often messy. It is said that when the British first took religion and caste census many Indians did not know whether to call themselves Hindu or Muslim.Ayyappa devotees are chanting praises for Allah at Vavar mosque in Sabarimala. pic.twitter.com/w7xS33bsNH — दिल्ली दूर नहीं (@DelhiIsNotFar) July 29, 2022Fact CheckUsing InVID tool and reverse image search on the different frames of the video we got the original video on the YouTube channel of SBR news1. The video was uploaded on Jul 24, 2019, with the title, “La ilaha illallah ayyappa swamula songs SBR news1.The man in the video is identified as Balaji swami. We found another video with the same song on the YouTube channel of N.balajiswami ayyappaswami bhajanalu. The title of the video was “Vavar swami song. Pedana Balaji swami songs. ayyappa swami devotional songs.”https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pOiQ9OVJUeAIn the description, it was written that this is a Vavar swami song. According to Wikipedia, Vavarswami is a legendary figure from Kerala. He is the celebrated Muslim acquaintance of the Hindu deity Ayappan. There is a shrine dedicated to Vavaraswami at Sabarimala, as well as Vavaraswami’s mosque at Erumely opposite an Ayyappan temple. This shows the religious and cultural harmony in India.Further, digging into the matter we found another video on YouTube with the title, “chalasani gardens ayyapaswami padi puja HD”Then, searching chalasani gardens on google, we got a picture of the hall on the site of chalasanigardens. Moreover, the address on site was written, “Mini Bypass Road, Vatluru, Eluru, Andhra Pradesh 534002, IndiaSimilarility between the background of viral video and the chalasani gardens can be seen below.ConclusionTherefore, the viral video is not of at Vavar mosque in Sabarimala but it is of chalasani gardens. Hence, users are sharing the video with misleading claims.
label: truth

content: Know the truth behind the picture of Raghav Chada asking for water for the rights of Delhi and Haryana- Read Fact Check A picture of Raghav Chadha, a Rajya Sabha member of the Aam Aadmi Party from Punjab is going viral on social media. In the viral image, he can be seen standing in front of a Mahatma Gandhi statue outside the Parliament House.He is holding banners in both of his hands. On one of the banners, Punjabi is written stating, ‘Allow Kejriwal to go Singapore.’On another, it is written, 'Delhi and Haryana should get equal water rights.’Social media users are sharing it with the claim that Raghav is asking for water rights for the people of Delhi and Haryana.A user on Facebook shared the image and wrote, “Is the Raj Sabha member of Punjab asking for justice for the interests of Punjab? Just look at the photo.”Fact Check:DFRAC reverse searched the Image and found the same image on the official Facebook account with the caption, ‘Keep the rights of farmers here!’The official Twitter account of AAP (Aam Admi Party) also debunked the fake news under the caption, ‘FAKE NEWS ALERT BJP Congress leaders posted a fake – photoshopped image of placards held up by AAP MP @raghav_chadha Legal Action will be initiated against fake news peddlers.’FAKE NEWS ALERT ‼️BJP Congress leaders posted a fake – photoshopped image of placards held up by AAP MP @raghav_chadhaLegal Action will be initiated against fake news peddlers pic.twitter.com/7Et42RzYZg — AAP Punjab (@AAPPunjab) July 23, 2022Conclusion:The edited picture is being circulated on social media sites.Claim Review: Raghav Chada asking for water for the rights of Delhi and Haryana.Claimed by: social media users.Fact Check: misleading
label: truth

content: Pakistani politician Shireen Mazari spreads misleading news against India- Read the Fact Check Former Pakistani Federal Minister for Human Rights, Shireen Mazari of PTI posted a screengrab of a news screen of Pakistani media channel SAMAA TV on her verified Twitter account. On the news plate, it was written in Urdu which can be nearly translated into English that Imran Khan’s win is India’s loss.Further, along with the picture she wrote, “One more agenda item of US regime change conspiracy will be undone when IK with the nation behind him wins elections. Will end move towards US subservience & signal failure of conspiracy & the local conspirators & will save Pakistan. No wonder US & India fear IK & his Absolutely Not!”Soon her tweet got viral with more then four thousand retweets and seven thousand likes. Similarly, many other PTI supporters have posted this news.FactCheckOn DFRAC fact check analysis, our team found that the article of India Today which was referred in the post is old. The article was of 23 July 2018.ConclusionTherefore, the claims of the post shared by Shireen Mazari and other PTI supporters is misleading.

content: Fact-Check- Video of the bridge collapse in Madhya Pradesh got viral as Bundelkhand Expressway￼ A video is going viral on social media sites. By sharing this video, users are claiming that the Bundelkhand Expressway, which was inaugurated by Prime Minister Narendra Modi a few days ago, collapsed within a few days. By sharing this video, people are slamming PM Modi and the Yogi government of UP.Further, sharing this video, a Facebook user named, Manoj Chaudhary Lankesh wrote- “The condition of Bundelkhand Expressway … just a few days ago, Prime Minister has inaugurated this expressway. , Fake man’s fake work!!”Similarly, many other users have shared the video targeting Modi and Yogi government.Fact Check:To know the reality of the viral video, we first did a reverse image search of some of the frames of the video. On searching, we found a video uploaded on the official YouTube channel of News- 24. According to this video of News-24, it is of the damaged bridge connecting Hoshangabad-Bhopal in Madhya Pradesh , when a part of the bridge collapsed in the very first rain. This bridge was built at a cost of crores.At the same time, many other media houses have covered the Bundelkhand Expressway. The Times of India has covered it and has not used a picture of a bridge in its report. According to the report, the Bundelkhand Expressway collapsed and got damaged at some places only after the first rain.According to the report of Dainik Bhaskar, Gawar Company of Rajasthan has constructed 296 km of Bundelkhand Expressway at a cost of 14800 crores. Due to the collapse of the expressway at 195 km, on Wednesday night, many vehicles were victims of the accident.
