Users are claiming that, in the 10-second viral video, PM Modi said that if my mother had stopped me on that day when I used to do small steals then today, I would not have become such a big robber. While sharing this video, a user wrote with a laughing emoji – “The truth does come out sometime..!!Similarly, many other users have also shared this video with similar captions.Fact Check:We fact-checked the viral video. We saw a word written in Bengali in the background of PM Modi’s video. After this, we started searching the video of PM Modi’s visits to Bengal. Meanwhile, we got a video on their YouTube channel of Narendra Modi.The title of the video is – “PM Modi addresses public meeting at Siliguri, West Bengal.”In this video, PM Modi was narrating the story of a robber, but indirectly targeting West Bengal CM Mamata Banerjee.At 39:06 minutes, he can be heard saying – “It is in Siliguri only a few days ago that Didi said that her Toll charges only Rs 100, 200, 500. What is the big deal? Tell me brother Didi is saying very comfortably that toll takes 100, 200, and 500 rupees. what does it have? Brothers and sisters… When we were young, we heard a story. In that story, a very big dacoit-robber was sentenced to death. As a last wish, he expressed his desire to meet his mother. After which the government made him meet his mother. When he met his mother, he cut off his mother’s nose. When people asked why you cut off your mother’s nose. Then he said- When I used to steal small things, if my mother had stopped me on that day, then today I would not have become such a big robber. ,Conclusion:Our fact check proves that the video going viral is from a year ago during the West Bengal assembly elections. During this, when PM Modi reached Siliguri to rally, he narrated the story of a robber-robber, targeting CM Mamata Banerjee. Which is being viral among social media users with the claim of misleading.Claim- PM Modi called himself a big robberClaimed by- social media usersFact Check – Misleading
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Picture of Akshay Kumar advertising online trading company goes viral A photo of Bollywood actor Akshay Kumar is going viral on social media. In this photo, Akshay Kumar is standing with a placard. Apparently, the actor is promoting / advertising an online trading company. Meanwhile, sharing this photo, social media users are fiercely criticizing him. One user wrote – “Shameless Akshay for few crores ”Similarly, many other users have also shared this photo.Fact Check:To find out the photo going viral, we did a reverse image search on Google. On searching, we found this picture on the official Twitter handle of the actor. He posted this photo on 9 April 2019. Further, in this photo, he is saying heartfelt thanks to Corona Warriors.Furthermore, he wrote- “Name : Akshay Kumar City : Mumbai Mere aur mere parivaar ki taraf se… Police, Nagar Nigam ke workers, doctors, nurses, NGOs, volunteers, government officials, vendors, building ke guards ko #DilSeThankYou”Actually, Akshay Kumar is heartily thanking the Corona Warriors for encouraging them. During the first wave of Corona, the Warriors had worked hard and contributed a lot in saving the country from this difficult situation.Conclusion:Therefore, the viral photo of the actor is fake. And, after editing his original picture, an advertisement of an online trading company has been inserted in it. Hence, the claim being made by social media users is fake.Claim- Akshay Kumar advertises online trading companyClaimed by- Social media usersFact Check: Fake
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Did Dubai King’s wife worship in the Tamil Nadu temple? Video goes viral A video is going viral on social media in which a woman is offering prayers in the temple. Social media users are claiming that this woman is the wife of the King of Dubai and she is worshiping without a burqa in a temple in Tamil Nadu.Further, sharing the video, a user named Chowkidar Ravichiruvolu wrote – “She is d wife of d King of Dubai supposed to be d head of Islam, on a business trip to Chennai n she visited Golden Temple in ShreePuram of TN No Burkha no abuse of Kaphirs. She wore thilak performed abhishekham to Goddess Lakshmi. Hear wht she is saying about visiting temples”Fact Check:On our investigation of the the viral video. Firstly, we visited the profile of user chowkidar Ravichiruvolu (@Ravichiruvolu1 ) who posted the video and checked his posts. Meanwhile, we got a reply from Hend FQ ( @LadyVelvet_HFQ ).In the reply, Hend FQ wrote – “ I am not the wife of the King of Dubai. The information shared is incorrect. I came back from India with wonderful memories & I remain true to my words shared that I was humbled by the generosity & kindness of the Indians shown onto me. I’m saddened with the current Islamophobia.”https://twitter.com/LadyVelvet_HFQ/status/1546859574694555650/Also Read: The truth of the letter that caused the hashtag #BoycottNothing And #DearNothing trend on the TwitterConclusion:Therefore, the woman in the video is not the wife of the King of Dubai. A verified Twitter user named HandFQ made it clear that he is in the video. Hence, the claim of the social media user is fake.Claim- The wife of the King of Dubai offered prayers in the templeClaimed by- chowkidar RavichiruvoluFact Check – Fake
label: rumor

content: The truth of the letter that caused the hashtag  #BoycottNothing And #DearNothing trend on the Twitter-Read the Fact Check Hashtags #BoycottNothing And #DearNothing are massively trending on Twitter. It has created a rage against the co-founder of One-Plus, Karl Pei among the South Indian peopl. This rage is against his new Mobile startup Nothing. Further, more the 8k tweets have been done till now using the hashtag #BoycottNothing.Further, a Twitter user shared a picture with the caption, “#BoycottNothing from South India #DearNothing.” In the image, it is written that “Dear Nothing At a time when entire India is going crazy about South Indian content, ‘Team Nothing’ has shown disrespect towards South languages. Plot, twists are here, ‘Nothing Phones’ is being manufactured in Tamil Nadu, they think India is all about the Hindi language, this kind of F*CKING behavior from the teamwork harmful for their long-term business.”At the same time, another user wrote,” #DearNothing we are also Indians @nothing You don’t encourage regional YouTube creators.”https://twitter.com/Saleem13296552/status/1546883424421494784Similarly, many people have tweeted using the above hashtag and showed their displeasure regarding nothing.Fact Check :On our analysis, we first looked for the reason behind the start of this hashtag. While doing so, we got a YouTube channel of Prasadtechintelugu. Tracking this channel on the internet, we got to know about a video uploaded by YouTuber named Prasad. This video led to the start of the hashtags #DearNothing and #BoycottNothing. Furthermore, the title of the video was Nothing Phone 1 Unboxing in Telugu?While unboxing the phone opened a letter. Inside the letter, the words are, “this device is not for South India People.” That letter caused the whole new hashtag trend on Twitter.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jryisIQht0k&t=24sBut, in the comment box of this video, the YouTuber himself has told that the letter at 0:24 was made just for presentation, it has nothing to do with the ‘Nothing Team’.ConclusionTherefore, this DFRAC fact check prove that the viral letter that caused displeasure on social media is fake. Because ‘Nothing’ has not sent any such letter. Hence, the hashtags #BoycottNothing and #DearNothing are not justified.Claim Review: Nothing sent a letter that it’s Devices is not for south Indian peopleClaimed by: Social Media usersFact Check: Misleading
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Edited photo of Babasaheb goes viral with misleading claim A photo is being shared on social media. It is seen in the post that the photo of Babasaheb Dr. Bhimrao Ambedkar and his wife is mounted on a bus. Social media users are claiming that this photo is on a city bus in Colombia, America. People are calling it a true tribute given by America to Babasaheb.Sharing this photo, a user wrote – ” Colombia (USA ) Of The picture of Baba Saheb on the city bus running on the roads is a real honor , America still considers Baba Saheb as its ideal because America’s economy is based on that book. Which Babasaheb wrote as a thesis for his doctorate degree during the British period.कोलंबिया(अमेरिका🇺🇸) की सड़को पर दौड़ती सिटी बस पर बाबा साहब का चित्र यह असली सम्मान है, अमेरिका आज भी बाबा साहब को अपना आदर्श मानता है क्योंकि अमेरिका की अर्थव्यवस्था उसी पुस्तक पर आधारित है। जिसे बाबा साहब ने ब्रिटिश काल में अपनी डाक्टर की डिग्री के लिए थीसिस के रूप मे लिखा था। pic.twitter.com/E9v06CvjQk — Jitendra Aske (@jitendraaske) September 19, 2020At the same time, a Facebook user also shared this post with a screen shot of this photo.Fact CheckWe did a reverse image search to fact-check the photo going viral. During this, we found the similar photo on the website of Wikimedia Commons. According to the description of this photo, it was published on 28 July 2008. This photo is of a city bus in Somerset, England. This photo was captured by a photographer named Adrian Pingstone.ConclusionOur fact check is proving that Babasaheb’s photo on the bus has been edited. His edited photo is being shared by social media users with a misleading claim.Claim- Babasaheb Ambedkar’s photo on the buses of Colombia (USA)Claimant- Social media usersFact Check – Fake
label: truth

content: ‘Aaj Tak’ made a misleading claim on the abdication of Emperor Ashoka after the Kalinga war ‘Aaj Tak’ news is going viral on social media. The news about Emperor Ashoka can be seen in this screen shot. In which it is written – “ Glorious History of Ashoka Pillar: Abandonment of Rajpat after Kalinga War in 273 BC ”. It is being claimed in this news that after the Kalinga war, Emperor Ashoka had abandoned the palace.Fact Check:We investigated this claim going viral. We first checked whether Aaj Tak really ran any such news? Our investigation revealed that Aaj Tak has run this news. The viral screenshot can be seen at 00:29 seconds in the video uploaded on Aaj Tak YouTube channel.On further investigation, we found a tweet by historian and writer Ashok Kumar Pandey. In which Ashok Kumar Pandey wrote – “ All limits of stupidity have been crossed and the anchor and his researchers are proving that even in class VIII they used to play Ludo sitting in the back seats. Emperor Ashoka ruled for some three decades after the Kalinga war. Pick up any book in the world and read it.मूर्खता की सारी सीमाएँ लांघ ली गई हैं और एंकर तथा उनके रीसर्चर यह साबित कर रहे हैं कि आठवीं की कक्षा में भी वे पिछली सीटों पर बैठकर लूडो खेला करते थे।कलिंग युद्ध के बाद सम्राट अशोक ने कोई तीन दशक राज्य किया। दुनिया की कोई भी किताब उठा के पढ़ लो pic.twitter.com/hVJluH8xTQ — Ashok Kumar Pandey अशोक اشوک (@Ashok_Kashmir) July 12, 2022For more information on this matter, we contacted Ashok Kumar Pandey. Ashok Kumar Pandey told that there is no need to fact check here, it is pure stupidity. He said that read any book in the world related to Ashok, you will get the right facts. If people had read even the eighth book, they would not have said such things. Taking forward his point, he wrote that even the makers of the film “Ashoka” did not do such stupidity.Conclusion:We can conclude from our fact check that the claim of ‘ Aaj Tak ‘ about Emperor Ashoka is misleading. Because according to historians, Emperor Ashoka ruled for three decades after the Kalinga War. After the Kalinga war, he did not leave the palace, but took a pledge never to engage in war activities and violence.Claim- Emperor Ashoka left the palace after the Kalinga warClaimant – Aaj TakFact Check – Misleading
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Is Pradhan Mantri Jan Kalyan’s department giving Rs 5000 to the vaccinated people? A piece of news is going viral on the internet that the Pradhan Mantri Jan Kalyan department is giving Rs 5000 to the people who are vaccinated. Further, Twitter user Arun Sharma shared a link on his handle. And, wrote the caption which can be nearly translated into English, “An important notice – those who got vaccinated Prime Minister’s Welfare department is giving Rs 5000 to them. If you have also got the corona vaccine Fill out the form now and get Rs 5000. Fill out the form from this link.”(“एक आवश्यक सूचना* – जिन्होंने वैक्सीन लगा लिया उन्हें 5000 रु प्रधानमंत्री जन कल्याण विभाग द्वारा दिया जा रहा है, आपने भी कोरोना का वैक्सीन लगा लिया है तो अभी फॉर्म भरें और 5000 रू प्राप्त करें इस लिंक से फॉर्म भरें”)Fact CheckWhile clicking on the link it first asks you for some details like the email id, total members of the family, and the name of the vaccine you took. Then, after that, it asks you the way through which you want the take your money. Further, in the end, it asks you to confirm and share this with your 5 WhatsApp contacts and groups.Since no government portal asks to share the link with your WhatsApp contact this site was not appearing to be genuine. Then, on keyword research also, we didn’t find any such news. Further, we checked on various government portals but there is no such official information.ConclusionTherefore, the link in the post is fake. And, there is no such announcement by the government.
label: rumor

content: Fact Check: Did BJP apologizes to Gandhi Family in the courtroom for putting false allegations on it? A screengrab of a tweet of Aaj Tak is going viral on the internet. Further, on the screengrab it is written, “CBI was not able to find single evidence against Gandhi Family, BJP apologised to Gandhi family in the court.”Further, sharing the screengrab Facebook user, Pitamber Mishra wrote the caption, “Truth may be disturbed but not defeated. After all!! He has to come, it will take some time..”(सत्य परेशान हो सकता है पर पराजित नहीं।आखिर !!उसे आना है जरा देर लगेगी।।)Similarly, many social media users have shared this screengrab on their social media handles.Also Read: Analysis of sponsored trends on Twitter after Supreme Court’s comment on Nupur SharmaFactcheckIn our factcheck analysis we checked the verified page of Aajtak to find the tweet. We did not find any such tweet. But, we found a post slamming these rumours. Furthermore, in the tweet it was written, “#FactCheck | The image of this fake tweet is being circulated in the name of Aaj Tak’s tweet.”ConclusionSince, Aajtak itself in a post, have clarified that the viral screengrab is fake. Therefore, there is no such news and the claims of the social media users are misleading.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: President Ram Nath Kovind’s 5-year-old statement viral with misleading claim A newspaper cutting is going viral on social media. In this cutting, a news of the statement of the President of India, Ram Nath Kovind has been published. The headline of the viral news cutting – ” President asked – why so few OBC, SC, ST and women judges ?” has given.Users sharing this post are questioning why the President was silent on all these matters for 5 years. Sharing this post, a user named Saurav Loyat wrote – ” Listen, now they remembered OBC, SC, ST and women, what did they do for 5 years? Just keep folding hands!” which translates in English.Fact Check:To investigate this news cutting going viral, we searched some keywords of the title on Google. During this we found a report published on the website of ‘ Dainik Bhaskar ‘ published 5 years ago. According to this report, the President had asked questions about SC, ST, OBC and women judges in the judiciary in 2017.News cutting going viral on us The Republic Press Posted on 26 Nov 2017 on a Facebook page called Found. According to this post, the viral cutting is from Dainik Jagran newspaper.Conclusion:Our fact check proves that the statement of President Ram Nath Kovind is from 2017. Therefore, the old statement of the President is being viral in a misleading manner by social media users.Claim- President Kovind raised questions on the shortage of OBC, SC, ST and women judgesClaimant- Social media usersFact Check – Misleading
label: truth

content: Did Hardik Pandya abuse Rohit Sharma in T20 match? Read the Fact Check India won the series after beating England by 2-1 in the T20I series. However, in the last match, India had to face defeat by the hands of England. At the same time, a 6 second video is going viral on social media. Users sharing this video are claiming that Hardik Pandya abused Captain Rohit Sharma during the T20 match.Social media users who made this video viral are fiercely criticizing Hardik Pandya and calling him arrogant. At the same time, many users are also running objectionable Twitter trends against Pandya on Twitter. Posting this video, a user wrote – “This incident of hardik pandya openly questioning & abusing Rohit Sharma shows that Even players don’t rate the new captain. #ShameonIndiancricket #HardikAbusedRohit”This incident of hardik pandya openly questioning & abusing Rohit Sharma shows that Even players don't rate the new captain.#ShameonIndiancricket #HardikAbusedRohit pic.twitter.com/dO4HeJIitx — Sharad yadav🇮🇳🇮🇳 (@SharadK85539031) July 10, 2022Moreover, many users shared this post with the same claim.Fact CheckTo check the veracity of the video going viral, we did a simple search on Google. During this we found a video uploaded on the YouTube channel of ‘Sports Tak’. Several panelists are sitting in this video, who were discussing the third T20 match between India and England to be held on 10th July. In the 25:00 to 26:33-minute portion of the video, an expert can be heard talking about the abuse.Experts say that Hardik Pandya is talking to Rohit Sharma regarding the issue of DRS. He is saying listen to me for DRS on my bowling, don’t listen to any XYZ. Experts also clarify that Pandya did not abuse Rohit Sharma.ConclusionOur fact check proves that Hardik Pandya did not abuse Rohit Sharma over the DRS controversy. Hence the claim being made by social media users is misleading.Claim– Hardik Pandya abused Rohit SharmaClaimed by– Social media usersFact Check – Fake
label: rumor

content: Fact Check: Picture of Rahul Gandhi with Dakota Johnson  again got viral. Know the reality. Every other day social media is filled with some news related to Rahul Gandhi. This time a social media user has shared a picture with the claim that Rajkumar of Gandhi’s family is on a foreign trip.Further, he gave a caption to the picture, “India’s economy is failing while the Rajkumar of Gandhi family is enjoying abroad. #Satire.”Fact CheckPeople may troll Rahul Gandhi on this image. But, in reality, the man in the picture with Dakota Johnson is not Rahul Gandhi. He is Dakota’s co-actor in the Fifty shades of grey movie series, Jamie Dornan. Moreover, we found the same picture on the website of Elle in an article of 7th September 2021.Further, it’s not the first time Rahul Gandhi’s Photo has gone viral with Dakota Johnson. Earlier also, social media users picked a picture of Jamie Dornan carrying Dakota Johnson in arms for their movie. And, trolled Rahul Gandhi.ConclusionThere may be a slight resemblance between the faces of Rahul Gandhi and the actor Jamie Dornan. But the viral picture is not of Rahul Gandhi. Therefore, some social media users are sharing the picture with fake claims.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Misleading claim of Atrocity Act on abusing Brahmins goes viral A post is being shared on social media. It is being claimed in this post that the Supreme Court has given a decision that now Atrocity Act will be applicable for saying abusive words against Brahmin society. Social media users are thanking Advocate Mukesh Bhatt for this, who filed the case in the Supreme Court.Sharing a screenshot, a user wrote- “A very happy news for all Brahmins. Many thanks to Advocate Mukesh Bhatt Ji. Supreme Court of India gave a big decision. The atrocity Act will now apply for abusing the Brahmin caste. Advocate Mukesh Bhatt ji filed a petition in the Supreme Court, which was recognized by the Supreme Court today. I congratulate Pandit Kanu Sharma (Advocate) on behalf of the entire Brahmin society.https://twitter.com/Arunbjp_/status/1529366405463670784?s=20&t=C_gkORy5yI1zvYIojGzG-wFact Check:To check this viral claim, we did a simple search on Google. But there was no news of any action being taken under the Atrocity Act on the use of abusive words against Brahmins. Since the users who made the claim posted on May 25. That’s why we went to the website of the Supreme Court and searched for the decisions given by the court. We did not find any such information there also.Thereafter, we contacted Supreme Court Advocate Siddharth Acharya. Siddharth Acharya told that no such decision has been given by the Supreme Court. He has termed such claims as misleading.Conclusion:Our fact check is proving that the viral claim is misleading. Because no such decision has been given by the Supreme Court.Claim Review- Atrocity Act will be imposed for abusing BrahminsClaimed by- Social media usersFact Check – Misleading
label: rumor

content: Fact Check: know the reality behind the viral pictures of the Landslides in Manipur’s Noni district. Two photos are going viral on social media about the landslide in Manipur. In the first photo, army personnel is seen on the road, while in the second many people are seen holding umbrellas.Social Media users are claiming that these pictures are of a landslide in Manipur’s Noni district, in which nearly seven army personnel died.A user on Facebook writes, “Sad and heart-wrenching accident Manipur – Army camp sunk in a landslide, 55 Army Jawans buried in mud debris, rescue operation continues, so far the bodies of 7 soldiers have been removed! God bless all the soldiers! A tearful tribute to the martyred soldiers! (Translates Hindi)Fact Check:We at DFRAC reverse searched the image on Google and found a report regarding this on the news website of FirstPost with the caption, “Nagaland: Eight Assam Rifles jawans killed, 6 injured in militant ambush.” Dated 4th May 2015.We found other report on Hindustan Times with the headline, “Assam Rifles soldier killed, 3 injured in IED blast in Manipur’s Ukhrul.” On 15th June 2017The second picture is from Manipur Landslides date 11th of July 2018 as per the report of India.comConclusion:The viral images have nothing to do with the landslide in Manipur’s Noni district. Both photos are old.Claim Review: the pictures are of a landslide in Manipur’s Noni district, in which nearly seven army personnel died.Claimed by: social media users.Fact Check: misleading
label: truth

content: In Bhagwant Mann’s wedding, Kejriwal was served langar sitting on the ground? Read Fact Check Punjab CM Bhagwant Mann is married to Dr Gurpreet Kaur. Many guests including Delhi CM Arvind Kejriwal attended Mann’s wedding. Many pictures of Bhagwant Mann’s wedding are becoming viral on social media. At the same time, a photo of Arvind Kejriwal is also going viral. It can be seen in this photo that Kejriwal is eating food while sitting on the ground.Users sharing this photo are claiming that at Mann’s wedding, Kejriwal was served langar by sitting on the ground. One user wrote- “Picture direct from Bhagwant Maan ji’s marriage”While sharing this photo, another user wrote – “Photo direct from Bhagwant Mann ji’s wedding….. CM of Delhi tasting langar at Punjab CM’s wedding”Fact Check:To check the veracity of the photo going viral, we did a reverse image search of the picture. During this, we found this picture posted on the Twitter handle of the Aam Aadmi Party. Aam Aadmi Party posted this picture on 3 April 2018. According to this post, Arvind Kejriwal had gone to the Bhandara organized by the employees of the Delhi Secretariat. During this, he ate langar sitting on the ground like a common man, bypassing the VIP culture.CM @ArvindKejriwal attends Bhandara organised by the Employees of Delhi Secretariat. AK is truly #JantaKaCM, He doesn't prefer any VIP treatment. pic.twitter.com/7Kvzr9chSN — AAP (@AamAadmiParty) April 3, 2018Conclusion:Our fact check is proving that the viral photo of Arvind Kejriwal is not of Bhagwant Mann’s wedding. This picture was of the Bhandara organized by the employees of Delhi Secretariat. Hence the claim being made by social media users is misleading.Claim Review- Langar served to Kejriwal at Bhagwant Mann’s weddingClaimed by- Social media usersFact Check – Misleading

content: Fact Check: Know the reality behind the viral video of a lady in a burqa getting hit by the car In the viral video, the girl in burqa is seen walking on the side of the road. But the car suddenly turns towards her and rams her. The girl is seen walking on the side of the road. A Santro car suddenly turns towards her and rams her. She is flung into the air after being hit by the car.Many users on social media are claiming it as a deliberate attack on the girl.@SupportProphetM page on Twitter writes, “A Hindu hits his car with a veiled Muslim and flees in Hyderabad.(Translates Arbi)هندوسي يضرب بسيارته مسلمة محجبّة ويهرب في مدينة حيدرآباد.#طرد_السفير_الهندي pic.twitter.com/6PjKyU32eu — الھیئة العالمیة لأنصار النبي ﷺ (@SupportProphetM) July 7, 2022Another user writes, “Muslim women hit in what appears to be a deliberate vehicular ramming attack in Hyderabad, India.”Muslim women hit in what appears to be a deliberate vehicular ramming attack in Hyderabad, India. pic.twitter.com/Ea1YsTgcGG — hurriyatpk (@hurriyatpk1) July 8, 2022Fact Check:DFRAC reverse searched the video using specific key frames. We found the news of the same incident on the news portal of NDTV.The headline states, “On Camera, Hyderabad Teen Flung Into Air After Being Hit By Car.” news was of the date 7th july 2022.The Times of India too covered the same news.In the report, it is written that a 19-year-old man, who also lives in the same locality and was learning to drive when this happened.Conclusion:DFRAC found that there was no Hindu Muslim angle to the viral video, neither it was done on purpose. It was clearly an accident.Claim Review: the reality behind the viral video of a lady in a burqa getting hit by the car.Claimed by: @SupportProphetM and @hurriyatpk1Fact Check: misleading

content: The Scholar getting viral with the Muslim Religion for a proactive speech is actually a Hindu- Read fact Check A video of a scholar is getting viral on social media. In the video, a bearded man can be seen who can be heard provoking Hindus in the speech by asking them why they are letting the Muslim population suppress them.Social media users claim the guy in the beard is from the Muslim religion who is provoking the Hindus. The video is getting a lot of shares on social media.A user on Facebook writes, “He is a Muslim scholar. Everyone listen, think and forward this video to other Hindus also.”(Translates Hindi)Fact Check:We try to search for the reality of the video for this, we noticed that few people commented under the posts that the man is not a Muslim scholar, rather he’s Hindu and called Acharya Prashant Sharma. Then we searched the internet and found the video from which the viral clip was taken.It was shared on Acharya Prashant Sharma’s official YouTube channel Darshnik Vichar.The 12-minute-long YouTube video was titled, “What is the reason behind the murder of Udaipur’s Kanhaiya Lal, Why was Kanhaiya Lal murdered – Acharya Prashant.” The section seen in the viral video begins around the 1.50-minute mark.We then also found a post on Acharya’s Facebook page where he posted that his video is being viral with a misleading claim of him being a Muslim Scholar.Conclusion:A video of a bearded man giving a provocative speech was not made by a Muslim scholar but by a Hindu preacher.Claim Review: claim the guy in the beard is from the Muslim religion and is provoking the Hindus.Claimed by: social media users.Fact Check: misleading.
label: truth

content: The woman who spits on the police is not Teesta Setalvad, but the leader of Congress, read a fact-check A video is becoming fiercely viral on social media sites. Users are sharing this video claiming that the women who misbehaved with the police is Teesta Setalvad.Sunil Gandhi captioned, “This is the great volunteer of the country Mrs. Teesta Setalvad. How gracious soumya!!” with this video posted in which It can be seen that a women who is being detained by the women police is so angry that she is spitting on the police.Fact Check:On reverse image search of some frames of this video on the internet, DFRAC found that the same video was shared by NDTV with the caption, “Protest with party workers in Delhi against ED questioning Congress leader Rahul Gandhi in #Watch #NationalHeraldCase Mahila Congress President Netta D’Souza spat on policemen during a protest with party workers in Delhi against the questioning of Congress leader Rahul Gandhi by the ED in the video tweeted on June 21, 2021.#Watch | Mahila Congress President Netta D'Souza spits at police personnel during a protest with party workers in Delhi against ED for questioning Congress leader Rahul Gandhi in the #NationalHeraldCase (ANI) pic.twitter.com/3bnoZP5xbV — NDTV (@ndtv) June 21, 2022The news agency, ANI has also uploaded a video on YouTube on the same news.On the other hand, Congress leader Netta D’Souza gave a clarification on this and captioned,“a propaganda is running against me on media. Here is the vedio to understand how I was hakled during that mud unwanted particles like hair some dust went into my mouth. Which I threw out of my mouth. I had no intention to disrespect our security personals. SATYAMEV JAYETE!” Written and tweeted a video.A propaganda is running against me on media. Here is the vedio to understand how I was hakled during that mud unwanted particles like hair some dust went into my mouth. Which I threw out of my mouth. I had no intention to disrespect our security personals. SATYAMEV JAYETE ! pic.twitter.com/NU6LmLijkY — Netta D'Souza (@dnetta) June 21, 2022Conclusion:It is clear from this fact check of DFRAC that this video is of Mahila Congress President Netta D’Souza and not Teesta Setalvad. D’Souza was protesting against the ED on June 21, so social media users are sharing this video with a false claim.Claim Review: Teesta Setalvad spat on women policeClaimed by: Social Media UsersFact Check: Fake(Follow #DFRAC on Twitter, Facebook, and YouTube.)https://youtu.be/hgjzQPZHndY
label: truth

content: The viral picture is not of an industrialist and fascist Eugen Schwab, who was close to Hitler- Read Fact Check A screenshot of an image along with the caption written below is getting viral on social media. There were two men shown in the image.The person on the right is the world economic forum (WEF) founder and Executive Chairman Klaus Schwab, who is also a Professor and was born in Ravensburg, Germany in 1938.Sharing this picture people are claiming that the man in military uniform is his father Eugen Schwab, who was a high-ranking Nazi close to Adolf Hitler.A Twitter user writes, ‘On the left, you can see the founder of the World Economic Forum, Klaus Schwab. On the right, his father, an intimate confidant of Hitler, the industrialist and fascist “Eugen Schwab” in uniform. Klaus was born in Hitler’s Germany in 1938. At that time, his father was in charge.’https://twitter.com/ManonCreativeM/status/1529035872066277377?s=20&t=4FlsGYlH7pruXqoVqxywHAThe post is getting increasingly viral with different captions.Fact Check:To investigate the viral picture DFRAC found, the photo shared online is not of Eugen Schwab, but of Nazi general Walter Dybilasz. Who is said to have been born in 1892 and died in 1950, possibly in Soviet captivity, some also claim that he was awarded with awards like German cross.Klaus Schwab’s father, on the other hand, was the managing director of a subsidiary of Zurich-based engineering firm Escher Wyss.Conclusion:The photo shared on social media is of German general Walter Dybilasz and not of WEF chief Klaus Schwab’s father. While Eugen Schwab was a member of some National Socialist organizations and managed a factory that used prisoners of war, this too does not tell any direct ties to the Nazi regime.Claim Review: The viral picture is of an industrialist and fascist Eugen Schwab, who was close to Hitler.Claimed by: social media users.Fact Check: fake
label: rumor

content: Fact Check: Old Video Of PM Modi gone viral with Misleading Claim amid ongoing Nupur Sharma controversy. Amid the ongoing Nupur Sharma controversy, a video of PM Modi with a sheikh is going viral on the internet. Further, sharing the video, a Facebook MONU JHA user wrote, “Children keep doing Nupur Nupur here, Papa Ji brought a gold necklace of 150 tola from Sheikh Sahib, Modi ji insults the blind devotees..”(“बच्चे यहां नुपुर नुपुर करते रहे और पापा जी शेख साहब से 150 तोले का सोने का हार ले आए गजब बेइज्जती करते हैं मोदी जी अंधभक्तो की”)Similarly, many other scoial media users have shared this video with similar sarcastic comments.Also Read: Picture of Udaipur murder accused Riyaz with Rahul Gandhi goes viral!Fact CheckUsing InVID tool and reverse image search on the different frames of the viral video, we got a video on the YouTube channel named Narendra Modi. The video was uploaded on Aug 24, 2019 with the title, “PM Modi conferred the highest honour of the UAE.”Further, on keyword search we found a tweet from the verified account ANI, dated August 24, 2019. Along with the Pictures Of Narendra Modi with Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan the caption given is, “Abu Dhabi: Prime Minister Narendra Modi conferred with Order of Zayed, UAE’s highest civilian award by Crown Prince, Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan.”Abu Dhabi: Prime Minister Narendra Modi conferred with Order of Zayed, UAE's highest civilian award by Crown Prince, Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan. pic.twitter.com/tezAhEDtJU — ANI (@ANI) August 24, 2019Moreover, we also got a tweet from the verified account of NDTV, dated April 4, 2019. The tweet stated that, “PM Modi conferred with Zayed Medal, UAE’s top civilian honour.” The Order of Zayed is the highest civilian decoration in the UAE.PM Modi conferred with Zayed Medal, UAE's top civilian honour https://t.co/JDVMfIJEaq pic.twitter.com/F3GqJn6rAZ — NDTV (@ndtv) April 4, 2019ConclusionTherefore, it is clear that the viral video is not related to the ongoing Nupur Sharma controversy. Hence, social media users are sharing an old video with misleading claims.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Fake picture of Venice city being in the shape of a heart goes viral. A picture of the famous Italian city of Venice is going viral on social media sites. It can be seen in this picture that the settlement of the city of Venice is in the shape of a heart.A user named Jules tweeted a picture of a drone shot with the caption, “Venice, Italy”. The heart-warming smile of Venice can be seen in this picture.Fact Check:On reverse image search of the image on the internet, we found that the same image was shared on a Facebook page called Home Decor Ideas with the caption, “Mirrored Aerial View of Venice, Italy Photo & Edit by: @lennart [IG]“. It is clear from the caption itself that this picture has been edited.At the same time, we found the original picture on Instagram’s page lennart, whose caption read, “BREAKING NEWS! Scientists have just discovered that the city of true love is not Paris, but Venice! Swipe to see the scientific proof! Don’t believe everything you read online. Believe in love, Happy Valentine.” (Hindi translation)It can be seen in this picture that Venice is not settled in the shape of a heart. The same reality can be seen on Google Maps as well.Conclusion:It is clear from this fact check by DFRAC that the picture of the city that is going viral is edited/photoshopped, as in reality, Venice is not in the shape of a heart. Hence, users are sharing it with a false claim.Claim: Picture of the city Venice in heart shapeClaimant: Social media usersFact Check: Fake
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Picture of Udaipur murder accused Riyaz with Rahul Gandhi goes viral! Read the complete story. A collage of two pictures is going viral on social media. In one of the images in the collage, former Congress national president Rahul Gandhi and Riyaz Attari, the killer of Taylor Kanhaiya Lal in Udaipur, can be seen with him. On the other hand, Riyaz Attari and Ghaus Mohammad are in the second picture. Riyaz and Gauss have been accused of brutally killing tailor Kanhaiya Lal.Sharing this picture, Facebook user Lallu Lal Yadav wrote – ” The real thing is, had you understood something.”At the same time, many other users on Twitter and Facebook have shared this picture with the same caption.Fact Check:To find out the reality of the viral picture, we did a reverse image search on Google. We found a report published on 13 May 2019 in the English newspaper ‘ The Times of India ‘ . This picture of Rahul Gandhi has been used in this report. It can be seen in this picture that it is not Riyaz Attari but Hardik Patel with Rahul Gandhi. The picture is of the time when Hardik Patel joined Congress in the presence of Rahul Gandhi.Therefore, our fact check proves that the original picture has Hardik Patel with Rahul Gandhi. Riyaz Attari’s picture is photoshopped out of Hardik Patel’s picture. Hence, the claims of social media users is fake.Claim- Riyaz Attari’s photo with Rahul GandhiClaimant- Social media usersFact Check – Fake
label: rumor

content: A misleading video of child kidnapping from Egypt is being shared giving communal angle- read the fact check A video of a child kidnapping is going viral on social media. In the video, a person dressed in a niqab came toward a child sitting on the roadside. Apparently, the child gave the niqab-clad woman some money then she touched the child’s shoulder. And, then the child got fainted and another man came with an auto-rickshaw(tuk-tuk). They took away the child on the rikshaw.Further, social media users are sharing this video with different captions. Giving the incident a communal angle, a Twitter user @Youram1208, shared the video with the caption, “In view of such incidents #IStandWithKapilMishra because these incidents are going to shock, as much as a Hindu wants to live with positive vibes, but the Mull@hs living in India will not allow Hindus to live with peace, #ढोंगी_राष्ट्रवादी #HinduInsultNotArt #ArrestTasleemRahmaniSimilarly, another user AZAD ARMY shared the viral video on Facebook with the caption, “Save and alert children from such gangs Save and warn children from such gangs.”(ऐसे गिरोहों से बच्चों को बचाएँ और सावधान करें)In the same vein, many other social media users have shared this video with the similar claim.Using InVID tool and reverse image search on different frame. According to these reports, the Ministry of the Interior reveals the mystery of the video of the “niqab” that caused panic in the social media.Moreover, we also got a tweet from the verified account of the @moiegy which clarifies that, “#وزارة_الداخلية revealed the circumstances of the circulation of a fake video clip on social media of a veiled woman kidnapping a child inside a “tuk-tuk” vehicle after he was drugged with a pin in his shoulder with the help of others.”According to the local reports, all four people who were involved in the incident were the residents of Girga, a city in the Sohag Governorate of Upper Egypt. The person in Niqab is a man. And, the viral video is scripted.ConclusionTherefore, the viral video is scripted and not related to India. It is from Egypt. Hence, the claim of the users related to this video is misleading.
label: truth

content: Yashwant Sinha has not said that Nupur Sharma will get arrested after he becomes President – Read fact check A screenshot is getting viral on social media sites in which it is written just below the picture of Yashwant, ‘Breaking: Will pass an order to arrest Nupur Sharma soon after taking oath as President of India: Yashwant Sinha’ (Translates Hindi). People all over social media are claiming this statement to be true.A user on Facebook writes, “Is he also from this earth Or someone is thrown from Mars..”(Translates Hindi)A Twitter user writes, “Whose punctured tube is this??????”https://twitter.com/sanjaykku/status/1543892887661907968?s=20&t=ULFMcJjkvKTngeB0CrddSAFact Check:First of all, we searched his verified Twitter handle of Yashwant Sinha. We found his tweet dated July 2, 2022, in which he referred to Nupur Sharma’s case and criticized BJP. He also asked Narendra Modi whether he is going to say something on this matter or not?ऑल्ट न्यूज़ के मोहम्मद ज़ुबैर को ये कहकर जेल में बंद कर दिया गया कि वो देश में वैमनस्य फैला रहे हैं। लेकिन भाजपा की एक प्रवक्ता, जिसने जहर फैला दिया इस देश में, उसके खिलाफ अभी तक कोई कानूनी कार्रवाई नहीं हुई। क्या प्रधानमंत्री जी इस पर कुछ बोलेंगे? pic.twitter.com/Sv5UOgGaQ7 — Yashwant Sinha (@YashwantSinha) July 2, 2022But, found no statement like that on his account.We also found a report on Indian Express with the headline, “Yashwant Sinha writes: India had won global respect. The Nupur Sharma row has dented it.”But again, we find him nowhere speaking the viral claim.Conclusion:DFRAC through the research found this information to be misleading as no such statement was given by Yashwant Sinha.Claim Review: Yashwant Sinha said that Nupur Sharma will get arrested after he becomes President.Claimed by: social media users.Fact Check: Misleading.
label: truth

content: A self-proclaimed Journalist sharing misleading video of a bus accident- Read The Fact check A video of a bus accident is going viral on the internet. Sharing the video users are claiming that this is the live scene of a bus accident in Kullu. Further, a social media user Imtiyaz Ahamad who claims himself a freelance journalist on his Twitter bio shared a video. Along with the video he wrote, “More than 20 dead Bus accident #Kullu just see the ground zero report #ACCIDENT“Similarly, many other users have share this video with the same claim.Fact CheckApplying reverse image search on different frames of the video, we got a video on YouTube channel named 007comfort. The video was uploaded on 31st December, 2011 with the title, “Bus Accident In Bolivia ( Bolivia’s death road swallows a bus).”Further, many media houses have covered this news. The title of the report is, “Horror as bus plunges off ‘Road of Death’ in Bolivia killing driver.” The driver died in the accident.ConclusionTherefore, the claim that this bus accident happened in Kullu is wrong. The incident took place in Bolivia. Hence, the claim of self-proclaimed Journalist Imtiyaz Ahamad along with the video is misleading.
label: rumor

content: Fact Check: Misleading video of Rahul Gandhi and Kashmiri Hindus goes viral Former Congress President Rahul Gandhi is often a target of social media users. Fake, misleading, and factless news stories against Rahul keep going viral. Similarly, a video of Rahul Gandhi is again going viral. In this video, a woman is talking angrily to Rahul Gandhi on a flight. Users are sharing this video with the claim that a Kashmiri woman is asking questions to Rahul Gandhi for opposing PM Modi on the Kashmir issue. Some users are claiming that Kashmiri Pandits are asking questions about Rahul Gandhi on the plane by Kashmiri Hindus.One user wrote- ” Kashmiri Pandits living abroad met Rahul while traveling in an airplane. Surrounding Gandhi and asking the question, why does he oppose Modi on the issues of Kashmir? Rahul Gandhi could not give an answer to this, the national media could hardly show this news. ,विदेश में रह रहे कश्मीरी पंडितों ने हवाई जहाज में यात्रा के दौरान Rahul Gandhi को घेर कर सवाल पूछे कि वो कश्मीर के मामलों पर मोदी का विरोध क्यों करते हैं?इसका कोई जवाब राहुल गांधी नहीं दे पाया, राष्ट्रीय मीडिया शायद ही ये न्यूज़ दिखा पाए। pic.twitter.com/56mAyqQ3a4 — Dilip Kumar Singh (@DilipKu24388061) July 3, 2022Another user wrote- ” Kashmiri Pandits surrounded Rahul Gandhi in the plane and asked .. why do you oppose Modi Ji on Kashmir. This shameless has no answer.”कश्मीरी पंडितों ने राहुल गांधी को प्लेन में घेर कर पूछाआप कश्मीर पर मोदी जी का विरोध क्यों करते होइस बेशर्म के पास कोई जवाब नही है pic.twitter.com/7pOKAIA5vN — ashok kumar awasthi (@ashokkumarawasr) July 1, 2022At the same time, this video was also posted from the verified Twitter handles of ‘ Panchjanya @epanchjanya’ and ‘ Organizer Vikli @eOrganiser ‘.Fact Check:To find out about the reality of the viral video, we did a simple search on Google. During this time we did not get any news of Rahul Gandhi being opposed by Kashmiri Pandits or Kashmiri Hindus on the plane. After which we reverse searched some frames of the video. We found a tweet from Congress General Secretary Priyanka Gandhi Vadra on 25 August 2019. The video going viral can be seen in this tweet. Retweeting the tweet of journalist Arun Kumar Singh (@arunsingh4775 ). According to Arun Kumar Singh’s tweet, while returning from Srinagar, the Kashmiri woman expressed her pain to Rahul Gandhi. Arun Singh’s tweet is dated 24 August 2019.How long is this going to continue?This is one out of millions of people who are being silenced and crushed in the name of “Nationalism”. For those who accuse the opposition of ‘politicising’ this issue: https://t.co/IMLmnTtbLb — Priyanka Gandhi Vadra (@priyankagandhi) August 25, 2019At the same time, we got a report from Dainik Bhaskar in this context. According to this report, Rahul Gandhi along with 11 leaders of 8 opposition parties had reached Srinagar to take stock of the situation in Kashmir and talk to the citizens there. There the administration returned all the leaders back to Delhi citing security. Meanwhile, a woman in the plane narrated her pain to Rahul Gandhi.Also Read: DFRAC Exclusive: Fake handles from Pakistan posting sensual content and deceiving TwitteratisConclusion:Therefore, the video going viral of Rahul Gandhi is 3 years old. In this video, the Kashmiri woman is not asking questions to Rahul Gandhi, but is telling her grief to him. Hence, this video is going viral on social media in a misleading way.Claim- Kashmiri Hindus surrounded Rahul Gandhi and asking questionsClaimant- Social media usersFact Check – Misleading
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Did UP Police arrest Maulana for making provocative statements against Nupur Sharma? A video is going viral on the internet of Police arrested two men. Social media users are claiming that Uttar Pradesh Police have arrested these two men for making provocative statements against Nupur Sharma. Meanwhile, a Facebook user named कृष्णा मिश्र, “Yesterday #NupurSharma was threatened by #Maulana..!!Today UP #Police lifted its doli.”(कल #नूपुर शर्मा को धमकी दिया था #मौलाना ने..!!आज यूपी #पुलिस ने इसकी डोली उठा ली)Similarly, many other users have shared this picture on the social media with the similar claim.Fact CheckUsing InVID tool and reverse image search on different frames of the Video. We got a three minutes long video on YouTube channel ofNews24. The title of the video is. “Nupur Sharma के खिलाफ भड़काऊ भाषण देने वाला मौलाना Mufti Nadeem हुआ गिरफ्तार | Rajasthan.”Further, we also found a tweet from the verified account of ANI MP/CG/Rajasthan in which it was written that, “Rajasthan | Bundi Police have arrested two clerics accused of giving inflammatory statements during a protest against suspended BJP leader Nupur Sharma. Further probe underway.”Rajasthan | Bundi Police have arrested two clerics accused of giving inflammatory statements during a protest against suspended BJP leader Nupur Sharma. Further probe underway pic.twitter.com/RMfAaVvdBx — ANI MP/CG/Rajasthan (@ANI_MP_CG_RJ) July 1, 2022Also Read: Fake handles from Pakistan posting sensual content and deceiving TwitteratisConclusionHence, the claim that Uttar Pradesh Police have arrested the Maulana is Misleading. He was arrestd by Bundi Rajasthan Police.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: The truth behind the viral video of a man distributing liquor wearing a BJP cap and scarf ‘Prashant Bhushan(@pbhushan1) a public interest lawyer and activist; shared this video from his official Twitter account he writes, “Wow Modi Ji, your party has turned Telangana into Goa too! What an aish!”(translates Hindi)Another verified user Kirti Azad writes, “inside #pm of @narendramodi speech, of workers outside @BJP4India In honor of Mother India Wine and Kebab this is their real face of the Hindu religion It’s not even worth ridiculing the height of shame @pbhushan1.”Fact Check:We at DFRAC simple searched on Google to know the reality behind the viral video we find many news reports on the same viral video, dated 20th December 2021.A news report from the Hindustan smart with the headline, “A person was seen distributing liquor wearing a BJP cap, Congress said – Modi Ji is distributing painkillers?”(Translates Hindi)Through the report, we found that the viral video was viral in the year 2021 too.The same video was uploaded by the UP Congress official twitter handle mocking BJP and Yogi Adityanath.Conclusion:The viral video is partly true as it is not from the recent year 2022, but from the year 2021.Claim Review: The truth behind the viral video of a man distributing liquor wearing a BJP cap and scarfClaimed by: social media users.Fact Check: misleading
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Aam Aadmi Party’s claim of giving jobs to 10 lakh people from the employment portal is misleading. Aam Aadmi Party leader and Deputy Chief Minister of Delhi Manish Sisodia has claimed in an interview to the English newspaper ‘The Hindu’ that 10.21 lakh people have got jobs so far from the job portal ‘Rozgar Bazar’ of the Delhi government.The newspaper quoted Manish Sisodia as saying- “Delhi Deputy Chief Minister Manish Sisodia said on Sunday that the state government job portal Rojgar Bazar, launched in June 2020, has so far created 10.21 lakh jobs in the capital. He said that the portal has come as a big relief to the people after the pandemic and subsequent loss of livelihood. He said that Chief Minister Arvind Kejriwal will fulfill his promise of providing 20 lakh more jobs in Delhi announced in the employment budget this year.This news has also been covered by ZEE DELHI-NCR HARYANA.Apart from this, many other newspapers, web portals and news channels have also published their reports on the news.Fact Check:To investigate this claim of Aam Aadmi Party and Manish Sisodia, we did a simple search on Google. During this we got a report published on the English newspaper ‘The Hindu‘ itself. In this report, the claim of the Aam Aadmi Party has been described as misleading.The Hindu has titled this report- “AAP’s claim of creating 10 lakh jobs is misleading”. It has been written in detail in this report that till May 1, only 12,588 people had secured jobs through the portal. This figure of 12,588 is also an estimate of the government, as it is based solely on phone calls with them. The Delhi government does not have the names or any other details of the people who actually got the job, the information has been confirmed by multiple sources.Conclusion:After analyzing the report of ‘The Hindu’, it is coming out that the claim of Aam Aadmi Party is misleading. According to this report, not 10 lakh people but only 12,588 people have got jobs.Claim Review- 10 lakh people got jobs from Delhi government’s employment portalClaimed by- Aam Aadmi PartyFact Check – Misleading
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Amit Shah’s old video on Telangana floods viral with the misleading claim A video of Home Minister Amit Shah is going viral on social media. Users who shared this video are slamming Amit Shah. These users claim that Amit Shah had reached Telangana. During this, Amit Shah kept silent on the question of a reporter. It can be seen in this video that a reporter asks Amit Shah about no help from the Center in the Telangana floods. During this Amit Shah remains silent.Sharing this video, a verified Twitter user named Ashok Basoya wrote- When the rain came, the flood came, then the Modi government did not help Telangana. Amit Shah – Silent….. it’s called journalism. @ INCTelangana @VamsiChandReddy _ @ KomatireddyKVR ”At the same time, this video is also being shared by many other users.Fact Check:For the fact check of this video. First we saw that the V6 on the video NEWS logo. We found this video on YouTube on the official channel of V6 NEWS . This is a video uploaded 2 years ago on 29th November 2020. Caption of this video is- Amit Shah Face to Face Over Hyderabad Floods, GHMC Elections 2020 | Exclusive | V 6 NewsThe description of this video shows that this interview of Amit Shah was taken during the municipal elections in Hyderabad. Amit Shah’s viral video is a clip of this video. In this 3-minute video, the reporter can be seen questioning at 40 seconds. On which Amit Shah does not keep silent, but he answers.Amit Shah replied- ” We have given maximum money to Hyderabad, but I want to say this much that when the house of seven lakh people got flooded. Where were Mr. Owaisi and Mr. KCR then? Didn’t even show up for a single day. People were in the water, there was water in the house, our workers, our MPs, our ministers have been among the people. ,Conclusion:A fact check of the video going viral proves that the claims being made by social media users are misleading. Because this video of Amit Shah is two years old and Amit Shah did not keep silence, instead he answers.Claim- Amit Shah was silent on reporter’s questionClaimed by- Social media usersFact Check – Misleading
label: truth

content: Know the Reality behind the viral video of a lady criticizing Rahul Gandhi.-Read this Fact Check. A 30-second video of Congress MP Rahul Gandhi is going viral on social media. In this, a woman can be seen and heard expressing the pain of Kashmir in front of Rahul Gandhi. Social media users are claiming this lady is criticizing Rahul Gandhi.A user on Facebook while sharing this video writes, “Kashmiri Pandits living abroad surrounded Pappu while traveling in an airplane and asked him why they oppose Modi on Kashmir issues. Pappu Gandhi could not give any answer.”Fact Check:DFRAC to know the truth behind the viral video started searching by uploading them to Google reverse image tool. The viral video was found in many media reports. The video was published on the website of TV9 Hindi on 25 August 2019.Reading the report we got to know that the lady was telling Rahul Gandhi about the situation in Kashmir.Rahul Gandhi and Priyanka Gandhi Vadra too tweeted and retweeted this video on their official Twitter account.It's been 20 days since the people of Jammu & Kashmir had their freedom & civil liberties curtailed. Leaders of the Opposition & the Press got a taste of the draconian administration & brute force unleashed on the people of J&K when we tried to visit Srinagar yesterday. pic.twitter.com/PLwakJM5W5 — Rahul Gandhi (@RahulGandhi) August 25, 2019How long is this going to continue?This is one out of millions of people who are being silenced and crushed in the name of “Nationalism”. For those who accuse the opposition of ‘politicising’ this issue: https://t.co/IMLmnTtbLb — Priyanka Gandhi Vadra (@priyankagandhi) August 25, 2019The news related to this was uploaded on bhaskar.comConclusion:DFRAC found the video is three years old. In August 2019, a Kashmiri woman expressed her pain in front of Rahul Gandhi on an airplane returning from Srinagar to Delhi. Now the same video is going viral with misleading claims.Claim Review: lady is criticizing Rahul Gandhi on Kashmir issues.Claimed by: social media users.Fact Check: misleading
label: rumor

content: Was judge JB Pardiwala a congress MLA between 1989-90 – Read this Fact Check The Supreme Court on July 1 strongly condemned the suspended BJP spokesperson Nupur Sharma and said that she should apologize to the entire country. The judges who were included in the bench were Justice Surya Kant and Justice JB Pardiwala.After this comment, people on social media started claiming judge JB Pardiwala was congress MLA between 1989-90.A user on Facebook writes, “Nupar apologizes to the country by coming on TV” – Supreme Court.”“Nupur Sharma responsible for Kanhaiyalal’s murder” – Supreme Court Judge J.B Pardiwala (Congress MLA 1989-90) Understand something?” (Translates Hindi)Another user shared a picture stating the same claim.Fact Check:To investigate on this claim DFRAC checked the profile of Justice JB Pardiwala that is available on the website of the Supreme Court. It is told here, that he was born in the year 1965 in Mumbai. His father, grandfather, and great-grandfather all were lawyers. It is also written here that JB Pardiwala’s father Burjor Kawasji Pardiwala had been the Speaker of the Seventh Gujarat Legislative Assembly.Gujrat Vidhan Sabha website shows Burjor Kawasji Pardiwala was the speaker from January 1, 1990 to March 16, 1990.In the website of the Election Commission, the information of Burjor Kawasji Pardiwala winning the 1985 Gujarat Assembly Elections as a Congress Party candidate is provided.Conclusion:It is clear from our investigation that Justice JB Pardiwala being a Congress MLA in the past is completely fake.Claim Review: Judge JB Padirwala was congress MLA between 1989-90.Claimed by: social media users.Fact Check: fake
label: truth

content: Old video of Hindu man in masjid disguised as Muslim goes viral.- Read the Fact Check A video is going viral on social media sites. In the context of the terrorist murder of Kanhaiyalal in Udaipur, this video is being shared by users, demanding action by sharing it as recent. Sharing the video CJ Werleman Sho wrote the caption, “A Hindutva goon with alleged ties to RSS dressed up as a Muslim to instigate communal riots. He was caught and handed over to police in Sayyid Colony, Jaipur.”Similarly, MIRZA BAIG gave the video caption, “Udaipur killers might be RSS guys below is the video of this man allegedly having links with RSS, was preparing to instigate riots by wearing Kurta-Pajama, sporting a beard in Jaipur. caught and handed over to the police. Zubeida Mosque, Sayyid Colony, Jaipur. ”https://twitter.com/BaigsonAuctions/status/1542534380643422208Likewise, many social media users have shared this video with the similar claim.Fact CheckOn reverse-searching different frames of this video on the Internet, DFRAC found that the same video was tweeted on June 14, 2022 by the Twitter handle @BPPDELNP.At the same time, when DFRAC spoke to an eyewitness of this incident from Jaipur, it came to light that this person belonging to Sindhi community had become a Muslim 15 years ago. He is a resident of Tonk, later came to Jaipur. It appealed for help from the worshipers in the mosque for treatment. Some people said that we suspect that he is a Hindu and comes to the mosque posing as a Muslim and collects donations and takes it away.After this some people of the committee of the mosque inquired. He was handed over to the police for not getting the identity card etc.During the interrogation of the police, he told that he was a Hindu earlier, but is now a Muslim. His family members are also Muslims. On the second day, the local people themselves got bail. This person has nothing to do with RSS.On the question of DFRAC whether he is related to RSS? Eyewitnesses told that there is nothing like this. it was spread by deceptionConclusion:It is clear from this fact check of DFRAC that this video is old, which is being shared misleadingly by users in the context of Kanhaiyalal murder case.Claim: Hindu person disguised as Muslim in mosqueClaimant: The CJ Werleman Show and other usersFact Check: Misleading
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Did 128 kg of gold and 150 crores of cash, 77 crores of diamonds found at the house of a priest? A video is going viral on the internet with lots of gold pieces of jewelry kept on a table and some policemen were seen around the table. Many social media users are sharing the video with the claim that these were found in an Income Tax raid at the house of one priest of Tirupati Balaji.Meanwhile, sharing the video a Twitter user wrote, Jasmine wrote, “where are your eyes, gold is here #तिरुपतिबालाजीमंदिर. Out of 16 priests, there was an income tax raid at the house of 1 priest in which 128 kg gold and 150 crores cash, 77 crores diamonds were found.. !!!!”(“आपकी नजर किधर है सोना इधर है #तिरुपतिबालाजीमंदिर के 16 पुजारियों मे से 1 पुजारी के घर इनकम टैक्स की रेड पड़ी जिसमें 128 किलो सोना व 150 करोड रुपए नगद ,77 करोड़ रुपए के हीरे मिले.. !!!! #PMOIndia“)Similarly, many other users have shared this video with same claim.Fact CheckOn reverse image search of different frames of the video and keyword research we found a report of the Hindu with a screengrab as similar to the video. The title of the report is, “Police recover 16 kg of jewellery from graveyard, one arrested” and it was published on december 21, 2021.Further, we also found the same video posted on Twitter by a verified account of @mahajournalist on december 20, 2021. And, the caption of the video is, “@VellorePolice has arrested a burglar, who drill hole into Vellore #Josalukkas jewellery store wall, decamp with 15kg gold and diamond jewels.”@VellorePolice has arrested a burglar, who drill hole into Vellore #Josalukkas jewellery store wall, decamp with 15kg gold and diamond jewels 🌟💐 pic.twitter.com/yzfZSvp6bY — Mahalingam Ponnusamy/ மகாலிங்கம் பொன்னுசாமி (@mahajournalist) December 20, 2021ConclusionTherefore, from out fact check analysis, it is clear that old video of incident with misleading claim. And, the video is related to theft in vellore not to the Income tax raid at the house of one priest of Tirupati Balaji.
label: rumor

content: Fact Check: Zee News and Ministers of BJP spread misleading video of Rahul Gandhi on the murder of Kanhaiya Lal Udaipur Murder case where Kanhaiya Lal, a tailor who was killed by two men over a post in which he supported Nupur Sharma amid the Prophet is now the talk of the town.Most common people and famous personalities have talked about this issue and consider it a heinous crime.Meanwhile, the Leader of Congress party Rahul Gandhi’s interview is going viral on social media. In the interview, he can be heard denoting the murderers of Kahniya lal as ‘kids’ and ‘children’.People all over social media are sharing this interview of Rahul Gandhi with anger. Many verified accounts too shared this video of Rahul Gandhi under the various caption.@ZeeNews telecasted a show on TV on Rahul Gandhi’s interview.@azad_Nishant writes, “Rahul Gandhi is calling the killers of Kanhaiya Lal who are actually jihadis as ‘children’.It is only possible in this country that to whom people are not ready to keep a servant in their house, Some people consider him as the candidate for the Prime Minister elections. Go do the defamation case. #KanhaiyaLal (Translates Hindi)@IamAjaySherawat writes, “Rahul Gandhi full of shamelessness, stupidity, and insensitivity.”(Translates Hindi)More verified accounts like Abhijeet-iyer-mitra, Himanshu Mishra, kamlesh saini BJP , etc too showed there disappointment and anger over Rahul Gandhi’s interview.Fact Check:DFRAC used specific keyframes and keywords to investigate the interview of Rahul Gandhi. We found the one on the Youtube Channel called ‘Manorama News’Here, that part can be heard which is getting viral on social media. By listening to his whole interview DFRAC found that Rahul was denoting kids and children to the ones who vandalize his office.Conclusion:Rahul Gandhi does not denote the murderer of Kanhaiya Lal as ‘kids or children’, but to the ones who vandalize his office. Hence, the viral interview has been edited and posted.Claim Review: Rahul Gandhi use the word ‘kid’ for the murderers of kanhaiya lal.Claimed by: Most verified accounts.Fact Check: Misleading
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Old video viral of celebrations on the renaming of Aurangabad A video is going viral on the internet. In this video, people can be seen dancing and singing. Social media users are claiming that this is a celebration video after the name of Aurangabad was changed.GyanGanga wrote the caption, “This is how citizens of #Aurangabad celebrated after their city was renamed to #Sambhajinagar”. Along with the video. In this video, everyone can be seen waving saffron flags in their hands and dancing.Fact Check:On reverse image search of some frames of this video going viral on the internet, we found the same video on the YouTube channel Pradhumna Jadhav Vlog, which was uploaded on 19 February 2022, “ShivJayanti 2022 Shivjayanti 2022 Special | Aurangabad Shivaji Maharaj Putla | Kranti Chowk |”At the same time, we also found a tweet from Lokmat, in which it has been told that Yuva Sena Chief Minister Aditya Thackeray unveiled the horse riding statue of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj at Kranti Chowk in Aurangabad. Happy Shiv Jayanti to all.Conclusion:This fact check of DFRAC proves that the video is shared with the claim of celebration of renaming of Aurangabad to Sambhajinagar is old, hence users are sharing it with a misleading claim.Claim: Video of celebrations after Aurangabad’s name was changedClaimant: Social media usersFact Check: Misleading(Follow #DFRAC on Twitter, Facebook, and YouTube.)
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Did the Economic times state false news reports on top 4 positions in the UPSC Exam? UPSE announced the Civil Service Examination Results on the 30th of May. The news was the highlights and headlines of many news reports.With this, a claim went viral on social media, which states that girls bagged the top four positions in the UPSE Civil Service Examination.Much Reputed media houses like The Economic Times and News18 too covered this report whose achieve links are provided.Fact Check:We searched the Keyframes and found that among the top 4 positions the AIR 4 (All Indian Rank) is eld by a man whose name is Aishwarya Verma, a student from Ujjain.Times of India writes, “Ujjain’s Aishwarya Verma is UPSC topper among men.”Conclusion:DFRAC found that many news reports were considering Aishwarya Verma a women only by looking at the name and without any thorough investigation.Claim Review: girls bagged the top four positions in the UPSE Civil Service Examination.Claimed by: The Economic Times and News.Fact Check: misleading.
label: truth
